articleTitle: Interval Optimal Dispatching of IES Considering Dynamic Characteristics of Natural Gas Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Compared with coal-fired thermal units, renewable energy resource, i.e. wind energy, has the advantages of low cost and low pollution. However, wind energy has inherent uncertainty, thus resulting in “wind abandonment” and “low utilization efficiency of wind energy ”. The emerging of integrated energy system (IES) is helpful to solve the problem of wind energy accommodation, convert electric energy into other energy for storage, and improve energy utilization efficiency. In this paper, an interval optimal dispatching of IES considering the dynamic characteristics of natural gas pipeline is proposed, which can further improve the capacity of the system to absorb wind power. Firstly, this paper describes the mathematical model of wind power uncertainty, and constructs the natural gas dynamic storage model. On this basis, an optimal scheduling model considering the dynamic characteristics of gas network is constructed. Finally, Case studies are carried out on the IEEE24 bus electrical system and 20 bus natural gas system to validate the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: A Joint Optimal Dispatch Method for Multi-integrated Energy Systems Based on the Source-load Adaptability
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to make full use of the complementarity between each regional integrated energy system (IES) and to improve the overall energy-efficiency, economic and environmental benefits, this paper proposes a joint optimal dispatch method based on the source-load adaptability for multi-integrated energy systems. This approach analyzes the source-load adaptability, adopts the improved grey correlation degree model for feature matching and makes an adaptability quantitative analysis of different IES and regional load. Then, the next step is to establish a hierarchical optimal dispatch model for the regional multi-IESs that is solved by using the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm. The simulation results show that the proposed method could achieve the highest economy benefits and take the source-load characteristics into consideration while realizing the collaborative optimization among regional multi-IESs. Moreover, the improved algorithm for model solving could obtain an ideal solution when further improving the convergence speed. Compared with the traditional algorithms, this algorithm has obvious superiority and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Imbalance Settlement Cost in Real-time Balancing Market Based on ABM Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the deepening of China's electricity market reform, the first batch of spot electricity pilot areas have completed the work of spot price settlement. However, in the actual settlement process, it found a lot of problems such as imbalance settlement costs(ISC), which exceeded the expectations of market designers. How to fully estimate the ISC in the market design stage so as to reduce the market risk and improve the market efficiency is the focus of market designers. Aiming at the problem of imbalance cost, this paper studies the market behavior of the main body in the real-time balancing market. Firstly, the agent-based model(ABM) method is established and multi scenarios are constructed to simulate the decision-making behavior and multi-parameter changes of market members. After that, the paper introduces the market agent decision algorithm and then analyzes the impact of market factors on the ISC through numerical simulation, and gives some suggestions to reduce the ISC so as to provide reference for the development of China's electricity spot market.

articleTitle: A New Method to Compare Performance of Forecasting Models
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Tremendous growth of solar and wind capacity worldwide has led to rapid development of renewable energy forecasting techniques, and the performance of various forecasting models are usually compared by statistical metrics. However, two factors are not considered in current comparison. One is the amount of the useful renewable energy, and another is the energy consumption during forecasting. These two factors are considered in the proposed new method. Performances of the ANN and RNN models with three different sampling frequencies from literature are compared using this proposed method. Furthermore, the relationships between four statistical metrics-RMSE, (CV)RMSE, E and R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>-and useful renewable energy are examined. Finally, the effect of adding a moving-window algorithm is tested. The use of the proposed method is expected to promote a virtuous cycle in which sufficient energy is available for our modern lives with fewer emissions of carbon dioxide.

articleTitle: Exploring the impact of COVID-19 on travel behavior based on EV charging big data
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has forced many governments around the world to implement strict lockdown measures and order citizens to stay at home, which has caused a major change in travel patterns. This study leveraged electric vehicle charging big data in Hefei, Anhui Province, China to estimate electric vehicle charging demand in the absence of the COVID-19 pandemic using multi-layer perceptron model, which quantified the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic. In addition, we employed the vector autoregressive model to investigate the dynamic relationships between the changes in charging demand and various explanatory factors. The results suggest that the daily average charging demand in Hefei decreased by 78.3 % compared to the predicted value during the pandemic. Furthermore, according to the variance decomposition and impulse response function analysis, national confirmed COVID-19 cases play a dominant role in reducing charging demand. The number of daily hospitalizations and Migration Scale Index also have significant and robust effect on the decrease in charging demand. The Air Quality Index and Baidu Index are susceptible to external factors and do not have a direct impact on the change in charging demand. Findings support a better understanding of changes in travel behavior during the pandemic and provide policy makers with references to deal with similar events.

articleTitle: A Non-iterative Solution Method for DC Optimal Power Flow Based on Holomorphic Embedding
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Optimal power flow (OPF) calculation is important in power system operation, but the conventional iterative solvers are sensitive to the initial guess and suffer from the computational burden caused by updating the Jacobian matrix in each iteration. To tackle these problems, the holomorphic embedding (HE) method is developed and shows great performance in power flow analysis. This paper proposes a holomorphic embed-ding method to solve the DC OPF with an initial guess selection based on the primitive economic dispatch. The corresponding Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions are reconstructed by embedding a complex variable and expanding variables into power series. The numerical solution can be obtained by solving the coefficients using the derived recursion equations and conducting Padé Approximant. The proposed method has been tested in five cases with different scales. This method is numerically validated to be effective and accurate, and shows greater convergent speed than the Matpower Interior Point Solver.

articleTitle: Optimal Planning Of Primary Frequency Regulation Capacity Of Wind-Storage Combined Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper analyzes the primary frequency modulation technology of conventional thermal power unit, wind turbine and energy storage system in the operation of power system. In the power system, energy storage and wind turbine are jointly involved in the primary frequency regulation of the power system, so that the wind turbine has the primary frequency regulation ability similar to that of synchronous generator. A chance constrained programming model with the objective of minimizing the standby cost of primary frequency modulation is established. The solution algorithm is the genetic algorithm in the intelligent algorithm based on random simulation, and the optimal configuration scheme of wind power load shedding rate and energy storage device under different confidence is obtained. The effectiveness of the model and algorithm is solved and verified.

articleTitle: Short-term Wind Power Predication Based on Feature Engineering and SOA-SVM
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Contraposing to the issues of strong randomness, large volatility, and high prediction error of wind power, this paper proposes a short-term wind power prediction method based on feature engineering and support vector machine optimized by the seagull optimization algorithm (ISOA-SVM). First, in feature engineering, the abnormal values are preprocessed and utilizing the Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC) method to analyze the correlation between wind power and every feature. On this basis, a set of new features are constructed. Then, in the construction of the combined model, the seagull optimization algorithm is utilized to optimize the parameters of the support vector machine, so as to realize the complementary advantages of the optimization characteristics of the seagull algorithm and the support vector machine in simplifying the high-dimensional space complexity problems. Finally, the short-term wind power prediction model is constructed based on the ISOA-SVM model. The emulation experiment is carried out with the relevant measurement data of a wind power field. The results show that, in relation to other models, the proposed ISOA-SVM model has more excellent precision and dependability of short-term wind power prediction, which provides a certain reference for power dispatching.

articleTitle: Improved LSTM Memory Recursive Neural Network Precise Compensation and Prediction for Phase Selective Switching Device
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a mathematic ideal model of circuit breaker's phase-selecting and switching device is established. It is concluded that the closer the circuit breaker's closing is to the zero crossing, the less influence it has on the AC system.The influence factor model of circuit breaker electric mechanism closing is established, and the influence of ambient temperature, control voltage, wear degree and contact displacement on circuit breaker is qualitatively analyzed. In this paper, based on the principle of sampling as little as possible in the field, a compensation method based on the improved LSTM neural network is proposed to predict the closing delay of circuit breakers. The error between the predicted value and the true value is accurately realized within 0.001s. The MATLAB/Simulink simulation model was established, and the phase-selecting and closing process was carried out on the basis of compensation based on the improved LSTM neural network prediction model. The harmonic content of the AC system could be kept within 2%, 100% meeting the harmonic control requirements of the power industry. Compared with the adaptive prediction model, there are 21.4% probability of harmonic content higher than 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>. In addition, the model presented in this paper can also provide a way of thinking for the intelligent on-line diagnosis of circuit breakers and the setting of optional switching devices.

articleTitle: Capacity Optimization for Wind/Photovoltaic Prosumers and Shared Energy Storage Operator: A Cooperative Game Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Game theory is applied in this paper to model the capacity planning of a shared energy system in a resident community comprised of energy storage batteries and prosumers with renewable energy resources, such as wind turbines and photovoltaic panel facilities. Cooperative game model is built to realize capacity optimization of renewable energy and energy storage system by taking prosumers and the energy storage operator as participants and their annual benefits as payoffs. Simulation results illustrates the feasibility of the proposed model. Comparison among the Nash equilibriums under different kinds of alliance structures shows that complete cooperation brings out more benefits and saves total installed capacity of the system, while competition will lead to decrease of benefits.

articleTitle: Research On Benefit Distribution In Coordinated Hydro And Wind Power Generation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The “bundling” consumption of clean energy is an effective solution to promote carbon neutralization. Balancing the interests of all parties is the key issue in the coordinated operation. By ensuring the fairness of interest distribution, the long-term cooperation could be promoted and make the interests maximize. Firstly, the characteristics and benefit distribution principles of CHWG (coordinated Hydro and Wind power generation) were introduced, and then the benefit distribution methods in CHWG were summarized and analyzed. An improved Shapley value benefit distribution method was proposed, and the optimization results were compared and analyzed. The improved Shapley method considered the risk-taking ability, resource investment and resource utilization, which is more convincing for benefit distribution.

articleTitle: Power Flow Correction Strategy Based on Improved Comprehensive Sensitivity Index
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Removal of overload lines may lead to power flow transfer within the region, resulting in large-scale cascading trip accidents. After the line overload occurs, how to quickly develop a reasonable power flow control strategy to eliminate the overload of the line is the key to prevent cascading outages in the power grid. In view of the low accuracy of sensitivity method and the slow calculation speed of optimal power flow method, this paper proposes a power flow control strategy based on improved comprehensive sensitivity index. According to the joint effect of nodes on overload line and heavy load lines, the improved positive and negative comprehensive sensitivity index is proposed to eliminate the nodes with small effect. The multi-objective optimization model of selecting scheduling nodes is constructed to select the scheduling nodes involved in the adjustment. Finally, the optimal power flow method is used to accurately obtain the output adjustment of the scheduling nodes, so as to quickly develop the power flow control strategy. The rapidity and accuracy of the proposed method are verified in IEEE39-bus system.

articleTitle: Transmission Line Fault Location Based on the Stacked Sparse Auto-Encoder Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Given the current situation that a large amount of data is available for transmission line faults, and supervised learning is mainly used to extract fault features, a fault location method based on Stacked Sparse Auto-Encoder (SSAE) is proposed. Firstly, the maximal information coefficient is used to reduce the dimension of the data. The data interval with good information density is selected, the deep network is used to extract features, and the network parameters are initialized by greedy layer-wise unsupervised pretraining. Finally, the linear regression layer is connected and fine-tuned with the fault distance data. The simulation data show that, compared with the traditional BP neural network method, the proposed fault location method has higher accuracy and obvious feature extraction ability.

articleTitle: Research on Temperature Rise of ±800kV VSC-DC Wall Bushing Superposed By DC and AC Loads
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: It is difficult to design and manufacture a qualified ±800kV VSC-DC Wall Bushing because of its special AC and DC combined operating condition. The AC and DC superposed status is originated from a bridge arm reactor side of a VSC-UHVDC transmission system. One of the keys for proper design is to obtain the exact temperature distribution when the bushing is applied by AC and DC currents. In this paper, the 3D model simulation and verification tests are completed considering with skin effect and eddy heat of rolled tubes to simulate the superposed AC and DC operating condition. And the relationship between simulation results and measured data are analyzed. Based on the results, the distribution of temperature rise of a ±800kV VSC-DC Wall Bushing are obtained which provides the significant data for electromagnetic-thermal coupling design and further to aid to fulfilling the domestic design.

articleTitle: Power Grid Reactive Voltage Control Method Based on Improved Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a grid reactive voltage control method based on improved reinforcement learning. Based on the theory of reinforcement learning, the convolutional neural network (CNN) is combined with Q learning, and the gradient descent method is used to update the weights to improve the reinforcement learning algorithm. Taking the switching instructions of the discrete reactive power regulation equipment as the control variable, and the voltage deviation of each node in the network as the objective function, the grid voltage control optimization model is established. Select the appropriate action strategy based on the grid input data, use the power flow calculation to check the optimization effect, update the weights, and iteratively optimize the newly generated input state quantities to form a grid voltage deviation solution process based on improved reinforcement learning. By optimizing the programming parameters to improve the control performance and reduce the calculation error of the voltage control. The IEEE 14-bus system is used for simulation analysis on the Matpower platform, and the experimental results show the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of Electromagnetic Defense for Resilient Power Grid Against Abnormal Damage
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Realizing the security and controllability of the new power system based on the energy internet is the fundamental to guarantee the normal operation of the power grid, which may suffer from abnormal invasion during the operation. In this paper, by establishing the finite element method model, simulating and analyzing the invasion of external objects represented by graphite fiber, and examining the changes of electromagnetic field around substation transmission lines under the condition of abnormal invasion situation, a power system early warning and protection method based on sensing technology was proposed through model construction and data processing. As another major research, the thermal-electrical coupling model was selected to analyze the influence of graphite fiber attached insulator on its performance, so as to study the failure mechanism of external insulation and put forward suggestions and plans for intelligent protection of outdoor electrical equipment.

articleTitle: Distributed Optimal Dispatch for Power System Considering Privacy Preservation and Transient Stability Constraint
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With large scale penetrations of distributed generation in power system, the conventional centralized power dispatching method faces problems such as privacy leakage and insufficient computational flexibility. To this end, this paper investigates the distributed optimal dispatching problem considering privacy preservation and transient stability constraint. Firstly, a distributed optimal dispatch framework is established for power system with distributed generators modelling as different agents. Then an optimization model with transient stability constraint is constructed, and a distributed algorithm for solving the optimization is proposed based on sensitivity analysis and alternating direction multiplier method (ADMM). By implementing the proposed algorithm, each agent can find local generator's optimal operation by transmitting only a small amount of information between neighboring agents, while ensuring the transient stability of the system. Finally, test results validate the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed optimal dispatching method.

articleTitle: Risk-Constrained Day-Ahead Scheduling for Wind Power and Pumped Hydro Storage Based on Information-Gap Decision Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, wind power and other renewable energy sources have been connected to the large-scale power grid. However, output power of the wind turbine is greatly affected by wind speed, resulting in strong variability and intermittence, with a certain degree of uncertainty. At the same time, due to the uncertainty of load demand in day-ahead scheduling, the power system scheduling model is changed from the deterministic model to the uncertain model. In this paper, Information-gap decision theory (IGDT) is employed to deal with the uncertainties from wind power and load demand. According to the risk preference of decision makers, a robustness model for risk-averse strategy and an opportunity model for risk-seek strategy are established for wind-powered pumped hydro storage system. Finally, the case study based on the improved IEEE-30 node system verifies the effectiveness of the IGDT-based model. The results indicate that scheduling plan and the maximum uncertainty acceptable to the system can be obtained on the premise of meeting expected costs.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation Method of Power Grid Operation Considering Index Correlation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In view of the current lack of consideration of the correlation between indicators in the evaluation of power grid operation, an improved evaluation model of power grid operation considering the correlation of indexes is proposed. In this paper, the power grid operation evaluation index system is divided into five first-level indicatorsincluding economics, cleanliness, safety, fairness, and power supply service quality. Then the corresponding second-level and third-level indicators are screened out from three stakeholders: power grid com-pany, power generation company and power users. The gray correlation analysis method is used to solve the degree of correlation between indicators, and then the weight determined by FAHP-improved entropy proportion means is adjusted to reduce the impact caused by index association. Finally, the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$A$</tex> fuzzy evaluation and the chouqet fuzzy integral are used to perform non-linear aggregation on the index evaluation value to obtain a comprehensive evaluation value. By evaluating the numerical analysis of the operation data of China Southern Power Grid within 5 years and comparing with other methods, the effectiveness of the evaluation method is verified.

articleTitle: Research on Comprehensive Index Evaluation System of Hybrid Ac/Dc Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the progress of power electronics technology, AC / DC hybrid distribution network has become an effective way to solve future distribution problems. This paper proposes a comprehensive index evaluation system for AC / DC hybrid distribution network based on relevant standards and references in view of the lack of a quantitative evaluation method. Firstly, the typical application scenarios of the AC / DC hybrid distribution network in the future are analyzed, and the corresponding development mode is established. Secondly, considering the constraints of various key technical indicators, a quantitative analysis method of various technical and economic indicators is proposed. A combination evaluation model of GRA + TOPSIS + RID for different application scenarios is constructed to optimize technical and economic indicators comprehensively. Finally, taking the actual data of a regional distribution network as an example, the correctness of the index and the feasibility of the evaluation model are verified. Moreover, the construction priorities in different scenarios are proposed, which can reference the development and construction of AC / DC distribution network in the future.

articleTitle: Hybrid Experimental Learning on Trading Behavior Analysis in Electricity Markets
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A modern electricity market is essentially a complex network, characterized by complicated interactions among cyber communications, physical systems, and social agents. Trading behavior modeling has always been complicated in the physical system-based market. In this paper, trading behavior modeling in the electricity market is solved by a data-driven method combining experimental economics and machine learning, called Hybrid Experimental Learning (HEL). Based on the historical and experiment simulated data, HEL models the trading behavior by a machine learning generative model. Taking a simulated electricity market based on the trial spot market rule in Guangdong, China as an example, a Wasserstein generative adversarial network (WGAN) is employed to generate the bidding strategies of a gas generator. By analyzing the result, some suggestions are given for long and short run decision-making for gas generators.

articleTitle: Optimal Economic Dispatching Approach for Multiple Flexible Energy Facilities Combined with Coal-fired Power Units in Frequency Regulation Service Based on SDR and Gaussian Randomization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To adapt the intermittency and volatility caused by high-proportion renewable energy in power system, it is effective to integrate rapid power regulation facilities, such as high-voltage electrode boiler or PEM electrolyser, into coal-fired power platform. The integration scheme improves power grid flexibility, meanwhile, generates indispensable secondary energy, such as heat, electricity, and hydrogen etc.. In order to achieve optimal economy of the scheme, this paper proposes an optimal economic dispatching approach for multiple flexible energy facilities and coal-fired power units for frequency regulation service. We firstly elaborate frequency ancillary revenue model according to the market rules. Taking the high-voltage electrode boiler and PEM electrolyser as examples, an optimal economic dispatch model of integration scheme respond to AGC signal is given, with fully considering the constraints of ramp, capacity, signal amplitude and regulation characteristics of different units. Finally, to deal with the non-convex issue when solving the optimization problem, a solution scheme is proposed, which relaxes the original problem by the semidefinite relaxation (SDR) and solves it through Gaussian randomization. An integration case shows the validation and efficiency of the approach. Compared with Monte Carlo method, this optimal economy approach is less computationally intensive and easier to carry out in application.

articleTitle: Active and Reactive Power Coordination Optimization Method of Distribution Network Based on Improved PSO-GA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The proportion of the distributed generation connected to the distribution network is getting higher and higher. At the same time, the randomness and fluctuation of the output of distributed generation will also lead to great uncertainty in the operation of the distribution network. In order to ensure the safety and economy of the distribution network, the simulation model of distribution network including the on-load tap changer, the distributed generation, the switchable capacitor and the energy storage system is established, in which the goal is to minimize the overall voltage deviation and the line loss. An improved PSO-GA algorithm is proposed to solve the model. Then the active and reactive power coordination optimization of the distribution network is carried out to solve the problem of node voltage overlimit when the distributed generation is connected to the distribution network. Finally, the IEEE 33-node system is taken as an example to verify the correctness of the model and the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Integrated Demand Response Based on User Comfort and Consumer Psychology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous research on integrated demand response (IDR), the analysis of residential customers' IDR characteristics and the exploration of IDR potential are drawing more and more attention. Therefore, load aggregators(LA) are considered to participate in the study of integrated demand response based on user comfort and consumption psychology. Firstly, we establish various types of response load models taking into account user comfort and consumption psychology, and then establish the IDR model of users. Secondly, the LA equipment optimization operation model is established based on the LA internal equipment modeling. Finally, the analysis shows that the proposed strategy can provide a more detailed and accurate comprehensive demand response strategy for residential customers and achieve a win-win situation for both LA and residential customers.

articleTitle: Research on Reconfiguration Strategy of Distribution Network Based on Improved Group Search Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The uncertainty of photovoltaic output makes it more difficult to achieve optimal control of power distribution system reconfiguration and reliable grid restoration. This paper uses fuzzy theory to improve the traditional group search optimization algorithm and expand it to the two-dimensional search space. Therefore, an optimization strategy of self-healing reconfiguration control for distribution network fault recovery based on improved GSO algorithm is proposed. Through the simulation analysis of the IEEE33-node system, the economy and reliability of this strategy in the distribution network containing photovoltaic power generation are verified. The results show that the distribution network fault reconstruction strategy based on the improved GSO algorithm can reduce the active power loss of the system after the fault is restored, and at the same time improve the efficiency of the reconstruction optimization path solution.

articleTitle: Research on Transient Power Characteristics of PMSG at Fault Clearing Time Considering Dynamic of Phase Locked Loop
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In large-scale wind power system, there are few synchronous generators, the power grid strength is weak, which lead to fault transient overvoltage problem. In 2011, the first transient overvoltage accident, which resulting in outage of wind power, occurred in JiuQuan in western of China. In recent 10 years, dozens of transient overvoltage events have occurred in northwest and northeast power grids in China. To solve this problem, this paper established single machine-infinite bus system with multi-pole permanent magnet synchronous generator based wind generator (PMSG) based on typical voltage ride through strategy. This paper studied the transient characteristics of PMSG terminal voltage and output power during short circuit fault in weak current grid. The influencing factors of transient overvoltage of PMSG terminal at fault clearing time were also researched. The results indicated that the when the short circuit fault occurred, the voltage phase would jump forward, and when the short circuit fault cleared, the voltage phase would jump backward. Due to the time delay of the phase-locked loop (PLL), the phase-locked result is different from the actual phase in the transient process of phase jumping, which will mislead the power control of PMSG. However, this misleading may be helpful to suppress the overvoltage of PMSG during the short circuit fault period.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Verification Technology of Information Specification of Relay Protection Strategic Standby Device
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the steady progress of smart grid construction and domestic equipment development, non-standard problems such as relay protection alarm information, action information and intermediate contact information from different manufacturers have become increasingly prominent, affecting power grid operation, anomaly analysis and accident handling. This paper studies the information standardization verification technology of relay protection strategic standby device, designs the relay protection information standardization test scheme, establishes the test template case library, develops a set of relay protection device information standardization automatic verification system, and applies it to the professional detection of domestic relay protection devices of State Grid Corporation of China. The standardized full closed-loop and one click information specification automatic test is realized to ensure the consistency of message semantics of domestic devices in field operation.

articleTitle: Arc Fault Detection Method Based on High-Frequency Electromagnetic Component
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: During the operation of the low voltage distribution system, the occurrence of series arc faults often causes line damage, grid trips, power quality degradation, even electrical fires. Aiming at the change of electromagnetic signal when arc fault occurs, this paper analyzes the time and frequency domain characteristics of the current under different loads, under normal operation of the line and arc faults. When an arc fault occurs, its high-frequency components increase significantly, especially under non-linear load conditions, which is regarded as the characteristic basis for arc faults. Combined with false residual current detection technology, this study proposes a new arc fault detection scheme by simulating the magnetic flux distribution of a high-frequency current transformer. The experimental results show that this method is effective in detecting arc fault. This provides a new idea for arc fault detection technology.

articleTitle: Research on Transaction and Settlement Mechanism of New Energy Resources Participating in Yunnan Power Market
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Taking Yunnan as an example, this paper preliminarily discusses the transaction settlement mechanism of new energy power plants in the power market dominated by hydropower. According to the special energy structure characteristics of Yunnan Province, the utilization hours, power consumption and wind and light abandonment of wind power and photovoltaic power generation in recent years are combed. The annual average output characteristics of wind power and photovoltaic power and the daily average output characteristics in wet season and dry season are compared. According to the national requirements for renewable energy consumption, the completion of the responsibility weight of renewable energy power consumption in Yunnan is statistically analyzed. At the same time, combined with the trend of wind power and photovoltaic parity on the Internet and the rapidly changing power supply and demand situation in Yunnan Province in recent years, the problems faced by new energy in the power market are explored. In view of the problems raised, combined with the actual experience of Yunnan, this paper studies the transaction organization and price mechanism of new energy power plants in the power market, and studies and analyzes the settlement mechanism and operation. According to the recent new energy development plan of Yunnan Province, the prospect of more extensive participation of new energy power plants in power market trading and settlement in the future is prospected, and relevant suggestions are put forward.

articleTitle: Modeling Carbon Capture Plants (CCP) as Responsive Demands
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With a global synergy dedicated to achieving carbon-neutrality, the power sector bears significant responsibility for transforming how electricity is generated and utilized. Carbon capture power plants (CCPPs), one promising contributor to the future generation mix, have been shown in the literature to behave like energy storage systems. In this paper, we nevertheless propose modeling the carbon capture plants as responsive demands. Consequently, the CCPP could be decoupled and converted into a traditional fossil-fuel thermal plant with a responsive load. The model is then integrated into a day-ahead unit commitment model. Numerical results indicate the potential of CCPP serving as a dominant source of generation flexibility. Interesting observations and implications following the decoupled CCPP model are discussed.

articleTitle: Chance-constrained Optimal Power-water Flow Considering Load Uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Considering power and water load uncertainties, this paper proposes a chance-constrained optimal power-water flow (CC-OPWF) model of the integrated electricity-water system (IEWS). Uncertainty margins obtained by the Monte Carlo Simulation method (MCS) and the probabilistic power-water flow (P-PWF) analysis are incorporated in the CC-OPWF model to reformulate the CC-OPWF model to a deterministic optimization model, which is solved by the proposed alternative iteration method. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by numerical simulations of a sample IEWS composed of the IEEE-14 bus system and a 7-node water system.

articleTitle: Real-time Incentive-based Demand Response for a Virtual Power Plant: a Rolling-window Multistage Stochastic Programming Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A rolling-window multistage stochastic programming (RW-MSP) model is proposed for the incentive-based demand response (IDR) scheme of the virtual power plant (VPP) considering uncertainties in real-time prices. Particularly, the VPP can induce the consumers to reduce their load demands by providing incentive rates, which helps to mitigate the critical load of the VPP and decrease its costs. Here, the IDR scheme, which models the energy interaction of the internal market between the VPP operator and its participants, is formulated as an optimization problem to minimize the energy costs of the VPP as well as guarantee the interests of consumers. To make sense of the stochastic model, the nonanticipativity constraints are introduced to guarantee that the decisions at each stage should only depend on the realizations of uncertainties up to the present stage rather than the future information. Different from the traditional deterministic method in which the decisions are determined simultaneously, the proposed RW-MSP model yields sequential decisions with the uncertainties revealed gradually over a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$K$</tex>-interval rolling-window horizon. The experimental results verify the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Study On Design Scheme Of Port Shore Power System Considering Economic And Environmental Benefits
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to meet the needs of energy conservation and environmental protection of power plant port terminals and help achieve the goal of “dual carbon”, this paper carries out the research on port shore power system. Firstly, the development of port shore power system is introduced. According to the actual situation of the transportation port of a power plant, the design scheme of port shore power system is proposed. The implementation of port shore power system verifies the feasibility of the scheme. The data analysis shows that the port shore power supply system has significant economic and environmental benefits.

articleTitle: Design of Micro-service Architecture for Lightweight Dispatching and Control System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the characteristics of integrated and coordinated operation of the current power grids become more significant, the SOA-based power grid dispatching control system has shown inadequacy in its ability to support information sharing and business collaboration between dispatch agencies. In recent years, micro-service architecture (MSA) has been widely deployed due to its low coupling of functional modules, strong scalability and performance advantages. At the same time, the development and progress of lightweight virtualization technologies such as containers (Docker) and hybrid storage architectures also provide low-level performance guarantees for MSA. Therefore, starting from the micro-service architecture, this paper designs and verifies a micro-service system architecture for lightweight dispatching and control system. The architecture is designed based on the MSA principle and realizes efficient resource scheduling and load balancing of the system through the container resource allocation method based on reinforcement learning. Meanwhile, the system supports real-time data access performance for the micro-service platform through complex heterogeneous data hybrid management technology and unified data access interface. The experimental results show that the system significantly improves the performance of the system under the sudden load, while effectively reducing the system delay and storage resource consumption.

articleTitle: Cooperative Wind Farm Control with Hybrid-Model-Based Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient and Model Selection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Using deep reinforcement learning to control the wind farm is difficult to practically apply in the real environment due to high learning costs. Model-based reinforcement learning utilizes the data-driven model to simulate the environment and accelerate the learning speed. But the model needs a large amount of data to achieve an accurate result. Therefore, hybrid-model-based reinforcement learning is applied to address this problem by combining the knowledge-driven model with the model-based reinforcement learning framework. The Hybrid-Model-based Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (HM-DDPG) algorithm with model selection method is proposed. Three scenarios in WFSim are built as the test environment. The simulation results show that the proposed method can accelerate the wind farm learning process and is more suitable for sizeable state-action space situations.

articleTitle: Coordinated Charging of Electric Vehicles in Distribution Network with High Proportion Distributed Photovoltaic
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The grid connection and utilization of distributed photovoltaic is an important way to deal with the current energy and environmental crisis. The voltage violation caused by high proportion of distributed photovoltaic access is an important factor restricting the distribution network to accept distributed photovoltaic. With the popularity of electric vehicles, charging control of electric vehicles has become an important means of distribution network operation control. A coordinated charging strategy for electric vehicles is proposed. The electric vehicles and distributed photovoltaic are aggregated into a virtual power plant to respond to the time-of-use price. Taking the maximum profit of virtual power plant and the minimum load variance of distribution network as the objective function, and considering the constraints of voltage violation, a multi-objective sequential charging model for electric vehicles is established. The MATLAB simulation shows that the coordinated charging strategy of electric vehicles can solve the voltage violation problem caused by high proportion distributed photovoltaic access. Compared with uncoordinated charging and distributed photovoltaic energy curtailment, the advantages of the coordinated charging strategy are illustrated.

articleTitle: Mechanism of the Influence of Inertia Control Scale Factor of Doubly-Fed Induction Generator on System Power Angle Stability
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, China is the only country among the world's major economies where carbon emissions continue to grow, and the construction of a new power system with new energy sources as the mainstay is an important path to achieve carbon neutral. With the large scale of doubly-fed induction generators access to the grid, the stability characteristics of system power angle become more complex. On the background of DFIG access to a two-area interconnected system, a model is firstly designed for the system according to the area center of inertia theory and the influence of DFIG virtual inertia on the rotor motion equations of synchronous machines in two regions is analyzed. Secondly, the influence of the inertia control scale factor of DFIG on system power angle velocity during system acceleration and deceleration phase is studied when a three-phase short circuit fault occurs and then the mechanism analysis of the first swing stability of system power angle is investigated. Finally, the system power angle stability is evaluated by the maximum deviation of system power angle and a two-area interconnected system is modeled in PSASP to verify the proposed theory.

Author Keywords: virtual inertia control scale factor of DFIG
the first swing stability of system power angle

articleTitle: Current Regulation Of Grid-Forming Converters
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The stability of passive damping of grid-side current feedback control and inverter-side current feedback control of LCL grid-connected inverter is analyzed. From the perspective of domain poles, the position of two conjugate complex roots determain the direction of root locus. Then affect the stability of systems. Digital time-delay is essentially a series correction, revealing that the delay changes control system phase characteristics. The phase lag of the digital delay is beneficial to system stability in some cases, but it depends on resonance frequency, switching frequency and the position of current sensor which is utilized for feedback variable. The paper designs the current controller parameters in the discrete domain. Given that engineering practicality, a method to determine controller parameters quickly is obtained. The theoretical analysis is validated by simulation and experimental results.

articleTitle: A Planning Method of Integrated Energy System Based On Gas Turbine Installed Capacity Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Gas turbine is the core energy equipment of integrated energy system (IES), whose installation scheme not only influences the installed capacity of other energy equipment, but also directly affects the operation strategy of IES. Thus, this paper aims at the existing problems that only focus on the system installed capacity and ignore the gas turbine installation scheme when optimizing the operation strategy of IES, and proposes a planning method for IES based on gas turbine installed capacity optimization as well as establishes the optimization model of IES. The natural gas consumption coefficient and heat generation coefficient are introduced into the model to separate variables and simplify the variable efficiency characteristics of gas turbine. Meanwhile, the matching coefficient is also lead-in to obtain the installation scheme including installed number and installed capacity of gas turbine. Besides, taking the operating load rate of energy equipment as decision variables and under the constrict of energy balance, the optimal operation strategy of IES and the installation scheme of both gas turbine and non-gas turbine equipment can all be obtained with total cost, energy efficiency and carbon emission of IES as objective functions. Meanwhile, an industrial park is selected as a research case in this paper to verify the effectiveness of the method proposed in this paper. It is proved that the proposed method can collaboratively optimize the installation scheme of each energy equipment in IES, and provide theoretical reference for the planning and design of IES and its economic, efficient and low-carbon operation.

articleTitle: An Assessment Method of Carbon Emission Reduction Additionality in Grid Dispatching Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Achieving the national goal of “carbon peak, carbon neutral” is a complex and challenging task. The carbon emission of the power industry accounts for nearly 40% of the total carbon emission, so the task of reducing emissions is heavy. However, carbon emission reduction in the power industry requires the joint effort of all segments of power generation, transmission, distribution, and consumption. It should be noted that the contribution of scientific assessment of carbon emission reduction in each segment is essential. This paper proposes a framework for assessing the carbon emission reduction additionality of subjects in every link of the power system. The proposed framework identifies the carbon emission reduction additionality of each link of power production, transmission, and consumption by comparing the carbon emission reduction benefits of a given measure with the intervention of the measure. In the evaluation framework, a multi-dispatching scenario evaluation method based on AC optimal power flow (AC OPF) is proposed to evaluate the carbon emission reduction benefits of the power grid under the clean-energy-consumption dispatching and network-1oss-minimization dispatching modes. The proposed method examines different transmission power scenarios of a new energy outgoing ultra-high voltage line and analyzes the carbon emission reduction additionality of the power grid. Finally, the feasibility of the proposed method is verified by simulations using a provincial power grid as a case study.

articleTitle: Subjective-Objective Combination Weighted Integrated Energy System Evaluation System Considering Carbon Trading Market
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the target of carbon peak and carbon neutrality, the establishment of an integrated energy system (IES) evaluation system considering whole life cycle operation and stakeholders has become an important issue, which is of great significance for minimizing carbon emissions, maximizing energy efficiency and ensuring energy system safe and stable operation. Firstly, the existing IES indices are analyzed, and an IES comprehensive evaluation index system is proposed based on comparing and refining current existing evaluation indices, which takes the revenue, reliability, society, energy efficiency, and sustainability aspects into consideration simultaneously. Secondly, a combination weighting method, which combine the merits of analytic hierarchy process (AHP), anti-entropy weight (AEW) and CRITIC method, is proposed in this paper to realize the quantitative evaluation of the IES comprehensive benefits. Finally, by comparing and analyzing a certain IES as an example, the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed comprehensive evaluation algorithm are verified. The proposed comprehensive evaluation method can help decision-makers better to carry out IES projects, promote the development of carbon transaction market and the transition to low-carbon energy structure.

articleTitle: Bi-level Planning Model of Urban Diamond-type Distribution Network Considering Load Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The traditional distribution network connection type has difficulty with adapting to the reliability requirements raised from extensive access of distributed power sources and other uncertain factors. “Diamond-type” urban power distribution network owns superior source and user access adaptability, load transfer and balance ability between stations, and fault reconstruction capabilities. This paper proposes the “diamond-type” bi-level planning model for urban distribution network firstly. The upper-level model optimizes the grid planning result, with ability to meet reliability constraints being calculated in the lower-level reconstruction model. Secondly, a calculation method is proposed to simplify the solution process. Finally, an example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the planning model and calculation method in this paper. The main advantages of the “diamond-type” connection mode in the urban distribution network are also compared and analyzed.

articleTitle: Research on Operation Mode of Comprehensive Energy Service System Adapting to Multi-Station Integration
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The comprehensive energy service system, adapted to multi-station integration, has rich prospects for power grid dispatching control and optimized operation because it connects various types of energy stations and users, and plays an important supporting role in accelerating the transformation of power grid enterprises and the current realization of “double carbon”. Aiming at the problems such as the lack of operation mode and commercial operation channels of multi-station integration smart energy station and comprehensive energy service system, this paper makes an exploratory research on the multi-station integration smart energy station and comprehensive energy service system, and explores the integration mode, potential functions and value-added businesses of multi-station integration, as well as the architecture of comprehensive energy service system Advanced application development and business value, in order to make a useful reference for relevant practitioners and industry development.

articleTitle: Study on the Economic Optimization of Park Integrated Energy System with Electricity-Heat-Cooling-Gas under Carbon Trading
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the context of establishing an energy system that helps achieve “carbon peaking” and “carbon neutrality”, it is important to introduce carbon trading into the integrated energy system to further promote the system's emission reduction capacity. This study establishes an economic dispatch model for the park integrated energy system by introducing the carbon trading cost, which contains four subsystems: electricity, heat, cooling and gas, and discusses the effects of introducing carbon trading on carbon emission, operation cost and equipment output of the park integrated energy system by comparing the dispatch results under two scenarios with and without carbon trading. The results show that the introduction of carbon trading reduces the output of high-carbon equipment and contributes to carbon reduction in the park by coordinating low-carbon equipment, energy storage and external energy sources to meet the park's load demand. The allocation of initial carbon quotas significantly affects the system's total cost, and their reasonable setting to enable the park to obtain emission reduction benefits will be an important topic affecting its motivation.

articleTitle: Research on Investment and Operation Mode of Multi-station Integration Data Center Station
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As an extension of the main business of the grid company, multi-station integration can give full play to the value of power grid resources and drive the development of the industry. It is in line with the strategic objectives of the grid company and the requirements of the development of emerging industries. It has a good development prospect and urgently needs to study its investment and operation mode. Firstly, this paper analyzes investment and operation subject of multi-station integration of the grid company;On this basis, the research method of Multi-station integration investment and operation strategy based on SWOT analysis model is proposed;Finally, the investment and operation strategy of multi-station integration data center station in a northwest province is clarified. The results show that: in terms of investment and operation subject, it is recommended to use provincial and municipal company investment (main business investment), and provincial communication company as the operation subject to carry out multi-station integration commercial operation;In the aspect of operation strategy, under the premise of leading investment and operation, it is suggested to adopt diversification strategy to deal with external competition.

articleTitle: A Survey: New Generation Artificial Intelligence and Its Application in Power System Dispatching and Operation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) technology features convenient calculation, high discrimination efficiency and low dependence on physical mechanism. Thus, the New Generation of AI (NGAI) and its applications on power system operation becomes research hotspots. However, its inherent disadvantages such as poor interpretability and weak stability also restrict its application. In this paper, the applications of the NGAI technologies in different operation conditions, including load and renewable energy forecasting, fault diagnosis, online stability assessment, frequency/voltage optimal control and operation mode planning have been analyzed. Besides, the problems in the existing researches are summarized and the basic application methods of AI technologies are pointed out: condition-adapted, problem-conducted, scenario-based and application-oriented. Finally, the future applications of AI technologies in power systems are prospected.

articleTitle: The Optimal Design of the Second-Order Generalized Integrator Phase-Locked Loop Under Power Voltage Distortion Conditions
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Phase-locked loop (PLL) based on traditional second-order generalized integrator (SOGI) cannot obtain the voltage, frequency and phase information accurately when there are multiple harmonic interference and DC offset in grid voltage. To solve this problem, this paper proposes an improved PLL that can suppress harmonic and eliminate DC component to extract the synchronous signal accurately. First of all, based on the derivation of distorted grid voltage expression, the problem of fluctuation in extracting synchronous signal from three-phase unbalanced voltage with harmonic by traditional PLL is analyzed. Then, the design of improved PLL is proposed, which is composed of an improved second-order generalized integrator and a frequency correction component which can suppress harmonics and eliminate disturbances under the condition of grid voltage distortion, and has self-adaptability in large frequency offset. Determine the control parameters to ensure that the proposed PLL structure has a better rejection to harmonic distortion than previous approaches, and realize accurate tracking of grid fundamental frequency synchronization information. Finally, the behavior of the proposed system is verified with MATLAB/Simulink simulation and Hardware-in-Loop Experimental Platform which prove the proposed PLL can realize the synchronous tracking performance of grid frequency and phase quickly and accurately in the non-ideal grid environment, and the results are consistent with the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: A Predictive Rolling Optimization Method of Load Balancing in Low-voltage Active Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the penetration of distributed generators connected to the low-voltage distribution network (LVDN) gradually increases, the three-phase imbalance problem becomes more and more serious. The traditional governance model suffers from the lack of timely calculation results and incompatibility with distributed generators (DG) connected to the network. Therefore, this paper proposes a novel three-phase unbalance governance method that combines load connection phase pre-decision and rolling optimization. First, the pre-decision module uses a wavelet denoising regression tree for short-term load forecasting based on historical data and a Chaos Particle Swarm Optimization (CPSO) for feeder current balance optimization. Secondly, the rolling optimization module uses a hierarchical optimization method to realize real-time fine optimization based on real-time data. The simulation results in the actual LVDN show that the proposed method can not only obtain a better balancing effect in the LVDN with distributed generator access but also the independent work of the pre-decision module and the rolling optimization module can still have the three-phase unbalance suppression capability in the absence of historical data or real-time data.

articleTitle: Sensitivity Analysis of Influencing Factors of Power Failure in Distribution Network based on Big Data of Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Considering the main factors affecting the fault outage of distribution network, such as grid structure, operation and maintenance management level and equipment level, the non-linear mapping relationship between input characteristic variables and fault outage reliability index value is constructed, and the prediction model of distribution network fault outage reliability index based on BP neural network is established. According to the proposed model, sensitivity analysis of each influencing factor is carried out, and the weak links of a city's distribution network are obtained, which can provide reference for the direction of reliability improvement.

articleTitle: Extremal-Distribution-Based Cutting Plane Algorithm for Efficiently Solving Two-Stage Distributionally Robust Unit Commitment Problems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The increasing penetration of renewable generation has introduced significant uncertainties to the power system. In order for system operators to derive a robust and efficient operation scheme, skilled decision-making methods are vital. In this paper, we present a distributionally robust unit com-mitment model, where the renewable generation is modeled as a bounded right-hand-side random vector. The model is built on a data-driven ambiguity set that exploits the expectation and probability density of random renewable generation. We first verify that a discrete extremal distribution always exists in such a model. Then, an extremal-distribution-based algorithmic framework is developed to efficiently handle the problem. The novel solution algorithm is shown to have a higher convergence rate theoretically, and perform faster practically compared with Benders-type algorithms. In the numerical experiments, we demonstrate the way of obtaining an extremal distribution, and validate the computational efficiency of our solution algorithm.

articleTitle: Short-Circuit Current Calculation Method for Power System with Renewable Energy Source and HVDC System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The short-circuit currents characteristics of renewable energy source (RES) and high voltage direct current (HVDC) system are different from the short-circuit currents characteristics of traditional synchronous generator (SG). According to the fault-ride-through (FRT) requirements of different types of RES, the steady-state short-circuit currents calculation models of doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) and inverter-interface renewable energy source (IIRES) such as photovoltaic (PV) and direct-drive permanent magnetic synchronous generator (D-PMSG) are built in this paper. Based on the converter switching function model and the HVDC control system, the calculation model of HVDC system steady-state short-circuit currents is built. Combined with RES and HVDC system short-circuit currents calculation models, a short-circuit currents calculation method for power system with multiple types RES and HVDC under ac power system fault is proposed. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method of short-circuit currents calculation is verified by simulation cases.

articleTitle: Optimal Configuration of Energy Storage Systems Considering the Risk of Insufficient Flexibility
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, the rapid growth of renewable energy has made the power generation cleaner, but also brought challenges to the power system. Volatility and uncertainty of wind power output will aggravate the flexible adjustment requirements of the system and increase the risk of insufficient flexibility. An energy storage configuration model considering the risk of insufficient flexibility is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the mathematical models to quantify the level of flexibility in supplies and requirements are established, and Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) is used to assess the cost of risk; secondly, the attenuation of energy storage life is considered to ensure the full life cycle economy of energy storage systems (ESSs) configuration; thirdly, a two-level programming model of energy storage configuration is established and solved using a mixed integer linear programming (MILP) embedded particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm. A case study is carried out based on the IEEE39-bus system to verify the effectiveness and accuracy of the method.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Block Chain in Promoting the Consumption of Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The issue of renewable energy power consumption is an important issue that needs to be solved. The combination of block chain technology and energy breaks the traditional concept of energy management and brings new opportunities to promote renewable energy power consumption. This paper briefly introduces the structure of the six levels of block chain and the key technology. And then, the structure of block chain and its decentralization, tamper-proof, traceability, multi-node sharing and other technical characteristics are analyzed. Finally, the application cases of block chain technology in promoting renewable energy power consumption in optimal operation of microgrid, peer-to-peer power trade, green certificate management and electric power transportation are discussed. The result shows that block chain has significant effect on the consumption of renewable energy.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Load Aggregators Participating in Demand Response Market under Low-Carbon Power System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To address the increasingly urgent issues of global energy security and environmental degradation, General Secretary Xi Jinping has proposed the “dual carbon” goal and the construction of a new power system dominated by new energy sources. It is one of the important ways to promote low carbon energy transition and achieve “dual carbon” goal to construct the demand response market transaction mode of load aggregator under new power system. Therefore, this paper puts forward a dispatching method for load aggregators to participate in the demand response market under the low-carbon power system, and gives some policy suggestions for load aggregators to participate in the demand response market under the low-carbon power system. Firstly, in the framework of the low-carbon power system, the definition of load aggregator is given, and the market function, technical function, voltage level limit, load response capacity requirement, grid access specification and technical standard of grid safety are analyzed. Second, research the load aggregators to participate in demand response market framework, combined with the new peak power system design cut demand response scenario, with the lowest cost of power grid operation, peak sharpening effect is best, at the same time meet the target of minimum carbon emissions, establish the low-carbon power system under load aggregators in optimal operation model of response to market demand; Finally, taking the receiving end system of China's low-carbon power as an example, the numerical simulation and analysis are carried out to prove the scientific nature of the optimal dispatching method of the load aggregator participating in the demand response market under the low-carbon power.

articleTitle: Fast Evaluation Method of Plug and Play Access Capacity for Distributed Generation in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper establishes a new mathematical model to analyze the penetration rate of distributed power in the distribution network. On the basis of considering the characteristics of the load interval of the distribution network, an optimization problem is adopted to establish a two-level programming mathematical model of the maximum access capacity of the distributed power supply to the distribution network considering the static safety constraints. The problem of solving two-level programming is turned into a problem of solving multiple single-level programming, and then a trust region sequence quadratic programming algorithm is proposed to solve the transformed single-level programming problem, and then the penetration rate of distributed power access to the distribution network. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can better solve the problem of the maximum access capacity of distributed power sources connected to the distribution network.

Author Keywords: trust region sequence quadratic programming algorithm

articleTitle: Study on Coupling Technology of Hydrogen Production by Electrolytic Energy of Volatility
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The use of new energy for electrolytic water hydr ogen production is an ideal model for efficient use of renewable energy systems, but the volatility of new energy has a negative impact on the stability of electrolytic hydrogen production syst ems. Aiming at the problem of local absorption of new energy s ources, this paper discusses the generation characteristics of ne w energy sources, quantitatively analyzes the fluctuation adapt ability of electrolytic cells, studies and analyzes the structural p rinciple and optimal control strategy of the coupling system ne w energy hydrogen production, and lays a theoretical and key t echnical foundation for the application of new energy electrolyt ic hydrogen production technology in the area of discarding wi nd and light.

Author Keywords: Electrolytic Water for Hydrog en Production

articleTitle: Research on Emergency Power Support Strategy for Multi-HVDC Transmission Network Based on Power Trajectory Sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to reduce the power surplus of the sending-end power grid and improve its transient power angle stability, emergency DC power support (EDCPS) can be provided to the sending-end power grid after the AC tie line fails in the multi-DC transmission power grid. Based on the EDCPS strategy, the power distribution among the DC lines depends on the close coordination between the DC lines. Therefore, it is necessary to design a coordinated control center with a higher control level, which brings considerable difficulty to the protection and control of the DC system. Accordingly, this paper proposes a coordinated control strategy for emergency DC power support based on the sensitivity of the weak link generator power trajectory. The DC lines are sorted based on the sensitivity of the electromagnetic power of the unit to the boost power of the DC lines. After the failure, give priority to the most sensitive DC line to participate in support. This strategy can minimize the number of DC lines participating in EDCPS, reduce the difficulty of coordinated control, and provide better support effects. In the modified IEEE 10-machine 39-node system, the effectiveness of this method is proved.

articleTitle: Research on Full Cost Chain Model of Power Grid Development and Operation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the development and operation costs of power grid companies, this paper first investigates and analyzes the node electricity price, the distribution of fixed transmission costs, the marketization status of transmission, distribution prices, and the analysis method of power grid costs, it is concluded that the existing node pricing mechanism does not take the impact of fixed transmission cost into account and fails to reflect the actual utilization of transmission line assets by users in different nodes, which leads to be unfair in the allocation of transmission cost. Secondly, based on analyzing and comparing the differences between the life cycle cost method and the whole link cost method in calculating the cost of the power grid, the calculation method of the whole cost for the development and operation in the power grid is defined and the concept of the whole cost chain is discriminated, then, the calculation model of full cost chain is established by determining the calculation and allocation method of each component of total cost chain. Finally, the example analysis shows that the full cost chain mechanism can reflect the end user's utilization of power system resources, reflect the difference in energy consumption by users at different times and different nodes, and guide users' behavior with reasonable price signals.

Author Keywords: the full cost chain of power grid
the reform process of electricity transmission and distributions

articleTitle: Robust State Estimation of Electricity-Gas Integrated Energy System Based on Multi-Time Scale Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the natural complementarity of physical characteristics of electricity and natural gas (electricity is easy to transmit and natural gas is easy to store) and the technical support of energy conversion equipment, the electricity-gas integrated energy system (IES) has received widespread attention both domestic and abroad. Heterogeneous energy systems in the integrated energy system have different time scales and therefore possess different dynamic characteristics. In this paper, a coupled mathematical model of the electricity-gas integrated energy system is constructed by considering data fusion of different time scales. To remain consistent capture rate in two systems, linear extrapolation and interpolation are used. In order to fully consider two-way interaction between the electricity and natural gas, a compressor model is studied, and integrated energy systems based on gas turbine (GT) and power to gas (P2G) are built. For the purpose of creating a state estimation model in electricity-gas IES with good robustness, weighted least absolute value (WLAV) is applied during the modeling process. Finally, a simulation example is used to verify the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Optimal Power Scheduling of Data Centers with Deferrable Computation Requests
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Data centers, as huge power consumers in distribution power networks, are believed to have significant operational flexibility with dispatchable computation requests and indoor thermal inertia. This flexibility can be utilized to arbitrage predictable time-varying electricity price or provide regulation services in power market. This paper studies the optimal power scheduling of a data center with deferrable computation requests and controllable air conditioning. The objective is to utilize the data center's flexibility to reduce its total operational costs (including both the electricity costs and server degradation) with time-varying electricity prices in a wholesale power market.
