A queue model is designed to describe the constraints of computation requests and a linear model is utilized to approximate the operation of air conditioning and thermal dynamics of the data center. The proposed model is a mixed integer quadratic programming that can be efficiently solved by the branch-and-bound algorithm in off-the-shelf solvers. Numerical experiments based on operation data of a real-world data center are conducted to validate the proposed method.

articleTitle: On The Convergence To Nash Equilibrium In Retail Electricity Markets
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The dynamic process of retail electricity markets evolving toward their market equilibria is considered. Due to the limited number of retailers and the nature of price competition, a retail electricity market is modeled as a Bertrand competition, and the Nash Equilibrium of which is with the competitive price. This paper studies whether the retail market can actually converge to its equilibrium, how fast the convergence is, and how much profit each retailer can obtain during such a dynamic process. The model of conditional value at risk (CVaR) is adopted to model the retailers' pricing strategies with different risk-averse degrees. Several widely-used regulation measures and their impacts on the convergence process are also discussed, such as ceiling prices, adding new competitors, switching cost, and staying cost as the response from retailers. Some interesting observations include that adding new retailers may not significantly accelerate the price convergence as many expected, and that limiting the range of price variations can accelerate the convergence if retailers are risk-neutral but decelerate the process if retailers are very risk-averse. These findings will help market administrators to better understand the dynamic of retail electricity markets and tailor their regulation measures thereupon.

articleTitle: The Multi-Stage Substation Coordinated Planning Method Considering the Overall Economy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a coordinate optimization model for multi-stage substation sitting and sizing to solve the problem of lacking effective coordination between target and intermediate years substation planning scheme. The planning schemes of target year and intermediate years are determined by a bi-level optimal framework. An overall criteria considering equipment operation time and rolling input cost is proposed to evaluate the economics of the proposed multi-stage substation schemes. Then, a coordinated optimal method for substation siting, sizing and power supplied division is presented for target year problem, and a rapid backward strategy is proposed for intermediate years problem. The proposed method can balance the economics of the target year and intermediate years planning schemes, and realize the overall optimization of multi-stage substation planning.

articleTitle: Data Center New Energy System under the “Peak Carbon Dioxide Emissions and Carbon Neutrality” Background and Comprehensive Evaluation Analysis Thereof
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The targets of “peak carbon dioxide emissions and carbon neutrality” put forward the requirements of high efficie ncy, high reliability and low carbon emission for the data center. A new totally direct current data center energy system with totally direct current supply and access to renewable energy and large-scale energy storage is proposed through analyzing the features and requirements in each sub-link of the data center “power supply-grid-load-energy storage” in the paper. The analytic hierarchy process and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method are utilized for comparative evaluation analysis between the new totally direct current data center energy system and the traditional alternating current data center energy system through establishing an index system considering system efficiency, availability, economy and environmental protection. The results show that the new totally direct current data center energy system proposed in this paper has higher efficiency and lower carbon emission than the traditional data center energy system. The comprehensive evaluation result is still better although the economy is slightly worse. It belongs to a new plan which can be considered in the future.

articleTitle: Analysis of Dynamic Characteristics of Doubly-Fed Induction Generator Under Different Drivetrain Vibration Suppression Strategies
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The rapid change of electrical control parameters under the interaction of machine and network is very likely to induce continuous torsional vibration of the flexible drive chain of wind turbine. Most of the existing torsional vibration suppression methods are based on the design of drivetrain dynamics equations, lacking consideration of grid stability. For this purpose the paper compares and analyzes the role of different dampers in terms of torsional vibration fatigue damage of the drivetrain and grid stability. First, a multi-degree-of-freedom drivetrain model considering the flexibility of key components is established, and the influence law of electrical control on the torsional vibration of the drivetrain is analyzed. Secondly, the electromagnetic transient simulation model of the doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) is established based on Fatigue, Aerodynamics, Structures, and Turbulence (FAST) and MATLAB/Simulink to reflect the electromechanical coupling characteristics. Finally, the effects of different dampers on the fatigue damage and grid stability of DFIG under grid disturbances are discussed by applying the linear fatigue cumulative damage theory. This provides ideas for improving the operational reliability and grid stability of DFIG.

articleTitle: Harmonic Modeling and Analysis of STATCOM Considering Frequency Coupling
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Static synchronous compensator (STATCOM) is widely used in distribution networks to compensate reactive power and alleviate power quality problems. However, with the integration of distributed energy resources (Solar, wind, etc.) and the access of electric vehicles and other new loads, the operation environment of the distribution network is increasingly complex. The non-ideal grid environment makes the harmonic interaction exist between the STATCOM and the grid, which threatens the stability of the whole system. Aiming at this problem, this paper presents the steady-state harmonic model of STATCOM under grid background harmonics, in order to quantitatively evaluate the interaction between harmonics and STATCOM. Based on this model, STATCOM shows the characteristics of harmonic coupling instead of traditional impedance form or Thevenin form. At the same time, the analytical expression of positive and negative sequence coupling impedance with clear physical meaning is determined. The validity of the harmonic coupling model was verified by using a ± 3Mvar STATCOM distribution system network simulation model developed in MATLAB.

articleTitle: An Investigation on Electricity Consuming Features for User Classification in Demand-Side Management Schemes
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The global deployment of smart meters has resulted in massive recorded data. By analyzing the data, we can capture users' electricity consumption behaviour. Data obtained contributes to the scheme design for the demand-side management (DSM) and the balance between the supply and demand sides in the power grid. For extracting consumption behaviour from smart metering data originally for billing purposes, a user classification model leveraging the ReliefF algorithm and CART method is proposed in this paper based on different DSM stimuli and time of use tariffs. Initially, 14 features strongly correlated to the electricity consumption patterns are extracted and weighted by the ReliefF algorithm, and 4 features therein are newly proposed in this work. Then, a Decision Tree is built by the CART method attributing the weighted features to classify users in various DSM program categories. Finally, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$k$</tex>-fold cross-validation is carried out. Towards demonstrating the user classification feature correlations to various DSM programs as classification categories, the feature weights for the real-world ISSDA dataset are demonstrated and discussed. Experimental results and analysis for correlations of extracted features to DSM schemes and cross-validation accuracy prove that the proposed method is able to distinguish users under various DSM programs.

articleTitle: Research on the Implementation Path of Hebei Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the change of development orientation and strategic targets, energy development in Hebei Province needs to enter a new stage of comprehensive upgrade. The construction of Energy Internet can promote the development of energy system in Hebei Province towards a clean, low-carbon, economic and reliable direction, which is conducive to the sustainable development of local economy, society, environment and resources, as well as to be beneficial for the high-quality development of the overall economy including the energy sector. This paper first analyzes the concept and functions of Energy Internet, studies the status quo of Energy Internet development globally and in China, especially in the Hebei province, in order to provide reference for Hebei Energy Internet construction and specific demonstration projects. Based on this, this paper points out that technique, platform, ecology, and market mechanism are the key aspects to facilitate local Energy Internet development, and it proposes an implementation pathway with specific suggestions.

articleTitle: Research on Investment Management of Residential Power Supply Project
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The Fifth Plenary Session of the 19<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> CPC Central Committee proposed to perform human-oriented novel urbanization, implement the urban renewal initiative and strengthen the renovation of old urban residential compounds and community construction. The supporting power supply project is an important energy infrastructure in urban residential area. At present, the policies on residential power supply are not well established e.g. investor, construction and engineering, property right, operation and maintenance service, investment return. The rights, responsibilities and benefits of the diversified stakeholders need to be further clarified. This paper sorts out and analyzes the typical international cases, takes reference of gas and heat supply sectors, and puts forward the model of investment, construction, operation and management of urban residential power supply project. For the renovation of power supply project of old residential compound, the model of “diversified investment, market-oriented conversion, ownership operation and reasonable investment return” is recommended so as to form the model of residential power supply project renovation, investment, operation and management featured with “government planning, voluntary participation of residents, engagement of multiply stakeholders, market-oriented operation, joint contribution and shared benefits”. With respect to the power supply project of newly-built residential compound, the model of “normalized supervision, benefit-targeted investment, standardized construction, ownership operation” is recommended so as to clarify the investment, operation, maintenance and service responsibilities in a scientific and rational manner, and establish a long-term mechanism of investment, construction and operation of power supply project of newly-built compound.

articleTitle: A Solution of Distribution Network Reconfiguration with Wind Power Using Improved ACO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The issue of distribution network reconfiguration has always been the focus of attention from industry and academia. In particular, the integration of large number of distributed wind farms brings new problems and severe challenges to the network reconfiguration of active distribution network. The paper presents a solution pertinent to the optimal network reconfiguration of distribution network considering wind power integration. This optimization model is composed of three objectives: minimum power loss, minimum average value of voltage deviation, and minimum variance of voltage deviation, whilst satisfying a series of system constraints. Regarding the established multi-objective optimization model, a kind of super-efficiency data envelopment analysis (SEDEA) model is applied to convert the muti-objective optimization model into a single-objective optimization model, and the scenario-based analysis method is utilized to handle the uncertainty of distributed generation. In addition, the reactive power characteristics of wind turbines are also considered during solutions. Taking into account the complex nonlinear characteristics of the established optimization model, an improved ant colony optimization (ACO) algorithm is applied to find the optimal decision solution. Finally, the simulations are performed on the IEEE 33-bus system as an example to validate the effectiveness of the proposed model and method.

articleTitle: Non-intrusive Inverter Air Conditioner Identification Using General Knowledge
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Effective monitoring and tracking the operating states of air conditioners, is of great significance to realize the power system demand response. In recent years, air conditioning load grows rapidly especially the load of inverter air conditioners due to the advancement of technologies. Based on the in-depth analysis of the operating mechanism of inverter air conditioners, combined with field measurement experience, this paper proposes a non-intrusive inverter air conditioner identification method, which is a dynamic programing (DP) model based on general knowledge. Through the suggested event detection method based on curve segmentation linearization and the event identification method based on event matching, it is possible to identify the operation status of inverter air conditioners in unknown sites without accumulating data for model learning and training. The effectiveness and superiority of this proposed method has been validated through the comparison experiments on in-situ data.

articleTitle: Research of Teaching Experiment Platform for Flexible AC/DC Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The application of Flexible DC power transmissi on and Flexible AC power transmission technology in modern power system improves the conversion and transmission efficie ncy of electric energy, enhances the control ability and flexibilit y of power grid, and greatly improves the absorption capacity of new energy such as solar energy. Flexible transmission tech nology plays an important role in achieving the goal of carbon peak and carbon neutrality. In order to strengthen the combin ation of theory teaching and engineering practice, the author se ts up the physical model of the flexible transmission system in t he power system dynamic simulation laboratory, designs the ex perimental teaching content, and integrated it into the course o f Comprehensive Experiment of Modern Power System, and carr ied out the teaching experiment. The practice results show that through the training of experimental teaching, the students hav e deepened their understanding of the theory knowledge of flex ible transmission system, accumulated the operation experienc e of flexible transmission equipment, and improved the student s' ability to master and apply the flexible transmission technolo gy.

articleTitle: Random Expected Value Power Supply Reliability Evaluation of Typical Urban Medium-Voltage Distribution Network Considering the Impact of Integrated Energy Supply
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the context of energy internet development, the application of the park-level integrated energy system promotes the energy utilization efficiency, and at the same time promotes the research necessity of the reliability assessment of urban medium-voltage distribution network considering its influence. This paper first constructs a configuration model for economic operation optimization of the integrated energy system, and then extracts the typical supply and demand combination boundary on which reliability assessment depends based on the random expected value model, and finally uses the simulation calculation of 11 typical grid combinations under normal mode, N-1 and N-2 scenarios (combined with three main network connection modes and four sub-main network connection modes) to explore the reliability level of medium voltage network considering the impact of integrated energy output. This paper aims at promoting the application of integrated energy technology in cities and providing useful reference for power grid planning and transformation.

articleTitle: Cost Optimization of Park Integrated Energy System Considering Combined Demand Response and Multiple Different Operating Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the introduction of the concept of global energy networking and the development of integrated energy system, multi-energy combined demand response has become an important means to achieve peak regulation and improve energy efficiency. Considering the demand response of electrical load based on electricity price and the demand response of heat load based on fuzzy comfort, this paper establishes an optimization dispatching model of the park integrated energy system by taking the park operators as the main body and the lowest comprehensive operating cost as the optimization objective. Then, a number of operating scenarios for industrial and residential users are established respectively, and the particle swarm optimization algorithm is used for example analysis. Through the cost analysis of different operating scenarios, the effectiveness and economy of the proposed strategy and model under each scenario are obtained.

articleTitle: An Integrated Energy Distribution System Planning Method with Multiple Energy Storage Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Integrated energy system is one of the most important development directions of the Energy Internet. At present, the integrated energy distribution system (IEDS) in urban areas, with electric power distribution system as core and coupling electric with cooling supply, has received widespread attention. This article focuses on IEDS with electrical-cooling coupling, and considers the flexibility potential brought by multi-energy complementarity and propose a planning approach for IEDS with multiple energy storage (ES). Heuristic moments-matching scenario generation (HMMSG) is used to model the uncertainties in electric/cooling loads; then, we formulate the IEDS planning model based on mixed integer linear programming. The case studies demonstrate the effectiveness of the IEDS planning method with a 16-nodes 33-lines example, in which ES construction and location site is considered.

articleTitle: Research on Risk-Based Planning of Power Grid Considering the Access of New Energy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the low-carbon and sustainable development of the power system, there are more and more new energy such as wind and solar power, as well as storage devices being switched into the grid. Source, grid, load and storage in the power system are all uncertain, bringing series of risks to the system. In order to improve the ability of the power grid to resist risk accidents, a grid planning method that takes risks into account is proposed in this article. First, probabilistic models for load, wind and solar power generation are established to characterize their randomness and volatility, and a charge and discharge strategy for energy storage (ES) devices is developed. Then, with the goal of minimizing load reduction, a probabilistic optimal power flow calculation method based on Latin hypercube sampling (LHS) is proposed to quantify the risk caused by uncertain factors. Moreover, a two-tier planning model of the power grid is developed based on a life cycle cost (LCC) analysis, where the objective function includes the cost of risk loss. Finally, the improved 18-bus system is constructed as an example for multi-scene planning, and the planning model is solved by the improved whale optimization algorithm (WOA). The results illustrate the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of the Hydro and Thermal Electricity Replacement Trading Model Between Yunnan and Guizhou Provinces Based on PROPHET
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the current background of the Chinese electricity market reformation, power generation rights trading plays a major role in reducing hydropower waste, improving the efficiency of resource utilization, and promoting energy conservation and emission reduction. In this paper, we introduce and study the background, mechanism, trading process, and mathematical model of replacement transaction between hydro and thermal power. A replacement trading model is built to adapt the characteristics of the China southern region including Guangdong, Yunnan, Guangxi, and Guizhou provinces. And we carry out simulation analysis based on MATLAB and PROPHET software. The case study results show that the replacement hydro and thermal power transaction between Yunnan and Guizhou can effectively avoid the occurrence of water abandonment and promote the consumption of surplus hydropower in Yunnan.

Author Keywords: replacement water and thermal power.generation right trading

articleTitle: An Improved Differential Protection Strategy of DC Distribution Network with Current Limiting Reactor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes an improved differential protection strategy for DC distribution networks by introducing the characteristics of current limiting reactor into protection criterion. The proposed strategy can improve the sensitivity of DC distribution network protection. Through detailed analysis of the fault characteristics of DC distribution network with current limiting reactor, the reasons for invalid protection caused by current limiting reactor are analyzed. Besides, based on the characteristics of the fault current, the compensation strategy is proposed. Then, an improved differential protection strategy is given, including fault identification criterion, protection start criterion and protection setting scheme. Finally, simulation results based on PSCAD/EMTDC are carried out to verify the reliability and sensitivity of the proposed protection.

articleTitle: Research On Risk Assessment Of China's PV-Storage Charging And Exchanging Power Station Under The Environment Of Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: PV-storage charging and exchanging power station (PV-S-CEPS) is an important facility to reduce photovoltaic rejection and improve the endurance of electric vehicles. Risk assessment of PV -S-CEPS in the environment of Energy Internet is of great significance to achieve the goal of carbon neutrality. In this paper, the risk factors are determined based on the improved diamond model, the evaluation standard is determined by the interval type-2 fuzzy set (IT2FS), the weight of each factor is determined by the fuzzy OWA operator method(F-OWA), the risk evaluation is conducted by the fuzzy extension matter-element method(F-MEEM), and the correctness of the results is verified by F-EWM and F-ORM. Results show that the development risk of China's PV -S-CEPS is relatively high under the environment of Energy Internet, suggestions over key indicators are also given in this paper.

articleTitle: Intrinsic Parameter Estimation of Railway Traction Power System Based on Impedance Measurement
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a method for adaptively extracting intrinsic parameters of the railway traction power system based on the wideband impedance measuring information. A wideband excitation signal is injected twice into the system at two connection points and only three pairs of voltage and current sampling signals need to be measured. Adaptive equivalent models representing the traction power supply system are established after determining the impedance characteristics of each region. The intrinsic parameters extracted are calculated from the adaptive equivalent model and the wideband impedance measurement results. The proposed method can be added to the existing measurement algorithms. It can provide accurate equivalent parameters and guidance for efficient model building. Experimental results show that the proposed method yields good parameter extraction and that it can also adapt to changes of order for various railway traction power systems.

articleTitle: Multistage Optimal Allocation of Gas Turbines in Integrated Electricity and Natural Gas Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The optimal planning in integrated electricity and natural gas systems (IEGS) generally considers future load growth, but at present most planning is only a single stage. It is a one-time allocation and investment of all equipment at the beginning of the planning period, which is easy to cause problems such as redundant allocation in the early planning period, insufficient capacity and aging of equipment in the later planning period. In addition, most natural gas systems (NGS) adopt the steady-state model, ignoring the dynamic characteristics. Therefore, this paper proposes the multistage optimal location and capacity allocation of gas turbines (GT) in IEGS and considers the dynamic characteristics of NGS, to meet the future load growth demand and improve the economic efficiency of IEGS. The planning model established with the life cycle cost as the objective function is a mixed integer linear programming (MILP) model. By solving the MILP model, the most optimal location and capacity of gas turbines in each planning stage are obtained.

Author Keywords: integrated electricity and natural gas systems

articleTitle: Transaction Mechanism of New Energy in Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Deepening the electric power system reform and building a new power system with new energy as the main body are the top priorities in the development of the energy and power field. The participation of new energy in electricity market transactions is in the early stage of development, and there are many problems in the mechanism design. Aiming at the problem of new energy participating in electricity market transactions, this paper summarizes and analyzes the current situation of new energy participating in the electricity markets at home and abroad, then puts forward the incentive mechanism and price mechanism of new energy participating in electricity market transactions, and finally makes some suggestions about this problem. The research objective is to better promote the participation of new energy in the electricity market, realize the efficient use of new energy, and help to achieve carbon peak and neutrality goals.

articleTitle: Study on Evaluation of Renewable Energy Accommodation for Receiving Power System and Influencing Factors
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Trans-regional renewable energy accommodatio n through high-capacity ultra-high voltage direct current (UH VDC) projects has become an important means to improve the utilization rate of renewable energy power generation and promote the low carbon energy transition. While meeting the demands of power transmission at the sending-end and the load growth at receiving-end, the feed-in of high-capacity UHVDC also has a significant impact on renewable energy accommodation of the receiving power system. In this paper, three indexes are selected to evaluate the renewable energy accommodation capaci ty of the receiving power system, including the proportion of power generation, the proportion of installed capacity and the utilization rate. The impact of DC power transmission curves, transmission capacity of AC power grid and renewable energy installed capacity on renewable energy accommodation is quantitatively analyzed based on an actual provincial receiving power system. The results show that optimization of trans-regional U HVDC transmission power curve, construction of strong AC power system structure and reasonable renewable energy installation capacity can improve the renewable energy accommodation of a receiving power system.

articleTitle: Primary Frequency Regulation Method for Thermal Power Units Based on Multi-Scale Morphological Filter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The high proportion of new energy grid connection puts forward higher requirements on the frequency response capability of the power system. In this paper, based on the multi-scale morphological filtering method, the frequency signal of the primary frequency regulation negative feedback channel of the thermal power unit is quickly decomposed, corresponding to the different response time scales of the unit inertia, primary frequency regulation, and secondary frequency regulation. The frequency control of frequency division is realized by setting reasonable coefficient for each frequency band signal, thereby effectively improving the unit's ability to adjust the frequency of power fluctuations in the entire frequency range. The frequency regulation model of power system including wind, water and thermal power is built by using Matlab/ Simulink. The simulation results show that the method can significantly improve the primary frequency regulation ability of the system and promote the absorption of wind power generation.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Simulation Study of the Herding Behavior Effects in the China National Carbon Market
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Mitigating climate change is a global consensus. China is aiming to have carbon emissions peak before 2030 and achieve carbon neutrality before 2060. The China national carbon market is one of the key measures to achieve this ambitious “30•60” target. Compliance enterprises, financial institutions, and individual investors are allowed to participate in the national carbon market and the complex trading interactions among these heterogeneous participants will make the market dynamics difficult to predict and analyze, bringing challenges to market design and regulations. Guided by the framework of cyber-physical-social system in energy (CPSSE), this paper constructs a hybrid simulation environment based on the Dynamic Simulation platform for Macro-Energy Systems (DSMES), in order to study the herding behavior effects on carbon market under different scenario settings. The behavior models of different carbon traders such as compliance enterprises, offset developers and financial institutions are analyzed and constructed. Then, the herding behavior effects are studied under different market scenario settings such as the supply of carbon emission allowance (CEA) and carbon offset credits (COC). Finally, key insights are discussed based on multi-scenario case studies, which provide decision support for market design and regulation.

articleTitle: Robust Coordinated Dispatch of Integrated Electric-Gas System at the Distribution Level Considering Uncertainty of Wind
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a two-stage robust dispatch model for the integrated electric-gas distribution system (IEGDS) is proposed against the uncertainty of wind power based on the distflow model and more precise pipeline equation of natural gas distribution network. The second-order cone (SOC) and piecewise linearization (PL) method are adopted to process the nonlinear constraints in the overall model. Due to the existence of auxiliary integer variables in the re-dispatch model, the overall model is solved by the nested column-and-constraint generation (NC&CG) algorithm. The example analysis verifies the robustness of the dispatch strategy and discusses the impact of the segment number on the performance of the solution algorithm. Finally, the convergence process of the NC&CG algorithm is displayed.

articleTitle: The Treatment Of AC/DC Hybrid Connection In Interregional Power Market Clearance
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Many regions worldwide, such as Europe and China, are constructing interregional electricity markets. While the intraregional power grid is usually a pure AC structure, AC/DC hybrid structure is more commonly used in interregional power grid, and this renders differences in clearance algorithm modelling. To tackle this problem, this paper firstly analyses the differences in model-ling of the AC/DC hybrid power grid and pure AC power grid in the spot electricity market. Based on the traditional economic dispatch model, this paper studies the operation characteristics of AC/DC hybrid interregional network and incorporates them in interregional electricity market clearing. Specifically, operation limitations, loss treatment and transmission cost treatment of tie lines are considered. The advantages of interregional power spot market are further analyzed compared with intraregional spot market. Through the joint clearing of interregional power grids, social welfare is significantly increased compared. Finally, a numerical example is given to verify the validity of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Supplementary Planning Of DESS In High Proportion Of Distributed PV + EV
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of increased voltage fluctuation and increased peak load caused by the high proportion of distributed photovoltaic (PV) and electric vehicles (EVs) connected to the distribution network, it is helpful to increase the storage efficiency and reduce the incremental cost of energy storage system (ESS) to carry out the energy storage supplement planning based on the aggregation of the EVs. Firstly, the “distributed energy storage +” resource partition hierarchical control topology and the economic incentive model of on-board energy storage aggregation are established, including on-board energy storage and distributed energy storage system (DESS). The mathematical models of on-board energy storage, DESS and the calculation model of the potential of on-board energy storage are established. Then, a DESS supplement planning model is built, which is including on-board energy storage participating in system peak shaving and valley filling. And the solution flow is given. Finally, an example is given based on IEEE-33 bus distribution network. It is verified that the supplementary planning based on the aggregation of existing resource is effective for cost reduction and efficiency increase of energy storage resource.

articleTitle: Overview and Prospect Analysis of The Mechanical Elastic Energy Storage Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The energy storage system is one of the important links in building a power system with new energy as the main body, which plays an irreplaceable role. The advanced energy storage technology has become the key core technology for peak shaving and frequency modulation, ensuring intermittent new energy access to the network and promoting new energy consumption. The diversification and complexity of the application scenarios of energy storage devices require energy storage devices with different operating characteristics to adapt to them, and then need diversified development. The mechanical elastic energy storage is a new physical energy storage technology, which has its own characteristics and advantages. This paper expounds the current situation and development space of mechanical elastic energy storage device from the aspects of operation principle, energy storage material selection, energy storage box structure optimization design, linkage energy storage box group assembly design, energy storage, power generation speed regulation and grid connection control technology, and analyzes and expounds the applicable scenarios of the mechanical elastic energy storage device.

articleTitle: Information Extraction Method of Power Grid Operation Mode Based on Double Layer Labeling Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the long-term power grid construction process, the grid dispatching department keeps many adjustment notices of grid operation mode, which record important grid equipment models and their corresponding operating status requirements. In order to facilitate dispatchers to quickly obtain information about abnormal equipment and its operating status when facing with emergencies, it is necessary to study the information extraction method to obtain grid operation rules from such texts. Due to the linguistic characteristics of the entities in the adjustment notices of power grid operation mode such as diverse expressions, uncertain lengths, complex structures and unclear boundaries, a double layer labeling (DLL) model is proposed. By constructing an independent deep learning network at each layer, DLL model first recognizes the outer-layer entities of power grid equipment model and operating state. Then, the key inner-layer entities which make up the power grid equipment model entity was recognized to map the power grid model entity to the corresponding ID. Finally, the unstructured adjustment notices of operation mode can be stored as structured information. The above method is a promising tool to help dispatchers reasonably arrange the operation mode of the power grid and eliminate the hidden dangers of the safe and stable operation of the power grid in time. The DLL model based on two independent Bidirectional Encoder Representation from Transformers and Long Short-Term Memory and Conditional Random Fields networks (BERT-BiLSTM-CRF) is proposed in the article, and the F1 values in the test data set reach 0.932 and 0.963, respectively. The experiment results validate the efficiency of the proposed model for extracting information from the adjustment notices.

articleTitle: A Novel V2V Charging Mechanism Based on Bargain Model within the Scheme of Internet of Smart Charging Points
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Considering serious environment problems and energy dilemma, the importance of electric vehicles (EVs) has attracted more and more attention. However, how to cope with large scale EVs and efficiently manage them when charging have also been a big challenge. At the same time, the architecture of internet of smart charging points (ISCP) has great potential to achieve distributed energy management towards EVs and supply foundation to implement vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) charging mechanism. For more flexible and valuable trade, a V2V charging mechanism based on bargain model is applied in this unique framework. To verify the validity of this mechanism, case studies are conducted for 153 EVs in the whole day. We finds that the total payoff is - 687.1182ұ in the case of normal charging mechanism, −36.2091 ұ in the case of V2V buyer-first charging mechanism and - 36.5998ұ in the case of V2V seller-first charging mechanism. The results indicate that the novel V2V charging mechanism can alleviate the grid load, protect privacy of consumers and bring economic payoff to consumers.

articleTitle: Spatial-Temporal Distribution Characteristics of Electric Vehicle Charging Load Considering the Traffic-side Intersection Delay
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Electric vehicles (EVs) play an indispensable role in reaching net-zero emissions. With high randomness, the EV spatial-temporal distribution characteristics are necessary for accurate EV charging load forecasting. And the intersection delay, affecting EV travel routes, cannot be ignored. Therefore, this paper proposes a forecasting method for EV charging load spatial-temporal distribution characteristics considering traffic-side intersection delay. Specifically, the percentile delay model (PDM) for different turning delays under traffic flow fluctuations at intersections is established. On this basis, a detailed dynamic traffic network model is obtained. Then according to users' travel habits and survey data, the travel patterns can be obtained by sampling, and the EV spatial-temporal distribution characteristics, including temporal, spatial, and state of charge, can be calculated. While calculating, the classic Dijkstra shortest path algorithm is improved to plan EV travel routes considering intersection delay and road driving time. Lastly, with a detailed EV charging model, the charging load is forecasted under termination conditions for the Monte Carlo simulation. The test results show that ignoring the intersection delay will make the lower load period demand underestimated seriously. And not only intersection delays but also intersection failures will influence EV charging load.

articleTitle: A Green Energy-saving Dispatch Strategy of the Pumped-storage Hydropower Station following Coal-fired Units in Peak Shaving
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Large-scale wind power integration has increased the power system's peak shaving pressure. At present, coal-fired units undertake the main peak shaving tasks and frequently operate at a low load level. However, this operation mode generates high energy consumption costs. At the same time, pumped-storage hydropower stations (PHSs) usually pump water and generate electricity at a relatively fixed time, which leads to low operating efficiency. Considering the energy consumption costs of coal-fired units in the deep peak shaving stage, this paper first establishes an entire peak-shaving-process energy consumption model of coal-fired units. Then a green energy-saving dispatch (GED) strategy of PHS following coal-fired units in peak shaving is proposed, and the peak-shaving economics of coal-fired units under the proposed strategy are analyzed. Results show that GED can effectively reduce the energy consumption costs of coal-fired units, raising the peak-shaving economy and the PHS utilization.

articleTitle: Problems and Technology Development Trends of Hydrogen Production from Renewable Energy Power Electrolysis - A Review
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: There is a hydrogen production route without carbon emissions, that uses power from renewable sources such as wind and solar energy to generate electricity and then electrolyzes water to produce hydrogen. So it is a clean energy in the true sense, and the hydrogen produced is also called “green hydrogen”. Hydrogen production by electrolysis of water is an important way to achieve zero carbon emissions. In the long run, hydrogen production by electrolysis of water is expected to become the main hydrogen production method. Here, two methods were reviewed for hydrogen production: alkaline water electrolysis (AWE) and proton exchange membrane water electrolysis (PEMWE). Also technical characteristics and technical development status of hydrogen production by water electrolysis were analyzed. Finally, the key research and development directions of AEW and PEMWE were respectively proposed.

articleTitle: Wind power prediction based on CNN-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Accurate wind power prediction is important to formulate power generation plans, reduce the impact of wind power integration into the power grid, and maintain the safe and stable operation of the power system. However, wind power output is affected by various factors such as wind speed, wind direction, temperature, air pressure, and humidity. So, it is obviously hard to accurately predict wind power over a long period of time only by relying on the historical power generation data. Therefore, this paper takes into account the influence of wind speed, wind direction, temperature, and humidity, and proposes a wind power prediction method based on CNN-LSTM. The method first uses the good feature extraction ability of convolutional neural network (CNN) to extract multiple features of wind power and its influencing factors data, then input them into the long and short-term memory network (LSTM) for predict, and finally realize the time series prediction of wind power. To prove effectiveness of the proposed method, use the method predict power generation of a wind farm in a certain area, and compare the prediction results with other methods. At last, the results show that the proposed method is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: A Load Forecasting Method of Electric Vehicles Charging Station Group Based on GAN-RF Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the stochastic and fluctuant problem of load in electric vehicles (EVs) charging stations, and considering the influence of human behavior on load forecasting, an information-physics-society system (CPSS) oriented load forecasting method for electric vehicles charging stations is proposed. Firstly, the generative adversarial networks (GAN) is used to handle the artificial load data with historical data. A huge amount of data including social behavior is generated and time-series load forecasting data is extracted by using stochastic forest (RF) algorithm to complete load forecasting for different charging stations, and the relative position information of each charging station is recorded by establishing spatio-temporal matrix, the load forecasting of electric vehicle charging station group is finished by filling the forecasting data into the space-time Matrix. The GAN-RF model is compared with support vector regression (SVR), BP neural network model. The experimental results show that the proposed method based on GAN-RF has high prediction accuracy and strong generalization ability.

articleTitle: Impacts of VSG Control on Frequency Response in Power Systems with High-Penetration Renewables
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increase of renewable energy into power systems, the system inertia continuously decreases, which poses challenges to the existing frequency regulating strategy. To improve system frequency response in the low-inertia system, Virtual Synchronous Generator (VSG) has been proposed in the literature. This paper investigates the VSG frequency response model and verifies the implementation at large scale. First, the frequency response model of VSC is investigated. In addition, the frequency response performance of the conventional synchronous generator (SG), the renewable power plant, and the renewable power plant with VSG are compared under different penetration levels of renewable energy. The simulation results show the capability of the CURENT Large-scale Testbed (LTB) for real-world, large-scale power system simulation in future scenarios and indicate that VSG-configured renewable power plants can provide the power grid with adequate frequency regulation ability under high renewable energy penetration.

articleTitle: Electrochemical Energy Storage Technology and Its Application Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing maturity of large-scale new energy power generation and the shortage of energy storage resources brought about by the increase in the penetration rate of new energy in the future, the development of electrochemical energy storage technology and the construction of demonstration applications are imminent. In view of the characteristics of different battery media of electrochemical energy storage technology and the technical problems of demonstration applications, the characteristics of different electrochemical energy storage media and the structure of energy storage systems are summarized. On this basis, different demonstration applications are analyzed by examples and their internal structures are analyzed. And the role played in the power grid, and finally the development of electrochemical energy storage technology was summarized and prospected.

articleTitle: An Interharmonic Suppression Control Scheme in PV System Based on DC-Link Voltage Perturbation Reduction
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The perturbation and observation (P&O) maximum power point tracking (MPPT) algorithm has been widely used in PV system. However, the dc-link voltage perturbation and drift problem during the tracking process is the main reason of interharmonics injection in PV system. In this paper an interharmonics suppression control scheme based on dc-link voltage perturbation reduction was proposed. To effectively suppress the interharmonics injection. The interharmonics suppression control scheme was divided into two stages according to the insolation change. When the insolation was stable, the dc-link voltage reference value was taken as the input variable. When the characteristic of three points oscillation was met for three consecutive times, it indicates that the MPP has been found. The perturbation step size was set to 0 and operated stably at the MPP. When the insolation changed, the power and voltages of three continuous operating points were sampled and used to ensure the correct tracking direction, which could reduce the dc-link voltage perturbation. The proposed control scheme could effectively reduce the perturbation of dc-link voltage and interharmonics injection. Simulations have been carried out to verify the effectiveness of the proposed control scheme in interharmonics suppression.

articleTitle: Combination Result of Two MPPT Techniques (Fuzzy Logic and Perturb and Observe Method): Comparison with The Conventional Perturb and Observe Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Extracting maximum power from a photovoltaic generator, regardless of meteorological conditions, remains a challenge in the field of solar photovoltaics. Therefore, techniques have been developed to find the best operating point of a photovoltaic module. These include the conventional perturbation and observation method and the fuzzy logic technique. In this paper, we present the combination of two MPPT methods, namely the perturbation and observation method and the fuzzy logic method. We aim to show whether the combination of two different MPPT techniques for a solar system is more accurate and efficient in determining the peak power point than the conventional perturbation and observation method alone.

articleTitle: TOPSIS Power Quality Comprehensive Assessment Based on A Combination Weighting Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to better perform operation and planning of active distribution system under the background of high penetration rate of new energy, this paper studies power quality assessment and proposes a method named TOPSIS based on the combination of AHP-CRITIC-EWM. First of all, considering the actual situation, the difference and relevance between power quality indicators, and the degree of dispersion of the evaluation data, the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) is used to determine the subjective weight of the indicators, and the criteria importance through intercriteria correlation (CRITIC) and the entropy weight method (EWM) are combined to determine the objective weight of the indicators. With the goal of the subjective and objective weights tending to be consistent, the minimum deviation combination weight model is established. Secondly, the index weights are integrated into the TOPSIS assessment method to meet the actual requirements of different indexes with different importance levels, and the assessment objects are quantified and graded. Finally, a case study is carried out, and the results show that the comprehensive assessment method proposed is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: Reactive Power Optimization of Distribution Network Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning and Multi Agent System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents a reactive power optimization method of distribution network based on deep reinforcement learning (DRL) and multi-agent system. Firstly, a method of extracting distribution network fusion features is proposed, which extracts statistical features from the operation data of distribution network. Then, the statistical features and historical control strategy are taken as inputs, and the network loss and voltage deviation are taken as outputs respectively. The network loss agent and voltage deviation agent are trained. The reactive power optimization problem is transformed into a multi-step Markov decision-making process, and the Double DQN algorithm is used to construct DRL agent. A multi-agent system is composed of network loss and voltage deviation agents and DRL agents. Network loss and voltage deviation agents provide rewards for DRL agents, while DRL agents provide strategies for network loss and voltage deviation agents. They cooperate with each other to obtain the optimal strategy. The reactive power optimization control experiment of IEEE-37 bus distribution network is carried out. The results show that the proposed method can effectively reduce the node voltage offset and network loss. It has nothing to do with the model and parameters of the distribution network system, and has fast online decision-making speed. It can improve the operation economy of the distribution network.

articleTitle: Evaluation Method of Wind Turbine Group Classification Based on Calinski Harabasz
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, the research on clustering of large-scale wind farms is gradually changing from the single-machine equivalence method to the multi-machine equivalence method for modeling, and the Calinski Harabasz principle-based wind farm grouping evaluation method is proposed for the problem of determining the optimal number of equivalents. Firstly, the active power of the system is collected, and the k-means method is applied to cluster, and the optimal number of equivalent machines is determined by comparing the dispersion between groups and the dispersion ratio within groups in various clustering cases. Secondly, the simulation analysis based on Xinjiang power grid confirms that the best equivalent model evaluated by the Calinski Harabasz method is similar to the detailed model results. the wind farm, which shows that the method is correct, and the calculation speed is faster than the conventional method, and it has good universality for complex systems.

articleTitle: Incorporating Knowledge Distillation Into Non-intrusive Load Monitoring for Hardware Systems Deployment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As an information provision technology, non-intrusive load monitoring can extract detailed load consumption separately from the mains reading, which is conducive to promoting residential consumers to join the demand-side response. The current deep learning model has been proven to be effective in NILM, but the huge amount of trainable parameters limits its implementation in hardware systems. Therefore, the knowledge distillation method is introduced into NILM. In this article, bidirectional gated recurrent unit (BiGRU) based on the spatial attention mechanism is first constructed as a teacher model to guide student model learning. Then, a small-scale student model is constructed, and the training of the model is implemented under the guidance of the teacher model. The experiments confirm that the proposed teacher model achieves better results than other methods, and the student model can also obtain results close to the teacher model, which provides a research direction for the deployment of deep learning models in hardware systems.

articleTitle: Evaluation of New Energy Accommodation Capability Based on Renewable Energy Power Prediction under “Double Carbon” Goal
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the goal of “double carbon”, the installed capacity of renewable energy except hydraulic will show a higher growth trend. In the future, new energy will become the main power source of power system, and it is particularly important to evaluate the accommodation capability of power grid for renewable energy. An evaluation method of new energy accommodation capability based on renewable energy power prediction is proposed. Based on the renewable energy output value predicted by the Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) for the next day, considering factors such as load characteristics, tie-line power and carbon emissions, the start-stop status of conventional units is optimized, the carbon emissions of thermoelectric units are limited, and the accommodation of renewable energy and carbon emissions are calculated. The practicability of the proposed evaluation method is verified by an example analysis of the new energy accommodation capability in a certain area of China.

articleTitle: Analysis of Demand Response Development Situation in China
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the analysis of the development of demand response related work in the past five years, a detailed introduction was made around the implementation of demand response and supporting policies. Taking three provinces in China as examples, the characteristics of demand response development in each province were analyzed, and the results and shortcomings of demand response in the previous stage were summarized. Combining the current energy transition and carbon emission reduction pressure, the future development trend of demand response was predicted.

articleTitle: Evaluation System of Distribution Network Admission to Roof Distributed Photovoltaic Based on AHP-EW-TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, roof distributed photovoltaic has gradually become the most widely used distributed power generation device, resulting in great changes in the development form of distribution network. The key to reliable operation of distribution network is to accurately evaluate the acceptance capacity of distributed generation. This paper constructs a photovoltaic optimization model based on AHP-EW-TOPSIS method. Firstly, an evaluation system including 8 evaluation indicators is constructed from the three dimensions of economy, reliability and stability. Secondly, use the entropy weight method (EW) and the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) to obtain the comprehensive weight of each indicator, and build a differentiated weight system; finally, based on the weight and the specific scores of each indicator, the power grid acceptance capacities of three regions are obtained, and can accurately find the specific reasons for the weaker power grid acceptance level. This paper provides a scientific basis for the planning and operation of a high-proportion distributed power distribution network.

articleTitle: Selection Strategy of Virtual Power Plant Members Considering Power Grid Security and Economics of Virtual Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the past, the virtual power plant (VPP) only considered economic optimization during the operation process, and ignored the safety of the distribution network, which caused the difficulty of implementing the VPP demonstration project. With the vigorous implementation of poverty alleviation policies such as photovoltaics, a large number of distributed power sources, mainly photovoltaics, have been connected to the grid. On the one hand, there may be a reverse flow of power and cause voltage over-limit problems. On the other hand, it also makes the composition of VPP present a variety of possibilities. In order to improve the utilization of existing resources in the distribution network, some resources in the distribution network are selected to aggregate into virtual power plants, and the different functions of photovoltaic, energy storage, electric vehicles and other resources in VPP and in the distribution network are analyzed. The distributed resource control strategy of VPP and distribution network is proposed, and the optimization model of VPP member selection considering the economy of VPP and the security of distribution network is established, and the improved IEEE33 node system is taken as an example to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Reserve Configuration of Power System with Storage Considering the Uncertainty of New Energy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Since wind and solar power are generally featured with randomness, intermittence and volatility, the high proportion of new energy will adversely affect the reliability of power grid. Energy storage can improve the flexibility of power system and also be employed to the matter of large-scale new energy grid connection. In this context, this article takes centralized energy storage as the research object. In order to give full play to the power regulation of energy storage, the remaining capacity is used as reserve on the basis of peak-shaving and valley-filling. In the article, Firstly, the operation characteristics of power system with storage are modeled, and then the author introduces the concept of ‘value at risk’, taking the minimum operating cost of the system as the objective function. Finally, the article proposes an optimization method for power system dispatching with storage. The simulation suggests that this method performs good adaptability to the fluctuation of new energy output.

articleTitle: Research on a New Method of Industrial Park Load Forecasting Based on Typical User Load Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the conventional park power load forecasting process, predicting the future annual load based on the current annual load level and expert experience, this method has certain limitations. Based on the new trend of energy development, the load density index method and the load characteristic curve fitting method are used, and the corresponding load characteristic curve normalization model is established based on the load data of each typical user on a typical day, and the annual maximum load characteristic is considered. Draw the annual park load density prediction curve, and verify the prediction results based on the relevant actual data of a certain year in Shanghai, laying a foundation for the development of the park multi-energy complementary system.

articleTitle: Intelligent Diagnosis Method of Distribution Network Fault for Construction of Digital Twin Coordination System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the large-area access of distributed power sources, higher requirements are put forward for the load-bearing and diagnosis of equipment in the distribution network. In order to improve the intelligent diagnosis ability of distribution network, an online fault diagnosis method based on Decision Tree (DT) is proposed in this paper, which can realize intelligent detection without additional auxiliary equipment. In this paper, the C4.5 algorithm is used to construct a transformer health assessment model. It can be seen from the results that the classification accuracy rate reaches 97.91%, and the Kappa index is 0.961, which is significantly better than the other three types of algorithms. This model is expected to realize the intelligent coordination between the physical space and the digital physical mirror space, which can greatly improve the self-diagnosis and operation capabilities of key equipment.

articleTitle: Molecular Dynamics Simulation on High Temperature Pyrolysis of Transformer Insulating Oil under Thermal Stress
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the long-term operation of the transformers, the electrical and mechanical properties of its insulating materials gradually deteriorate due to the influence of thermal stress and other factors. Transformer insulating oil will decompose to generate a variety of small molecular substances at high temperatures. These small molecular substances will form bubbles in the insulating oil, and small gas bridges will be formed in severe cases, resulting in transformer insulation discharge. Therefore, the researches on the pyrolysis laws of insulating oil under thermal stress are helpful for early detection of latent thermal faults in power transformers, thereby reducing the probability of insulation faults in power transformers. In this paper, the molecular dynamics method based on Reactive Force Field (ReaxFF) is used to establish the models of mineral oil containing three typical hydrocarbon molecules, and the constructed molecular models are subjected to high-temperature pyrolysis studies at four different temperatures of 2200K, 2400K, 2600K and 2800K. In computer simulations, the main pyrolysis pathways of transformer insulating oil are summarized by using element tracing technology and simulation images. The main conclusions are as follows: (1) The three hydrocarbons are all cracked under high temperature, and the order of pyrolysis is paraffin, naphthenic, and aromatic hydrocarbons; the reaction pathways of the insulating oil pyrolysis are roughly divided into two stages: 1) In the initial stage of pyrolysis, three hydrocarbons mainly undergo dehydrogenation and chain scission reactions, and a large amount of small molecular chain hydrocarbons are generated. 2) In the late stage of pyrolysis, the secondary pyrolysis occur in small molecule chain hydrocarbons, the ring-opening and pyrolysis occur in cycloalkanes and aromatic hydrocarbons. (2) With the temperature increase, the number of small molecule gases generated by pyrolysis gradually increases; C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20</inf> is first decomposed into C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf>~C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">19</inf>, and then C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf>~C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">19</inf>is decomposed into smaller molecules C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>~C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</inf>; most of the carbon atoms in the system are collected in C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>~C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>at the end of pyrolysis, which proves that C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">l</inf>~C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>are the final products of insulating oil pyrolysis.

articleTitle: Process Mining for Wind Turbine Maintenance Process Analysis: A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The maintenance of the entire life cycle of wind turbines is important for a wind power project. The main reason is that whether wind turbines can perform their best during the operation period is one of the key factors to measure the success or failure of a wind farm investment. However, with the increasing number of installed wind turbines, how to perform the maintenance in an efficient way will become a challenging problem. To lead better services, the first step is to analyze how the maintenance process or workflow really works in real-life scenarios. Process mining is such a technique which can perform process analysis over event logs recorded by information systems. Although various process mining case studies have been reported in current literature, there is no relevant study about the maintenance of wind turbines in the domain of energy systems. As an initial investigation, in this paper, we present a brief case study on applying process mining for wind turbine maintenance process analysis, based on several real event logs. Specifically, we have given the design of our study and reported the analysis results. We believe that the study will be of value to the community to understand the merits of how process mining technique can improve wind turbine maintenance processes in practice.

articleTitle: Single Phase Grounding Fault Location Method based on the Change of the Zero Sequence Current Along with Compensation Degree
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Single phase grounding faults occur frequently in distribution networks, which is hard to detect and locate especially those faults grounded via high impedance. This paper proposes a single phase grounding fault location method based on the change of steady state zero sequence current along with the compensation degree. Firstly, the distribution law of zero sequence current along the line for the single phase grounding fault in ungrounded system is analyzed. The correlation of the zero sequence current change with the compensation degree is also analyzed. Then the method of distinguishing grounded fault and disconnection fault is obtained. Finally, the fault location process is summarized. The simulation results show that the correctness of the location principle is not affected by the grounding impedance and the number of grounding lines.

articleTitle: Optimal Operation Scheme of Integrated Energy System With Wind Energy-Solar Energy-Hydrogen Storage
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In case of the depletion of nonrenewable resources and the increasingly serious earth contamination problem, clean non-fossil power gets to hold the main position of the coming world energy market. The hazard of volume intermittent power delivery poses the main challenges to the stable and risk-free performance of power supply system. Considering the instability and stochasticity of photovoltaic and wind energy, a combine-energy integrated model based on energy hub with hydrogen energy as the transit point is proposed. In order to maximize the operating profit of multi-energy system, a matrix coupling method is proposed to optimize the coordinated operation of multi-energy system. The matrix can represent the status of energy flow. CPLEX is used to acquire the best balance solution of the scheduling. The simulation results show that, compared with the traditional hydrogen-free operation mode, this model achieves higher renewable energy utilization rate and greater economic benefits.

articleTitle: A Tilt Angle Measurement Method Of Power Tower Using UAV LiDAR Point Cloud
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The power tower is easily affected by various meteorological and geological disasters, resulting in accidents. This paper presents an accurate measurement method of power tower tilt angle based on UAV LiDAR point cloud. This method uses the scattered three-dimensional laser point cloud obtained from LiDAR transmission line patrol of UAV to calculate the tower centerline by automatically fitting the tower body structure, so as to calculate the tilt angle of the tower. The measurement error sources and application conditions of this method are discussed. The application in transmission line detection proves the effectiveness and correctness of this method.

articleTitle: A Robust Short-term Wind Power Forecasting Algorithm Based on LSTM-XGBoost Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The generalization ability of a single wind power prediction model is insufficient. When using this model to predict complex weather conditions, the prediction accuracy in a small range is low, which affects the overall prediction accuracy. To solve these problems and improve the overall robust performance, this paper presents a dynamic weight combination model based on LSTM-XGBoost. First, this paper analyzes the correlation between numerical weather forecast data and historical power data. Then, the pre-processed data sets are used as LSTM model and XGBoost model inputs. Next, the prediction results of single models and extracted features are used as the input of the XGBoost-based dynamic weight combination model to get the expected wind power prediction value. The results show that compared to a single model, the proposed model not only performs better in the case of large power variations but also has lower overall error.

articleTitle: Large-scale Offshore Wind Farm Electrical Collector System Planning: A Mixed-Integer Linear Programming Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a planning method for large-scale offshore wind farm (OWF) electrical collector system (ECS) based on mixed integer linear programming, in which the sizing and siting of offshore substations and the lines between wind turbines (WTs) are optimized. We found out that the problem is similar to power distribution system planning, where the topological constraints for distribution network expansion planning (DNEP) are applied to guarantee the radiality of ECS topology and accelerate the solving process. Case studies based on an OWF with 63 fixed-locations WTs demonstrate the effectiveness of proposed method, in which the cost of ECS's investment on cables is reduced by <inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">23%</inf>, power loss reduced by 44% compared with a conventional design, and the calculation time reduced with the help of the radiality constraint.

articleTitle: A Carbon Emission Flow Analysis Model and Method of Active Distribution System Based on Power Flow Tracing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the dual pressure of energy and environment, low carbon of power system has become the focus of current research. It is a basic work to calculate the carbon emission of power system scientifically and accurately. A carbon emission analysis model and method for distribution system with distributed generations is proposed in this paper based on the theory of power system carbon emission flow. Firstly, the deep correspondence between current and carbon flow is found that is named carbon flow density. Then, the carbon flow density is used as a bridge to establish the carbon emission analysis model of the distribution systems with distributed generations which combined with the perfect system power flow theory and considered the network loss and high proportion of distributed generations. Finally, the effectiveness and practicability of the method are verified by IEEE-33 node system.

articleTitle: Path Planning of Electric Power Inspection Robot Based on Improved Lion Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To solve the disadvantages of the traditional lion swarm algorithm in power inspection path planning, such as parameter dependence, poor global optimization ability, prone to the premature phenomenon, and central tendency, an improved lion swarm algorithm was proposed. By exploring and developing an equilibrium factor <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\omega$</tex>, the position relationship of the lion group is more dependent on the number of populations and the number of iterations, jumping out of the local optimum, and significantly improving the global optimization of the algorithm. Finally, based on the MATLAB simulation platform, the grid environment model was constructed, and the optimal decision rules of electric power inspection robot walking were generated by the rough set theory.
