The traditional genetic algorithm, particle swarm optimization algorithm, lion swarm algorithm and improved lion swarm algorithm were used to find the optimal path. The simulation results showd that the improved lion swarm optimization algorithm has the shortest path length and the fastest iteration convergence speed, and it is efficient and economical for power inspection.

articleTitle: Dynamic Dispatch Of Hybrid Hydro/PV/PHS Complementary Power Generation System Based On Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Formulating an optimal operation strategy of hybrid hydro/photovoltaic (PV)/pumped hydro storage (PHS) complementary power generation system is of great significance to solve the problem of PV grid connection and consumption. However, traditional methods are difficult to adapt to the dynamic variation of the real system due to the uncertainty, volatility, and intermittency of PV power. Based on this motivation, a reinforcement learning based framework is proposed to learn an optimal decision policy for online intelligent economic dispatch for hybrid hydro/PV/PHS system considering both the economic benefit and power fluctuation. The Markov decision process (MDP) is used to convert the operation model and deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG) algorithm is adopted to learn environmental information including PV power output, price and the inflow runoff of hydropower station. A case study is simulated and the results demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Information Flow Based Cyber-Physical Power System Modeling and Simulation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Modern power system is a typical cyber-physical system (CPS). The stable operation of the modern power system relies increasingly on the well-functioning cyber system. Therefore, it is important to include the possible effects of the cyber system as we assess power system stability. Since our main purpose of considering the cyber system is to study its possible effect on power system operation, and cyber system mainly affect the physical system through affecting the information flow, we mainly focus on the information flow as we model the cyber system. In the proposed model, the details in cyber system operation is not considered to reduce redundant calculation burden. Instead, cyber elements and cyber contingencies are classified and modeled based on their effect on the information flow, reflecting their possible effect on the operation of the power system. We can simulate the CPS by integrating the proposed cyber system model with the power system model and conducting mixed simulation. Case study is carried out in the AVC system in the IEEE-14 bus power system. The result shows the proposed cyber system model and CPS simulation method can be used to analysis the possible effect of cyber contingencies on the power system.

articleTitle: Joint Optimal Operation of Cascade Hydropower Stations in Yandu River Basin in Dry Season Under the Background of Dual Carbon Target
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Run of river hydropower stations are widely distributed and numerous in China. Under the background of double carbon target, runoff prediction can give full play to the optimal operation mode of hydropower station, so as to reduce the layout of traditional thermal power station and lay the foundation for realizing carbon neutralization as soon as possible. In this paper, by comparing various hydrological models, the runoff prediction model reflecting the characteristics of the actual problem is established, and the reasonable and available optimal operation method is formulated, which provides convenient operation means for the economic operation of cascade hydropower stations in Yandu River Basin.

articleTitle: Research on User- Transformer Relationship Based on Improved Dynamic Time Warping Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The wiring of low-voltage distribution network is complex, and the relationship between households and transformer is inaccurate and difficult to be organized. Accurate household transformer relationship in low voltage distribution station is an important premise for line loss statistics and abnormal line loss detection. In this paper, the time-series voltage data collected on the low-voltage side of the transformer and the intelligent meter side of the user are used to calculate the similarity between the time-series voltage sequences of the user by using the improved dynamic time warping algorithm (FastDTW). According to the similarity, k-means clustering algorithm is used to realize shape-based clustering. The users connected with the same transformer can be grouped into one class to realize the phase separation identification of the household transformer relationship in the platform area. In this paper, an example is given to demonstrate the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Fire Suppression And Cooling Effect of Perfluorohexanone on Thermal Runaway of Lithium-Ion Batteries With Large Capacity
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The LiFePO4 lithium-ion battery with large capacity (202 Ah) was selected as the object. The burning characteristics of lithium-ion battery caused by the external overheating were analyzed, and the fire suppression and cooling effect of perfluorohexanone on the thermal runaway was discussed. Results showed that the surface center temperature of the thermal runaway battery was the highest. The maximum critical temperature was approximately 105°C. The initial fire of LiFePO4 battery module was quickly extinguished using the perfluorohexanone, and the flame was extinct within 2 s. The surface temperature of the battery was effectively reduced by releasing continuously perfluorohexanone. The maximum cooling rate on the surface of the thermal runaway battery was 0.24 °C/s. However, the continuous injection time should be extended as far as possible to ensure the cooling effect in the practical fire protection application.

articleTitle: A Preliminary Study on the Construction of New Rural Power Grid under the Dual-Carbon Target
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of the rural economy and the continuous increase in electricity consumption, the problems of high energy consumption, multiple failures, weak loading, and poor environmental protection in rural power grids have become increasingly prominent, which are incompatible with the green development concept advocated by the country. In order to meet the needs of economic development and respond to the national dual-carbon target strategy, this article starts with analyzing the status quo of rural power grids, studying the future development direction of rural power grids, and proposing a new rural power grid construction plan based on clean energy and optimized network structure for reference.

articleTitle: Performance Detection and Analysis of Built-in UHF Sensors for UHV GIS Equipment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The manufacturing and installation process and other issues directly affect the performance of the built-in ultra high frequency partial discharge sensors for GIS equipment. The performance and the placement of the sensors determine the effectiveness of the UHF PD monitoring system for GIS equipment. Therefore, partial discharge sensor performance detection research and on-site test are of great significance. This paper first introduces the characteristics of the UHF method and the performance parameters of the UHF PD sensor. The performance detection system built by the GTEM cell is used to perform the performance detection of the GIS built-in UHF PD sensor. Later, this paper uses network analyzers to carry out on-site UHF PD sensor test, and proposes optimization suggestions for the placement of the built-in UHF PD sensor through the test results.

articleTitle: State-of-Charge and State-of-Health Estimation Algorithms of Lithium-ion Batteries using SMO
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The state of charge (SoC) and state of health (SoH) monitoring of power lithium-ion batteries is the basis of the battery management system (BMS). The estimation of SoC and SoH is a hot issue in battery management system research today. This paper refers to a third-order electrochemical model based on the average electrode of a lithium battery. Based on this model, the paper establishes a battery SoC and SoH estimation observer based on linear sliding mode and full-order terminal sliding mode algorithms. The paper uses the Luenberger algorithm and terminal sliding mode algorithms to estimate the SoC and SoH of lithium-ion batteries to improve their stability and convergence and uses Lyapunov's theory to verify the convergence of the observer. The accuracy and robustness of SoC and SoH estimations are verified by the dynamic stress test (DST) and federal urban driving conditions (FUDS) test data.

articleTitle: Robust Transmission Expansion Planning Considering Massive N-1 Contingencies with High Proportion of Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In a power system with high proportion of renewable energy, transmission expansion planning (TEP) is further complicated by the intermittency and the volatility of renewable energy, which dramatically increases the diversity of system states. Hence a key problem is that a transmission planning scheme meeting a security criterion under the peak load state may not satisfy the security criterion under other system states. In this paper, to ensure the N-1 security of transmission planning schemes under various system states, a novel robust planning approach considering massive N-1 contingencies is proposed. The convex hull of scenarios is derived by the quick-hull algorithm and then we use the convex combination of vertices to represent any single scenario in the convex hull. Within the adjustable robust optimization framework, the size of the planning model is greatly reduced. A case study implemented on a revised Garver's 6-bus test system shows that the proposed method can ensure the N-1 security criterion of the transmission planning scheme under various system states.

articleTitle: Renewable Scenario Generation Based on Improved Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing penetration rate of renewable energy sources in power systems, it is vital to characterize renewables' intrinsic variability and uncertainty. Scenario generation is a key approach which could provide a series of possible power scenarios in the future for the system planner and operator to make decisions. In this paper, a data-driven renewable scenario generation method is proposed, which utilizes improved generative adversarial networks. The minimax normalization method is used to improve the training stability of the model. And after training, the generalization performance of the proposed model is verified. Moreover, several metrics are used to assess the quality of the scenarios. The results show that the proposed model can accurately describe the uncertainty of wind and photovoltaic power.

articleTitle: Study on Decision Rule in Stochastic Economic Dispatch Considering Uncertainties of Renewable Energy and Power Load
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Uncertainties of renewable energy and load have become one of the major challenges for operation of power system. This paper studies a two-stage stochastic economic dispatch model considering uncertainties from both renewable energy and load. Dispatch decisions are separated into here-and-now and wait-and-see optimization variables where uncertainties of renewable energy and load are modelled as multiple scenarios. In two-stage stochastic dispatch, the second-stage decision rule is crucial for effective redispatch actions. We compare the affine decision rule with fully adaptive decision rule in stochastic dispatch model in this paper. Result of numerical tests shows that conservativeness of affine policy and the variability of renewable generation and load are positively correlated.

articleTitle: Capacity and Power Allocation Strategy of Energy Storage Participating in Grid Peak Shaving
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: High penetration wind power grid with energy storage system can effectively improve peak load regulation pressure and increase wind power capacity. In this paper, a capacity allocation method of energy storage system under peak load regulation scenario is proposed. The upper model combines the investment cost, operation cost, arbitrage income, environmental income, and wind power grid benefits during the entire life cycle of the energy storage system, with the goal of maximizing the net income during the energy storage life cycle; the lower model optimizes the charging and discharging power of the energy storage system according to each energy storage configuration scheme in the upper modeling, and its objective is to minimize the standard deviation of system net load and waste wind power. Finally, under the conditions of local grid load and wind power data, verified the effectiveness of capacity allocation strategy.

articleTitle: Intelligent Fault Diagnosis Method of Power Grid Based on Multi-source Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of poor reliability and low accuracy when a single switching quantity information or electrical quantity information is used to judge the faults of power grid, an intelligent fault diagnosis method of power grid based on multi-source feature fusion of switching and electrical quantities y is proposed in this paper. The electric fault characteristics are extracted from the line, busbar and transformer fault recorders, and the fault characteristics of the switching quantities are extracted from the circuit breaker and the protection action outlet. The fault Petri net production rules of power grid are generated by combining the extracted switching and electrical quantities, and the neural Petri net model of power grid fault diagnosis is established by using radial basis neural network (RBF). The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by the simulation examples of faults in and out of the region. The simulation results show that the fusion of switching and electrical fault information can effectively improve the fault diagnosis efficiency and fault tolerance of power grid.

articleTitle: Composite Power System Reliability Evaluation Considering Space-time Characteristics of Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a new methodology to access the reliability of composite generation and transmission system considering the space-time characteristics of wind farm. Based on sequential Monte Carlo (SMC), the proposed method uses a wind power sequential two-state model to represent the wind farm reliability model. And the sequential property of wind speed, the wake effect and the influence of tower height are taken into account. The IEEE-RTS79 is used to test the method and the results show that with the proper wind power integrated, the reliability of composite system increases.

articleTitle: Study on Melting Ice Current Characteristics under Low Temperature and High Wind Speed
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Icing on transmission line becomes more serious in the past ten years, and the icing area gradually expanded from the traditional south to northeast area. Ice melting is an effective method to deal with the icing disaster. But the existing ice-melting research mainly focuses on traditional ice-coated areas with low wind speed and mild temperature. But it is difficult to apply to northern regions and alpine mountainous areas with low temperature and high wind speed conditions. In response to such issue, this paper establishes an equivalent thermal circuit model for ice melting process, and studies the quantitative effects of wind speed and temperature on the characteristics of ice melting current, and obtains the law of melting ice current under low temperature and high wind speed.it provides information for the parameter design of ice melting system in extremely cold regions.

articleTitle: An Attention-based CNN-GRU Model for Resident Load Short-term Forecast
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the background of electricity market, accurate short-term forecast of residential load can effectively strengthen demand side management. However, the randomness and uncertainty of residential electricity consumption increase the difficulty of prediction. The traditional prediction models are facing with some problems that it is difficult to effectively extract high-dimensional features and important information is easy to lose when the length of the time series is too large. Based on these, the paper established an Attention-based CNN-GRU model for resident load short-term forecast. In this model, CNN plays a role in extracting the features of historical power consumption data, GRU neural network combined with Attention mechanism is used to model these extracted features dynamically. Real data of individual household electricity consumption is taken as an example, and simulation experiments are carried out in three scenarios of univariate single step, multivariate single step and multivariate multi-step prediction respectively. The results of the experiment demonstrate that the proposed model achieves reasonable accuracy and robustness.

articleTitle: Capacity Configuration and Control Strategy of EV Charging Station with Integrated Wind Power and Energy Storage Based on SSA
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the number of people using electric vehicles increases and the types of electric vehicles (EV) become more complex, the load of electric vehicle charging stations (EVCS) is full of uncertainty, which may pose challenges to the stability of the grid. This paper proposes a sparrow search algorithm (SSA)-based EVCS with integrated wind power and energy storage capacity configuration model and corresponding operation strategy, which can find the optimal capacity allocation more efficiently, reduce the peak load of EVCS, avoid some fluctuations, and obtain certain benefits (or reduce certain losses). Simulation results verify the feasibility of the proposed theory. At the same time, the use of second-hand batteries improves the economy of the system and solves the recycling problem of used electric vehicle power batteries.

articleTitle: Generator-Grid-Load-Storage Coordinated Optimal Dispatch Considering CO2 Emission in Active Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Massive clean energy access to power system is an inevitable trend in the future. This paper proposed a generator-grid-load-storage coordinated optimization dispatch method considering CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions in active distribution network. Timing models were employed to consider the volatility and uncertainty of flexibility resources. Based on the NS-MOPSO algorithm, a multi-objective generator-grid-Ioad-storage coordinated optimal dispatch model was established. The optimal objectives were CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emission, operation cost and voltage stability of distribution network. And the decision variables were active and reactive power output of distributed generators (DGs), grid, on-load tapping changer (OLTC) and load regulation factor. IEEE 33 buses distribution network system was employed to verify the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Optimal Operation of Gas-Electricity Integrated Energy Systems with Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The environment-friendly gas-fired power plants have intensified the interdependence and economic efficiency of gas-electricity integrated energy systems (GEIES). This paper proposes an optimal operation of constrained electricity units and pipeline-constrained natural gas units which are conducted to minimize the total operational cost of GEIES. Demand response program (DRP) has been viewed as flexible assets in smart grid, which is expected to alleviate the volatile renewable energy sources (RESs) penetration. The gains of DR implementation with GEIES are investigated in this research. A numerical case study combining the IEEE RTS 24-bus system and Belgian 20-node natural gas network has validated the advantages of DRP in GEIES. The electricity cost decreases by 8.73% compared with non-participation DRP. The total cost for GEIES reduces by 2.93% under 20% DRP penetration level. The simulation results validate that a higher DR penetration level causes less volatility of load demand and total cost payment.

articleTitle: Low-carbon Economic Dispatch of Integrated Energy System Considering Hydrogen Mixing in Natural Gas Pipeline
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid growth of the penetration rate of renewable energy, the construction of Integrated electricity-natural gas system (IEGS) has important economic and environmental significance. Power-to-gas (P2G) technology, as a new energy conversion and storage method, provides an important way for wind power consumption. Due to the limited local consumption of hydrogen energy and difficulty in exporting, this paper proposes an IEGS optimal scheduling model that considers hydrogen mixing in natural gas pipeline and aims at the lowest system operating cost. After the verification of the improved IEEE 14-node power network and the Belgian 20-node natural gas network coupling system, the operation mode of the IEGS proposed in this paper can expand the hydrogen demand, increase the hydrogen transmission capacity, and promote wind power consumption. At the same time, it can achieve carbon emission reduction and improve the economics of system operation.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning Based Preventive Maintenance for Wind Turbines
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Wind turbines have been the core devices in the low carbon society, where the maintenance cost occupies the critical part of the life cycle cost. A preventive maintenance (PM) problem is formulated to reduce the maintenance cost caused by random failures of WTs, while guaranteeing the reliability of WTs with multiple components, e.g., blades, generators, main bearing, and gearboxes. A linear state transition function is introduced to capture the relation between the PM actions, degradation, and equivalent age of each component. The Weibull distributions and reliability functions are adopted to quantify the reliability level of each component. The state transition and reliability level functions are embedded as the environment function of a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) problem, where the maintenance costs caused by PM actions are treated as the reward function. The DRL problem is further formulated as a Q-network (DQN) with two hidden layers. A practical example is used to verify the effectiveness of the proposed strategy. The results indicate that the learned policy can take advantage of an opportunistic window to maintenance components whose condition is closed to be maintained, reducing the downtime duration and the maintenance costs.

articleTitle: Square-root Extended Kalman Filter-based Detection of False Data Injection Attack in Smart Grids
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper studies the detection of false data injection attack (FDIA) in smart grid via the Square-root Extended Kalman Filter(SREKF). Due to the deceptive characteristics of FDIA, traditional <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\chi^{2}$</tex> detector-based detection method can be bypassed. For this reason, the security of smart grids is faced with the huge challenges. In order to address this problem, a SREKF-based detection method against the FDIA is proposed in this paper. Based on the constructed nonlinear grid model, a SREKF-based state estimation algorithm is developed to enhance the accuracy of state estimation. Furthermore, a state residual-based detector is given by considering the covert characteristics of FDIA. Finally, the simulation experiments verify the effectiveness of the proposed detection method by using detailed studies on an IEEE 6-bus smart grids.

articleTitle: A Hierarchical Optimization Model for Shared Energy Storage and Multiple PV Prosumers: A Heuristic Algorithm and Stackelberg Game Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of the sharing economy and energy storage technology, the application of shared energy storage has become more and more important. A hierarchical optimization model for shared energy storage and multiple PV prosumers to provide reference ideas for the capacity allocation and pricing issues of shared energy storage operator is proposed in this paper. First, the system framework is introduced, and the role of each subject is analyzed. Next, a stackelberg model between the shared energy storage operator (leader) and multiple PV prosumers (followers) is established. Furthermore, considering the capacity allocation problem of shared energy storage operator, a bi-level optimization model is proposed, in which the upper layer is the capacity allocation problem, and the lower layer is the aforementioned stackelberg model, which can be solved by the heuristic algorithm. Finally, the IPOPT solver is combined on the MATLAB platform to solve the problem, and the situation when the shared energy storage operator cooperates with prosumers is discussed and compared, and it is verified that the advantage of this method in weighing the benefits of shared energy storage operator and prosumers. At the same time, the capacity configuration of shared energy storage is optimized.

articleTitle: Matching Analysis of Synergic Development of the Energy Internet Industry System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The development of the Energy Internet industry system promotes the transformation of the energy industry, which upgrades the traditional energy industry to an industry with dual attributes; that is, energy industry and energy service industry. However, the synergic development of the Energy Internet industry system is confronting challenges on how to achieve synergy. Addressing this literature gap, this study adopts a systems theory perspective and begins with a theoretical review on industrial synergy mode and business synergy tactics. To enable synergic development, this study proposes a matching analytical framework with three dimensions; that is, industrial synergy mode, business synergy tactics, and influential factors. Through in-depth interviews and investigation, we conduct a matching analysis, proposing a three-dimension model and suggesting a matching scheme that, first, the most appropriate industrial synergy mode for the synergic development of the Energy Internet industry system is the industrial ecosphere mode. Second, the selection of business synergy tactics is dependent on the impact of influential factors; that is, while the electric grid business is the “Body” business, leading the “Four Wings” businesses, they have different methods of resource reusability to realize synergy. This study thus contributes to research on the Energy Internet industry system by proposing a direction and guidance to its synergic development.

articleTitle: Object Detection Method Based On Improved SSD Algorithm For Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: SSD (Single Shot Multi-Box Detector) is an object detection algorithm based on deep learning. As one of the most mainstream detection algorithms, it can greatly improve the detection speed and ensure the detection accuracy. In this paper, in order to improve the feature extraction capability of the network and the ability of the algorithm to detect small objects, the CBAM (Convolutional Block Attention Module) is introduced into the SSD network. The improved network uses DIoU (Distance-IoU) instead of IoU (Intersection over Union) in the original network. DIoU is more consistent with the mechanism of target frame regression than IoU. DIoU takes into account the distance between the target and the anchor, the overlap rate, and the scale, so that the target frame regression becomes more stable, and there will be no problems such as divergence during training like IoU and GIoU. The improved SSD algorithm was tested for comparison on the National Grid dataset. The experimental results show that the detection accuracy of the improved SSD algorithm on the test set is increased by 3.3% compared with the original SSD algorithm.

articleTitle: A Data-Driven Method for Electricity Theft Detection Combing ConvGRU and K-means Clustering
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the problem of electricity theft through the tampering of smart meters continues to increase, the anomalous behavior of electricity theft becomes more diversified and is difficult to be detected. Therefore, data-driven methods are needed to detect different types of electricity theft. However, most of the features used in the existing data-driven methods are designed and selected through shallow networks or based on the researchers' prior knowledge, lacking the spatial-temporal feature understanding of electricity consumption data. In this paper, a novel electricity theft detection method based on the convolutional gated recurrent unit (ConvG RU) model is proposed to address the above concerns. In particular, the con-volutional part is applied to extract the spatial features between different user data due to its global perception characteristics, and the G RU part is utilized to learn the internal temporal features of the electricity consumption data series. Besides, K-means clustering is employed as a data preprocessing method combined with the ConvGRU model to improve the detection accuracy. Numerical experiments based on the realistic dataset are conducted to show the satisfactory performance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of the Large-Scale Charging Pile Based on the Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, the existing charging pile detection and evaluation index system only considers the technical indicators, economic indicators, environmental indicators and safety indicators, but ignores the impact of special environmental factors and historical operation data on equipment performance testing, and fails to comprehensively evaluate the performance of charging piles. This paper proposes a charging pile historical maintenance data based on cloud storage, as well as charging pile brand, model, environmental temperature and humidity indexes. The membership degree of each index is solved by the gray cloud model, and then the evaluation score after testing is revised based on the weight value of the AHP analytic hierarchy process of each index. It can improve the accuracy and reliability of the testing of charging piles, and then it can be applied to the testing and evaluation of large-scale charging piles.

articleTitle: Resonance Suppression Method for Multi-Parallel Inverters
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For the resonance problem arising under the parallel operation condition of LCL-type multiple inverters, a multi-inverter grid-connected Norton equivalent model is established, the resonance peak distribution is analyzed, and the effect on system resonance when the number of inverters and system parameters are different is studied. Based on the aforementioned study, an improved active filtering feedback control strategy is proposed. Finally, a parallel model of two inverters is built in matlab/simulink simulation platform to verify the correctness of the theoretical analysis and the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Implementation of Constant Current or Constant Voltage Output Based on Switching Circuit for Battery Charging Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The charging technology based on wireless power transmission technology has a good application prospect. Due to the real-time change of the battery equivalent load and the relative position of the charging coils on both sides, the output current and voltage of the wireless charging system will change, which can not meet the requirements of the constant current or constant voltage charging for the lithium battery. The compensation topology on both sides of the wireless charging system has a decisive impact on the constant current or constant voltage output of the system, but the existing compensation topology has some problems, such as the constant current or constant voltage output and the zero phase of the input impedance can not be realized at the same time, and the constant current or constant voltage output parameters change with the mutual inductance of the coupling coils; In this paper, a hybrid compensation topology based on switching circuit is proposed. Through the topology switching on the secondary side, the constant current or constant voltage output can be realized when the load changes, the zero phase input impedance can be realized in both working modes, and the parameters of the two working modes are independent of the mutual inductance of the coupling coils; The constant current or constant voltage output of wireless charging system can also be realized by phase-shifting control on the primary side when the mutual inductance changes. The simulation results show that the proposed hybrid compensation topology can meet the design requirements.

articleTitle: Development of Temperature Rise Simulation APP for Three-phase Common Enclosure GIS/GIL
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Thermal performance is one of the core properties of three-phase common enclosure GIL, which plays a decisive role in its structural size design and cost. The evaluation of GIL temperature rise performance involves complex electromagnetic-flow-thermal field coupling simulation, which has low modeling efficiency and great difficulty in use and brings difficulties to developers. Considering the skin effect, proximity effect, natural convection, radiation and other influencing factors, a three-phase common enclosure GIL temperature rise simulation model is established and invalidated by four testes. The results show that the maximum temperature rise error is 1.6K. The simulation results show that the skin effect and proximity effect increase the equivalent resistance and power loss of conductor by 33% compared with DC condition. Finally, a highly customized simulation APP is developed, in which users only need to input structural dimensions and material properties parameters so as to avoid the complex modeling process. The actual application results show that the APP can improve the efficiency of pre-processing and post-processing of simulation by more than 20 times and the overall efficiency by more than 10 times.

articleTitle: A Novel Multi-Port Hybrid DC Circuit Breaker for VSC-based DC Grids
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: DC circuit breaker (DCCB) is an essential key equipment to selectively isolate the fault line and ensure continuous and reliable operation of the VSC-based DC grid. The conventional two-port hybrid DC circuit breaker (HCB) has shown excellent performance in fast interruption speed and low conduction loss. However, the considerable construction cost will severely constrain its large-scale application with the expansion of VSC-based DC grid. In order to effectively tackle this problem, a novel multiport hybrid DC circuit breaker (MP-HCB) and its operation principle are proposed in this paper. In the topology of proposed MP-HCB, all ports share the single main breaker (MB) to interrupt the fault current. Besides, all power electronics sub-modules are in the form of the cascaded diode full-bridge module. In addition, the diode valve and IGCT valve are employed to connect the MB and each port to provide the current path under the condition of DC line fault and DC bus fault. By these designs, the total cost of proposed MP-HCB can be significantly reduced, while the excellent performance can be maintained as the two-port HCB. Finally, the effectiveness and applicability of proposed MP-HCB are verified in different fault scenarios based on PSCAD/EMTDC simulations.

articleTitle: Flexible On-grid and Off-grid Control Strategy of Photovoltaic Energy Storage System Based on VSG Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the substantial increase in photovoltaic installed capacity, the proportion of photovoltaic inverters in the power grid has gradually increased. The power system tends to be power electronic, which makes the system lack of inertia, and the power grid is more susceptible to power fluctuations, posing a threat to the safe operation of the power system. The Virtual Synchronous Generator (VSG) technology enables the output of the photovoltaic inverter to simulate the operating characteristics of the synchronous generator, which provides a practical and effective solution to the problem of lack of inertia in the power system. Based on the establishment of the mathematical model of the grid-connected optical storage system, this paper presents a VSG-based inverter parallel-off-grid switching control strategy to realize active-frequency and reactive-voltage regulation. The correctness of the proposed control strategy is verified by simulation. The results show that the PV energy storage system has good power tracking ability, can realize flexible on-grid and off-grid switching. At the same time, the system can provide inertia and damping, and simulate the primary frequency regulation and primary voltage regulation characteristics of synchronous generators to improve system stability.

articleTitle: Scheduling and control of massive electric water heaters based on equivalent energy storage model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Electric water heaters (EWHs) account for large amount of household electricity consumption and EWH power consumption has a high correlation with residential daily load curve. The participation of EWHs in demand response (DR) requires system operators to develop a scheduling model for large amount of EWHs. In this paper, the aggregate EWHs are modeled by the equivalent energy storage (EES) model considering the dynamics of the thermostatically-controlled automatic water mixers (TCAWMs). In addition, the EWHs' ramp characteristic constraint is added into the model, in order to smooth the residential daily load curve. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by testing results.

articleTitle: Digital Twin Based BESS State Estimation and Operating Opimization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Battery energy storage is considered of vital importance for future renewable energy sources based power system. Lithium-ion battery has the potential in the area and now takes the biggest share of the emerging energy storage market. However, the safety and optimal operation of the Li BESS is still a problem both for research and industry. Local BMS and other control methods encountered great difficulties to identify battery charging state and health state. This paper presents a digital twin based BESS state estimation method which utilizes the data storage and computational ability of cloud platform. Therefore, all the real-time data from the scattered BESSs can be aggregated and analyzed for modelling and parameter identification. This provides a more accurate and adjustable modelling solution. The BESS components are analyzed and the corresponding failure modes are given, and the battery state and fault are inspected from the whole system not battery itself. The structure of the digital twin is developed and the operating mechanism is established. Furthermore, the battery model of a series cluster and its SOC and SOH estimation methods are proposed based on the machine learning algorithm. This work provides a useful reference for the safety and reliable BESS.

articleTitle: Research on Trading Strategy of Virtual Power Plant with Distributed Energy Aggregation Based on Cooperative Game
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the extensive grid connection of distributed energy resources (DER) such as wind power and electric vehic les, the traditional centralized regulation method will be difficu lt to meet the flexible regulation needs. As a new organization manager of distributed resources in the regional power grid en vironment, virtual power plant (VPP) has the advantages of fle xible management and free transaction. Therefore, this paper proposes a trading strategy for DERs to participate in VPP bas ed on cooperative game. Firstly, we introduce the working mec hanism of VPP participating in market clearing. Secondly, we build a model considering the power sales revenue of DERs, th e penalty revenue of reducing wind abandonment and power g eneration cost. On this basis, we optimize the collaborative opti mization model of VPP cluster through cooperative game. The n, in order to promote fair distribution, the income distribution strategy is given based on Shapley value. Finally, an example i s analyzed based on the data of the actual energy aggregators. The results of the example show that the model proposed in thi s paper can effectively improve the income of each DER and en sure the stability of the cooperative cluster alliance.

articleTitle: Research on Operation Mode of “Wind-Photovoltaic-Energy Storage-Charging Pile” Smart Microgrid Based on Multi-agent Interaction
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to study the ability of microgrid to absorb renewable energy and stabilize peak and valley load, This paper considers the operation modes of wind power, photovoltaic power, building energy consumption, energy storage, and electric vehicle charging piles under different climatic conditions, and analyzes the modeling and analysis of the “Wind-Photovoltaic-Energy Storage-Charging Pile” microgrid.The analysis of the calculation example shows that when the light conditions are sufficient, the smart microgrid will sell the surplus electric energy that should be sent back to the grid with the charging pile at the contract price, which increases its own income and reduces the operating cost of the charging pile. It also improves the ability of the microgrid to absorb wind and photovoltaics.

articleTitle: Short-Term Electricity Consumption Forecasting Based On Long Short-Term Memory Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: High-precision electricity consumption forecasting can not only ensure the safe and reliable operation of the power system, but also bring considerable economic benefits. Aiming at the contradiction between the demand for high-precision electricity consumption forecasting and the insufficiency of traditional forecasting methods, this paper uses a short-term electricity consumption forecasting model based on long-term short-term memory network (LSTM) to forecast daily electricity consumption on an hourly scale in a Wanda shopping mall in Guangdong. First, analyze the characteristics of the total electricity consumption of the mall to obtain its dominant influence factors. Secondly, the LSTM-based short-term electricity consumption prediction model is used to predict the total electricity consumption of the mall on an hourly scale. At the same time, in order to improve the accuracy of the prediction, the comfortable temperature range and time characteristics are modified in the model. Finally, in order to qualitatively and quantitatively evaluate the effectiveness of the model in this paper, the classic BP and Elman models are selected as comparison benchmarks for comparison experiments. The experimental results show that the prediction model used in this paper has higher prediction accuracy than traditional prediction models.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Online Monitoring Device for Operating State of GIS Isolating Switch Operationg Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: During the inspect of circuit breaker, it is necessary to isolate it with an isolating switch in case of danger to staff. However, lately, there have been many malignant accidents such as the isolating switch operating mechanism broken rod and the isolating switch did not disengage the work. For monitoring the working conditions of the GIS high-voltage isolating switch operating mechanism online, an online monitoring method for the working status of the operating mechanism of disconnector according to the double analysis method of current and angular displacement is proposed to realize online monitoring of the GIS disconnector. It obtains the current value, current-time curve and stroke-time curve of the driving motor during the action process of the GIS isolating switch by using a current transformer and a rotary displacement sensor. Then according to the current value, current-time curve, +5% envelope and the change law of the isolating switch contact stroke-time curve, indirectly judge whether the isolating switch is working normally. That is, it can monitor whether the operating mechanism is jammed, whether the drive motor coil is disconnected, whether the isolation and grounding position are in place, etc. Practical use proves that The device can conduct on-line monitoring for the operating mechanism of the disconnector during operation, and meet the key technology requirements for the construction of the national power grid.

articleTitle: Efficiency Analysis of AA-CAES Based Energy Hub Considering Combined Cooling, Heating and Power
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Advanced adiabatic compressed air energy storage (AA-CAES), with the capability of combined cooling, heating and power, has the potential to meet multiple demands in an efficient and environmentally friendly manner. This paper proposes the output efficiency analysis method from the perspective of energy distribution for the AA-CAES based trigenerative energy hub. The impact of the electrical energy storage rate and air expansion heating rate on different output performances is investigated within the range of energy distribution parameters. Efficiency indicators and maximum output envelop surfaces are visualized to present variation trends under different parametric combinations. Optimal energy distribution coefficients and the corresponding quantities of output energy are also searched for different targets. Case studies verify that the proposed method facilitates realizing higher output efficiencies with energy distribution parameters adjustment under different output demands.

articleTitle: Optimal Operation Strategy of Energy Storage System Considering Wind Uncertainty and Power Market
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Considering the uncertainty of wind power output and the market price of electric energy and frequency modulation auxiliary services, a model is established. The established model adopts a two-stage collaborative operation optimization method. The first stage aims to maximize wind power consumption and lowest cost, and the second stage aims to maximize the profitability of idle energy storage system under the energy market and frequency regulation market. The proposed strategy is obtained through the analysis of the calculation example. The energy storage system not only reduces the fluctuation of new energy and improves the dispatchability and absorption capacity of wind power, but also can increase the operating income in the environment of the energy market and ancillary service. Especially when the price of frequency regulation market is high, it has good economic benefits and reduces the cost recovery period of investment in the energy storage system.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization Method of Cleaning Parameters of Insulator Dry Ice Cleaning Robot
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the influence of natural conditions such as rain and fog, the pillar insulators of substations accumulate a large amount of pollution on their surface to form a pollution layer, which can easily cause pollution flashover and seriously affect the operation safety of the substation. Based on the developed dry ice cleaning robot, this paper uses BP neural network combined with bat optimization algorithm to establish an insulator dry ice cleaning parameter optimization model, and optimizes the cleaning parameters with the goal of meeting the requirements of the cleaning effect and minimizing the consumption of dry ice. By collecting natural pollution A comparison test of the effect of manual pollution cleaning was carried out to confirm the adhesion of the pollution, and the parameters were input to the optimization model to obtain the optimal cleaning parameter combination. Experiments show that the proposed method improves the efficiency and cost-effectiveness of insulator cleaning operations, and has good practical value.

articleTitle: Suppressing Overvoltage by Synchronous Condenser Based on Multiple Renewable Energy Stations Short Circuit Ratio(MRSCR)
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous development of renewable energy, the voltage stability strength of the power system is gradually decreasing. Therefore, installing synchronous condenser in the sending system has become a necessary condition to support the stable operation of the renewable energy access system and solve the problem of renewable energy overvoltage. The multiple renewable energy stations short circuit ratio (MRSCR) can be used to quantify the power grid strength. Aiming at the configuration requirements of the synchronous condenser, this paper analyzes the influence principle of the synchronous condenser on the calculation result of MRSCR based on the negative correlation characteristic between MRSCR and overvoltage. A synchronous condenser configuration method based on the calculation results of MRSCR is proposed to suppress overvoltage. Finally, the simulation verification of the synchronous condenser configuration method is carried out. The simulation results show that the method proposed in this paper can effectively reduce the number of synchronous condenser configuration.

Author Keywords: multiple renewable energy stations short circuit ratio (MRSCR). method of synchronous condenser configuration

articleTitle: Coal-rock Interface Recognition Method Based on GAF-deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of whether the shearer can recognize the coal-rock interface during the mining process, a coal-rock interface recognition method based on Gramian Angular Field (GAF)-deep learning is proposed. First, the vibration signal generated by the shearer in cutting different proportions of coal and rock is the sample information database of different cutting signals. Secondly, using the Gramian Angular Difference Field (GADF) and the Gramian Angular Sum Field (GASF) in the Gram angle field, the vibration signal generated during the cutting process is converted into a 2D image. And the image input is introduced into the ResNet-34 network model of migration learning, and finally the ideal recognition accuracy is obtained, and the classification and recognition of the coal-to-rock ratio of the coal-rock interface is realized. Identifying the coal-rock interface is beneficial to reduce the wear of the shearer picks, reduce the workload of subsequent coal washing and coal preparation, and contribute to the reduction of carbon emissions and the realization of smart mine construction.

Author Keywords: Clean and efficient use of coal

articleTitle: ISCP-Data: A Vehicle-to-grid Dataset For Commercial Center And Its Machine Learning Application
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Vehicle-to-grid (V2G) is an emerging technology for grid stability and environmental protection. However, predicting the unknown data accurately in V2G optimization is difficult. And utilizing the machine learning and big data method for V2G operation becomes a feasible method. Therefore, a vehicle-to-grid dataset for commercial center and its machine learning application are conducted in this paper. Firstly, three categories of datasets, i.e., conventional load data, PV output data and PEV charging data, are selected as the trend of power grid operation. Secondly, a V2G scenario of commercial center is designed, and the maximum values of three parameters were calculated. Next, both the centralized method and the distributed method are used for data annotation. In case study, the dataset is applied through a variety of machine learning methods. The results show that the accuracy of V2G prediction is up to 94%.

articleTitle: Dynamic Stability Analysis and Improved Control Strategy of DFIG System during LVRT
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the impedance of grid increasing, the risk of interaction between rotor-side current controller loop (RCC) and the phase-locked loop become bigger. The dynamic stability problem of the doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) have become increasingly prominent. Especially inappropriate controller parameters will further induce dynamic instability during low-voltage ride-through (LVRT). Based on the harmonic linearization method, the output impedance model of the DFIG system which consider PLL and internal controller is derived. Then, the interaction degree of the controllers is analyzed under different controller parameters. Moreover, a virtual impedance control method is proposed, which just controls input three phase voltage of PLL, the internal controller parameters and structure are not affected. Finally, the robustness of the proposed method is explored under different rotor speed and voltage dip degree.

articleTitle: Analysis of Cyber Attacks on Wind Power Generation Systems in Damping Inter-area Oscillations of Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the application of damping controllers developed using remote feedback signals provided by phasor measurement unit (PMU) and wida-area measurement system (WAMS), the wind power generation system (WPGS) can damp the inter-area oscillations of power system. Nevertheless, the damping control system of WPGS may suffer from malicious cyber attacks, which will deteriorate the performance of WPGS and even destabilize the power system operation. This paper considers the various types of cyber attacks, including false data injection attack (FDIA), time-delay attack (TDA), denial of service (DoS) attack, coordinated cyber-physical attack (CCPA), and analyzes the effects of these cyber attacks on WPGS in damping inter-area oscillations of power system. Simulation studies are carried out on a two-area four-machine power system integrated with WPGS to investigate the cyber security of WPGS.

articleTitle: Average-Value-Based Integrated Induction Machine-Rotor Side Converter System Model in EMTP-type Programs
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, an average-value-based IM-RSC model is proposed based on a modified phase domain machine model and the average-value based converter model. The system conductance matrix for the proposed model becomes constant due to the parameter and space symmetry of the rotor windings, consequently, the simulation efficiency is improved significantly. Besides, the AC- and DC- circuits of the proposed model are decoupled by using one time-step delay to avoid the prediction of rotor voltages. The time-delay can be ignored when using sufficiently small integration time step, while a prediction of electrical variables is applied to enhance accuracy for simulations using large integration time-steps. A study case for DFIG system, which embeds the proposed IM-RSC model, is created in an EMTP-type program, and a same case is built using detailed switch model and qd- induction model in PSCAD. Simulation results compared with PSCAD show that the proposed model maintains good accuracy during both slow and fast transient studies. In addition, it shows more efficient than the detailed models.

articleTitle: Microgrid Energy Management using Improved Reinforcement Learning with Quadratic Programming
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a reinforcement learning (RL)-based algorithm is proposed to study the economic dispatch for a grid-connected microgrid (MG) with renewable energy resources (RES), diesel generator (DG), energy storage system (ESS) and electric vehicles (EVs). Multiple uncertainties such as intermittence of renewable power generations, fluctuations of load consumptions and randomness of real-time electricity price bring great challenges to the stable and efficient operation of MG. Focusing on the economic dispatch problem of MG, we propose improved reinforcement learning which can reduce the difficulty of searching for the optimal action of reinforcement learning in complex operation patterns through combining deep reinforcement learning (DRL) and quadratic programming. The proposed solution is learning-based and does not require an explicit model of MG with multiple uncertainties. A detailed simulation study is carried out with actual data, and the performance is compared with other DRL algorithms. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in both deterministic and uncertain environments.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Scheduling of RIES Based on Incentive Integrated Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Integrated demand response (IDR) and energy storage equipment are important in the context of global energy internet. The two factors can optimize the accommodation capacity of renewable energy, improve the level of peak load shifting, and make the operation of power system more economical. The regional integrated energy system (RIES) has developed strong research value after the concept of integrated energy system has been put forward. Firstly, the RIES model, including the dimension of renewable energy, energy conversion equipment, energy storage equipment and multi energy load, is established. Secondly, the load can be categorized into fixed load, reducible load, transferable load and replaceable load. Taking the lowest total operating cost of RIES as the objective function, an incentive integrated demand response scheduling strategy is proposed. Taking an industrial park in China as an example, the model is solved by using CPLEX with YALMIP. The result indicates that the scheduling strategy proposed in this paper can not only realize the peak load shifting, but also gain better economic benefits.

articleTitle: Study on the Standard Calculation Model of Power Demand Response Incentive Subsidy Based on Master-Slave Game
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the incentive subsidy standard of power demand response based on master-slave game, this paper const ructs a measurement model. Based on the qualitative analysis o f the influencing factors of power demand response incentive su bsidy mechanism, a standard calculation model of power dema nd response incentive subsidy based on the master-slave game between power grid companies and multiple users is establishe d, and the validity of the model is verified by numerical exampl e analysis.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Power Flow Calculation Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid advancement of modern power system reform and the popularization of large power grid system and supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) system, data-driven method has become a new field in power system research. Aiming at the problem that the traditional power flow calculation method cannot update the system operation status in real time due to the real-time change of power system topology, this paper proposes a data-driven power flow calculation method based on deep neural network. The calculation results are compared with Newton's method and PQ decomposition method. The results show that this method is superior to the above traditional algorithms in accuracy and calculation time.

articleTitle: Ultra-short-term Photovoltaic Power Prediction Based on Elman Neural Network and Satellite Cloud Images
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Solar photovoltaic (PV) power generation has developed rapidly in recent years due to its clean and pollution-free characteristics. However, the variability of weather makes PV power generation very volatile and random, which brings challenges to the planning and operation of the existing power system. Therefore, accurate prediction of PV power generation is of great significance to improving the reliability of power system operation. This paper proposes a PV power prediction model based on Elman neural network and gray value extraction method of satellite cloud images, which effectively utilizes weather pattern and improves the accuracy of PV power prediction. Firstly, the satellite cloud image is grayed to get the gray value, and the gray value interval is clustered. Then the clustering result is used as the input of Elman neural network to build the PV power prediction model. Finally, the actual data are used to analyze the calculation example. The simulation results show that the optimization model after adding the gray value information of the satellite cloud image is more accurate than the original model. The relative coefficient of variation (RCV) is reduced from 5.42 % to 4.01 %, and the accuracy is increased by 1.41%. It provides a reference for using satellite cloud images to predict PV power generation.

articleTitle: Revenues Allocation Model and Evaluation Method for Joint Transaction of Wind-Thermal Power Generation Rights Based on Cooperative Game
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of abundant wind energy resources but insufficient consumption in some areas, this paper proposes a joint transaction model of wind-thermal power generation rights based on cooperative game theory. Three allocation strategies: the nucleolar method, Shapley value method, and the equal modified disruption propensity (MDP) method, are used to allocate the revenues of each power generation enterprise after cooperation. MDP index of three allocation strategies is compared in case study, and then the technique for order preference by similarity to ideal solution (TOPSIS) comprehensive evaluation method is used to calculate the relative satisfaction of the three allocation strategies. Result shows that each power generation enterprise is more willing to accept the distribution of revenues by the equal MDP method allocation strategy. The joint transaction of wind-thermal power generation rights can effectively promote the consumption of wind power, and also bring additional benefits to power generation enterprises.

articleTitle: Symmetrical Semidefinite Programming with Bifurcation Phase-Changing SOPs for Unbalanced Power Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The integration of unstable and/or uneven single-phase renewable distributed generation (DG) exacerbates the network imbalance problem. These unbalanced situations lead to financial losses, wasteful asset utilisation, and security haz-ards to network infrastructure. In this paper, a new phase-changing soft open point (PC-SOP) with bifurcation connection is proposed to allow various single-phase connections in three-wire systems. Then for three-phase unbalanced systems, operational strategies based on various cases are outlined. The optimal strategy for reducing power losses and three-phase imbalance can be identified by optimizing the regulation of SOPs and DG curtailment. The relaxation method of symmetrical semidefinite programming (SDP) is then used to adapt the initial non-convex nonlinear model into an SDP model that can be solved effectively by commercial solvers. Case studies are carried out on an IEEE 13-node three-phase system to validate the efficacy and efficiency of the presented SOP solutions and their operational strategy,

articleTitle: Static Stability Analysis of Integrated Electricity and Gas System Considering Voltage and Pressure
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The increasing strengthening of linkage between electric power system (EPS) and natural gas system (NGS) has brought great challenges to the security and stability of Integrated Electricity and Gas System (IEGS). In this paper, a steady-state multi-energy flow model with an ideal Energy Hub is presented. Then, the concept of static voltage stability in power system is further extended to the static stability of IEGS considering the voltage and gas-pressure restrictions. Based on the concept, a continuous multi-energy flow (CMEF) calculation method is developed to determine the static stability margin of IEGS. Finally, a case study of IEGS coupled by 2 natural gas-fired generators units (NGUs) is employed to analyze the effects of increasing power load in (EPS) to the static stability of IEGS. The results show that static stability margin varies according to the power generation plan of two NGUs.

articleTitle: Planning Model for Electric Vehicle Charging Station Considering Battery Capacity
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To support the orderly growth of the electric car sector, proper planning of electric vehicle charging stations is critical. In this study, an optimization model of electric car charging station design is constructed using the minimal yearly cost as the object function, taking the restrictions of charging capacity and investment into account. To guarantee that the planning outputs are more consistent with the EV constraint, the battery capacity constraint considering EV's own factors is utilized to replace the service radius limitation. The case study demonstrates that the technique provided in this work is both practical and scientific, and that it can be used to plan electric car charging stations.

articleTitle: Calculation, Measurement And Engineering Application Of Loop Closing Current In Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of inaccuracy of power grid operation parameters, inaccuracy of loop closing current calculation and phase angle difference measurement, firstly this paper analyzes the influencing factors of loop closing current, proposes a steady state loop closing current evaluation method based on power flow superposition, and next gives the corresponding relationship between steady state loop closing current and transient loop closing current. Using the data of maximum load section for Beijing power grid in 2020, this paper expounds the selection method of equivalent impedance and the calculation method of closing loop current, and then applies 5G measurement terminals to realize the collection of the phase angle difference and analysis of the closing loop current. Lastly, it carries out the demonstration application in the cross region closing loop point of Beijing substation. Through the phase angle difference analysis and closing loop current calculation, it improves the accuracy of the company's regulators to judge whether the system can carry out closing loop operation according to the operation experience.

articleTitle: Real-Time Recursive Correction State Estimation Utilizing Only SCADA Measurements
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a high-efficient recursive correction state estimation method is proposed for the real-time tracking of power system states. Here, both the field timing measurements and trigger measurements from supervisory control and data acquisition systems are considered. In this regard, timing measurements are processed by a conventional batch mode estimator, while trigger measurements are processed in a novel continuous-data-stream manner, which enables the high refresh rate update of power system states. Each type of measurement runs its own state estimation in parallel, and only the estimated results are exchanged with each other. Extensive numerical results involving several IEEE standard systems validate the timeliness, accuracy, and robustness of the proposed state estimation method.

articleTitle: A Novel Fault Location Method for High Impedance Grounding Fault in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: It's difficult to detect high impedance grounding fault due to the low fault current and intermittent process. In this paper, a fault detection and location method based on zero-sequence power correlation coefficient is proposed. First, according to the analysis of zero-sequence fault current and voltage, the zero-sequence power direction of fault lines are opposite to the zero-sequence power direction of healthy lines. Then, according to the fault characteristics difference of zero-sequence power between fault and healthy lines, the correlation coefficient of zero-sequence power is proposed to discriminate the fault line. Finally, the proposed method is validated by the simulations using PSCAD and MATLAB. The results indicate that the proposed method can locate the high impedance grounding fault lines and is slightly affected by the transition resistances.

articleTitle: A DC-collector Topology and Its Application for Wave Energy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Wave energy is a applicable renewable energy in ocean for electric supply. The DC integration is a significant way for application and transmission of wave energy. A DC collector and its control strategy for wave energy application are proposed in this paper. The DC collector can adapt heavy fluctuation voltage operation by permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM). But also, the wave PMSM operation mode can be modified by the submodule of DC collector. Furthermore, the submodule and control are independent. The corresponding control is also independent. Thus, unbalance voltage problem in series constructure is avoid, and the voltages of DC collector and submodules can be ensured stability and smooth. The simulation results validate the control strategy.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Synchronous Generators Reactive Power Output During Transient Process
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the insufficient short-term voltage security margin of many large scale receiving-end power grids in China, it is necessary to install new dynamic reactive power devices or increase the dynamic reactive power reserve of the system by adjusting the operating point of different devices. However, the actual reactive power output of the generators during transient process may not be related to the dynamic reactive power reserve. Besides, the common method can't explain the mechanism of the transient reactive power output. Therefore, based on the mathematical model of synchronous generators, we derive the analytical expression of the reactive power output during the transient process, and then establish the relationship between the steady-state operation conditions and the transient reactive power output. Next we analyze the impact of some key parameters on generator transient reactive power output. Finally, simulation is conducted based on the IEEE 39-bus system, which verifies the correctness and effectiveness of the evaluation method and the conclusions drawn in this paper.

articleTitle: Two Stage Deep Peak Regulation Ancillary Service Market Clearing Model Considering Virtual Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Renewable energy such as wind power and photovoltaics integrated to the power grid have brought challenges to deep peak regulation. In order to address the deep peak regulation problem, virtual power plants (VPP) are proposed to provide with deep peak regulation ancillary service. This paper designs the deep peak regulation ancillary service market mechanism considering participation of VPPs. The thermal power units and VPPs are proposed to participate jointly in the deep peak regulation ancillary service market. Two stage deep peak regulation ancillary service market clearing model are established, the day-ahead clearing model and the real-time clearing model. The deep peak regulation ancillary service market adopts the marginal clearing method. The thermal power units and VPPs can obtain profits by actual deep peak regulation capacity and clearing price. Finally, the case analysis show that the proposed market mechanism is effective and the economy of deep peak regulation is significantly improved.

articleTitle: Bitcoin Mining Recognition Based on Community Detection with Electricity Consumption Data
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the aim of bitcoin mining recognition, a method based on community detection is built with small sample of Sichuan daily bitcoin mining electricity consumption data. The method precisely categorizes Sichuan bitcoin mining entities according to their electricity consumption patterns. It is found that Sichuan bitcoin mining activity is strongly featured with seasonality and highly correlated with local hydropower generation. Such a discovery is a key not only to explaining the characteristics of the electricity consumption curves, but also to extending the method summarized from Sichuan case to other provinces. In practice, from Xinjiang power-intensive consumers, suspicious bitcoin miners are detected with the method and their mining activity is found to be correlated with local wind power generation. It is inferred that difficulty in green power utilization during the abundant period results in low electricity price which attracts bitcoin mining activity. By comparing the electricity consumption curves of Sichuan and Xinjiang (suspicious) bitcoin mining entities, a character of peak-valley complementation in temporal distribution implies a nomad electricity consumption of the miners, which could be influential to green power utilization as well as power transmission and distribution.

articleTitle: Conditional Mutual Information Based Interpretable Key Feature Selection Method for Power System Security Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As more and more renewable energy and high voltage direct current devices have been introduced into power system, it becomes extremely complex compared to the traditional one. In order to evaluate the stability of the power system, the most instinct way is to extract and analyze the key features that can represent the stability status most. However, human feature engineering alone is not enough to select all the key features from a large number of candidate features. Therefore, it is necessary to use advanced key feature selection methods to extract the key features of power system. The paper proposes a feature selection method based on conditional mutual information, which takes the pre-selected key features and transient stability knowledge as information seeds to find other complementary key features. The experimental results show that the proposed method has high prediction accuracy compared to the feature selection method using traditional filtering metric.
