Then, the optimal operation mode model of IES is established, including the economic optimization operation mode, environmental protection optimization operation mode and energy saving optimization operation mode model. Secondly, the optimal operation mode of IES is evaluated based on AHP comprehensive evaluation. The process includes establishing the hierarchical structure model of IES, constructing the comprehensive evaluation judgment matrix of IES, single ranking and consistency test of IES level, general ranking and consistency test of IES level. Finally, an example is given to verify the effectiveness, practicability and rationality of the proposed comprehensive evaluation strategy. The results show that the proposed comprehensive evaluation strategy can effectively evaluate the optimal operation mode of the IES, and can provide theoretical guidance for the optimal operation mode.

articleTitle: Direct Thermal Load Control in Active Distribution Networks Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the growth of electrical power consumption in the tertiary industry, the proportion of building thermal load is increasing significantly. On the demand side, load aggregators attempt to realize peak shifting by direct active power control of heating ventilation and air-conditioning (HVAC) devices. However, the difficulty in establishing accurate physical models of HVAC equipment has limited the performance of model-based optimization methods. Recently, deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has been widely studied and trusted to achieve optimal decisions without priori knowledge on the environment. In this paper, a DRL-based building thermal load control method is proposed to provide the auxiliary service of load shifting under the premise of thermal comfort. A resistor-capacitor model is introduced to describe the thermodynamics of exterior protection structure, and the regulation behavior is formulated into a Markov decision process. Then, an augmented algorithm called improved deep deterministic policy gradient (iDDPG) is proposed with high sample efficiency. Comprehensive numerical simulations are conducted to verify the feasibility and superiority of the proposed method. The results have supported the effectiveness of iDDPG in maximizing thermal comfort, optimizing peak shifting effect and reducing network loss.

articleTitle: Carbon-oriented Local Integrated Energy System Multi-energy Coupling Market Design
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the background that countries all over the world constantly advocate energy conservation and emission reduction and seek to deepen the reform of power systems and introduce new energy trading policies, this study constructed a carbon-oriented local integrated energy system multi-energy coupling market architecture. This construct was aimed at problems that current multi-energy coupling market research has not considered, including multi-energy substitution characteristics and carbon emission factors. First, taking the local integrated energy system as the main physical architecture, a multi-energy coupling market architecture was constructed combining the main market participants of different energy subsystems. Second, a model of the subsystem markets in the energy coupling market, and the joint clearing method were proposed. Finally, the guiding role of the energy coupling market was analyzed by simulation for reasonable pricing and carbon emission reductions of different energy market operators.

articleTitle: Research on the Distribution Efficiency of Green Certificates in China Based on DEA Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a measure of the efficiency of the green certificate market, and then selects the input and output efficiency evaluation data indicators, uses DEA-BCC model to measure the operating efficiency of the green certificate market in China's 7 provinces from 2017 to 2018. The results show that in the 7 regions analyzed, the green certificate market has not yet fully reached the state of DEA efficiency, and the green certificate market is not yet fully effective. The lower technical level, unreasonable quota standards, and higher green certificate prices hinder Effective operation of the market. Due to the decline of technological progress, the overall efficiency showed a downward trend from 2017 to 2018. Each green certificate market should adjust the quota standards to improve operational efficiency.

articleTitle: Robust Coordinated Operation of an Integrated Electricity-Heat System With Multi-Energy Microgrids Considering Uncertain Interactive Power
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The uncertainty of interactive power between the integrated electricity-heat system (IEHS) and multi-energy microgrids (MEMGs) can cause economic and security problems. In this regard, this paper proposes a coordinated and robust operation strategy of IEHS with MEMGs based on Stackelberg game and two-stage robust optimization. Firstly, a deterministic two-layer optimization model for coordinated operation is established based on Stackelberg game theory, and linearization techniques such as KKT optimality condition and binary expansion method are applied to convert the two-layer model into an easily solvable mathematic program with equilibrium constraints. After that, a two-stage robust optimization model is established considering the uncertainty deviation of the interactive power of the scheduled and actual values, with the first stage being the coordinated day-ahead scheduling under the expected scenario and the second stage being the feasibility check of the intra-day safe operation under the worst-case scenario. Subsequently, the feedback of the worst-case scenario in the second stage is improved for the uncertainty set of the interactive power, and the adjustment constraint of the interactive power is added in the first stage. Finally, the nested C&CG algorithm is used to solve this optimization problem. The case studies verify the effectiveness of the proposed method for robust coordinated operation of IEHS with MEMGs.

articleTitle: Control Method of Electric Vehicle Virtual Energy Storage Participating in Power Grid Peak Shaving Based on Predictive Modeling
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The electric vehicle virtual energy storage (EVVES) can play the role of peak shaving, frequency modulation, tracking renewable energy output, and as a backup power source for the power grid. This paper addresses the available capacity of EVVES. Forecasting for research. According to different working modes of electric vehicles, electric vehicles are classified into different time periods in a day. On this basis, the minimum remaining capacity of electric vehicle battery, the remaining capacity of spare travel, and the daily mileage are considered. The control model of electric vehicle virtual energy storage participating in power grid peak shaving is established. In order to verify the effectiveness of the model, two optimization algorithms are used to solve the model. The virtual energy storage capacity of electric vehicle is obtained by prediction, and the simulation is carried out combined with the load operation data of a regional power grid. In addition, the economic feasibility of virtual energy storage system is studied and the stakeholders are analyzed. It provides an essential support for EVVES to participate in the network side of the service.

articleTitle: Research of Additional Loss in 10kv Distribution Network Under Complex Power Quality Disturbances
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy saving and consumption reduction is one of the important means for power supply enterprises to improve their economic efficiency. However, with the widespread access of distributed generation and non-linear loads, the power quality problems make it difficult to neglect the additional losses in the distribution network. Firstly, the additional loss caused by three-phase unbalance is theoretically derived; secondly, according to the superposition principle, the formula for calculating the additional loss generated by distribution line and transformer when harmonics exist alone is derived; then the formula for calculating the additional loss of each part when the two are considered together is derived. Finally, the losses of the line and distribution transformer are simulated for each case by using the Matlab platform. The results show that the theoretical derivation is in good agreement with the simulation results.

articleTitle: Privacy-preserving Voltage Consensus Control for Heterogeneous Energy Storage Systems in Islanded Microgrids Based on Virtual Node Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of microgrids (MGs), the level of terminal intelligence is gradually improving. Although the data processing and autonomous decision-making capabilities of the terminal have been greatly improved, the likelihood of terminal information being disclosed to its adversary also increases. To solve this problem, this paper investigates the voltage restoration for energy storage systems (ESSs) in an islanded AC microgrid as the object to study the distributed privacy preserving consensus strategy for MGs, and this method can be easily extended to other research objects. Firstly, considering the effect of droop coefficients, the model of the ESSs is considered as a linear heterogeneous multiagent system (MAS) model. Furthermore, virtual node mechanism, which avoids divulging the initial condition by inserting a virtual node associated with the real node to communicate with others instead of the real node, is adopted to make the output voltage of energy storage (ES) agents exactly converge to the reference value. It should be noted that the information flow between each pair nodes is directed and only from virtual node to the real one. After that, we carry out the consensus analysis and privacy-preservation of the controlled system. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed control scheme is validated in the MATLAB/Simulink environment.

articleTitle: Carbon Trading Based Short-Term Production Simulation of Wind Power Integrated System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the background of low-carbon economy, wind power has become an important force in promoting the low-carbon development of electricity and has received widespread attention. However, the uncertainty of wind power brings new costs such as additional reserve capacity costs, balancing costs to the operation of power system, which weakens the market competitiveness of wind power. This paper redefines the short-term electricity cost composition from the perspective of low-carbon economy, and applies stochastic programming theory to propose a short-term production simulation model for wind power integrated system. The model aims to minimize the expected cost of electricity production in short-term time scale, coordinately optimize the day-ahead power output, real-time power output, power reserve capacity, wind spillage and load shedding. Simulation results of the modified IEEE 30-bus system show that the proposed model can effectively quantify and evaluate the impact of carbon trading mechanism, carbon trading price, and wind power installed capacity on electricity costs, carbon emission reduction and operation risks.

articleTitle: “Energy Red Packet” Incentive-based Bidding Mechanism and Its Benefit Sharing in the Transactive Energy Market
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to accommodate redundant renewable energy during load valley periods within an industrial park, this paper proposes the “energy red packet” incentive-based bidding mechanism to strategically motivate industrial electric power and heat consumers to get demand response autonomously. A benefit sharing mechanism is designed based on the Shapley value method to give participants bonuses regarding their contribution to the system cost savings within the industrial park. A realistic case in China is studied to verify that the proposed mechanisms are able to utilize resources most efficiently and give the DR participants their bonuses allocated in a fair manner.

articleTitle: Principle and Implementation of Networked Protection in Active Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The performance of conventional protections has deteriorated in active distribution networks (ADN) because of high penetration of distributed generator (DG) and solid state transformer (SST). In this paper, based on the features of short-circuit current fed by DG and SST, the current distribution characteristics of ADN are analyzed. Moreover, a networked protection scheme is proposed for ADN. This scheme compares the amplitudes of negative-sequence, zero-sequence and phase currents between different ports of grid component to realize fault identification. It can act rapidly and has the ability to cope with large transition resistance. Communication system only needs to transmit current amplitude, and synchronous sampling is not required. In addition, there is no requirement for voltage measurement, which will help to reduce cost. The effectiveness of the protection scheme is verified via simulation tests.

articleTitle: Non-intrusive television recognition based on harmonic current characteristics
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Non-intrusive load monitoring (NILM) is an effective means to realize detailed user energy monitoring. As a kind of appliances which is widely used and can intuitively reflect the user's behavior, the recognition of television (TV) is of great significance for NILM application. However, it is often difficult to recognize TV in the aggregated load data because of its relatively poor power-range distinction and complex power consumption characteristics. In this paper, the harmonic current characteristics or the fundamental-third harmonic current space trajectory is analyzed, and they are combined with the random power fluctuation characteristics during TV operation and other prior knowledge as multi-dimensional load signatures of TV. Based on this, an unsupervised non-intrusive TV recognition framework and method is proposed. Experimental analysis on collected real-world dataset shows that the proposed method can detect and recognize TV with fluctuating operation characteristics accurately and effectively.

articleTitle: Investment Evaluation Index System for Pilot Projects of Incremental Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the deepening of the reform of electric power system, in order to accurately evaluate business of incremental power distribution, this paper proposes a preliminary comprehensive investment evaluation index system about incremental distribution network. Firstly, the constructing principles for investment evaluation system about incremental distribution network should be analyzed. Then, the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) and the Delphi method are used to construct the evaluation index system for investment about incremental distribution network. Furthermore, this paper introduces how to use the AHP determine the weight value of each indicator. Finally, relevant suggestions could be given for the sake of providing strategic decision support for the construction, investment and operation of the incremental distribution network for grid companies, and to further promote the overall stable development of the power market.

articleTitle: Influence of Distributed Generation and Demand Response on Security Region for Active Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The urban power grid is becoming active, clean and smart and the operating conditions is becoming complicated. Security region is a new theory for distribution system dispatching and operating. This paper focuses on the distribution system security region (DSSR), considering two main elements, which are distributed generation (DG) and demand response (DR). Firstly, the features of security operating of distribution systems with DG and DR are discussed then the DSSR with DG and DR is modeled. The DSSR visualized sections are observed on the case studies and the influence mechanism of DG and DR on DSSR is proposed. According to this, the suggestions for the distribution system planning and operating is proposed. The DSSR in this paper would be a useful tool of the security monitoring and analysis for urban power grids, in which the user load service is more important than the service of DG and DR.

articleTitle: Design of Adaptive Power Distribution Protocol Conversion System based on MQTT Cloud Edge Interaction
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of the power Internet of Things, more and more intelligent terminals in the power scene need to interact with users for information. Building a standard information physical model to realize the unified access of multi-source and heterogeneous terminals is a major problem faced by the construction of the electric Internet of Things. Based on MQTT's good adaptability to the Internet of Things and Docker's cross-platform, this paper designs a system for adaptive conversion of power distribution protocol based on the Internet of Things management platform. Firstly, the frame structure of distribution specification is analyzed and the process of protocol adaptive recognition and analysis adopted by the system is explained. Then, it describes the interaction function of the cloud controller and the side controller docking Roma platform and Docker engine, analyzes the call method of Roma platform based on HPPTS protocol to the north API and Docker API, and explains the Pub/Sub model based on MQTT protocol. And how the platform and devices communicate based on a custom Topic. The cloud edge interaction between controller and controller completes the interface call and system implementation of adaptive protocol transformation. It has completed the test and verification of the adaptive conversion system of power distribution protocol in Hunan Communication Laboratory, which provides an open IoT platform for the power IoT system of Hunan Province, and provides important guidance for the construction of a set of intelligent cloud edge system in Hunan Province. It is of great significance for the construction and promotion of the power IoT system of Hunan Province.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Based Sameness Recognition Method for Power System Management Information
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: State Grid Corporation's power construction project information comes from multiple regions and different scale power construction sub-project, and there are missing fillings and irregularities, which makes supervision difficult, and brings difficulties in project acceptance and management. Based on the random forest algorithm, our work proposes a sameness analysis method of engineering problem description text, and realizes the task of automatic classification of engineering defects. This work first defines the concept of sameness recognition in power construction project, and performs Chinese word segmentation on the problem description text in the engineering information data set after the standardized processing. Then, this work constructs a feature vector space. By implementing random forest algorithm, this work conducts sameness analysis and defect classification on the construction problem text, and proves the effect of the method proposed in this work through case analysis.

articleTitle: Graph Based Storage and Analysis of Secondary Circuits in Smart Substation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of substation automation, the number of secondary equipment has risen sharply, which lead to a more complicated network topology, and the difficulty to manage and analysis of secondary circuits quickly and accurately. In order to improve the semantic richness and visualization level of secondary circuits in smart substations, a graph-based smart substation secondary circuits storage and analysis method is proposed. According to the substation configuration description language (SCL), a representation of SCL based on property graph model is proposed. Based on graph model, the information in substation configuration description (SCD) file is then mapped to graph database. In order to improve the completeness of graph database, entity resolution and relationship completion are implemented. In application, a typical 220kV smart substation file is used to construct a complete graph database and then it is employed to create and visualize secondary circuits of the substation. The performance test results show that graph database is more efficient and stable in different query tasks.

articleTitle: Optimal Energy Storage Allocation and Benefit Analysis for Electricity Retailers
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the further open of the electricity market, the electricity retailers often need to configure appropriate amount of energy storage to reduce the operation cost. In order to solve this problem, an energy storage capacity optimization model is proposed to minimize the operation cost of the electricity retailers under the participation of multiple flexible resources. The adjustable resources and operation cost of the electricity retailer is analyzed. And the economic model of energy storage allocation for the electricity retailer is built based on the life cycle cost. In order to solve the sequential decision-making model, the Soft Actor Critic algorithm (SAC) is used to find the optimal storage capacity allocation for electricity retailer based on grid search. Finally, the proposed model is verified by various simulations.

articleTitle: A Photovoltaic Array State Evaluation Method Based on Combined Weight and MCMC
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the operating environment of photovoltaic arrays is complex and the operating status affects its power generation efficiency and service life, a new method based on combined weight and Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) dynamic simulation is proposed used to evaluate the status of photovoltaic arrays. Firstly, the failure probability about evaluation system of photovoltaic module string units is constructed under the premise of considering the impact of environmental factors on the evaluation indicators, combined with the G 1 method and entropy weight method to combine the weights of the evaluation indicators and obtain the failure probability of photovoltaic modules string unit. Then by establishing the relationship between random variables and evaluation indicators, using MCMC to simulate the state of the photovoltaic array. The simulation results show that the method can accurately reflect the operating status of the photovoltaic array, identify abnormal arrays and give early warnings in time, which can provide a reference for the intelligent maintenance of photovoltaic arrays.

articleTitle: Optimal Configuration of Off-Grid Microgrid Considering the Uncertainty of Photovoltaic Power Generation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Off-grid microgrid can effectively solve the power supply problems in remote and underdeveloped areas, but the current research on microgrid mainly focuses on the grid-connected mode, while the research on off-grid mode is less. Aiming at the uncertainty of photovoltaic power generation influenced by seasonal weather and other factors, this paper establishes an economic mathematical model aiming at minimizing the weighted sum of each cost of five types of distributed generation. One year's load, temperature and illumination data in a certain area were cut down to obtain 12 typical daily scene data. Then, YALMIP toolbox was called through MATLAB software and CPLEX solver was used to solve the results. Finally, the results were analyzed and compared to verify that the proposed model and constraints had certain significance.

articleTitle: Improved Atom Search Optimizer of Offshore Wind Power for Fault Ride-through Capability Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper designs an improved atom search optimizer (IASO) to enhance the fault ride-through (FRT) ability of offshore wind power. Based on the proposed IASO, the Euclidian distance ratio of original atom search optimizer (ASO) is adopted to realize dynamical update with iterations. It can effectively and efficiently acquire a proper trade-off between global exploration and local exploitation based on the repulsion and attraction intensities variation among various atoms. Then, IASO is adopted for optimal tuning of PID control parameters of doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) in offshore wind farm to enhance its FRT capability, which is of great importance to assure a stable and reliable operation under diverse faults scenarios. Case studies under Matlab/Simulink environment are carried out to validate its specific performance compared against that of the other well-known meta-heuristic methods, namely, particle swarm optimizer (PSO).

articleTitle: The Future of GB Electricity Supply: Carbon Neutral Impact on Electricity Wholesale Price
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Decarbonizing the energy system to emit fewer GHGs is vital for reducing the extent of global climate change. UK National Grid has outlined two credible energy future scenarios to describe how to establish a net-zero carbon emission power system by 2050, but did not analyze the purposed system impact on the wholesale price. This paper addressed a merit order stack (MOS) model to demonstrate the spread and volatility of hourly wholesale prices. The model involves not only different generation types but also battery storage and interconnections between the UK and other countries. Case studies are conducted in two net zero scenarios, with four typical weeks so that each one represents one season. Numerical simulation results show that in one net zero scenario, the community renewable, the wholesale electricity price will largely be driven by renewables but also impact by nuclear and EU interconnections. It even seems possible to only use wind power to balance the UK national demand for few hours in winter. In other seasons, this scenario requests electricity importation from the European continent to balance the load. In another scenario Two Degree, the existence of gas CCS technology could reduce carbon emissions, leading to a lower short-term marginal cost, therefore the wholesale price often equals the marginal cost of gas CCS or imported electricity price from Europe no matter which season. But the price could rise to higher level if wind power shortages occur.

articleTitle: Virtual Energy Storage Control Method of Electrolytic Aluminum Park Based on Production Data Driven
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, Chinese electrolytic aluminum industry has developed rapidly. Electrolytic aluminum load consumes a lot of power and has a great potential of demand side response. Aiming at the problems of low inertia of isolated power grid system and weak wind power consumption capacity, this paper proposes a virtual energy storage control method based on production data driven in electrolytic aluminum park. The scheme determines the virtual droop control based on production operation state by analyzing the state of charge of energy storage equipment in industrial park and the production process of electrolytic aluminum load in industrial park, The effectiveness of the proposed control method is verified based on SFR model.

articleTitle: An Edge Gateway Communication Load Balancing Method considering Service Timing Logic in Distribution Area
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to reduce network congestion and improve the edge layer network access capability and edge gateway data transmission capability, the problem of insufficient communication access network bandwidth resources and unbalanced container communication load caused by massive data edge convergence transmission is solved. Considering the high concurrency of service timing logic and real-time data transmission in service distribution platform area, this paper proposes a communication resource scheduling algorithm based on container architecture under multi-mode transmission. While reducing the real-time data transmission delay, the load capacity of the edge layer communication access network is improved, and the load balancing of the northbound interface multi-module data link is realized. In this paper, the topology structure and data transmission mode of the distributed device monitoring network based on the “end-edge-cloud” architecture are firstly explained, and the related channel parameters are given. Then, in the process of simulation and modeling of communication system, a double-tank equivalent model based on queuing theory is used, and the feedback control method is used to control the transmission system. The experimental simulation results show that the adaptive tracking optimization algorithm as the edge container communication load balancing algorithm can effectively reduce the transmission delay, adapt to the distribution service timing and logic constraints, and have a good load balancing effect.

articleTitle: Review of the Application of Urban Multi-Source Big Data in Power System in China
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Against the background of smart energy construction, the data analysis of multi-source big data in various fields of cities based on the power system will bring new possibilities for the analysis of urban energy utilization and further promote the planning and construction of smart cities. Based on the application status of power big data and multi-source big data from various fields in power systems, this paper discusses the development trend and difficulties difficulty of urban multi-source big data in power system construction and application. First, the strategic significance of big data technology to the construction of smart energy is analyzed from the perspective of the power grid and the perspective of energy-using customers. Secondly, the application scenarios of data in various fields in power systems are sorted out, and the development trend of multi-source data fusion analysis is discussed. Finally, the application scenarios expansion of multi-source data fusion analysis in smart energy construction is prospected based on the key research fields of energy internet construction, and the application difficulties of big data technology in the background of smart city construction are summarized.

articleTitle: Research on Location and Capacity Planning of Data Centers Under New Energy Access
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The data centers with high power consumption and stable power characteristics can be integrated into the smart grid with new energy as a potential load to reduce the phenomenon of wind and light abandonment of new energy. Considering the constraints such as voltage and branch power that cannot exceed the limit, this paper proposed a strategy to find the best location and capacity of the data center, established an optimization model based on discrete particle swarm algorithm, and analyzed the impact of different configuration schemes of the data center on the overall benefits as well as the total loss of the system. Simulation results show that the proposed method can better solve the location and capacity planning of multiple data centers, reduce the total loss of power grid while considering economic benefits, and effectively promote the consumption of new energy.

articleTitle: Robust Optimal Operation of Multiple Energy Systems with High Wind Power Penetration Considering Thermal Inertia of District Heating Network and Carbon Emissions
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The use of wind power is a desirable way to alleviate the energy crisis and reduce carbon emissions. However, the uncertainty and intermittency of wind energy have brought challenges to the system's stable operation. Also, the wind power accommodation is often restricted due to the CHP operation following the thermal load. This paper proposes a robust optimal operation for multiple energy systems with high wind power penetration. Information gap decision theory (IGDT) is employed to better depict the inherent uncertainty of wind power output. Besides, the thermal inertia of a district heating network (DHN) is formulated to enhance the operational flexibility. The penalty cost of carbon emissions is also introduced to the objective function. Numerical results on the modified IEEE 33-bus distribution system and 6-node heating network illustrate the effectiveness and economy of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Multi Element Aggregation Control Strategy Of Wind-Photovoltaic-Storage-Electric Vehicle Based On Virtual Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, multi energy aggregation is carried out for wind power, photovoltaic, energy storage and electric vehicles that can participate in networked charging and discharging, and a multi energy aggregation control model with virtual power plant as the operation control hub is established. In order to make full use of the randomness of new energy power generation and the dual controll-ability of power supply load of electric vehicle charging and discharging which can give full play to the role of wind power, photovoltaic, energy storage device and chargeable and dischargable electric vehicle in joint peak shaving, The two-level control strategy of power grid dispatching virtual power plant is formulated on the basis of fully considering the safe and economic operation of power grid, the utilization rate of new energy, the comprehensive cost of electric vehicle users and the operation economy of energy storage device. The control strategy uses the rolling analysis method based on Markov decision process to give the power generation and charge discharge operation instructions of each element within the control range of the virtual power plant, and uses the general strategy aggregation method to simulate the impact of the operation instructions made by the two-level control mechanism of the current power grid and virtual power plant on the future power grid, so as to ensure the optimality of the operation instructions under multiple time scales. Finally, an example is given to verify the effectiveness of the model and control strategy.

articleTitle: A Stability Verification Method for Initial Paths in the Early Stage of Black-start Progress
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: When there is a power blackout in a large regional grid due to a serious accident, the black-start scheme should be taken in order to quickly restore the power supply to important loads to guarantee less economic losses and ensure social stability. Black-start is the last defense of the power system safety, thus it's of great significance to develop a reasonable black-start scheme for speeding up the recovery process and reducing the accident loss after the blackout. A reliable black-start initial path plays an important role in ensuring the successful establishment of the initial system, which lays a solid foundation in increasing the black-start successful rate and shortening the black-start time and reducing the power outage loss. Bus the recent researches at home and abroad, which focus on black-start, inclined to judge whether the scheme can achieve a great performance not to guarantee black-start successfully. Therefore, this paper proposes a stability verification method for initial paths in power grid black-start subsystem construction, concluding frequency and voltage stability, small disturbance verifications in establishing the subsystem, to select out reliable black-start initial paths which could ensure the successful establishment of the initial system.

articleTitle: An Opportunity Cost Based Replacement Strategy for Transformers
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Accurately evaluating the economic life of a transformer not only plays an important role in appropriately scheduling its secure and economic operation, but also provides the basis for determining its replacement strategy. Considering the characteristics of the transformer failure rate in its life cycle, the Arrhenius-Weibull model which is widely employed for describing the transformer temperature aging failure is first presented to model the loss failure stage in the failure rate bathtub curve. A transformer age reduction factor is next introduced to characterize the effect of transformer maintenance. Then, the opportunity costs are calculated through comprehensively considering the economic factors of the transformer maintenance and replacement. Finally, the opportunity costs of the transformer maintenance and replacement are used as the criteria for determining the optimal replacement timing of the concerned transformer. A sample example is served for demonstrating the essential features of the presented method.

articleTitle: Learning Optimization of Power Grid Dispatch Considering Load Aggregator and Uncertainty of Both Source and Load
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The aggregator has become an effective way for load-side units to participate in the power grid dispatch, and the uncertainty of both source and load brings a great challenge to the power grid dispatch. So the power grid dispatch optimization problem considering load aggregator and uncertainty of both source and load is studied in this paper. First, a two-stage load optimization model is established based on the load management mechanism of load aggregator. In the first stage, load aggregators decide the load reduction through the game during peak hours. In the second stage, each load aggregator independently dispatchs the loads inside. With this two-stage model, the load curve is optimized, and the peak-valley difference is reduced. Then a power gird dispatch optimization model considering uncertainty of both source and load on dispatching is established with the objective of minimizing the economic cost and wind abandonment. A corresponding learning optimization model based on a Markov decision process is established. At last, an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm and reinforcement learning method are used to solve the strategies of the load-side optimization and source-side dispatching models respectively. Experiment results show that the methods proposed in this paper can effectively reduce the cost of power generation and improve the level of wind power consumption.

Author Keywords: uncertainty of both source and load

articleTitle: A Novel Fault Diagnosis Method for High Voltage Circuit Breaker Based on Density Peak Clustering
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The trip/close coil current is a significant signal to realize the fault diagnosis of high voltage circuit breaker (HVCB). In order to correctly diagnose known faults and effectively identify unknown faults, the paper proposes a fault diagnosis method for HVCB based on the density peak clustering (DPC) algorithm. First, coil current features are extracted and input into the optimized DPC algorithm to output the optimal cluster centroids, providing a reliable HVCB fault diagnosis basis. Then, the operating state of HVCB is identified by calculating the values of Euclidean distance between the new sample and cluster centroids. At the same time, a threshold is introduced to compare with the-values of Euclidean distance to determine whether the new sample is an unknown fault or not. Finally, the proposed method is compared with the back propagation neural network (BPNN) algorithm to verify its ability to identify unknown faults and diagnostic performance. The results prove that the proposed method can effectively and accurately identify various known and unknown HVCB faults even when the number of training samples is few. Additionally, the DPC process is visual and can be supervised manually. The proposed method is very suitable for HVCB fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Influence of Fault Ride-Through Characteristics of Wind Turbines on Transmission Power of Ultra-High Voltage AC/DC Hybrid System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous construction of large-scale wind and thermal power bundling ultra-high voltage (UHV) AC/DC transmission projects, the dynamic characteristics of wind turbines have an increasing impact on the transmission power of the system. The transmission power is constrained by various constraints such as transient overvoltage, power angle stability, and dynamic stability, making it difficult to analyze. This paper takes a typical UHV AC/DC hybrid transmission system as an example, first, the system transmission power constraints are sorted out. Then, the fault ride-through dynamic characteristics of wind turbines are analyzed. Further, the influence of fault ride-through characteristics on different types of constraints is studied, and the evaluation method of the system transmission power range is proposed. Finally, the influence of fault ride-through characteristics on system transmission power is explained and relevant suggestions are given, in order to provide a reference for the design and safe operation of actual projects.

Author Keywords: wind and thermal power bundling system

articleTitle: A Probability Measure Model for the Adaptability of Distribution Network Planning Considering Multiple Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to make the distribution network planning better adapt to the development of the regional economy and society, this subject has carried out a systematic study on the adaptability of the planning. By analyzing the internal and external influencing factors of distribution network planning, the candidate indicators for planning adaptability evaluation are proposed; using the interpretation structure model method, key indicators are selected, and a complete indicator system for the adaptability of distribution network planning is constructed. Then, considering the subjective and objective factors, time and probability characteristics of the evaluation index, the index weight design was carried out, and the index measurement model was established. Finally, taking Wangjiangjing area distribution network planning as an example, a case study is carried out to verify the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: The Evaluation Index System and Method of Electricity Spot Market Based on SCP Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The construction of the power market evaluation system is an important process in the construction of the power market. With the continuous development of China electricity spot market, how to combine the development characteristics of the domestic electricity spot market and systematically propose a set of index systems to evaluate the market development process and operation status is an urgent problem that needs to be resolved. Based on the SCP(structure-behavior-performance) theory commonly used in the evaluation of foreign electricity markets, this paper lists key indicators from three aspects: market structure, market behavior and market performance. At the same time, combined with the characteristics of the analytic hierarchy process and the fuzzy set theory, the fuzzy analytic hierarchy process is introduced to organically combine the objectivity of indicators and the subjectivity of expert judgment, which can quantitatively analyze the development of various aspects of the market. Finally, the actual data of the PJM market in the United States is used to analyze, and the results prove the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Incremental Distribution Network Source-load-storage Collaborative Planning Method Considering Uncertainty and Multi-agent Game
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: How to obtain the optimal decision-making scheme based on the investment behavior of various stakeholders is an important issue that needs to be solved urgently in incremental distribution network planning. To this end, this paper introduces the virtual player “Nature” to realize the combination of game theory and robust optimization, and proposes an incremental distribution network source-load collaborate planning method with uncertainties and multi-agent game. Firstly, the planning and decision-making models of DG investment operators, distribution network companies, power consumers and distributed energy storage (DES) investment operators are constructed respectively. Then, the static game behavior between DG investment operators and distribution network companies is analyzed based on the transfer relations between the four participants. At the same time, robust optimization is used to deal with the uncertainty of DG output, and the virtual player “Nature” is introduced to study the dynamic game behavior between the DG investment operator and the distribution company. Finally, a dynamic-static joint game planning model is proposed. The simulation results verify the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Simplified Calculation and Analysis of Sea Grounding Electrode Temperature Rise
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In HVDC transmission projects, sea electrode has a broad application prospect because of the good conductivity and heat dissipation of seawater. Temperature rise is one of the limiting conditions for grounding electrode. After analyzing the distribution of the current field, the calculation model is simplified to an infinite length cylindrical grounding electrode, and the flow field model of circular cylinder is simplified to a planar one. With the help of MATLAB, typical value of temperature rise of sea electrode is calculated, and the influencing factors such as current density, seawater resistivity, seawater velocity and seawater thermal characteristic parameters are analyzed. It is found that the temperature rise of sea electrode is about 0.00005 °C. The low resistivity is the key factor leads to a smaller temperature rise.

articleTitle: Fault-tolerant Design of Power Edge Computing Processor Based on Full-hardware Dual-core Lockstep
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous reduction of integrated circuit process nodes and the increasingly complex working environment of power edge computing chips, the reliability of processors is facing severe challenges. The current fault-tolerant methods of commonly used processors either occupy a large area, or have high performance overhead and insufficient real-time performance. In response to this problem, this paper proposes a full-hardware dual-core lock-step power edge computing processor fault-tolerant design method and specific implementation, then builds a simulation-based fault injection platform, and finally conducts a lot of tests on its related indicators. The test results prove that the fault-tolerant design has excellent reliability and real-time performance, while reducing the area cost, and is particularly suitable for low-cost, real-time requirements.

articleTitle: Community Charging Stations Planning under Shared Energy Storage Mode: A Stackelberg Game Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to solve the increasing electric grid load problem due to the travel demand of users, aiming at the charging problem of large-scale electric vehicles in the community, a capacity planning method for community charging stations under the shared energy storage mode based on the Stackelberg Game is proposed in this paper. First of all, the model of community charging stations under the shared energy storage model is introduced; Secondly, we build a Stackelberg Game based on the problem of the charging station's pursuit of the largest investment and construction profit and the user's pursuit of the smallest cost of use, and transform it into a bi-level programming problem for modeling; And use KKT (Karush-Kuhn-Tucker) condition and big M method to transform it into a monolayer mixed integer linear programming problem. Finally, a calculation example is applied to verify the rationality and effectiveness of the charging station capacity planning method. The results show that the capacity-constraining method of Stackelberg game can ensure the rationality of charging station capacity planning and improve the economics of charging station planning.

articleTitle: Graph Convolution Network Considering Edge Node Feature Aggregation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the level of power grid intelligence continues to enhance, the identification of power grid topology becomes more and more important. Generating embedded vectors of power grid topology is an important method to identify power grid topology. At present, in the field of embedded expression of graph nodes and semi-supervised learning, graph convolutional networks (GCN) have been widely used. But the typical GCN model performs poorly in the classification performance of graph edge nodes. In order to improve the classification performance of graph edge nodes, this paper proposes a graph convolutional network considering edge nodes feature aggregation (Enfa-GCN). The Enfa-GCN model realizes feature aggregation of graph edge nodes by marking the missing key features of graph edge nodes. This paper conducts a large number of experiments on three benchmark data sets to evaluate the Enfa-GCN model. Compared with the most advanced models, Enfa-GCN has advantages in graph edge node classification and overall graph node classification performance. Among them, Enfa-GCN is 1.42%, 0.44%, and 0.87% higher than GCN on the Cora, Citeseer, and Pubmed data sets, respectively. It shows that the Enfa-GCN model has a significant effect in improving the classification performance of graph edge nodes and the classification performance of whole graph nodes.

articleTitle: Day-ahead Probabilistic Forecasting of Achievable Incentive-based Demand Response Potential for Load Aggregator
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As an intermediary between residential customers and system operators, load aggregators (LA) are responsible for integrating the residential customers' demand response (DR) potential and enabling their transactions in the day-ahead market. Profit of the market trading process mainly relies on the pre-estimated achievable DR potential, which puts forwards the necessity of its accurate forecasting. Therefore, this paper proposes a probabilistic forecasting model to forecast the day-ahead achievable DR potential at the aggregated level under an incentive-based demand response (IBDR) program. Firstly, we attempt to establish the customers' DR potential, during which a home energy management system (HEMS) is introduced to implement load adjustment for electrical appliances. Secondly, several features that may affect the DR potential are extracted, among which the more relevant ones are selected through the support vector machine recursive feature elimination (SVM-RFE) method. Finally, based on these selected features, a support vector machine (SVM) method is adopted to establish the DR potential point forecasting model, and then the probabilistic forecasting model of the aggregated DR potential is established through the superimposition of the point forecasting results and the corresponding error distribution, the latter could be estimated by the non-parametric kernel density (NKDE) method. Case studies show that a good performance could be achieved by the proposed probabilistic forecasting model and the feature selection process could significantly improve the forecasting accuracy.

articleTitle: Multi - objective Planning of Distributed Generation With Coordination of Economics and Reliability
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Driven by the goal of carbon peak and carbon neutralization, the establishment of a new generation of energy body with a high proportion of renewable energy as the core is particularly critical. The access ratio of distributed photovoltaic power generation and wind power generation will further increase. The high proportion of distributed power will bring new challenges to the power system and the reliability of the power supply will be threatened. This paper mainly studies the planning method of distributed generation from the perspective of investors' economic benefits and users' power supply reliability requirements. Aiming at analyzing the influence of distributed generation access on voltage distribution, the reliability index considering voltage fluctuation is established for voltage-sensitive users. Finally, taking the standard IEEE 69 bus radial distribution system as an example, the multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to optimize the access capacity and location of distributed generation. The results show that the algorithm proposed in this paper can well meet the needs of decision-makers, and can select the optimal scheme that reflects the comprehensive value of distributed generation.

articleTitle: Distributed Robust Optimal Scheduling for Integrated Energy System Considering Source-Load Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: There are some problems such as uncertainty in the output of renewable energy such as wind and light, and deviations between energy prediction and actual demand in the integrated energy system (IES) with high penetration rate of renewable energy. Energy storage is an effective solution to the above problems way, but excessive energy storage capacity will lead to economic decline of the integrated energy system, and less will lead to insufficient overall regulation capacity of the integrated energy system. Based on this, electric and thermal energy storage devices are used to participate in IES optimal scheduling, and the combined output threshold of source-charge-storage is used to measure the effect of source-charge-storage cooperative operation in IES, then a source-charge-storage matching index was proposed in this article. An optimization model with the goal of minimizing the running cost of the integrated energy system with electricity / thermal energy storage equipment under the constraint of matching degree is established by this index. Calculation examples show that the proposed indicators and models can effectively reduce the system operation cost and improve the level of renewable energy consumption.

articleTitle: Multi-timescale Optimal Scheduling of Integrated Energy Systems Based on Wind/Light to Hydrogen
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Considering the impact of wind/photovoltaic power output and uncertainty of customer load demand on the integrated energy system, an optimized dispatching model of the integrated energy system based on wind/photovoltaic hydrogen production is established. On the premise of meeting power balance, the multi-stage utilization of hydrogen energy gives full play to the multi-energy complementary characteristics of the integrated energy system, improves system flexibility, maintains its safe and stable operation, and reduces operating costs. The model develops an optimal scheduling strategy by combining multiple energy conversion devices with a multi-timescale optimization method. The model includes a day-ahead optimal dispatching model targeting the lowest daily operating cost; an intra-day rolling optimal dispatching model targeting the lowest energy purchase cost and hydrogen energy loss rate within the day; and a dynamic adjustment model targeting the lowest equipment output power adjustment. The simulation results show that the multi-stage utilization of hydrogen energy is beneficial to improving the system economy and reducing the loss of renewable energy.

articleTitle: A Novel Pricing Method Based on Robust Optimization with EVA Participation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the new round of power system reform, the electric vehicle fleet, as a new type of power subject on the distribution side, can be effectively dispatched by aggregators to alleviate the blockage problem during peak load periods of the power grid. In a market environment, a reasonable pricing model reflects the associated costs while providing price signals for the formulation of EV aggregator dispatch strategies. Therefore, this paper proposes a distribution network location incremental pricing method (D LIP) that reflects the impact of stochastic load fluctuations on operating costs. In the proposed approach, the day-ahead spot market determines the final electricity prices through dynamic tariffs (DTs) from the distribution system operator (DSO), and electric aggregators profitably participate in the electricity market as a form of virtual energy storage. To mitigate the uncertainty in the predicted prices, the ellipsoidal uncertainty set in robust optimization is used to represent the uncertainty component of the prices, and then aggregators adjust the charging and discharging strategies of electric vehicles under the objectives of reducing the cost of electricity purchase and relieving blockages. Finally, the dynamic tariffs on the distribution side under this market framework are calculated using the proposed pricing method. Verify the rationality of its pricing method by using the IEEE 33-bus distribution network system as an example. Results of case studies show that the proposed DLIP method can successfully alleviate the congestion in distribution networks.

articleTitle: A Review: Comprehensive Effectiveness of Electric Vehicles in Market
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As it can eliminate the external pollution through a market-oriented way, the entry of new energy electric vehicles (EVs) into the carbon trading market will be promising. In this paper, we give an overview of the electric vehicles in both electric market and carbon trading market. Significant cutting-edged studies are listed for an overview on the contribution of electric vehicles attending in both two markets, providing ideas of establishing a comprehensive effectiveness evaluation system. In the end some ideas and directions of future study are given, and more work are required to build a practical frame.

articleTitle: Research on Estimation of Regional Housing Vacancy Rate Based on Electricity Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The housing vacancy rate is an important indicator that reflects the health of the real estate market in a region, developed areas abroad have relatively complete statistical systems and methods, but there is no completely unified calculation method in China. The article uses the electric Electricity big data platform, obtain residential electricity consumption data, define a user who consumes less than 10 kWh for 10 months each year as an empty user, get the housing vacancy rate based on the number of vacant households and the total number of households. To research the housing vacancy rate of the province with the four cities as pilots, in-depth analysis of the main factors affecting the housing vacancy rate, study the regional distribution characteristics and change trends of the housing vacancy rate, provide reference for local governments to formulate macro policies.

articleTitle: Stochastic Optimal Dispatch of Integrated Energy Campus Microgrids Considering the Time-Delay of Pipelines
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A stochastic optimal dispatch model for integrated energy campus microgrid (IECM) is proposed, which considered the stochastic fluctuation of photovoltaic and photothermal power outputs and the time-delay of energy transmission in cooling/heating and gas pipelines. The orthogonal collocation on finite elements in the two-dimensional domain was used to transform the partial differential equations describing the dynamic of pipelines into algebraic equations. The State-space approximate dynamic programming (SS-ADP) algorithm is adopted to solve the stochastic optimal dispatch model. Firstly, typical state spaces are generated by solving deterministic optimal dispatch models in a series of stochastic scenarios. Secondly, approximate value function (AVF) of each typical state is obtained based on the transition probability matrix of random variables and the similarity index. Finally, by the forecast scenario of random variables, the optimal dispatch solution can be obtained by solving each time period's optimal model successively based on the AVFs of typical states. Test results on an IECM demonstrate the correctness and efficiency of the proposed model and algorithm.

articleTitle: Transient Stability Self-Adaptive Assessment Based on Sample Enhancement of DCGAN
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Since there are very few transient instabilities in the actual power system, the stable and unstable samples are extremely unbalanced, which brings great difficulties to the data-driven transient stability prediction. And due to the time-varying nature of the power system, the rapidity of the generation of new training samples in the online application of temporary stability prediction faces challenges. Aiming at the problem of decreased prediction accuracy when the AI network is applied to the transient stability prediction of the power system when the operation mode or topology of the power grid changes greatly, a method of transient stability self-adaptive assessment based on sample enhancement of improved DCGAN is proposed in this paper. While offline, perform cluster analysis on the historical topology of the power grid, generate a historical sample database, and train the temporary stability prediction model. When the topology of power grid changes, the new scene is matched with the historical scene and the samples are transfered to the new scene through a certain transfered principle. Then, the instability sample set is screened out, and the instability sample is enhanced by the improved Deep Convolutional Generative Adversarial Network(DCGAN). Finally, the offline model is fine-tuned with the new training samples after transfer and enhancement to realize online transient stability self-adaptive assessment. The experimental results of the Central China Power Grid show that the method can generate effective training samples for changing systems, balance power system instability data, and greatly reduce the sample generation time when the model is updated online, and improve the accuracy and Gmean value of transient stability prediction in new scenarios, which considering both the speed and accuracy of self-adaptive assessment.

articleTitle: Feedback-based Optimal Dispatch for Virtual Power Plants in Active Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Virtual power plants (VPPs) play an increasingly important role in power systems as they provide flexibility and efficiency for active distribution networks and serve as a great tool of energy management for the power grid penetrated with plenty of distributed energy resources (DERs) in the future. This article aims to propose a novel optimal dispatch method for VPP to realize real-time autonomous optimization. The proposed method combines the advantage of model-based method and data-driven method to provide instant optimal points trajectory based on system feedback, i.e., measurements. Firstly, the approximated mapping from control variables to state variables is established. Then a zeroth order optimization method is presented to calculate real-time command of DERs. The proposed strategy is adaptively compatible with the sudden change of the system and provide effective voltage support verified by the simulation in the unbalanced distribution networks.

articleTitle: Diversified Connection Cascade Planning for Intelligent Medium Voltage Distribution Network in Xiongan New Area under High Reliability Positioning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The high standard requirement of Xiongan New Area determines ensuring power supply reliability as a key planning goal. This paper introduces the cascade planning method for high reliability intelligent medium voltage distribution networks. In order to meet the needs of different regional functional positioning and user power supply reliability requirements, as well as coordinating the configuration of intelligent equipment and investment benefits, this paper establishes a medium voltage primary backbone network planning and a secondary backbone network self-healing control model. Based on the simulation results of 11 typical network connection mode combinations, consisting of 3 types of primary backbone network connection modes and 4 types of secondary backbone network connection modes, the effectiveness of the cascade planning scheme is verified under normal mode, N-1 and N-2 scenarios. Actual planning experience in Xiongan New Area are given, aiming at providing useful reference for the planning of the medium-voltage distribution network in the newly developed area.

articleTitle: Short-term Load Forecasting Based on Kprototypes Clustering and Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Short-term load forecasting is the basic of generation scheduling optimization, power grid dispatching, power market transaction and electricity pricing. The accuracy of prediction will significantly affect the optimal allocation of resources and the improvement of economic and social benefits. On the one hand, there is a high correlation between the short-term load and historical load, and the future load can be predicted through historical data. On the other hand, short-term load forecasting is easily affected by weather conditions and social factors. Therefore, by synthetically considering the historical load data, meteorological data and social factors, this paper proposes a short-term load forecasting method based on kprototypes clustering and random forest. Firstly, the natural and social attributes affecting short-term load forecasting are selected, the historical days are clustered by kprototypes algorithm, and the category of the days to be predicted is determined. Then, the data of the category of the day to be predicted is used as the training set, and the random forest algorithm is used to predict the load. Finally, an example is given to verify the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Optimal Dispatch Model considering Flexible Demand Resources and Bidding Uncertainty of Distributed Generation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The increasing proportion of distributed generation (DG) brings intermittency and indeterminacy to the power grid, and the rising amount of the flexible demand resources (FDRs) is re-shaping the way in which electricity markets are operated. This paper aims at the market operation mechanisms considering the uncertain DG and the FDRs. Firstly, the bidding strategies of DG can be formulated according to their risk preferences, and the corresponding bidding strategies based on Pareto front have been constructed. Then, the FDRs are also taken into consideration in the process of market trades and centralized clearance. Lastly, an optimal dispatch model is established where the independent system operator (ISO) will minimize the total costs based on the above risk-based behaviors of DG and the dispatchable FDRs. Numerical results of the simulation case studies are utilized to illustrate the feasibility of the model.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Virtual Stability Control Device Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of incomplete test items or inability to work due to the lack of test conditions for the stability control devices of some substations during the joint debugging and testing of the stability control system engineering, a virtual stability control device platform was researched and developed. According to the data frame format of the communication content between the stability control devices, special software is developed to virtually send and receive these communication messages, and the messages are converted from Ethernet format and El format through the protocol conversion device to realize real-time communication between the control client and the stability control device. Practical application shows that the virtual stability control device platform can not only communicate with stability control devices of different manufacturers, but also flexibly virtualize various types of stability control device communication messages, which is convenient to operate and has good practicability.

articleTitle: A Fast Fault Simulation Method of Distribution Network with Distributed Geration Based on Neural Petri Net
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Since the traditional fault location method can no longer meet the requirements of safe and stable operation of distribution network with distributed generations, a fast fault simulation method of distribution network with distributed generations based on neural Petri net is proposed in this paper. According to the fault location rules of the Petri net, the segment fault simulation model of the distribution network with distributed generations is established based on the Petri net, and the segment fault simulation of the distribution network is realized by using matrix algorithm. In order to improve the self-learning ability of the fault diagnosis Petri net model, the neural network is combined with the traditional Petri net model, and the fast simulation model of distribution network fault based on the neural Petri net is established. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by a fault simulation example of the distribution network with distributed generations. The simulation results show that the combination of neural network and Petri net has strong fault reasoning ability and adaptive ability, which can realize the fault location quickly.

articleTitle: Arc Fault Risk Evaluation Based on Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: DC arc fault is easy to cause fire and endanger the normal operation of DC distribution systems and equipment. The arc fault protection approaches could be different according to the severity of the arc fault. In order to solve the above problems, an arc fault risk evaluation method based on the image recognition is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the images of DC arc fault are preprocessed to improve the clarity of the images. Then, the morphological structure characteristics and texture characteristics of the images are extracted, and the arc fault risk level is divided into three levels to achieve the evaluation of arc fault risk level. Finally, the real position of arc is determined by the binocular distance measurement. The binocular camera is calibrated with the checkerboard, after the intrinsic and external parameters of the camera are gained, the arc fault images are stereo corrected. The Block Matching (BM) algorithm is used to stereo match the corrected image to obtain the three-dimensional coordinates and depth of the arc. The experimental results show that the accuracy of arc fault risk evaluation is above 95%. The positioning error of arc fault is less than 2 mm, which has good accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Reclosing Device of Low-voltage Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of collective tripping caused by voltage loss or undervoltage fault of 0.4kV low-voltage circuit breaker in each distribution room due to 10kV distribution network tripping, Because the low-voltage circuit breaker does not have automatic reclosing function, as a result, the manual on-site closing is affected by the distribution area of the distribution room, which prolongs the outage time and reduces the reliability of power supply. Taking STM32 as the main control, this paper designs an automatic reclosing device of low-voltage circuit breaker, realizes the function of automatic reclosing of circuit breaker after undervoltage fault trip, and improves the reliability of power supply. The device intelligently researches and judges the fault type of the low-voltage circuit breaker trip by collecting the fault voltage and the fault current, and only recloses under the under-voltage fault, and at the same time establishes a communication mechanism between the working state of the circuit breaker and the operation and maintenance personnel, which greatly improves the low-voltage distribution network the safety and reliability. Experiments show that the device is accurate and easy to implement, and can meet the needs of actual engineering applications.

articleTitle: Dynamic Evolution Mechanism of High-End Chemical Industry Based on System Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: According to the theory of system dynamic, analyzing the influencing factors of high-end chemical industry, using VENSIM software, dynamic network model of high-end chemical industry development is constructed, and mechanism of its development is analyzed.

articleTitle: Reactive Power Optimization In Distribution Networks With High Penetration Of Renewable Energy Based On Second-Order Cone Programming
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the reduction of fossil energy, new energy power generation has become a new trend and is becoming more and more popular. Although it can effectively alleviate the resource problems of the grid, at the same time due to its own randomness and volatility, it will bring instability problems such as voltage flicker to the grid. Therefore, after new energy is connected to the grid, how to coordinate with the grid to respond to situations such as new energy fluctuations and load fluctuations, and participate in reactive power optimization together, is a problem worthy of study. In this paper, experiments are carried out on IEEE33 examples. Select static var compensator and doubly-fed wind generator as reactive power regulation equipment, take minimum network loss and minimum voltage offset as the comprehensive objective function. The power optimization problem is solved under the requirements of voltage and current constraints, power flow constraints, and equipment operation reactive power constraints. This paper introduces a second-order cone optimization method to convert the original power flow model into a second-order cone programming problem. This article divides four scenarios according to the equipment access and the different goals to carry out the test respectively. Through the comparison of the network loss and the voltage deviation, it is proved that the new energy can promote the reactive power optimization after the it is connected to the grid, and the second-order cone programming algorithm is verified its effectiveness and superiority in the reactive power optimization.

articleTitle: Research of Topology and Test on Charged Melting Ice
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Icing of the transmission line seriously affects the safe operation of the power system. Ice melting with current on line can effectively solve this problem. Most of the methods must blackout the line before ice melting. Few charged ice melting methods are not practical. To make charged ice melting more practical, this paper proposes a method by DC isolation circuit. It is verified by 220V charged ice melting test.

articleTitle: Study on The Dynamics of Natural Gas System and Linepack Storage in Integrated Energy Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
