abstract: With the development of gas-fired turbines and the emerging power-to-gas (P2G) technologies, power systems and natural gas systems have been becoming more interactional. To study the integrated energy system and improve its operating efficiency, this paper models the integrated energy system in detail with the consideration of the linepack storage. Then, the dynamic characteristics of natural gas state and linepack storage with power load changes are analyzed and verified in case studies.

articleTitle: A Practical Evaluation Method for Power Supply Capacity of Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Load distribution, network structure and the mode of load growth are the main factors affecting the power supply capacity of distribution network. Traditional evaluations are mostly carried out from the perspective of planning, which ignores the dynamic adjustment of grid and has inconsistency of the mode of load growth with its actual situation. From the perspective of practicality, this paper proposes an evaluation method under the background of actual load growth. First, sequence operation theory is employed to determine the mode of load growth., and load prediction is carried out by small load growth combine with large user's application. Second, bi-level optimization model is established to tap the power supply potential while guiding operation of system, which optimizes the configuration of switches in the upper model and the access locations of large user in the lower model, then obtain the maximum power supply capacity of network under the actual load growth. According to the case study on the IEEE33-bus system with the first scenario of natural load growth and the second scenario of large user's application at the same time, the proposed method is effective and practical.

articleTitle: Reliability Evaluation of the External Power Supply System of Electrified Railways Considering the Access of PV Power
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: External power supply system is vital to the proper operation of the electrified railways, photovoltaic (PV) access to external power supply has become a major trend and pose a significant challenge to reliability. Therefore, this paper proposes a reliability evaluation method considering PV access to external power supply for electrified railways. Firstly, the simulation model of weak external power supply is built, and the optimal capacity of PV access is selected by calculating the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$N$</tex>-1 pass rate of the model. Then, the system operating state is simulated by the Monte Carlo method, and the operating state is analyzed based on the DC optimal power flow (OPF) considering the node load type. Finally, the reliability of the electrified railways is evaluated by defining and calculating the relevant metrics, and the design reference for the optimization scheme of the external power supply of the existing electrified railway is provided based on the evaluation results.

articleTitle: Frequency Regulation Strategy of Wind Farm Based on Frequency Deviation Regulation of Parallel Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The large-scale wind power integration causes the power system to face the problems of inertia reduction and insufficient frequency regulation capacity. Its active participation in power grid frequency regulation is an important means to solve this problem. Based on the load shedding and frequency modulation control strategy of Doubly Fed Induction Generator (DFIG), this paper proposes a droop control strategy of wind farm based on the equal adjustable capacity proportion mode of wind farm, which realizes the participation of wind pow-er generation in the primary frequency regulation of power grid. Finally, the effectiveness and feasibility of the control strategy are verified based on PSCAD / EMTDC simulation platform.

articleTitle: Spot Trading Scheme for Realizing Self-Balanced Operation in Electrical Power Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the background of the development of a low-carbon economy and the increasing complexity of distribution systems, distribution networks have proposed higher demands on the optimization strategy for economic operation. Aiming at the goal of realizing the peak and valley self-balancing of the distribution networks, this paper designs a new scheme of spot trading in the distribution network, and elaborate on the two-way quotation, quotation by time and clearing method of real-time spot trading in this scheme. In this research, the difference of the spot trading between provincial-level and distribution networks was first clarified to clear the mutual relationship and transaction goals of these two markets. Secondly, the objective function and bidding mode of day-ahead trading and real-time trading have been set up reasonably to achieve two-way optimization of the load and the power. What's more, the nodal pricing of distribution networks suitable for clearing in the local market has also been considered. Finally, we proposed a spot trading solution that can achieve the coordinated operation of the distribution networks and the provincial networks, which is committed to achieving the optimal economic operation of generation, consumption, storage and load of the electricity in distribution networks.

articleTitle: Electricity Consumption Forecasting Using Extreme Learning Machine With The Generalized Maximum Correntropy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The forecasting technology of electricity consumption is essential both in power system scheduling and in the open power market. However, in the current electricity sales company's electricity consumption forecasting problems, the historical electricity data and the error distribution of electricity consumption forecasting are usually nonlinear and non-Gaussian. Due to the small user scale, some random events and data collection errors will cause outliers. These outliers has a greater impact on the prediction results, which makes traditional prediction methods no longer applicable. In order to solve this problem, this paper uses generalized maximum correntropy criterion as a new loss function to replace the mean squared error loss function in the traditional ELM, and constructs the GMCCELM electricity prediction model. Finally, the historical electricity consumption data of a commercial user in Guangdong province and the corresponding temperature data are applied to the electricity consumption prediction model established in this paper. An actual case is given to illustrate the superiority and effectiveness of the electricity consumption prediction model compared with other existing methods. The prediction results show that, compared with the traditional ELM and other algorithms, the robust prediction model established in this paper can effectively improve the accuracy of electricity consumption forecasting.

articleTitle: Power Generation Efficiency Prediction Methods of Photovoltaic Panel under Dust Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Dust on the surface of photovoltaic panels can cause the reduction of power generation efficiency and therefore impact efficiency of photovoltaic power plants. A prediction model based on convolutional neural network by taking image of dust status as inputs and power generation efficiency as outputs is established. The data sets of “Dust status image-Power generation efficiency” used for prediction models are collected from actual data acquisition experiments. Prediction models including four classical convolutional neural network models, such as AlexNet, VGG16, ResNet34, ResNet50, and V1, V2, V3 based on VGG16 were trained by acquired data set. The result demonstrates that the proposed V2 model with relatively simple structure and suitable learning step can accurately and quickly predict power generation efficiency of dust status image of photovoltaic panel. In addition, the proposed model provides technical support for photovoltaic power plants to improve power generation efficiency and economic benefits.

articleTitle: Cluster Analysis of the Electricity Consumption of Student Dormitories in Institutions of Higher Education Located in the Hot Summer and Cold Winter Region in China
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The electricity consumption of student dormi-tories in institutions of higher learning is characterized by diversity, high utilization rate, and high energy use intensity. The electricity consumption characteristics of users are primarily studied through clustering calculations; however, for building types that exhibit clear seasonal distribution patterns and utilization rates, such as student dormitories, traditional clustering calculation methods perform poorly in distinguishing the electricity consumption preferences of the occupants. In this article, an indirect two-step clustering method is proposed and compared with two other clustering methods. The results indicate that, in addition to highlighting the seasonal characteristics of student dormitories, the proposed indirect two-step clustering method can improve the feasibility of the clustering calculation.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimization of Distribution Network Based on On-Load-Tap Changer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the comprehensive optimization problem of distribution network, an improved method of on-load-tap-changer is proposed as a means of adjustment to reduce the operation time and the multi-objective function, it is named as 0–1 variable method. The control variables are selected transformer taps position. The non-convex nonlinear problem is converted into a solvable convex optimization problem by second-order cone programming relaxation and accurate linear modeling of on-load-tap changer. The test results of IEEE 33 node show that compared with the large M method, the on-load-tap-changer model can significantly accelerate the operation speed and better the optimization of comprehensive targets.

articleTitle: Optimal Operation Management of Distribution System Based on Electro-Thermal Game
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the deteriorate of climate environment, the development of clean energy has become one of the most important ways to alleviate the bad situation. Wind power is the most mature renewable energy, how to promote its effective consumption has been widely concerned. Especially in winter, the CHP based electro-thermal coupling system is limited by the heating demand, which occupies a lot of power generation capacity, leading to the problem of wind abandonment becoming more serious. Therefore, based on the practical problems and from the perspective of distribution operator, a two-stage stochastic optimization model is constructed by considering electro-thermal coupling energy substitution to promote the efficient consumption of renewable energy. Firstly, according to the theory of decision-dependent uncertainty, the load demand model is proposed, and the uncertainty of wind power is described based on Weibull distribution. Then, in the day-ahead stage, prescheduling and pricing strategy are optimized based on the predicted value. And in the real-time stage, the system power balance is achieved according to the actual load value and renewable energy output. The simulation result shows that the proposed model can motivate the demand side to participate in energy transformation, increase the utilization of renewable energy, and improve distribution operator's income.

articleTitle: Toward the Reactive Power Compensation Optimization in Fujian Power System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The reactive power compensation issue of Fujian power system is discussed in detail in this paper. Firstly, the basic model and principle of reactive power compensation for different voltage level system is illustrated, where the major compensation item is quite different from each other. Secondly, the reactive power compensation situation is analyzed based on the reality of Fujian power system. Moreover, the utilization efficiency issue of compensation equipment is investigated from several aspects, including load factor, cable reconstructing and reversing power from lower voltage system. Finally, an optimal allocation guide of reactive power compensation is respectively proposed for 500kV and 220kV power system, where load factor, charging power, N-1 contingency are concerned. Especially, it is recommended for 220kV system considering differentiated allocation solution for different load factor, which is helpful for the compensation allocation of future power system project.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Configuration Method of Devices for Integrated PV Storage and Charging Station
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Electric vehicles play a huge role in promoting energy conservation and emission reduction. However, when large-scale electric vehicles are connected to the grid, the charging load brings a short-term load impact to the grid, which affects the safe operation of the grid. The integrated PV storage and charging station utilizes PV and energy storage to balance the charging load of electric vehicles in order to reduce the impact. Aiming at the planning demand of the integrated PV storage and charging station, PV and energy storage model based on life prediction is established. The objective is to maximize the net income of the station, and the constraints are the devices operation and power balance constraints. Base on the objective and constraints, this paper put forward an optimal configuration model for integrated PV storage and charging station devices. The model is solved by genetic algorithm. Finally, the effectiveness of the method is verified by a study case.

Author Keywords: integrated PV storage and charging station

articleTitle: Research on the Acceptability of New Energy under the Constraint of Grid Transient Voltage
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the large-scale integration of new energy sources such as wind and solar, conventional power sources have been gradually replaced, and the dynamic reactive power support capability has been greatly reduced due to the reduction of synchronous machine power sources. At the same time, the voltage stability problem of the power grid will be prominent, and there is a risk of system voltage instability after transient faults. In extreme cases, it may cause new energy to disconnect from the grid and bring a chain reaction, and the voltage stability problem has become one of the main factors restricting the capacity of new energy consumption. In the process of studying the change of grid voltage characteristics in the process of replacing traditional power sources with high proportion of new energy sources, the transient voltage sag relationship is described based on the binary table corresponding to time and voltage, and the transient voltage margin measurement index is represented by the voltage drop area. The above further refines and characterizes the voltage support capability of the generator. In the study of the gradual replacement of conventional units by large-scale new energy, a new energy acceptance capacity evaluation method considering transient voltage constraints is proposed to evaluate the maximum connected new energy capacity of the grid, and it is verified in the actual grid.

articleTitle: An Advanced Control Strategy for Bidirectional Isolated Three Phase AC/DC Dual-Active-Bridge Converter in Hybrid Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes an advanced control strategy consisting of current stress optimization based on triple-phase-shifting (TPS) modulation for front-end DAB converter and 33% PWM method for back-end three-phase full bridge inverter. Compared with the traditional phase shift control, the control strategy proposed for the front-end DAB converter achieves linear control and significantly reduces current stress. In addition, it reduces the DC-Link capacitance, which improves the safety of the equipment. The 33% modulation method adopted by the full bridge inverter at the back-end reduces the switching loss of semiconductor devices. The principle, derivation and realization of the proposed control strategy are described in detail. Simulation results are presented to validate the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Control of Regional Integrated Energy System Based on Competitive Swarm Optimizer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of economy and society, people's demand for fossil energy has gradually increased, and environmental problems have become increasingly serious. In order to find an environmentally friendly and energy-saving energy supply method to replace the original high-polluting energy supply method, this paper establishes an electric and thermal energy regional integrated energy system model, considering the integrated energy operation constraints under the electric and thermal coupling, and adopts competitive swarms optimizer. The algorithm economically optimizes the distributed power sources and loads in the regional integrated energy system, and obtains the optimal operation mode of the integrated energy system. The final calculation example results show that the competitive particle swarm algorithm can significantly improve the operating economy of the distributed power and load of the integrated energy system, realize the economic and stable operation of the integrated energy system, and improve the energy utilization rate.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Power System Configuration Simulation Platform and Its Application in Intelligent Mode Arrangement
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: According to the polymorphic requirements of large power grid simulation and analysis, the idea of logical configuration is introduced into the field of power system simulation, and a set of visual configuration platform applied to large power grid simulation is designed and developed. Firstly, the overall structure and interactive interface design of large power grid configuration simulation platform are proposed. Secondly, the key technologies of large power grid configuration simulation platform are deeply discussed from the implementation of event driven engine. Finally, the innovative application of intelligent large power grid operation mode arrangement system is realized based on the configuration platform. The configuration simulation system replaces the customized development mode of conventional manual software coding by visual logic configuration, which greatly improves the rapidity and flexibility of the simulation requirements of multi-state large power grid.

articleTitle: Artificial Short-circuit Test and Result Analysis of Ximeng UHV AC/DC Transmission Project
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The prospect of “carbon peaking and carbon neutrality” determines the major role of power supply of renewable energy, and proposes higher requirements to the development of renewable energy as well. Due to the reverse distribution characteristics of the resource endowments and electricity load, most of the large-scale renewable energy is centrally sent out through long-distance AC/DC power systems, which makes the short-circuit ratio of multiple stations of renewable energy stations low, and the coupling characteristics of source and network complicated. Moreover, the problem of transient overvoltage caused by AC and DC faults is outstanding. Ximeng UHV AC/DC transmission project is the system with the world's largest scale of once-grid-connected wind power and the most complex wind-fire bundling transmission line. The introduced artificial short-circuit test in this paper is promoted with detailed plan, considering the actual situation of geography, wind resources, grid strength, etc., and carried out in different voltage levels and different operation modes. The multi-dimensions data such as grid voltage and wind turbine power response is recorded and analyzed comprehensively, and the characteristics of transient overvoltage and wind turbine power response of Ximeng UHV project are concluded, finally the direction of further research is discussed.

articleTitle: Research on Creep and Shrinkage Characteristics of Bidirectional Geogrid in Transmission Line Engineering
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, two types of polypropylene (PP) bi-directional geogrids were tested under the same stress level. After the creep test, they were completely unloaded and their shrinkage was observed. Combined with the test results, the Kelvin series model is used to simulate the shrinkage test process of geogrid, and established the mathematical equation to describ the viscoelastic plastic shrinkage deformation of geogrid. The test results are well fitted.

articleTitle: Advanced Microgrid Energy Management Based on an Improved Acpso Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To improve the economy of microgrids and reduce the environmental pollution from electric vehicle electricity consumption, this paper proposes an energy management strategy of integrated optical storage and charging, which aims at minimizing the initial capital cost and storage energy while considering the time-varying characteristics of power generation and demand. First, an improved chaotic particle swarm optimization algorithm with adaptive inertia weights (ACPSO) is proposed to solve the microgrid energy management problem. Second, the proposed algorithm utilizes the initial population of the chaotic sequence to produce the particle group algorithm to adjust the inertial weight parameters of the particle group algorithm adaptive to evolutionary states, thus improving the global search ability of the particle group and effectively avoiding local convergence problems. Finally, the proposed control strategy is simulated and verified for a comprehensive energy demonstration site. The results show that the scheme improves the economic efficiency of the integrated energy demonstration site and effectively reduces the system energy consumption.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Integrated Energy Systems Considering the Resource Trading Among Users
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of new energy sources, the volatility and intermittency of new energy output and load will further increase the risk of integrated energy system operation. In order to reduce the risk and improve the flexibility of the integrated energy system, the paper proposes an integrated energy system optimization model considering integrated demand response resource trading. The energy trading platform is constructed by combining blockchain technology and energy management system to introduce integrated demand response resources into the energy trading market. A two-layer optimization model is built considering users and load aggregators. The algorithm results show that based on the model and trading framework constructed in the paper, the trading of integrated demand response resources among users is realized, which effectively promotes the participation of non-responsive users in demand response, significantly reduces the energy cost of users and improves the revenue of load aggregators.

articleTitle: Forms, Key Supporting Technologies and Business Models of the Integrated Energy Service Station
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The integrated energy service station (IESS) is a new concept for the fusion of power supply and value services. A systematic discussion about the IESS is made in this paper. Firstly, the definition of the IESS is proposed. The feasible components of the system are discussed. The typical forms of the IESS are studied. Secondly, the key supporting technologies of the IESS are pointed out and comprehensively discussed, which contains the siting, sizing, integration, and operation technologies. Thirdly, the feasible business models of the IESS are introduced and analyzed. Finally, a research prospect is made and the future developments of the IESS are described.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Sizing and Location of Substation According to Point Load Forecast Based on BIM
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The development of the power grid relies on the development of the city. The target of power gird planning is providing safe, reliable and high quality electrical energy for consumers according to the charging buildings and roads of the city. The layout of buildings and roads is described more precisely, so that reliable basic data for power load forecast and power grid planning is provided by BIM. This paper takes street block as a unit to carry out the point load forecast base on BIM. Then optimal sizing and location model of substations is established with the objective of minimum cost and the constraints on full coverage of power supply, substation load rate and power supply radius. The model is solved by particle swarm optimization algorithm. Finally, the effectiveness of the method is verified by a case study.

articleTitle: An Improved Master-Slave Control Strategy for Medium Voltage DC Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The voltage fluctuation and unreasonable power distribution caused by multi-mode switching affect the stability of DC distribution system operation. To solve these problems, this paper improves the traditional control strategy of the system. Firstly, the operations of the ring DC distribution system are categorized into different working modes. Then, this paper analyzes the disadvantages of the traditional control strategies and improves it. The proposed control method endows the converter stations of all terminals with the ability of DC voltage and power regulation. Finally, the three-terminal ring DC distribution system is established, and the operating characteristics of the system applying the improved control are improved.

articleTitle: A Study On Hydraulic Balance Optimization Of District Heating System Based On Data-Mechanism Fused Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To optimize the hydraulic balance of the district energy system, this paper introduces a modeling method based on data mechanism fusion. First, build a physical model of the heating network, combining Bernoulli and basic equations of continuity, basic knowledge of graph theory and the topological structure of the network to calculate the hydraulic condition. And calculate the flow distribution of each heating network branch according to the user's heat demand. Then, the neural network regression model of the valve characteristic curve is established, and the model is trained with the operating data. Finally, use Viheating software to simulate a thermal power station to verify the hydraulic balance optimization. The results showed that the energy consumption of the thermal power station was reduced by about 17.61 %.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Helicopter-based Wildfire Monitoring Technology for Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, wildfires have occurred freq uently near transmission lines, seriously threatening the sa fe and stable operation of power grid. During the high-in cidence period of wildfires, such as the Spring Festival an d Tomb Sweeping Day, helicopters can be used to monito r wildfires near transmission lines. After the wildfires are detected, they can be immediately extinguished by helico pters. The helicopters can also deal with large-scale wildfi res that are difficult for ground firefighters to extinguish. This greatly improves wildfires monitoring and extinguishing efficiency. In this paper, based on the visible and infr ared image recognition model of wildfires, combined with the characteristics of helicopter wildfire monitoring, a wil dfire visible image long-distance rough recognition model based on HSV (Hue, Saturation, and Value) color space a nd infrared image close-range accurate recognition model are established. For the transmission problem of helicopte r patrol video, a real-time transmission method of helicop ter patrol video based on satellite communication is propo sed, and the installation plan of the helicopter's wildfire monitoring pod and satellite communication equipment is designed. The field application in Hunan province is carri ed out to verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the me thod proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the strength in Receiving-end Power Grid Considering Wind Power Injection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The receiving-end power grid which large-scale renewable energy access and multi-infeed HVDC external power access requires system put a reliable power system strength to ensure the stability of the receiving-end system. However, the coupling relationship between devices and between devices and AC systems. Therefore, how to calculate and describe the voltage stability of the system has become a necessary problem to be solved in the double high power system. From the perspective of generalized short circuit ratio of multi-infeed HVDC, the static voltage stability of multi-infeed HVDC receiving-end system considering wind power connection is studied. Firstly, based on the steady-state model of the system, the influence of wind power on the power flow Jacobian matrix is analyzed, and the qualitative analysis of the influence on the power grid strength is completed through the sensitivity of eigenvalues; secondly, a modal perturbation theory based on gSCR and Calculation method of MIDC critical generalized short circuit ratio after wind power is connected. Finally, the accuracy and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified by a simulation example.

articleTitle: Investigation on Differentiated Transformation Strategy of Coal to Electricity based on Big Data Statistical Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper is focused on the “coal to electricity” users have low use efficiency of electrical equipment and high investment in supporting power grid. In order to improve this problem, we analyzed the user's power consumption information, current equipment power supply capacity and power consumption status based on the platform of marketing measurement, production PMS and visual big data information. And then the differentiation standard is formulated. At last, we summarized simple and practical methods to improve the quality of “coal to electricity” user and the utilization efficiency of equipment. This paper will provide a reference for improving the efficiency and benefit of large-scale policy investment in power supply enterprises.

articleTitle: Analysis on Potential of Small Hydropower Increasing Power Generation in Mengdong River Basin
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Small hydropower is a clean energy source. According to the characteristics of the Mengdong River Basin, the hydrological forecast model adopts the three-water source Xin'an River model. At the same time, the DPSA optimization algorithm is used to optimize the power generation dispatching plan of the cascade reservoir group, and improve the power generation and the utilization rate of water resources. The analysis result shows that the total power generation of the Mengdong River cascade hydropower station optimized dispatch is greater than the actual total power generation in operation. The actual total power generation in operation is 57,796,870 kWh, while the total power generation of the optimized dispatch is 64,032,600 kWh, which can increase the power generation by 10.79%.

articleTitle: The Decay Characteristics Based Capacity Configuration Method for User Side Battery Energy storage
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: When the capacity decreases to about 80%, the battery can not be used in EV, but can be used for electric energy storage. The retired batteries are obviously different from new batteries on the aspect of the decline characteristics, the cost composition, operation performance and economic benefits. When the retired batteries are applied to the power energy storage on the user side, the capacity configuration methods are also quite different. In this paper, the “<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\varepsilon-\mathrm{N}$</tex>” model of battery decay characteristics is established, and then a user side decommissioned battery energy storage capacity configuration method considering the decay characteristics is proposed, and the corresponding problem is solved based on the two-level optimization framework. The case analysis shows that the decline characteristics have a certain impact on the energy storage configuration scheme and the economic benefits of users, which also verifies the rationality and feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Production Simulation Method for Frequency Response Capacity Planning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low frequency load shedding caused by the lack of high power of extra high voltage faults and the frequency stability of the grid due to the high penetration of renewable energy, it is an inevitable trend to develop standby capacity planning for power systems oriented towards frequency response. The traditional standby capacity planning method, which only considers the supply and demand power deviation index, can no longer meet the demand for fast frequency response. In response to the above problems, it is found that the dynamic change of system frequency needs to be considered when formulating capacity planning for fast frequency response. Considering the multi-resource structure of modern power systems, this paper simulates the output of wind power units, thermal power units, gas turbine power units, et al. Based on the idea of parameter aggregation, this paper establishes a frequency response model containing multiple resources and multiple units, and reduces the order of the model. A mathematical analysis method is used to solve directly for the frequency nadir to improve computational speed. The simulation examples and their results show that the probabilistic production simulation method proposed in this paper takes into account the dynamic frequency change process, and that its analytical method is faster compared to the simulation method and can meet the needs of standby capacity planning for fast frequency response.

articleTitle: A Two-Step Quadratic-Convex Based Tightening Method for Electricity-Gas System Optimization Considering Current Margins
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of energy interconnection, electricity and gas systems transfer energy with each other frequently. Thus, the demand for improving the connected system's efficiency and reliability is required. This paper proposes a two-step approach for solving the optimization problem in the electricity-gas system by quadratic-convex based tightening method. The first step is to convexify the non-linear and non-convex optimization problem by quadratic-convex relaxations, which enlarge the solution region. The second step involves multiple tightening iterations to narrow the relaxed solution region. Besides, the security indices of the electricity system are considered in the co-optimization model. The implement of the current margins prevents the overload current of transmission lines. The applicability and effectiveness of the proposed method are tested through case studies.

articleTitle: Online Matching Method of Wind Farm Unit-level Data
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of wind generation technologies, a wind farm is becoming larger and larger, but the huge unit-level real-time operation information is difficult to obtain. In view of the lack of unit-level operation data, this paper establishes the mapping model between the measurement data at the point of interconnection and unit-level data. Firstly, according to the historical operation data of the wind farm, the characteristic scenes are analyzed, and the historical scenario database of the wind farm is established. Then, according to the scenarios in the database, a multi-level neural network model is trained for the wind farm, and the matching model of unit-level information is established. At the same time, a matching mechanism of negative feedback regulation is proposed to ensure the consistency between the matched and measured total power of the wind farm to improve the accuracy of data matching. Finally, the online matching method of unit-level data is formed, and its effectiveness is verified by the actual operation data of a wind farm.

articleTitle: Online Assessment Method of Switching Overvoltage Risk Using the Participation-Factor-Based Reduced-Order State-Space Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: When the modern power grid deals with the power outage caused by natural disasters, the primary task is to restore the power supply quickly and safely. Therefore, the risk assessment of switching overvoltage is very important in the research of black start. Aiming at the disadvantage that electromagnetic transient simulation takes too long, this paper proposes an on-line evaluation method of switching overvoltage, which constructs the state-space equation of the system, analyzes the degree of participation between each state variable and each dominant mode based on the participation factor analysis method, and further gives the fast solution method of state space equation. The effectiveness and rapidity of the evaluation method are verified in the study of a transmission network with six transmission lines on PSCAD platform.

articleTitle: Optimal Dispatch for Integrated Energy Microgrid Considering Start-up and Shutdown of Hydrogen Production
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of renewable energy sources and carbon neutrality unfolding worldwide, the integrated energy microgrid is receiving more and more attention. However, there is a lack of in-depth research on the characteristics of hydrogen production which is the core of integrated energy microgrid. This paper analyzes the transition processes of start-up and shutdown in the hydrogen production with the standard solution for the hydrogen volume which cannot come into the storage tank. Then the mathematical model for the economic optimal dispatch in the microgrid is proposed. Numerical results show the effectiveness of the proposed optimal dispatch and the operation cost of microgrid is reduced by up to 19.4%.

articleTitle: Electricity Demand And Carbon Emissions Forecast Of China's Civil Vehicles Under The Background Of Electrification
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on China's goal of reaching the carbon emissions peak in 2030, the energy saving potential of China's civil automobile sector and the contribution it can make to the carbon emissions peak are explored. This paper first studies the current electricity consumption and carbon emissions of civilian vehicles assuming they are fully electrified, which proves that civilian vehicles have extremely high carbon emission reduction potentials, and they are the objects that need to be focused on to hit peak emissions. Secondly, forecast the holdings of civilian vehicles and electric vehicles in 2030. Then regression analysis is used to predict the number of civilian vehicles and electric vehicles in 2030, and based on the new electricity consumption and the carbon emissions generated by the new electricity after electrification. And the result is that China's electric vehicle terminal demand in 2030 is 181.354 billion kWh. Finally, according to the power supply structure in 2030, the carbon emissions changes caused by the electrification of the civilian vehicle field are predicted, that is, the total emissions generated by electric vehicles in 2030 are about 130.8 million tons.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of FPGA Based Boost Half Bridge DC-DC Multiphase Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Recently, fuel cells as a highly efficient, clean energy conversion device with multiple applications have received particular attention. DC-DC module is an important component of fuel cell energy conversion device. Based on this, this paper studies a new type of DC-DC converter which is used in high power applications. The structure of the multiphase converter are introduced, for the interleaved control strategy and its implementation for multiphase converter is proposed in this paper is described in detail, analyzes the working principle of the system and the zero voltage switching condition, gives the system in a complete working mode switch period, expounds the concrete the steps of control system and the main circuit parameter design, based on high frequency transformer in the same ratio and different conditions were analyzed by MATLAB simulation and experimental verification.

articleTitle: Research on Technology of Ice Melting with Load Based on Dual SVG Flow Control
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Line icing can easily cause towers down and lines broken, which seriously threatens the safe operation of the power grid and power supply. Current ice melting is an economical and efficient means to deal with line icing. But the existing engineering application of ice melting technology is required line outages, which is greatly affected to the power grid. In order to realize the ice melting without power outages, a method of ice melting with load based on dual SVG flow control is proposed. Power flow controlling can increase the line current to achieve the purpose of line ice melting. Finally the aim of ice melting with load is realized. The feasibility of the scheme is verified by calculation and simulation of dual SVG flow control for 10kV lines.

articleTitle: A Coordinated Control of Hybrid Energy Storage System for Photovoltaic Power Smoothing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The output power of photovoltaic (PV) is often volatile and intermittent, its large-scale grid connection will cause a huge burden on the stable operation of the power system. In recent years, there are more and more examples of energy storage systems used to smooth power fluctuations caused by PV. This study developments a hybrid energy storage system (HESS), which composed of battery, supercapacitor and flywheel energy storage. In this study, a two-stage low-pass filtering strategy is proposed to divide the unbalanced power that needs to be smoothed into high, medium, and low-frequency signals. Furthermore, Proposing a coordinated control strategy based on the state of charge (SOC) of battery and supercapacitor, and the angular velocity of the flywheel. Finally, the simulation results of typical solar-storage combined power generation system under various operating conditions are compared and analyzed to verify the effectiveness and rationality of those proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Technical Requirements for Autonomous Point Cloud Collection and Autonomous Inspection of Unmanned Aerial Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid growth of grid load, the length of transmission lines is increasing year by year. The contradiction between the increase in overhead transmission line operation and maintenance workload and the shortage of personnel has become increasingly prominent. UAV autonomous inspections are more and more widely used in transmission line inspections. However, the current point cloud collection of traditional UAVs has the problems of long collection period and low quality. In this paper, through the combination of front-end vision algorithm and autonomous flight technology, the whole process of unmanned aerial vehicle point cloud acquisition is realized. It also introduced the UAV inspection content and clarified the relevant technical requirements for UAV inspection shooting and storage. The operation process and method of drone inspection have been standardized. This can improve the efficiency of drone inspections. And it helps to improve the intrinsic safety level of the line.

articleTitle: A New Coordinated Distribution Network Planning Method Considering Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the gradual implementation of many distributed power generation connections and various demand-side responses to construction projects, the overall planning of the distribution network has encountered certain challenges. It pointed out that the source network load with all aspects of interactive communication and demand-side response is all over the Internet technology harmonious coordination method. First, create an overall planning decision model for distributed generation (DG) investment project operators, power grid investment project operators, and power installation customers to participate in demand-side response (DSR). Then, select an improved response evolution algorithm to obtain a secondary integrated digital model. Taking IEEE33-BUS as an example, the model fitting linear fitting ant colony algorithm has been verified. The collaborative and comprehensive approach reasonably establishes the response plan for customers of power installation projects to participate in DSR, carries out “source network load” cooperation and win-win, and promotes the use of resources.

articleTitle: Reliable Electricity Pricing Method of Distribution Network Considering Outage Loss Increment and Differentiated Demand
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of distribution network power supply reliability and the differentiation of user reliability requirements, distribution network reliability price has become one of the significant directions in electricity price research. First of all, this paper establishes the reliability indexes of distribution network by using the electric energy consumption information, the actual data of distribution network lines and equipments that obtained from different types of end users, then different types of end users are partitioned according to the reliability indexes, and reliability indexes of each power supply zone are calculated. Secondly, combined with the proposed long-term planning investment strategy of distribution network, the maximum outage loss function models of different power supply zones are established and solved by comprehensively considering the unit outage loss, load growth rate, power supply reliability level and the value of expected energy not supplied in each power supply partition. Thirdly, considering the influence of unit power injection at each load point on the investment horizon of distribution network, the outage loss increment is introduced into the long-term incremental cost method, and the regional electricity price of each power supply zone is calculated. Finally, the reliability price of end users is calculated by value engineering theory considering the difference between the users' reliability demand and the reliability level of actual power supply zones.

articleTitle: A Fault Diagnosis Method for Single Phase Break in Distribution Network Based on Multi-Voltage-Level Information Fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The single-phase break fault is one of the common faults in distribution network. When a line breaks down, the change of voltage and current is not obvious before fault point. Especially for the branch-line-break fault which happens very frequently, the change of voltage and current along the whole trunk line is not obvious and it's difficult to find the fault point. This paper focuses on fault location for four types of single-phase break fault. Symmetrical component method is firstly used to analyze fault characteristics, and then the fault diagnosis method based on multi-voltage-level information fusion is proposed accordingly, which could locate both trunk line fault and branch line fault. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by simulation analysis.

articleTitle: Research on Transient Stability Analysis of Win d-Photovoltaic-Thermal-bundled Power Transmitted System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Wind power, photovoltaic power is the main way of new energy power generation in China. Bundling the three of the wind, photovoltaic, thermal power and then transmitting by AC/DC hybrid system is an important way to achieve the power transmission of new energy bases in my country. First, the typical model of the wind-p hotovoltaic-thermal-bundled power is established based on PSD-BPA. After, the effects of wind, photovoltaic and thermal differential ratio on system transient stability are analyzed using equal area criterion, and it is concluded that with the increase of the exhibition, the transient stability of the system is enhanced. Finally, it is giving a simulating analysis and conclusions to wind-photovoltaic-thermal-bundled power using the PSD-BPA. The results indicates that when the load and the total output of the power plant remain unchanged, with the increase of the proportion of wind and photovoltaic power output, the transient stability of the system will be enhanced, and when the total out put of wind and photovoltaic power is constant, increasing the proportion of wind power is more conducive to the enhancement of the transient stability of the system.

articleTitle: Comparison of Different Parameter Optimization Objectives under DCSCF for MMC-HYDC-Grid
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to ensure the reliable ride through of modular multilevel converter power grid (MMC-HYDC-Grid) under DC short-circuit fault (DCSCF), the current limiting reactor (CLR), arm reactor (AR), and sub-module capacitance (C) in the main circuit need to be optimally configurated according to specific optimal objectives. In this paper, two different optimal design objectives are proposed and compared, which are the minimization peak values of DC fault current and maximum transient energy flow (TEF) suppression rate and suppression efficiency during 10ms after pole to ground fault (PTGF), while the CLR, AR, and C parameters are taken as optimization variables to find the more cost-effective optimal configuration. To test proposed method, the model for four-terminal MMC-HYDC-Grid is built through PSCAD/EMTDC simulation platform. Genetic algorithm (GA) is used to solve the optimization problem. The comparative analyses of the simulation results show that the optimal model with TEF suppression rate and suppression efficiency as optimization objectives take into account the economic performance index of restraining DC fault current, thus reducing the cost of current limiting.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Distributed Stability Control Test System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve the test efficiency and test accuracy of the engineering stability control system, a automated test system solution for the stability control system based on distributed collaborative testing and virtual device communication is proposed, which can adapt to different test situations including multiple stability control stations and single stability control station. The paper introduces the principles and implementation methods of the four key technologies which used in the stability control system test system in detail: wireless collaborative testing technology, virtual simulation of stability control device technology, test case generation technology and test report generation technology. Then a detailed explanation about the realization process of the key technology is introduced through the stability control engineering examples.

articleTitle: Tie-Line Feasible Region Characterization Method for Nonlinear Regional Power System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With increasing demand for electricity and renewable energy, tie-line power exchanges among interconnected power networks facilitate the efficient utilization of power resources. Exact description of tie-line feasible region guarantees the security in power dispatching. However, because of the existence of nonlinear constraints, the tie-line feasible region is usually complex. This paper proposes an approximation method to characterize the original tie-line feasible region considering nonlinear constraints such as transmission capacity limit. A sufficient number of boundary points of the original nonlinear tie-line feasible region are obtained through the process of finding optimal solution by translating the facets, which is called multisegment boundary approximation method, then connect these boundary points to complete the approximation. Meanwhile, the accuracy of the approximation method is measured by Monte Carlo method. The calculation results demonstrate the validity of the multi-segment boundary approximation applied to nonlinear tie-line feasible region.

articleTitle: Electricity Price Prediction Based on Empirical Mode Decomposition and Minimum Gated Memory Network Quantile Regression
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the open electricity market, accurate short-term electricity price prediction is crucial for market participants to formulate market strategies. This paper proposes an electricity price prediction method based on empirical mode decomposition and minimum gated memory network quantile regression. Empirical mode decomposition is used to decompose the electricity price sequence into several modal components, and the quantile regression (QR) and minimum gated memory network (MGM) combined with QR-MGM, a hybrid model, to predict each modal component under different quantiles, and use the kernel density estimation to obtain the probability density function of electricity price for the reconstructed prediction results. Taking the electricity price data of the American ERCOT power market as an example, it shows that the proposed combined forecasting method not only has higher accuracy of short-term electricity price prediction under the same training time, but also obtains a more reliable electricity price probability density function, which provides more effective information for market participants to formulate optimal market strategies.

articleTitle: Collaborative Planning of Distributed Generation and Distribution Network Considering Dynamic Reconstruction of Grid
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problems that the current collaborative optimization of distributed generation and distribution network involves less distribution network expansion planning and the existing collaborative research has a single applicable grid structure, a collaborative planning method of distributed generation and distribution network considering grid dynamic reconfiguration is proposed. Firstly, aiming at the lowest overall economic cost, a bi-level model of distributed generation and distribution network collaborative planning is established. The upper and lower levels determine the new lines and transfer, and the location and capacity of distributed generation respectively; Secondly, according to the actual characteristics of the two layers, the corresponding coding and solution methods are proposed, and the solution framework of bi-level programming is given; Finally, the planning results with or without distributed generation are calculated according to the actual example, which verifies the scientificity and practicability of the model and method.

articleTitle: A Two-Stage Maintenance-Operation Robust Optimization Model Considering Line Forced Outage
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Considering the effect of line forced outage in the power system with wind farms, a two-stage maintenance-operation robust optimization model is proposed. The model aims at minimizing maintenance and operation costs as well as wind curtailment and load shedding while considering wind power and line forced outage uncertainties. Then we use column and constraint generation algorithm to solve the two-stage three-layer problem. The simulation results of IEEE 6-bus and IEEE 39-bus systems show that taking all kinds of uncertainties into consideration can significantly enhance the robustness of power systems to deal with uncertainties.

articleTitle: Standardized Modeling of Integrated Energy System for Multi-Scenario Interaction
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Standardization is a necessary way to realize the information interaction of the integrated energy system. Compared with traditional power systems, the standardization of integrated energy systems has technical challenges such as multi-energy flow coupling, more complex operating scenarios, various types of equipment and different characteristics. Based on the experience of interactive standardization of power systems, steam heating system and the existing IEC61970 series of standards. The unique classes and attributes of integrated energy systems were extended. And the topological models of heat system, cold system and gas systems were described.

articleTitle: Two-stage Robust Optimal Dispatch of AC/DC Hybrid Microgrid Considering the Influence of Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of the microgrid system, the natural properties of various distributed power sources are gradually shown. Due to the great influence of natural factors on fans and photovoltaic, the prediction of the current day is often biased. The above factors increase the difficulty of the microgrid system scheduling. In view of the uncertainty of wind turbine and photovoltaic cell panel output, a two-stage robust optimization model of microgrid system including wind generator, photovoltaic panels, gas turbine and energy storage equipment was constructed by using the two-stage robust optimization method, taking the total operating cost into consideration and the output constraints and climbing constraints of each unit in the system. C & CG algorithm is used to solve the problem, and the effectiveness of the optimization method is verified.

articleTitle: A Calculation Method of Energy Storage Configuration Based on Abandoned Power
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the dual support of “double carbon” and “energy revolution”, the installed capacity of new energy in Shanxi Province will continue to grow rapidly, and it is expected to exceed 70 million kW in 2030. At present, the peak shaving capacity of power grid is insufficient, and the high proportion of new energy will lead to a large number of abandonment. As a strategic emerging industry, energy storage is not only an important link to enhance the security, flexibility and comprehensive efficiency of power system supply, but also one of the key technologies to support energy transformation. The allocation calculation of energy storage is a research hotspot in recent years, but the calculation method based on intelligent algorithm is difficult to realize engineering application. In this paper, a calculation method of energy storage power and energy allocation based on new energy abandonment power is proposed. Based on the actual abandonment power and quantity of power grid, the energy storage allocation power and energy are calculated and obtained by engineering method, which has strong engineering adaptability and popularization value.

articleTitle: Partial Discharge In Cable Heads: Causes And Preventive Measures For A Gas Insulation Ring-Network Cabinet
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Because of their compact structure, gas insulation ring-network cabinets are commonly used worldwide. However, recently, nearly 100 incidents of burning cable-joints occurred at different locations throughout China. Thanks to the analysis of the failing cable-heads and modern online monitoring technology of partial discharge, which is based on capacitance coupling, important information, which is analyzed in detail in this paper, could be obtained. The evidence, presented in this paper, suggests that during the installation and operation of cable joints, the matching body of cable-boot sleeve and fuse-well pile head needs to be well sealed and grounded to avoid the localization and concentration of the electric field. Furthermore, the information about the partial discharge can be obtained by checking the phase holes of the live display of the ring network cabinet. This way it is possible to enable online monitoring of partial discharge in a ring-network cabinet, which enables early warning and increases the safety of the power system.

articleTitle: Two-Stage Bidding Strategy of Virtual Power Plant in Electricity and Carbon Emissions Trading Markets
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to promote the consumption of renewable energy under the market environment, the virtual power plant (VPP) integrates distributed wind power, photovoltaic generator, energy storage system, controllable load and other dispatchable resources to participate in electricity market as a whole. Meanwhile, VPP can participate in the carbon emissions trading market (CETM) to improve its environmental benefits. At present, few articles study the bidding strategy of VPP for multiple markets, and the specific current market mechanism in China was also not considered. To solve the above research gap, aiming at the optimal operation of VPPs facing the day-ahead electricity market (DAEM), real-time electricity market (RTEM) and CETM, a two-stage bidding strategy of VPP is established to maximize its revenue while minimizing its operational risk. This paper adopts CVaR as the risk measurement index to quantify risks caused by uncertainties of wind power output, photovoltaic output and electricity price. When developing the bidding strategy, consider the deviation electricity tariff settlement mechanism (DETSM) in China's current electricity market operation mechanisms, and analyze its impact on VPP's revenue. Finally, an example is given to verify the effectiveness of the proposed bidding strategy.

articleTitle: Multi - Functional Coordination Control for Bidirectional Interlinking Converters in Islanded Hybrid AC/DC Microgrid Cluster
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a multi-functional coordination control for bidirectional interlinking converters (BICs) is proposed in islanded hybrid AC/DC microgrid cluster. First, a new droop principle for BICs (include bi-directional DC/DC converter and bi-directional AC/DC converter) is established which can realize proportionally power distribution of the whole islanded hybrid AC/DC microgrid cluster. In addition, When DC or AC microgrids lose the power balancing and DC voltage, AC frequency/voltage control capability, the BICs can control the DC voltage, AC frequency/voltage and DC common bus voltage automatically and the mutual power support within the microgrids will satisfy the total load demand. Then, define the first-level m utual a ssistance rule (FMAR) a nd second-level mutual assistance rule (SMAR) to achieve flexible power management. The FMAR and SMAR will be activated by the energy management system orders when load fluctuates in DC or AC microgrids. The under-loaded microgrid first participate in mutual power assistance with FMAR, otherwise, SMAR will be triggered. This configuration c an a void unnecessary power exchange and effectively utilize the reserve capacity of under-loaded microgrids. Finally, simulation cases are carried out to show the validity and efficiency of the proposed multi-functional coordination control strategy.

articleTitle: Post Disturbance Review System Based on Multi-Source Information
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Focus on high coupling, poor flexibility and difficult expansion of traditional post disturbance review(PDR) system, a method of realizing PDR system based on microservice architecture is proposed. According to the functional requirements, the PDR system is reconstructed into four fine-grained microservice modules: grid model, accident record, operation record and human-computer interaction, effectively avoid the strong coupling and stacking of the system. All microservices runs in container that is isolated from each other and deployed on the cloud computing platform, which effectively improve the stability and disaster recovery level of the system. The test results show that the PDR system has the advantages of stable operation and good response efficiency, and provides technical support for digital power grid construction.

articleTitle: Estimation Of Battery State Of Health Based On Random Weight PSO-ELM
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The estimation of the battery's state of health is instructive for the use and maintenance of the battery. The more accurate the estimated health status is, the higher the reliability of the system. Because the battery is influenced by many elements such as internal resistance, temperature and voltage, it is difficult to directly calculate its health status. Aiming at problems such as difficulty in measuring internal parameters and difficulty in mathematical modeling when estimating battery health status under operating conditions, this paper first predicts the health status of the battery through an extreme learning machine (ELM), and then uses random weighted particle swarm algorithm to optimize the ELM, and finally through the comparison of the prediction results of the extreme learning machine and the random weighted particle swarm optimization extreme learning machine, the validity of the battery health prediction used in this paper is verified.

articleTitle: Day-ahead Dispatch of Smart Energy Aggregators Based on Regenerative Clean Heating and Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In response to the increasing air pollution in winter, the clean heating operations centered on the transformation of electric heating have been carried out continually in northern China. In the future, with the gradual maturity of load-side resource aggregation control model and the deepening of the digital power grid, heat storage electric boiler will get access to the smart energy aggregator with various local distributed energy sources, aiming to promote the consumption of renewable energy and achieve more flexible and diversified control. This paper is based on the operating principles of heat storage electric boiler and the smart energy aggregation. Under two types of demand response scenarios including time series of electricity prices and demand-side peak shaving ancillary service markets, this paper mainly builds a day-ahead aggregation scheduling model with heat storage electric boiler, distributed photovoltaic and electric energy storage. Finally, based on the history data of the heating period in Shangyi County, Zhangjiakou, the calculation example is solved and analyzed. The result verifies the effectiveness of the aggregation scheduling model based on the regenerative clean heating under the demand response mechanism.

articleTitle: Frequency Regulation Parameter Identification of Wind Farm AGC System Based on Data Driven Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, with the increase of wind power penetration, it is necessary for wind power to undertake the responsibility of frequency adjustment in the future. In this paper, the identification technology of wind farm frequency regulation parameters based on data-driven method is studied. Firstly, the structure framework and control index of automatic generation control in current power system are analyzed, and the process curves of primary frequency regulation and secondary frequency regulation of actual wind farm are drawn. Then, the primary frequency regulation transfer function parameters and secondary frequency regulation related parameters of wind farm are identified by using data-driven algorithm. Through the simulation of several experimental data of a wind farm in northern Hebei Province, it is verified that the data-driven algorithm has higher identification accuracy than the traditional two-point method and slope method.

articleTitle: Study on Simple Field Test Method for Thyristor Control Performance of SVC
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The test for thyristor control performance in TCR is an important basis to measure the performance of SVC control system. The existing test methods and devices are too complex and complicated. They are not suitable for the field operation environment. This paper proposed a novel simple field test method for thyristor control performance of SVC. The method can realize the effective detection of SVC thyristor control performance with simplified wiring and common field instrument. It is suitable for the field operation environment. Their validity and feasibility were verified by using the proposed methods to test actual SVC in field.

articleTitle: Analysis of Power Chip Failure in Busbar Protection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This article describes the failure analysis process of the power chip of the bus-bar protection device. The failure point of the domestic DC/DC power supply chip is located and analyzed by means of electrical analysis and destructive physical analysis, and the cause of the chip failure is analyzed from the perspective of application conditions. A set of convenient, practical, and efficient chip failure analysis solutions is provided which can quickly and effectively locate chip failure locations through common testing methods, and analyze possible factors that cause failure stress. And suggested improvement measures are proposed.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Simulation Framework for Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The emergence of the Integrated energy system (IES) reflects the trend of the energy supply systems, which is conductive to achieving sustainable development. Dynamic simulation can be regarded as a digital twin of the IES, and is applied to generate data and simulate the operations, etc. Thus, it is a significantly meaningful work to implement related studies. In this paper, considering the multi-time scale characteristics of energy categories in the IES, a cooperative dynamic simulation framework based on multiple platforms is proposed, where APROS is applied for the slow-time scale simulation while RT-Lab is for the fast-time one, and the multiple platforms communicate with each other via OPC UA protocol. Under this framework, a dynamic simulation application case of an industrial IES, involving gas, heat and power networks, is studied. Furthermore, an operation strategy optimization is conducted from the aspects of economy, efficiency and environment for a typical winter energy supply scenario for taking the time-of-use energy prices and integrating renewable energy. The experimental results demonstrate that the framework proposed in this study is effective, which can provide technical support for IES researches.

articleTitle: Identification Method of Load Model Static Characteristic Coefficients Based on Disturbance Data
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The paper carries out the identification and analysis of the static characteristic coefficients of the load model based on the daily disturbance data. First, based on the linear model, a theoretical analysis of the identification method of the integrated load static characteristic coefficient is carried out. Second, the identification process of the integrated load static characteristic coefficient is explained. Finally, the feasibility and applicable scope of the identification method are proved by the Simulation examples.

articleTitle: Destination-driven EV Fast Charging Station Capacity Configuration
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The rapid development of electric vehicles (EV) puts forward higher requirements on the configuration of fast charging stations (FCS): improving the operating economy of FCSs while taking into account the impact on the power grid and improving the convenience of charging for users, so this paper proposes a destination-driven FCS capacity configuration method. Firstly, considering the guiding effect of time-of-use (TOU) price on charging behavior, a charging demand model for EVs is established. Secondly, considering the convenience of traveling to the next destination after charging is completed, a destination-driven FCS selection method that comprehensively considering the road distance and congestion is proposed. Then, a FCS capacity configuration model is established to minimize the construction and operation and maintenance costs of FCSs and vehicle queuing time cost. Finally, a simulation analysis is conducted in a traffic network to verify the correctness and effectiveness of the model and method proposed.

articleTitle: Research on Isolation Scheme of A Distribution Power Network With MVDC- Flexible Interconnection Based on MMC
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To solve the problem of low reliability of the traditional AC distribution network, the use of DC technology can be used to realize the flexible interconnection and closed loop operation. Especially, MVDC-flexible system based on multi-module converter (MMC) can significantly improve the power supply reliability and the ability to accept distributed energy and energy storage. However, the influence of fault condition and imbalance of three phase voltage can transfer to further system if interconnection with MVDC-flexible system can not isolate them. Thus, in the research, the different technical isolation schemes of A MVAC distribution network with MVDC-flexible interconnection was compared and studied. The use of DC transformer solutions and its future development potential was focused on.

articleTitle: Demand Response Potential Measurement Based on Adjustable Load Scale
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing pressure of power supply in China, demand response, as an important resource of power system, has been widely concerned. Demand response potential assessment is the premise of its implementation. Reasonable assessment of demand response potential is of great significance for effectively gathering demand side resources. Taking Jiangxi Province as an example, this paper forecasts the load after the adjustable load analysis, analyzes the user adjustable load, and evaluates the demand response potential of different users. The calculation results show that the theoretical load reduction scale of the province in the next five years will be 2.3044 million kW to 3.4871 million kW, and the proportion of load reduction will be 8.09% to 8.72%.

articleTitle: Treatment Method for Series-type and Parallel-type Compensation Equipment in Voltage Sags
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To solve the problem of voltage sags, a treatment method for series-type and parallel-type compensation equipment in voltage drop state is proposed.
