Compared with the traditional general type compensation equipment management, this method can further divide the connection mode of the production line equipment and the compensation equipment. The method processed has higher adaptability compared with tradition method, and the calculation result is more accurate, which is convenient for the worker to have a comprehensive and multi-field understanding of each production line before the voltage sags, and it was verified that the method was very effective.

articleTitle: The Discussion on the Replacement Strategy of Overrunning Protection In Smart Substation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: On the basis of analyzing the existing problem of smart substation, this article discusses the extended-used protection for intelligent substation. Three replacing scheme are proposed for the extended-used protection, it is analyzed concretely in the preparation stage, protection installation and protection device debugging stage. Three scheme are contrasted and analyzed in five respects including the construction period, construction difficulty, operation maintenance, systematic risk and effect of bus differential protection. The optimum scheme is the outdoor installation protection. I hope this article can provide reference function to the protection replacement and operation of intelligent substation.

articleTitle: A Bilayer Daily Load Curve Clustering Method Based on Short-Time Cross-Correlation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The diversity of residential consumer load curves in the shape characteristic, amplitude and time domain increase the difficulties of clustering analysis. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a bilayer clustering method for daily load curves based on short-time cross-correlation. Firstly, to achieve better clustering of load curves, the short-time cross-correlation coefficient is used as the distance metric to weaken the effect of time domain differences on shape similarity. Then, the shape clustering results are clustered on amplitude by taking the Euclidean distance as a distance metric. The proposed method not only considers the influence of temporal characteristics on the distance metric, but also has the ability to identify the shape and amplitude of daily load curves. Case study on the measured data, verified the effectiveness of the proposed method in load pattern recognition.

articleTitle: Optimal Configuration of Isolated DC Microgrid Capacity Based on Cbpio Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Distributed power sources with random and intermittent characteristics will cause power fluctuations in the microgrid system, so then affecting the economy and reliability of the microgrid. Therefore, this article proposes a method for isolated wind/light/hydrogen/storage DC microgrids. Firstly, the capacity allocation optimization model is constructed with the goal of the least unit electricity cost, the lowest load shortage rate, and the lowest energy surplus rate. Secondly, a new intelligent algorithm, pigeon inspired optimization algorithm, is used to solve the model. In view of the defects of the algorithm which is easy to fall into local optimum and low convergence accuracy, this paper proposes four methods to improve it. Through the qualitative analysis of the test function, the effectiveness of the algorithm is verified. Finally, a simulation model is established to verify the rationality of the model.

articleTitle: Freight Train Speed Tracking Based on Optimal Preview Control
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Freight train automatic speed accurate tracking is the key link of stability and safety. To reduce the influence on tracking accuracy caused by large time delay of freight train speed tracking system, the response time and command transmission delay characteristics of traction and braking system are studied in this paper, a train speed tracking control model with first-order delay and pure delay is constructed. The freight trains optimal preview speed tracking controller was designed using difference operator, compare with sliding mode controller and fuzzy PID controller, this controller has the characteristics of high response, small speed error.

articleTitle: Study on Wind Power Accommodation Method Based on Controllable Electric Heating
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: It is predicted that renewable energy will replace coal as the cheapest energy source in 2025; by 2037, renewable energy power generation will exceed coal power generation, leading the low-carbon development of the energy system. However, renewable energy has the characteristics of discontinuous production, randomness, fluctuation, uncontrollability, and geographical dispersion. According to the centralized management mode of the traditional power system, it is difficult to meet the requirements of large-scale utilization of renewable energy. Residential electricity consumption is an important part of electricity consumption. According to statistics, my country's domestic electricity consumption accounts for 12% of the total electricity consumption and is increasing year by year. Although the household load of residents is small, its quantity is huge, distributed throughout the grid, and it is highly consistent with the effective use of high-permeability renewable energy: “collection on site, storage on site, and use on site”. In areas requiring heating such as Heilongjiang Province, electric heating in winter will account for most of the household load and become a suitable demand-side response carrier. This paper predicts the power generation of wind power for a period of time in the future. At the same time, it analyzes the user's electric heating history data, finds its heating law and basic model, and uses the intermittent and controllable characteristics of electric heating load. By designing a reasonable control method, under the premise of meeting the heating load and heating, solve the current wind power consumption problem.

articleTitle: Electricity Market Clearing Model Considering Uncertainty of Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the large-scale grid connection of new energy such as wind power, it is very necessary to consider the output uncertainty of new energy such as wind power in the power market clearing model. In this paper, a robust optimization clearing model based on box uncertainty set and a distributed robust optimization model based on Wasserstein metric ambiguity set is proposed. The dual theory is used to deal with the model without increasing the difficulty of solving the model. Finally, the effectiveness of the model is verified by a simulation case.

articleTitle: Dynamic Phasor Estimation Method Considering False Data Injection Attack
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: When the smart grid data acquisition system is attacked by false data injection, because the measured data is tampered, the wrong state estimation will lead to the wrong action of the smart grid controller. This paper proposes a dynamic phasor estimation method considering false data injection attack. Firstly, the electrical signal model suitable for dynamic conditions is established by Taylor series expansion of the electrical signals which include harmonic, noise and other conditions; Then, the method which based on the double suboptimal-scaling factor strong tracking Kalman filter algorithm (DSTKF) and Euclidean distance is used to detect, track and estimate the phasor; Finally, the proposed estimation method is used to simulate the electrical signal with noise and false data attack. Besides, the signal of IEEE 39-bus system is also estimated with this method. The results show that this proposed method can not only detect the false data attack and mutation in electrical signal, but also has high estimation accuracy and tracking ability for dynamic phasor.

articleTitle: Tapping the Potential in Air-conditioning Loads at Telecommunication Base Stations: A Semi-Markov Control Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: China has built a huge number of telecommunication base stations, each of which has air-conditioning load (ACL). In order to tap the potential of the ACLs to provide flexibility in power system operations, this paper develops a semi-Markov control method. Due to the adoption of autonomous control instead of direct load control strategy, the proposed method can better ensure cyber security and data privacy, while ensuring that the space temperature of the base station is within the allowable range. The lock time of ACL is incorporated in the semi-Markov model to avoid frequent switches of ACLs. Two cases with 1,000 and 10,000 base stations were simulated, showing that the aggregate power can accurately track the target power with the proposed method, while ensuring the indoor temperatures of the base stations are within the allowable range and the diversity of the ACLs' operating states.

articleTitle: A Method For Predicting Reactive Voltage Of Photovoltaic Transmission System Based On Double-RF
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the target of “30 60”, the power system is characterized by a high proportion of new energy on the source side, and the uncertainty of new energy generation leads to a strong vulnerability of the power system. This causes a short circuit fault to occur during the transmission of electric energy in a large-scale HVDC transmission system, which causes the voltage of the AC bus at the end to decrease first and then increase. If the reactive power compensation support is not returned in time in the process of low voltage through, it will cause the risk of overvoltage and damage to every part of the power system. By predicting the severity of overvoltage in advance, the reactive power compensation device can be adjusted in time to avoid accidents. In this paper, the mechanism of AC bus overvoltage is analyzed, and the fault of power system is simulated by using PSCAD software. Then, the double-RF algorithm is built to predict the overvoltage level, and the results show that the identification accuracy of this method can reach 98.82%, which is conducive to the timely and rapid decision of reactive power compensation and the reduction of overvoltage level.

articleTitle: Hydrogen-Based Integrated Energy System Planning Considering Temperature-Based Heat Supply and Demand Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Hydrogen is widely regarded as a secondary energy with great potential on the way to achieve peak carbon emissions and carbon neutrality. There is a growing body of literature that recognizes the importance of hydrogen-based integrated energy system. The heat supply and demand are mainly involved with the temperature of heating or heated medium, mass flow and energy. In order to accurately formulate the energy production, transformation and utilization in the integrated energy system, we develop a hydrogen-based integrated energy system with temperature-based heat supply and demand model. The planning problem of the developed system is modeled as a two stage stochastic mixed integer problem with bi-linear constraints. Gurobi Optimizer is utilized to solve the problem. The numerical results show the model can accurately describe the detailed temperature change of heat exchange process between the heat supply and demand side. Moreover, the developed system can significantly reduce carbon emissions when hydrogen price is at a low level, which can be a effective way to achieve carbon neutrality.

articleTitle: Development of Leakage Current Monitoring Senors of MOV for URV/ERV Series Capacitors
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: According to the requirements of monitoring high-voltage equipment and monitoring leakage current of MOVs in series capacitors, double core compensation methods was adopted in this paper, and large window or diameter of micro-current sensor was developed. The developed sensor coil has an outer diameter D=160mm, an inner diameter d=120mm, and a thickness H=10mm. The maximum measurement error is −2.9% in the range of 0.2mA to 5mA. It is difficult for the sensor to measure the current below 0.2mA, because of the interference of background noise. Using the same compensation circuit, the larger the diameter of sensor will be, the worse the measurement accuracy will be. The transient voltage suppressor (TVS) and thyristor surge protection device (TSPD) were adopted in the aspect of impulse current protection design. The test results showed that the sensor developed worked normally under the impact of 8/20µs1@10kA and 2mA@2.5kA square wave and after the test the measured amplitude was still accurate. The sensor presented various of transient processes under the impact of 8/20µs and 2ms square wave current. The sensor had certain ability of self-recovery and self-adjustment, and it can be restored to normal after about 120ms~ 165ms. The transient process of the sensor is related to the material, dimension of the core, coil turns and the dynamic characteristics of the compensation circuit.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis and Comparison of DC Power System with Different Droop Control Methods
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of renewable energy system, de power system has been widely applied to accommodate multiple renewable energy sources and power electronic loads, where the voltage source converters (VSCs) are commonly adopted as interconnected interface. The power electronic characteristic of VSCs will bring in stability issues, while the impedance-based stability theory can be used to analyze system stability. In the dc power system, droop control method is widely adopted to coordinate different renewable energy sources, where the droop gain and control structure of droop-controlled VSCs will both affect system stability. This paper mainly focuses on the stability issue in droop-controlled dc power system, and investigates the impacts of droop gain and different control methods based on the developed impedance model. Furthermore, the validity of stability analysis results is further verified through the simulation results.

articleTitle: Power System Modal Identification Based on Prony Levenberg Marquardt
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Regarding the accuracy problem of low-frequency oscillation parameter identification in the current power system, this paper proposes a new method of extracting low-frequency os cillation modal parameters, combining the Prony algorithm and the Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm. First, the Prony algorithm is used to calculate the initial values of the modal parameters of the low-frequency oscillation, and then the Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm is used to iterate to find the optimal values of the parameters. Through the simulation of a 3-machine 9-node system, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified, and it has certain advantages compared with the traditional method in terms of identification accuracy.

articleTitle: Model Parameter Identification of Wind Farm's Primary Frequency Control based on Actual Power Response Characteristic
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Since wind power penetration is becoming high in power system, its characteristics of primary frequency control has more and more important influence on freque ncy stability analysis of power system. Through research on model parameter identification of wind farm's primary frequency control, the model for parameter identification was determined and wolf pack algorithm was developed as calculation method for parameter identification based o n actual power response data. Then parameter identificati on was applied to an actual wind farm. The comparison between simulation data and actual data indicated that th e identified model parameters could agree with actual po wer response of primary frequency control well.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of the Grid-Connected Raft-Type Wave Energy Conversion System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper describes a fully coupled simulation model of a grid-connected raft-type wave energy conversion system. The three-stage energy conversion and the detailed mechanism model of raft-type wave energy converter (WEC) are studied. Based on the mathematical models of motion equation, hydraulic power take-off system (PTO), generator and controller, the model of the grid-connected raft-type wave energy conversion system is established via Simscape and Simulink software. And the co-simulation analysis is carried out. The feasibility of the model design and the effectiveness of the system controller are verified by the simulation results, which provide a basis for the subsequent system design and later optimization.

articleTitle: Power Grid Fault Diagnosis based on Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power grid dispatching is developing in intelligent directions, and data-driven fault diagnosis has become a development trend for power grids. However, the current power grid fault diagnosis method is lack of data-driven model for power grid fault diagnosis. Based on the quantitative characteristics and time series distribution characteristics of alarm information, a fault diagnosis method of power grid based on Support Vector Machine is proposed. Considering the duration of a single alarm information, the time sequence characteristics of a single fault device and the information amount of the whole fault event, the fault type decision model and the faulty device decision model are constructed based on the Support Vector Machine algorithm. The alarm information generated by the simulation system is used for fault diagnosis. The experimental results show that this method can deal with different forms of alarm information and adapt to the complex working conditions of the engineering site.

articleTitle: Analysis of Reactive Power Coordinated Control of Large Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The wind power has brought many problems to the grid. Among them, the voltage stability problem is the most prominent. The main reason is insufficient reactive power. In response to the above problems, this article first starts with the wind farm itself, excavates the reactive power generation ability of its own equipment, and conducts in-depth research on the reactive power generation ability of the rotor-side inverter and the grid. The side inverters of doubly-fed wind turbines were studied, the mechanism of participating in reactive power regulation was explored, the optimal coordinated control strategy of the two was proposed, and the software model of large-scale wind farms was established in DIgSILENT/power Factory. The simulation calculations are carried out with the help of a typical power grid with 3 machines and 9 nodes. The results show that various faults have occurred in the power grid. The results show that the research strategy can support power grid voltage recovery. There is no need to resort to additional reactive power compensation devices, which reduces the construction investment.

articleTitle: Improved Sliding Mode Control for Low-voltage Ride Through of Hybrid Drive Wind Turbine
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Hybrid drive wind turbine (HDWT), equipped with the speed regulating differential mechanism (SRDM), is able to be friendly connected to power grid without the need of partly- or fully-rated converters. In order to enhance the low-voltage ride through (LVRT) capability of HDWT, this paper presents an improved sliding mode control (SMC) method for the excitation unit of synchronous generator (SG), in which an extended state observer (ESO) is also constructed for the compensation of the internal/external disturbances, such that the SG excitation unit, fed back by the ESO, can guarantee the reactive power support performance during the grid voltage faults. Taking advantages of the built simulation platform of HDWT, comparative case studies are carried out under randomly varying wind speeds and different faults in grid-end. The superiority of the designed SMC based on ESO as well as the satisfactory operating performance in LVRT of the proposed SRDM-based HDWT are verified.

articleTitle: Deploy Mobile Hydrogen Trucks to Improve Energy Supply System Resilience
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: During the last several decades, energy supply systems (electric/gas/heat) have been threatened by the increasing and destructive natural disasters. When disasters happen, the system infrastructure implementations of the energy supply system are destroyed, then result in the disconnecting of various load consumers. Thus, how to improve energy supply system resilience under disasters is a key problem. In present paper, a four-fold integrated framework is proposed to resist to the natural disasters, which is utilizing mobile hydrogen trucks (MHT) distributing hydrogen tanks to microgrids (MG) based on transportation network (TN). We Firstly, a temporal-spatial natural disaster destructive model is presented, which is deployed to evaluate the destructive level of the electric/heat/gas grid supply networks. Secondly, MHT based multiple travelling model is presented to characterize truck delivery behaviors among hydrogen produce companies and MG, and the travelling time is calculated based on the traffic flow assignment. Next, the operation model of the multi-energy supply (MES) grid-connected MG is presented. Last, based on the survival ability of the grid supply networks, and the arrivals of hydrogen trucks, MES MG runs the optimal operation algorithm. The simulation results reveal that the utilization of MHT efficiently transport hydrogen tanks to MES MGs and can improve the system resilience.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Wind-Fire Bundling on Power Angle Stability of Sending End System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, an equivalent model is established for the analysis object of the doubly-fed wind power centralized connection receiving-end large system, and the analysis is carried out based on the power angle characteristics and transient characteristics of the doubly-fed wind turbine. First of all, the electromagnetic power analysis expression of the synchronous machine of the single-ended power transmission system is adopted to analyze the influence of the equivalent output of wind power to replace the thermal power output and connect to the system on the initial power angle of the synchronous machine. Secondly, by studying the characteristics of the active power of the doubly-fed fan after a fault occurs, and analyzing the influence on the system's transient power angle stability based on the Equal Area Rule. The research results show that when the wind power is connected to the system, the initial power angle of the synchronous machine decreases and the transient stability increases; the active power characteristics of the doubly-fed wind turbine have a positive effect on the transient power angle stability of the system.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis and Design of Inductive and Resistive SFCL for HB-MMC-HVDC Under DC Faults
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Half bridge (HB) modular multilevel converter (MMC) based high voltage direct current transmission system (HVDC) is a feasible solution to integrate large renewable energy. However, how to realize DC fault ride-through capability (FRT) of the HB-MMC-HVDC is a huge challenge. This paper intends to use resistive and inductive superconducting fault current limiters (SFCLs) to limit the rising rate of the DC fault current, so that the DC fault current can be isolated by the hybrid DC circuit breakers (CBs) before triggering MMC blocking, reducing the negative influence on the healthy part of the DC system. Firstly, the working process curve of the hybrid DC CBs is introduced, and the SFCLs are analyzed from a view of system level. Then the key parameter design methods of the inductive and resistive SFCL are proposed based on the DC FRT strategy of the HB-MMC-HVDC. Both the analytical and the simulation results show that the proposed design method of the resistive and inductive SFCL is correct and effective.

articleTitle: Research on Grounding Methods of DC Microgrid Based on Power Supply Connectivity and Reliability
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of distributed energy, DC loads, variable frequency loads and voltage sensitive loads, DC microgrids will be widely used in future power grids. At this stage, there is no uniform standard for the grounding design of the DC microgrid, and the grounding methods used in various domestic demonstration projects are also different. Aiming at the DC microgrid based on two-level voltage source converter, this paper analyzes the pros and cons of various grounding methods from the perspective of power supply continuity and reliability. It is recommended to use TT grounding for occasions with high power supply reliability requirements. The selection of the grounding method in the actual project needs to consider many factors. Therefore, the conclusion of this article cannot be used as the judgment standard of the DC microgrid grounding design, but it can provide a certain reference for the designer.

articleTitle: Two-Stage Robust Optimization of Microgrid Based on Adaptive Uncertainty Budget
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Robust optimization, as an important technique for the centralized consumption of renewable energy, effectively considers the impact of uncertain factors on the microgrid operation. This paper proposes an adaptive uncertainty modeling method considering the historical and predictive data correction. The historical correlation is first applied to correct the unreasonable forecast value in the photovoltaic (PV) power prediction interval (PI) to improve the interval sharpness. Then, a method valuing the adaptive budget that considers the prediction correlation is proposed. Finally, a two-stage robust optimal microgrid scheduling model employing polyhedral uncertainty set with adaptive uncertainty budget is established. The column-and-constraint generation algorithm is used to obtain the day-ahead robust scheduling decision. Specific calculation examples illustrate the rationality and superiority of the proposed model of microgrid optimal operation.

articleTitle: MIQP Reformulation and Reliable Solution of Stochastic Economic Dispatch
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Chance-constraint economic dispatch (CCED) has been extensively studied in the operation of high-proportion power systems. However, it is still a challenge to handle the expected power adjustment cost analytically and efficiently with non-Gaussian uncertainty. In this paper, we propose a piece-wise quadratic fitting technique to accurately approximate the expectation terms in objective functions and then transform CCED into a mixed integer quadratic programming (MIQP) problem, which can be solved efficiently with off-the-shelf optimization solvers. Compared to the classical sequential linear programming (SLP) technique, the proposed method has more stable convergence and is more applicable in practical engineering.

articleTitle: Resonance Characteristics and Resonance Suppression Method for Multi-Parallel LCL-Type Inverters
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: When the LCL filter is used as the inverter filter network to suppress the harmonics of the grid-connected current, the grid resonance will be caused by the inherent third-order characteristics, which seriously affects the power quality and system stability. For the resonance problem of multi-paralleled inverters in distributed grid-connected power generation system, the equivalent model of multi-inverters is established, and the distribution of resonant peak is analyzed. The influence of the number of inverters and the power grid impedance on the resonance characteristics of the system is analyzed in detail. And then, an active damping control scheme based on proportional current feedback of capacitor current is proposed to realize the resonance suppression. Finally, grid connected multi-inverters model was built in MATLAB Simulink+plecs platform to verify correctness of the theoretical analysis and the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Performance Test and Analysis of National Secret Algorithm SM2 in Power Data Protection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power data contains a wealth of privacy information. Data protection has always been an urgent problem to pay attention to. Domestic cryptographic algorithm is one of its implementation methods. Aiming at the application of SM2 algorithm in power data protection, this paper first analyzes the principle and process of asymmetric encryption and decryption algorithm SM2, extracts SM2 algorithm from gmssl cipher library and transplants it to Linux system, and then uses Visual Studio 2017 + Qt development software to classify and test SM2 algorithm according to encryption and decryption process and specification length. In a small amount of plaintext length overhead test, SM2 algorithm meets the actual operation performance index and can protect power secret data.

articleTitle: Bidirectional Buck/Boost Converter Based on SiC MOSFET
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: SiC MOSFET is widely used in power electronic devices such as power converters because of its low on resistance, good thermal stability and fast switching speed. In this paper, a prototype of bidirectional buck / boost converter is designed based on SiC MOSFET and STM32 single chip microcomputer. Synchronous rectification technology is used to improve the efficiency of the converter. The driving circuit suitable for SiC MOSFET is designed to increase the reliability of the converter. Finally, the prototype converter is tested in the laboratory.

articleTitle: Fine Modeling in Thermal System of Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The integrated energy system (IES) is a system of coordinated planning and unified dispatching of various energy sources. It uses the coupling of electricity, heat and gas to improve the efficiency of system operation, so as to improve the energy efficiency. Up to now, due to the diversity of thermal equipment, the structure of thermal system has become very complex, but its essence is nothing more than the calculation of thermodynamic properties of various substances. This paper focuses on the thermodynamic calculation of thermal system and summarizes the basic principles of engineering thermodynamics and general empirical formulas in detail. Based on the idea of fine modeling, a general calculation model is built for the density, saturation temperature, saturation pressure, enthalpy, entropy and other state parameters of gas and liquid under ideal and actual conditions based on the MATLAB/Simulink platform. It provides a model foundation for subsequent modular modeling and IES node and network research. It has strong scalability and can adapt to the needs of continuously developing and more complex heat networks. Finally, the feasibility of the model is verified by simulation analysis.

articleTitle: Active and Reactive Power Coordination Optimization of Wind-Light-Storage and Distribution Network Based on Improved Gray Wolf Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to achieve the goal of “double carbon”, a large number of wind, light and other new energy generation is connected to the power system, which brings great challenges to its security and stability. Equipped with certain energy storage can improve its stability. In this paper, the active and reactive power coordination optimization model of distribution network with wind-light-storage is established, which can effectively increase the consumption of renewable energy and reduce the network loss and voltage deviation. Then, an improved multi-objective gray Wolf algorithm (MPSWO) based on particle swarm niche technology is proposed. The model can be solved effectively. Finally, the simulation results of IEEE33 and IEEE69 nodes show that the model can effectively reduce the network loss and voltage deviation, and improve the operation stability of the distribution network. It also shows that the proposed algorithm is universal.

Author Keywords: Active and reactive power coordination and optimal scheduling

articleTitle: A Novel Substation Networking Methodology with Visualization and Supervision Support
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Substation network composed by sophisticated Ethernet bridges is one of the key components of smart substation constructed with IEC 61850 protocol. With the rise of voltage level of substations, more difficulty the configuration and maintenance of substation network arise following. To facilitate quantities of network configuration and visualize the opaque network transmission logic, a novel auto-routing technology based on Substation Configuration Description (SCD) file is developed to make the substation network operation and maintenance work easier and more intuitively. It offers a plug-and-play capability for substation network to let Intelligent Electric Device (IED) to be accessed freely, due to the related forwarding table was generated automatically via the subscription association information defined by SCD file. Implementation of auto-routing and use cases are provided to illustrate the application of this novel substation networking methodology, as the user's guideline.

articleTitle: A Power-based Piecewise Probabilistic Harmonic Model of Secondary Residential System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Harmonic voltage distortion in residential distribution network become quite serious since more and more nonlinear home appliances have been used. However, it is challenge for the utility to fully figure out the severity of the distortion due to the shortage of power quality monitor in distribution network. In response to this problem, this paper establishes a probabilistic harmonic model of secondary residential system(SRS) which represents the low voltage side of the service transformer, and it can be applied to probabilistic harmonic load flow calculation. A large amount of field waveform data is recorded at several service transformers to develop a power-based piecewise harmonic model of the secondary residential system. The use of the piecewise harmonic model is verified by carrying out the probabilistic harmonic load flow in a three-phase four-wire residential distribution network.

articleTitle: Effect of DFIG Under Droop Control on Center Migration of Out-of-Step Oscillation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As a high proportion of new energy is connected to the power system, the system stability will be profoundly affected. According to the output characteristics of doubly-fed-generator under virtual droop control, the out-of-step oscillation center migration is analyzed. Firstly, virtual control is added to improve the current source output control strategy of doubly-fed-generator. Secondly, when there is a small disturbance in the system frequency, the doubly-fed-generator will increase the power and improve the stability of the system. Then, in the out-of-step oscillation scenario, the external equivalent characteristic of the doubly-fed-generator under the control strategy are analyzed, and the influence of the control strategy on the out-of-step oscillation center migration characteristic is analyzed. The influence of the control strategy in this paper to the system stability is verified by a two-machine simulation built by Matlab /Simulink.

articleTitle: Analysis And Calculation Of The Short-Circuit Current Of Xiamen VSC-HVDC Project
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For the heavy load urban power grid, the short-circuit current is closed to the breaking capacity of the AC breaker. After the voltage sourced converter high voltage direct current (VSC-HVDC) is connected, the short-circuit current of VSC-HVDC will be provided during the fault period, which will cause the short-circuit current exceed the standard value and affect the normal operation of the power grid. Taking the Xiamen VSC-HVDC project as an example, this paper analyses the VSC-HVDC control mode, obtains the short-circuit current calculation method. The Xiamen AC / DC hybrid model is built, and the correctness of the proposed method is verified by simulation. The results show that the amplitude and phase angle of the VSC-HVDC short-circuit current have great influence on the total short-circuit current, and the amplitude is easily controlled by the current limiting controller, so the phase angle control should be emphasized. For Point of Common Coupling (PCC), the short-circuit current of single-phase grounding fault may be larger than three-phase grounding fault, which should be taken into account. The ideas provided in this paper have practical engineering significance for the city power supply by VSC-HVDC.

articleTitle: Research on Stability Control Strategy of AC/DC Parallel Transmission System Based on the Uncertainty Analysis of Transient Shock Fault Shape
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: HVDC power transmission presents a variety of power transmission structures. Among them, there are many uncertainties in the operation and control of the AC/DC parallel structure. The power angle, frequency, and voltage problems are deeply coupled under some serious faults, and the characteristics are extremely complex. This paper sorts out typical AC/DC parallel transmission projects at home and abroad, refines typical AC/DC transmission system models, analyzes the transient impact process after different types and different timing DC blocking faults based on time and space uncertain factors, and reveals various types of DC under multiple uncertain factors Fault conduction mechanism, clarify the most serious fault form. Aiming at the characteristics of strong, direct and weak AC power grids, a stability control strategy formulation principle that takes into account the uncertain analysis of transient impulse fault morphology is proposed. The practice of “M-L” DC transmission project proves that the stability control strategy based on the principles proposed in this article can meet the needs of DC high-power test and operation.

articleTitle: A Data-Driven Based Energy Consumption Modeling for Heterogeneous Servers in Data Centers
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The server is recognized as one of the main energy consumption equipment in data center, of which accurate energy consumption modeling is the key of improving the data center's energy efficiency. This paper proposes a data-driven based energy consumption modeling for the heterogeneous servers popularized in the modern data center, i.e. it constructs a polynomial based energy consumption model by using the real-time server performance data published in the SPECpower_ssj 2008. The results illustrate that the server can have different energy consumption characteristics even with the same CPU and it also shows the superiority of the proposed model. Lastly, this paper takes the data center with 1000 servers as an example, a comprehensive comparison analysis between the proposed model and the existing server energy consumption models is conduced, and the results show the accuracy of the proposed model and the effectiveness to track the actual energy consumption profile.

articleTitle: Detection of False Data Injection Attack in Smart Grid via Sliding-Mode Interval Observer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the typical malicious cyber-physical attack, false data injection attack (FDIA) has led huge impacts to smart grid security. Therefore, this paper develops a method against the FDIA based on sliding-mode interval observer detection. By considering the limitation of detection threshold design, an detection criteria based on interval residual is designed. In addition, a sliding-mode interval observer is further proposed to improve the accuracy of state estimation by considering the effects of unknown disturbance. Based on the l<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> performance, the robustness of interval residuals against the unknown disturbance is improved. Finally, the effectiveness and superiority of developed detection method against FDIA is demonstrated on the IEEE 36-bus grid.

articleTitle: Research on Distributed Power Trading Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A large number of grid-connected distributed photovoltaic and wind power generation projects bring challenges to traditional electricity market trading. A distributed power trading model based on blockchain technology is designed in this paper, and the transaction process is introduced in detail. The transaction is established in an annual cycle and settled monthly. The trading model adopts the average price of the sellers' and buyers' quotation price by matching, and the matching transaction takes into account the influence of the differences in transmission prices between different buyers and sellers. The matching transaction mechanism and the monthly transaction settlement mechanism are elaborated. A distributed power trading system based on blockchain technology is developed on the Ethereum platform. Combined with a distributed power trading example, the feasibility of the trading system for distributed power trading is verified.

articleTitle: Voltage Control Strategy of Distributed Photovoltaic Cluster in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of voltage rise caused by the high-penetration distributed photovoltaic cluster connected to the distribution network, this paper proposes a bottom-up, trigger-type hierarchical voltage control strategy of distributed photovoltaic cluster. When the voltage is exceeded the limit, the local voltage control layer is based on the photovoltaic inverter Q(U) segmented droop control strategy to achieve rapid response to the voltage change of the point of connection. If the voltage is still exceeded the limit after local voltage control, in the cluster voltage control layer, in accordance with the priority to use the reactive power adjustment capability of distributed photovoltaic, and the principle of minimizing the reduction of photovoltaic active output, adjust the active and reactive power output of distributed photovoltaic based on the voltage sensitivity analysis method to maximize the consumption of distributed photovoltaic while ensuring the safe operation of the power grid. Finally, simulations verify the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Research And Implementation Of Real-Time Accurate Simulation Platform For Large-Scale Stability Control System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the design characteristics of the stability control system, the control strategies of each station in the system are abstracted and integrated, and classified into standardized logic and customized logic. Based on the real-time digital simulation system platform, a three-layer architecture of the real-time simulation platform for the large-scale stability control system is designed. The standardized simulator based on FPGA/DSP and the customized simulator using device virtualization technology are designed in detail. The design scheme of the real-time accurate simulation platform for large-scale stability control system is proposed. From the perspective of hardware requirements, simulation accuracy, and platform adaptability, the differences between the simulation platform and the existing real-time digital simulation test platform are compared and analyzed.

articleTitle: Research On Voltage Regulation Strategy Of Multi-Terminal DC Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the widespread application of distributed energy, traditional AC power grids are facing greater stability issues. DC power grids have gradually become the focus of research due to their simple structure and better absorbing properties for new energy generation. The paper studies the voltage stability and raises a layered voltage adjustment method. The voltage adjustment is divided into several parts. The six ports of DC grid are coordinated and controlled for voltage regulation. Finally, the valitity of the proposed strategy is verified through the construction of a simulation model.

articleTitle: Fault Location Method Of Flexible DC Transmission System Based on End-To-End CNN-LS TM Parallel Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The fault location of high-voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission line usually needs to determine the characteristic quantity and then calculate it. In this paper, the artificial extraction process is removed and the end-to-end parallel neural network is applied for fault location. The multi-port flexible DC transmission system model is built on the MATLAB/Simulink simulation platform, the line fault current under different fault conditions is extracted, and the CNN-LSTM parallel neural network model is built. With the proposed fault distance measurement method and its corresponding parallel neural network, average error less than 0.2 km can be achieved under a large amount of test case. Compared with single CNN and single LSTM networks, this method maintains high accuracy and reliability, which can handle the fault resistances range from 0.01Ω to 200Ω. The simulation results validate the feasibility of proposed fault location method.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of a Novel Single-Sided Flux Pad for Dynamic WPT System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For the dynamic wireless charging system of electric vehicles, the structure of the coupling transformer has a significant impact on the system performance. The double-sided flux pad is known as good coupling performance over large air gaps with good lateral tolerance to misalignment. However, the magnetic leakage on the back can't be ignored, necessitating the addition of an extra shielding device. This paper proposes an II-single-sided Flux Pad with a larger fundamental flux path height and better coupling performance than a double-sided Flux Pad. Besides, there is little flux leakage in the edge region, and The structure has high tolerance to horizontal misalignment(y-direction).

articleTitle: A Novel Method For Residents Indoor-Outdoor Detection Based On Power Consumption Data
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper a feasible model is proposed to achieve indoor-outdoor detection using high-frequency power consumption data. Many tools can be applied to analyze power consumption habits, among which wavelet transform is an effective one. A method based on sliding window strategy is used to detect indoor-outdoor status. This model is then evaluated in a power supply region in Hangzhou and proved to be accurate. Compared with other methods that are widely used, this model is able to handle high-frequency power consumption data and thus has a good performance.

articleTitle: Research on Deterioration Mechanism of Oil-paper Insulation of 220 kV Current Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The electric and thermal combined deterioration mechanism of the oil-paper insulation of the 220 kV current transformer with different thermal aging times is investigated. The breakdown strengths and breakdown time are obtained with different dwelling times. Furthermore, the life exponents under different temperatures and different aging times are evaluated by a step-by-step increasing voltage test. Finally, the four multi-factor aging models about the remaining life, the electric field, and the temperature are developed. It is shown that the breakdown voltages and the breakdown time decrease rapidly with the increase of the temperature or the thermal aging time, whereas the breakdown time increases with the increase of the dwelling time. The life exponent of the oil-paper is more sensitive to the thermal aging at room temperature, whereas it is more sensitive to the temperature compared to the thermal aging when the temperature exceeds 50 °C. The expected life of the oil paper decreases with the increase of the temperature and thermal aging time. Moreover, the remaining life is inversely related to the electric field and the temperature in the three multi-factor aging models. CRINE model has the best fitting accuracy among the three models. The results can provide theoretical support for the safe operation of the 220 kV current transformer.

articleTitle: Analysis on Self-heating Process of Battery Modules in Energy Storage Station Based on Equivalent Circuit Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The safety of battery modules in energy storage station is a key factor for the power system with high proportion of renewable energy. In this study, the thermal runaway of battery module resulted from self-heating process is investigated and analyzed with the heat balance theory and corresponding equivalent circuit model. With the help of this model, the thermal response of cells in ESS is analyzed, and the influence of cell degradation, cell numbers, and module ventilation on safety of ESS is obtained. The results show that the aged cells with lithium plating, increased cell numbers in a single module and no ventilation show negative impacts on the safety of battery module. This study provides a practical analysis model and meaningful design guidance on the ESS design.

Index Terms: Increase In The Number Of Cells

articleTitle: Experimental Research On New Circuit Breaker Based On True Type Test Platform Of 10kV Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, ground faults are a hot research topic at home and abroad. As many scientific research institutions and manufacturers continue to deepen single-phase ground faults, they have proposed a new type of environmentally friendly primary and secondary fusion pole-mounted circuit breaker ZW68. However, the manufacturer’ s products vary from good to bad, so the 10kV distribution network true platform is used to screen the quality of distribution network products. At the same time, single-phase grounding fault tests with different transition resistances and intermittent are grounding are carried out, verifying the new co-box type one and two times Integrated circuit breaker ZW68's ability to handle faults. Finally, through testing multiple new type common box type primary and secondary fusion pole-mounted circuit breakers ZW68, we put forward practical suggestions for the manufacturer's new products.

Author Keywords: distribution network true type test platform
new type primary and secondary fusion circuit breaker

articleTitle: Non-uniform Quantisation Current Differential Protection Algorithm Applied On Power Specific Integrated Circuit
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: An improved current differential protection algorithm, which actually based on non-uniform quantisation because of the dissimilar sampling demands between transient state and steady state of power system, is presented and mounted on the power specific integrated circuit (PSIC) named FUXI. This method reduces the computational pressure on the PSIC by non-uniformly quantizing the electrical quantity information sampled. This paper also verifies the feasibility of applying the improved algorithm to power-specific integrated circuits by comparing the correctness of the logic running on the chip and in simulation. It practically indicates the engineering application value of power specific integrated circuit in the relay protection.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation Analysis of Grid-connection of Superconducting Generator
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Offshore wind power generation system needs lar ge capacity synchronous generator with high power density, so the lightweight and small size of the superconducting synchron ous generator (SCSG) have a broad prospect in the field of offs hore wind power generation. To apply superconducting synchr onous generator to offshore wind power generation, designing t he corresponding grid-connection system is required. In this pa per, a 3.6 MW class offshore SCSG is designed and its perform ance is simulated using the finite element method (FEM). A coo perative control strategy combining the superconducting field coil and the converter is proposed. A Simulink model of the supe rconducting wind power system (SCWPS) is built to evaluate th e system operation under variable wind speed and Low-voltage ride-through (LVRT) performance.

articleTitle: Robust Parameters Based on VSG & Virtual Inductor Design Considering Power Decoupling
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Virtual synchronous generator (VSG) technology is a hot spot in current research. However, there are few virtual inductors with robust control parameters and power decoupling. Firstly, the grid connection model based on VSG control is simplified by adding the constraint condition of power loop cutoff frequency. On this basis, the small signal model of VSG grid connection is established. Then the constraint conditions of phase Angle margin, droop coefficient and power loop cutoff frequency are added. Based on the above constraints, robust control parameters of VSG power loop are designed. The design method of virtual inductance is obtained. Finally, a simulation model is built in Matlab to verify the effectiveness of the proposed robust control parameter design method and that the virtual inductance selected by the proposed method can realize the decoupling control of the VSG power loop under the operating conditions of the variable power grid.

Author Keywords: Robust control parameter design of power loop

articleTitle: An Analysis Method for The Influence of Governors and PSSs on Low-frequency Oscillation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The existing analysis methods of low-frequency oscillation mostly rely on the calculation of eigenvalues, eigenvectors and residues. A new method based on frequency response matrix for analyzing the influence of governors and PSSs is proposed in this work. Through this method, the effects of multiple controllers on stability can be calculated at one time without calculating eigenvectors, the results can be shown in the complex plane, which is straightforward for analyzers. The analysis result reveals that the effects of controllers on stability depends on the phase of their transfer function and some elements of frequency response matrix of synchronous grid. In addition, parameters tuning of the controllers based on calculation results is feasible. Case study of the four-machine two-area is conducted by the proposed method. Eigenvalue analysis validates the calculation results.

articleTitle: Summary of Cost Management Analysis of Power Grid Enterprises Based on Transmission and Distribution Price Reform
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of power system reform, the profit model of power grid enterprises has changed greatly, and the power grid investment and cost will be strictly supervised. The investment must comply with the government planning and be approved by the government, otherwise it cannot be included in the effective assets and accrued income, and the exceeding standard cost cannot be included in the allowable cost. Under this supervision mode, power grid enterprises will face a new incentive mechanism, and the performance accumulation of power grid enterprises will come from effective investment, asset management and cost control, which puts forward higher requirements for their resource allocation ability. This paper analyzes the impact of power grid enterprises on cost management under the background of new power system reform, analyzes the practices of domestic and foreign research institutions and power grid enterprises in optimizing cost management, and looks forward to the direction of cost management of power grid enterprises in the future.

articleTitle: Energy Optimal Operation Strategy of Ship Power Station with Multi Energy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the energy regulation and optimal operation strategy of multi energy ship power station. Firstly, the energy conversion coupling model of diesel generator set, energy storage system, new energy and ship load is established. Secondly, the power distribution of multi energy ship load is optimized, and a smoothing strategy of full cycle power fluctuation of multi energy ship based on virtual battery model is proposed. Finally, the filtering method is used to control the hybrid energy storage system for real-time power distribution to smooth the power fluctuation in the grid. The results show that the active power loss of the optimized ship power system is significantly reduced, the multi-layer structure and operation efficiency of the multi energy ship are significantly improved, and the economy, stability and security of the ship power system are effectively improved.

articleTitle: Efficient Application Of Csma In Hplc Networks For Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In HPLC (High-speed Power Line Communication) networks, path evaluation is based on the discovery list messages, with nodes judging the link quality by the number of the received messages of the discovery list. However, the discovery list messages may collide with each other in the channel access, and the node can not determine whether the message loss is caused by the poor link quality or the collision. The path evaluation is not accurate. In this paper, a window scaling method is proposed, which can effectively reduce the collision probability and improve the accuracy of the path evaluation. In the proposed method, the size of the backoff window depends on the number of the network nodes. The proposed method can minimize the size of the backoff window and maximize the number of the transmitted messages. Moreover, it achieves accurate network maintenance and efficient resource utilization.

articleTitle: Smart Substation Configuration File Management and Verification Technology and System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Smart substation configuration files carry key information and parameters such as primary equipment model and electrical topology, secondary equipment configuration and virtual circuit connection. Configuration errors can easily lead to abnormal operation and even incorrect protection actions. The management and verification of configuration files are essential to the safe and stable operation of substations. In the whole process of configuration and life cycle of smart substation configuration files, due to lack of management and verification measures, the correctness and uniqueness of configuration files are difficult to guarantee. This article introduces the typical configuration file management process of State Grid Corporation, proposes measures such as configuration file version difference comparison, legality check, integrity check, consistency check and normative check, and designs a configuration file management and verification system, Can realize the effective management and verification of configuration files.

articleTitle: Design of Basic Control Strategy for Energy Storage Type MMC
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy storage technology plays a transitional role in the entire system, improves equipment utilization, reduces power loss, and improves system reliability and system stability. Firstly, the relevant topology structure and the principle of modular multilevel converter are introduced. Secondly, according to the control method used in the common modular multi-level converter and the two-way DC/DC control method of the energy storage unit in the reference, the control system including voltage and current double closed-loop control, voltage equalization control, and two-way boost type as an example DC/DC control, etc. are designed. Finally, according to the designed main circuit parameters and control strategy, the circuit model of the energy storage type modular multilevel converter is built using Matlab/simulink, and a stable waveform is debugged.

articleTitle: Analysis of Static Stability of Virtual Synchronous Converter Based on Line Impedance Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the high penetration of power electronics, the internal mechanism of hybrid AC/DC distribution network stability has changed, and the existing power frequency phasor method cannot meet the requirements of system analysis. It is necessary to carry out research on the stability of hybrid AC/DC distribution network based on converter networking. Firstly, First, using the traditional power system power angle stability theory, the types of virtual synchronous converter grid-connected instability are studied, and the stability of power electronic converters is divided into static stability, small signal stability, and transient stability. According to the equivalent power transmission model of the converter system, the mathematical expressions of the maximum transmission power of the converter connected to the grid and the minimum short circuit ratio of the grid are derived. Based on the changes of line impedance characteristics under weak grids, the focus is on the changes in the static stability work area of the system under different grid intensities. Finally, simulation is used to verify the validity of the theoretical analysis. The results show that with the decrease of power grid strength, the steady-state working area of the converter system will continue to shrink, and problems such as limited transmission power and static system instability may occur under weak grid conditions.

articleTitle: Optimal Models and Methods for Coordinated Planning of Power Networks Based on Power Network Full-Cost Chain
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous deepening of the electricity sales side, the entire power market will gradually evolve into a three-dimensional, open, and efficient integrated platform. The introduction and innovation of new market players and trading systems will certainly affect the costs and benefits of grid companies. Have a broad and far-reaching impact. At the same time, power grid companies are gradually changing the past development strategy of “heavy transmission grid, light distribution network”, and began to attach importance to the coordinated development and construction of transmission and distribution networks. This paper divides its revenue into transmission and distribution business revenue and electricity sales business revenue according to the business model of the power grid enterprise, and establishes a corresponding calculation model for analysis. Then, under the constraints of fixed investment budget of the power grid, the future decision-making plan for transmission and distribution network planning is optimized.

articleTitle: Insurance Pricing in Electricity Retail Market Based on Reliability Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the deepening reform of power market and the expansion of the electricity retail market, the demand of electricity customers and power suppliers for the power system reliability is much higher. In this paper, an insurance pricing method based on the reliability analysis of power system is proposed. The method combines system reliability with actuarial science. The corresponding premium is obtained according to the reliability index, and then the electricity price is determined using the insurance premium. Firstly, the reliability analysis of the power system is performed based on Monte Carlo method, and then the reliability index is obtained. Second, a method is proposed to transfer numerical reliability indices to quantified risk indices. The risk evaluation refers to a case in which risk is represented by loss. The loss considers the relationships between power failure data and the information of electricity customers. Finally, the power failure loss is used to determine the premium and the price of electricity. Applying the insurance mechanism to the electricity retail market can reduce users' loss.

articleTitle: Research On Purchasing And Selling Energy Strategy Of Virtual Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As China's electricity reform enters the deep water zone, virtual power plant gradually participates in the market competition as a kind of comprehensive retails electricity supplier. Based on the electricity market and natural gas market, this paper puts forward the operation mode of double-layer virtual power plant. The upper layer is composed of commercial virtual power plants to participate in energy market transactions, while the lower layer is composed of technical virtual power plants to control the hybrid mode of distributed power supply. A virtual power plant purchase and sale energy model considering user selection behavior is built. The goal is to maximize the profit of comprehensive purchase and sale energy, and particle swarm optimization algorithm is adopted to solve the problem, and then the optimal strategy of purchase and sale energy of virtual power plant is determined. The results show that the proposed method can achieve multi-energy market coupling and complementation, increase user stickiness and improve the comprehensive income of virtual power plants.

Author Keywords: strategy of energy purchase and sale

articleTitle: A New Wind Power System Coordinated and Complementary Control Strategy with Hydrogen Storage System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a conceptual solution to promote the grid-connected operation performance of WT based on front-end speed regulation (FESR). Among them, this article integrates a hydrogen storage system (HSS) into a wind turbine based on FESR. The fundamental structure and mathematical modeling method of the programme are examined. Combining energy regulation and coordinated control methods, a case study was carried out on the random variation of wind velocity and grid electric tension defects, thereby verifying the possibility of the HSS generator based on FESR. The hydrogen hybrid system has satisfactory operating performance in the field of maximizing the use of wind power, restraining export power undulations and enhancing the wind turbine's low-voltage ride-through (LVRT) ability.

articleTitle: Layout Scheme of Energy Storage Stations for Multi-Application Requirements
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Because of the fast response and four-quadrant regulation ability, the application of energy storage has become more wider. This article researches the layout scheme of energy storage stations considering different applications, such as suppressing new energy fluctuation, supporting reactive power, as well as relieving power flow evacuation. These applications are all the local and partial problems for power grid, therefore they can be considered together and converted to joint operation problem by optimization method. The paper proposes the optimization method which including every step for multi-applications and their constraints, meanwhile gives the solution to seek the optimal layout locations. The simulation of actual power grid verifies the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Data-Driven-Based Aggregate ACLs External Modeling and Load Tracking Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Air conditioning loads (ACLs) can be used as flexible loads to participate in load shaving and accommodate the fluctuation caused by renewable energies. However, most of the existing control methods do not consider time-varying characteristic of the aggregate ACLs' external model (AAEM). This paper proposes a data-driven AAEM and a corresponding load tracking control strategy. Based on the cost function of individual ACLs considering thermodynamic characteristics, the data-driven AAEM is established by using neural network. By this way, computational complexity of calculation AAEM is reduced. The load tracking control strategy considering the data-driven AAEM can effectively reduce the number of times of switch and the total cost. The simulation results verify the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Research on Reactive Power and Voltage Equalization Control Strategy of Photovoltaic Inverter Cluster
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Reactive power optimization control is an important part of power grid connection. With the construction of New Power System, a large number of distributed new energy will be built and connected to the Grid. In order to deal with the randomness and volatility of new energy and hidden dangers of high proportion of new energy in Grid, reactive power optimization control of grid connected power supply is an important measure to stabilize the power system. Photovoltaic(PV) inverters have independent reactive power control and output capabilities through decoupling. Based on this, this paper proposes a reactive power and voltage equalization(RVE) control algorithm for inverter groups. Aiming at the phenomenon of poor power quality at the source-load point of common coupling(SLPCC) and large voltage drop difference in PV station, a RVE algorithm based on reactive power and voltage vector relationship of inverter generation nodes and array iteration is proposed, and the operation simulation is performed. The results show that the control strategy can carry out effective reactive power control and voltage equalization to inverter groups.

articleTitle: Single Phase Arc Grounding Fault Line Selection Method for Distribution Network Based on Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of fault line selection when arc grounding occurs in distribution network, a method based on random forest algorithm is proposed. This method uses wavelet packet analysis to extract the characteristic information of fault zero sequence current signal, uses kernel principal component analysis to reduce the complexity of sample data, and uses random forest algorithm to train fault line selector suitable for single-phase arc grounding fault in distribution network. Simulation results show that the random forest fault line selector can effectively select the feeder with single-phase arc grounding fault. The scheme has practical significance in fault line selection of single-phase arc grounding in distribution network.

articleTitle: Research on Unit Removal Method Under Islanding Operation of Small Hydropower Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As a common renewable distributed power source, improving the utilization of small hydropower through microgrid technology can reduce carbon emissions and improve the power supply reliability of distribution network. Hydropower micro grid belongs to power transmission type micro grid, and the problem of high frequency will appear in the initial stage of the island. In view of the problem that the frequency of small hydropower micro-grid increases rapidly in the early stage of isolated island, this paper first analyzes the operation characteristics of small hydropower micro-grid in the early stage of isolated island, and then puts forward an optimized cutting scheme of isolated hydropower network based on ROCOOF. In order to verify the effectiveness of the scheme proposed in this paper, based on the simulation model established by Simulink, this paper verified that the small hydroelectric micro grid quickly reached the frequency stable state at the initial stage of the island under multiple simulation conditions.

articleTitle: Modeling of Electric - thermal Multi - energy System and Coupling Method under Different Time Scales
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the study of multi-energy system, this paper builds the thermal system and power system models based on Thermolib / Simulink, and refers to the energy hub (EH) model to form a refined multi-energy system. For multi-energy systems, different subsystems have significantly different dynamic processes and change at different time scales. The inertia of the power system is small, and the regulation is fast, while the inertia of the thermal system is large, and the response to load and pressure is slow. Therefore, there are significant differences between different systems, resulting in low simulation speed and low simulation efficiency. This paper proposes a method to solve the coupling of systems with different time scales. The original simulation method is improved to ensure the accuracy of simulation and improve the efficiency of calculation.

articleTitle: Research on FL-SMC of DFIG Grid-Side Converter Under Unbalanced Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The active and reactive output power of the doubly-fed induction generator grid-side converter under unbalanced grid voltage conditions will be affected. In order to improve the dynamic response performance of the system, a nonlinear control strategy for a grid-side converter is propoesd under unbalanced grid voltage conditions, combining sliding-mode control technology and feedback linearization theory. This strategy avoids the coordinate transition to introduce coupling items and can respectively achieve the control objectives of the grid-side negative-sequence current suppression of the grid-side converter, the suppression of active power and DC bus voltage fluctuations, and the suppression of reactive power fluctuations. The effectiveness and practicability of the control strategy are simulated and experimentally verified by building the MATLAB/Simulink simulation platform.

articleTitle: Voltage Situation Awareness of Active Distribution Network Based on Grey Correlation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The access of distributed generation and demand response in active distribution network makes the operation of power grid complex and changeable. The intermittent and uncertain output of some distributed generation makes the voltage fluctuate greatly, which brings difficulties to the prediction of voltage. In order to reduce the impact of uncertainty of distributed generation output on voltage and obtain the real-time operation status and future development trend of active distribution network quickly and accurately, this paper proposes a voltage situation awareness method based on grey correlation analysis. A large number of historical data are used to establish the grey correlation model to predict the voltage situation and trend of distribution network, which provides the basis for the active voltage control.

articleTitle: DC Emergency Power Support Applied into Frequency Corrective Control
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
