abstract: The research and application of DC system participating in safety and stability control is still limited to preventive control belonging to the first defense line and emergency control belonging to the second defense line. Exploring and applying the operating characteristics and control capabilities of DC systems is an important technical approach to improve the safety and stability of power grid. DC emergency power support (DCEPS) can be applied into corrective control belong to the third defense line to prevent system collapse coordinating with the traditional third defense line measures such as low-frequency load shedding/high-frequency generator tripping; When an abnormal change of frequency occurs, the DCEPS function is activated to reduce the load shedding/unit control amount. From the two aspects of setting calculation and developing control devices, the preliminary plan for realizing DCEPS to participate in the frequency corrective control is explained. Use the data of the actual power grid to simulate and analyze the beneficial effects of DCEPS participation in the third defense line. Considering the timing characteristics of the third defense line and DC system operation and control characteristics. Discussing the issues that should be paid attention to when DCEPS is applied into the frequency corrective control has important reference value for the construction of the third defense line with richer technical means.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Coordination Mechanism of DFIG Based on Inertia Response
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Recently, wind power generation in China developed rapidly. However, its characteristics of low inertia and operating according to the maximum power tracking mode will lead to the lack of the inertia and the decline of the frequency regulation ability of the system to a certain extent. Based on the frequency response model of Doubly Fed Induction Generator (DFIG), this paper analyzes the influence of Phase Locked Loop (PLL) control parameters on the inertia response of DFIG, and evaluates the inertia characteristics of DFIG. Finally, a time-domain simulation example system is built to verify the effectiveness of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Research on the Optimal Regulation Strategy of Loop Closing Device Based on Phase Shifting Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the quality of life continues to improve and the industry continues to develop, the reliability of power supply has become more demanding, and how to effectively achieve non-stop load transfer in distribution networks has become a hot research topic. However, the actual operation of the power grid is often not able to meet the closing conditions, therefore, efficient and safe non-stop load transfer requires the study of new closing device technology. At present, there are studies on the use of phase shifting transformer as loop closing device for loop closing transfer, but the regulation process has voltage fluctuation problems, so the regulation strategy needs to be further optimized to ensure better voltage quality. An improved phase shifting transformer with amplitude phase adjustment is proposed for the control regulation optimization needs, and the optimization method of the regulation strategy of the loop closing device based on the improved phase shifting transformer is described. Firstly, the working principle of loop closing device based on phase shifting transformer is analyzed. Secondly, the structure of the phase shifting transformer is improved and designed for the demand of voltage quality optimization. Again, to improve the voltage quality, the optimized control strategy of constant amplitude smooth regulation of voltage is proposed. Finally, the simulation is carried out in the PSCAD/EMTDC environment based on the loop closing transfer scenario of 10kV distribution network, and the optimization effect of the improved loop closing device is compared and analyzed.

articleTitle: A Cyber Risk Assessment and Detection Method for Power Systems Against Data Integrity Attack on Load Frequency Control
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Modern power system is a typical cyber-physical system due to the coupling of primary and secondary systems. The development of renewable energy and smart grids make many new application scenarios. Various new communication technologies make the system complex. Cyber systems and complex network environments have introduced a series of security issues. All of which make them easy to become ideal targets for cyberattacks. Therefore, it is of great significance to the research of cyber security in cyber-physical systems. This paper selects a scenario of centralized LFC, considers the linearized discrete system model under partial observation with Gaussian disturbance. Based on the known and un-changed characteristics of the physical model of the control system, dynamic watermarking is used to detect data integrity attacks from malicious sensors.

articleTitle: Optimal Recovery Scheme of Power System Considering Available Resources in Micro-Grids
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Large area blackouts due to unpredictable incidents like extreme weather condition and cascade failures will reflect badly on economy and development in the society. Therefore fast and economic recovery of the power system is important since the power supply can be restored at little cost. In this paper, an optimal scheme which uses the micro-grid resource to restore power is introduced. There are two main objectives in the proposed optimization problem. One is to minimize the basic-structure-building time in the early stage of the black start(BS) procedure. And the other is to decrease the total load lose caused by the black out. A normal boundary intersection(NBI) method is applied to form Pareto surface so that the black start bi-objective optimization problem is solved effectively. The proposed scheme is tested in the IEEE 39-bus system to verify the effectiveness and the practicability.

articleTitle: Nd-Net: Exploring Non-Defective Features for More Robust Inspection of Power Transmission Line Defect
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Defect detection in aerial images is a significant w ork in power transmission line inspection. Thanks to the applic ation of object detection neural network, favorable performance has been achieved in detection of common defects. However, d ue to an feature alignment problem of defective and non-defecti ve data has not been resolved in state-of-the-art research, a big gap, between performance of current models and expected accu racy in applications, still exists. In this paper, a novel network a rchitecture, consisting of a multi-label classification head follow ed by a backbone network, is proposed. The backbone network in the architecture is taking advantage of non-defective fittings features in background. Experimental results show that the pr oposed method achieves more competitively capabilities with high accuracy, compared with previous architectures.

articleTitle: Location Optimization of Electric Vehicle Time Sharing Rental Network for Electric Power Company Exclusive
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problems in the development process of electric vehicle time-sharing rental service, such as unreasonable planning of rental network and uncertainty of service object of time-sharing rental. An improved p-median model with multi factor participation in decision-making is constructed by using the idea of p-median model. Firstly, considering the land cost of the candidate network, the distance from the time-sharing rental network to the demand area, the construction area of the network and the user demand, the mathematical model of the improved p-median model is established with the total construction cost of the network as the objective function. Secondly, the Voronio-diagram is used to dynamically plan the service range of the candidate nodes, and the particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to optimize the solution model. Finally, the optimal layout of the time-sharing rental nodes is solved by iteration. Taking Lanzhou City as an example, this model is applied to plan the optimal layout of the exclusive electric vehicle time-sharing rental network of the power company, and divide the service scope. The results show that the model can effectively select the appropriate network layout and reasonably divide the service scope of each network.

articleTitle: Joint Optimal Dispatching Strategy Of Pumped Storage And Thermal Power Units With Large-Scale Wind Power Integration
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The volatility, uncertainty and anti-peaking characteristics of large-scale wind power greatly increase the peak regulation burden of the power grid, which leads to frequently deep peak regulation of thermal power (TP) units. As a result, the total peak regulation cost of the system increases greatly, the operation economy of TP decreases and the phenomenon of abandoned wind gets serious. However, most of the pumped storage (PS) power stations in China adopt the strategy of timing dispatch, which makes its flexibility regulation effect not exerted effectively. Based on the background, the dispatching benefit models of PS and the peak regulation cost model of TP units in the whole process are established respectively. With the objectives of maximizing dispatching benefit of PS, minimizing peak regulation cost of TP and abandoned wind power, a joint optimal dispatching strategy of PS and TP units with large-scale wind power integration is proposed. Based on the 10-unit example system, the peak regulation effect of is simulated and compared between the proposed strategy and the existing operation strategy. The results show that the proposed strategy in this paper can effectively improve the dispatching benefit of PS, the economy of TP peak regulation and the capacity of wind power consumption, which verifies the validity of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Energy Optimization Dispatching of Islanded Microgrid Based on Multi-Agent System and Improved Symbiotic Organisms Search
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To improve the economy benefit of energy optimization dispatching of islanded microgrid (MG), the structure of islanded MG system based on multi-agent system (MAS) is designed and an improved symbiotic organisms search algorithm (ISOS) is proposed. The structure of islanded MG based on MAS allocates the functions of the agent corresponding to each unit to balance the power and energy, achieving economic and coordinated operation of each unit. On the basis of symbiotic organisms search, ISOS introduces recombination and mutation phase to increase the diversity of symbiotic organisms and improve the global search ability. Simulation shows that the operation cost of islanded MG based on ISOS is 90.806 ϵ less than that SOS. Moreover, the 100 times experiments on energy optimization dispatching based on ISOS and SOS shows that the average operation cost of islanded MG based on ISOS is 92.585 ϵ less than SOS and the probability of ISOS searching for the global optimal solution comparing SOS increases by nearly 39%. Therefore, the energy optimization dispatching of islanded MG based on ISOS can obtain greater economic benefit.

articleTitle: Industry Electricity Demand Forecast by Integrating Multiple Correlation Analysis Methods
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the high quality development of China, power grid is expected to be more reliable and stable. Industry electricity demand forecasting is extremely important as it takes a high proportion in electricity demand. Taking the influence factor of industry electricity demand into consideration, this paper proposes an industry electricity correlation analysis method based on the combination of association rules mining and principal component analysis, and explores the leading influence factors of industry electricity growth by establishing historical electricity-related analysis data sets. Based on the dominant influence factors obtained by the above two methods, the traditional ARIMA model and multiple regression model are improved respectively, and the industry electricity demand model integrating multiple correlation analysis methods is obtained. Finally, an empirical analysis is carried out by taking the nonferrous metals industry in a certain region as an example. The results show that the improved model has a higher prediction accuracy than the traditional prediction model.

articleTitle: Small Signal Stability Assessment of Power System Based on Sade-ELM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Along with the increasing scales of power system, the traditional numerical method to calculate the damping ratio of system to evaluate the small signal stability cannot meet the requirements of real-time analysis. Therefore, we propose a small signal stability assessment method for power system based on Extreme Learning Machine (ELM) optimized by Differential Evolution Algorithm with Strategy-Adaptation (SaDE). The node power, generator power and branch power are taken as inputs of the model in this method. Meanwhile, the minimum damping ratio of the system is taken as the output, and fits input data and output data. The results of 3-machine 9-node and 10-machine 39-node systems show that the method can estimate the minimum damping ratio of the system after off-line training of historical data without considering the change of control parameters. Compared with the prediction results of Back Propagation (BP) and ELM models, SaDE-ELM has the lowest error, the highest prediction accuracy and the strongest generalization ability.

Author Keywords: Small signal stability assessment of power system

articleTitle: Optimal Planning Method of Renewable Power Distribution Network Based on Dynamic Wind and Photovoltaic Power Abandonment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: If a certain amount of renewable power generation is reduced every year, the large-scale expansion of the German power grid may be reduced. In this paper, a dynamic optimization method of renewable power abandonment in the distribution network is proposed. In this place, only when the thermal constraint of a certain line is reached can the specific feeding power be limited. The method is particularly directed to reducing the power that leads to thermal limitations. Therefore, it is suggested that the new allocation factor be based on the AC power flow equation. Considering the further growth of renewable power, this paper will analyze the probability of the real high-voltage distribution network in Germany. This method has great potential in reducing and optimizing classical power grid expansion. Germany's power turnover cost can be minimized because the reduced power is less than the transportation abandonment capacity.

articleTitle: Optimal Planning of Distribution Network Considering Reliability Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The uncertainty of wind and light output make the coordinated operation and control of the distribution network composed of distributed generation (DG) and regional loads become complicated. So the correct and reasonable planning of the type and number of distributed power sources for the distribution network is of great significance for improving the reliability and economy of the distribution network grid-connected system. This paper studies the distribution network optimization planning including wind turbines, photovoltaics, and energy storage. Establishing a mathematical model with the goal of optimal system economy, using the load, wind speed and light data of a certain area for one year to reduce the scene. Then obtaining 12 typical daily scene data, and using the Yalmip toolbox in MATLAB to solve the problem and to obtain the configuration type and number of distributed power sources. On this basis, a demand response model considering load reliability is introduced to further optimize distributed power planning. The results show that the economy is the best when distributed power sources and large power grid jointly supply power to the load side. After the introduction of demand response considering load reliability, the economy is further improved.

articleTitle: Grid Voltage Control with New Energy, Energy Storage, and Flexible Load Based on Combined Model and Improved MPC
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of grid voltage fluctuation caused by new energy grid connection, this paper proposes a dual-time-scale grid voltage control method based on combined model and improved model predictive control (MPC). First of all, in order to effectively improve the accuracy of reactive power control instructions, this paper uses a combined prediction model instead of the traditional single prediction model as the prediction kernel; secondly, the improved multidimensional chaotic traversal particle swarm algorithm is used as the optimization kernel in the long-time scale control to deal with the problems of many kinds of particles and large dimensions. Thirdly, the improved MPC method based on the error dynamic feedback coefficient is used to complete the rolling optimization in the inner short-time scale voltage regulation. Finally, taking the actual regional power grid in a certain area of eastern China as an example, comparing the traditional dual time-scale voltage control to verify the feasibility and advancement of the improved strategy proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Evaluating Stochastic Flexibility Model of Vehicle Charge Stations in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The number of electric vehicles (EVs) and electric vehicle supply equipment (EVSE) increase rapidly in recent years. A large number of EVs have great potential to provide power flexibility. This is because the EVs usually continue connecting with EVSE after get fully charged. If the arrival and departure times of EVs can be estimated, the flexibility of EVs charging can be utilized. In this paper, the random factors are taken into consideration to evaluate the stochastic flexibility model of EVSE. A time-variable battery model is used to describe power flexibility. The Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) and chance constraint method are proposed to describe the uncertainties quantitatively. The results of the numerical tests demonstrate the evaluation process and show the economic value.

articleTitle: Aggregation Effect On Particle Motion And Electric Field
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Process of particles and droplets aggregation due to the liquid bridge is investigated, and increased particle size is applied to the particle tracing around the DC transmission line. Agglomeration kernel is applied to the aggregating process of droplets and particles. Comparing the capture process of particles before and after agglomeration effect around the DC transmission line, it can be concluded that particles with aggregated size (after agglomeration) are not easy to be captured by DC electric field force, and the charge of particle is the determinant factor on the capturing process, and aggregated size of particles and droplets cause higher distortion of electric field.

articleTitle: Analysis of Adjustable Potential of Sewage Treatment System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The sewage treatment factory has the characteristics of environmentally friendly and energy intensiveness. First, the technological process of the sewage treatment system was analyzed. Then, the main energy-consuming model in each process of sewage treatment was constructed. On this basis, the adjustable potential of each device in the sewage treatment process was calculated. Finally, the strategy of sewage treatment system participating in demand response event was proposed. The adjustable potential of sewage treatment system with A/O process can reach up to 30% in the case study, providing effective load resources for grid regulation. The strategy proposed in this paper for the sewage treatment factory to participate in demand response are effective and practical.

articleTitle: Research on Harmonic Dynamic Interaction Analysis and Suppression Methods of Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of microgrid technology, microgrid has gradually become an indispensable supplement to the traditional power grid. However, the nonlinear load in microgrid will cause serious harmonic pollution in the system. This paper analyzes the basic principles of droop control and gives a microgrid model under peer-peer control. Then, this paper explains the generation mechanism of harmonic voltage in the microgrid and the principle of virtual impedance. Furthermore, the article proposes a harmonic suppression method based on harmonic virtual impedance. Finally, the effectiveness of the method is verified by simulating the microgrid model with nonlinear load and observing the voltage distortion rate at the point of common coupling.

articleTitle: An Improved Strength Pareto Evolutionary Algorithm for Optimization of Residents' Load and Storage
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A coordinated optimization model for load and storage based on the improved strength Pareto evolutionary algorithm, to improve the power quality, electricity consumption reliability and reduce the cost of the electricity. First of all, a model for the users' energy storage system is established and proposed the principles to classify the loads according to the statue of the participation. Secondly, considering the mechanism of time-of-use price and demand response, a multi-objective load and storage coordinated optimization model is proposed with the objectives of reducing the cost of electricity, fixing voltage deviation, and extending the electricity consumption time. The model considering the constraints of power balance, the state of charge of the energy storage system, and the allowed range of flexible load. Then, an optimal solution strategy is proposed based on the improved strength Pareto evolutionary algorithm. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed model is verified by a low-voltage network simulation example.

articleTitle: Low-carbon Economic Operation of the CHP System with P2G Heat Recovery and Heat Storage Tanks for Wind Power Consumption
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In response of the current situation of the low efficiency of power to gas utilization and the limitations of only configuring heat storage tanks to improve the ability of absorbing wind power, this paper constructs a combined heat and power system with the coordination operation of power to gas heat recovery and heat storage tanks. The principle of the system for wind power consumption is firstly deeply described, and the carbon trading mechanism is introduced into the model considering the carbon emission. Furthermore, a low-carbon economic optimization model is set up with the objective to minimize the total cost of system operation. Finally, the simulation analysis in different operation scenes for a regional combined heat and power system is discussed in detail to verify the validity and availability of the proposed method in the paper.

articleTitle: Fast Tracking Phase-Locked Loop Based on Complex Vector Form and Phase Difference Interval Judgment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Phase-locked loop guides the current phase angle for the converter. Fast phase angle tracking is important for the converter control effect and system stability. This paper proposes a fast tracking phase-locked loop based on complex vector form and phase difference interval judgment. The phase difference acquisition and loop control all adopt complex vector form. The phase difference interval is judged by the value and relationship of the real and imaginary parts of the phase difference complex vector. In order to speed up the phase angle tracking, the output of the phase-locked loop is compensated based on the interval judgment. The structure and the controller design of the proposed phase-locked loop are also illustrated in this paper. The simulations are used to verify the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed fast tracking phase-locked loop.

articleTitle: Research on Suppression Strategies of Wind Farm Subsynchronous Oscillation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, as the power system is developing towards a “double-high” system with a high proportion of new energy generation and high proportion of power electronic equipment, the problem of new sub/super-synchronous oscillation caused or participated by it is becoming increasingly serious, which has brought a serious impact on the safe and stable operation of the power system and the economic requirements. Therefore, it is of great significance to study the suppression strategies of subsynchronous oscillations in wind farms. This paper proposes three subsynchronous oscillation suppression strategies based on the subsynchronous oscillation mechanism of wind farms, including parallel STATCOM (static synchronous compensator devices), additional virtual resistors, and parallel bypass damping filters. The effectiveness and adaptability of the three methods are verified through modal analysis and time domain simulation.

articleTitle: A Novel Capacitance Determination Method of Metal Oxide Arrester Blocks when Excited by VFTO
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, the Ultra-High Voltage(UHV) and Extra-High Voltage (EHV) power system has been greatly developed. Subsequently, Gas Insulated Substation(GIS) has received more extensive attention and applications. In the application of GIS, Very Fast Transient Overvoltage (VFTO), which caused by the operation of the disconnector, need to be focused on. Owing to the high frequency and unpredictable amplitude of VFTO, it may beyond secure level of stable operation of GIS, and the insulation of equipment may be damaged as a result. As one of the dominating overvoltage protection equipment, surge arresters, operating with capacitance calculation method has attracted extensive attention of researchers. Since the capacitance experimental method was not suitable for most VFTO condition, i.e. operating with high frequency and amplitude, this paper described a capacitance determination method by a novel substitutive experiment method of MOA blocks with excitation of VFTO.

articleTitle: The One Network Oprerating Platform For E-Vehicle Based On Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the deteriorating ecological environment and the intensification of energy and resource exhaustion problems, the use of e-vehicles has become one of the directions of social change. China vigorously promotes the development of e-vehicles, and the market share of e-vehicles is increasing. However, services such as the installation and charging of the charging piles that are matched with e-vehicles need to be further optimized. At this stage, the installation process of private charging piles requires multiple offline visits to the State Grid hall, the charging pile construction team, the property management company and other departments, which is time-consuming and laborious. Some procedures can be handled online, but each system needs to upload data repeatedly. The data review cycle is long, user operations are complicated, and user experience is poor. In order to solve the existing pain points, this paper proposes a Block chain-based e-vehicle The One Network Oprerating platform, which integrates distributed digital identity, fine-grained authority control and other technologies to realize the whole process of e-vehicles declaration, contracting, construction and charging online, so as to promote the accelerated development of China's electric vehicle industry through convenient, safe and credible service of The One Network Oprerating, and help China achieve the “carbon peak and neutrality goals” as soon as possible.

articleTitle: Influence of Stray Parameters for High-frequency Resonance of MMC-HVDC Systems Based on Digital-analog Hybrid Simulation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The damping characteristics of flexible DC transmission system based on modular multilevel converter (MMC) change greatly during operation mode switching. When the impedance of DC system changes, it is easy to cause high-frequency oscillation due to the interaction of stray parameters in AC system. In this paper, a simplified frequency impedance model of the converter is established based on the topology and control logic; Secondly, combined with the frequency impedance characteristics of AC system before and after the operation mode change, the possible oscillation risk points under the interaction of AC and DC system are analyzed in principle; Finally, a full real-time electromagnetic transient simulation of the high-frequency oscillation caused by the change of AC system operation mode is carried out in the YU-E south channel model built in the Hypersim simulation platform to verify the correctness of the proposed theoretical model.

articleTitle: Virtual Synchronous Control of PV-Building System by Utilizing Thermal Inertia
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: An energy management strategy of PV-building power system for improving solar power accommodation ability and frequency stability is proposed by extracting thermal inertia of buildings into electric system. Firstly, a virtual energy storage model for inverter air conditioning loads, which consists of an equivalent thermal parameter part and an electrical parameter part, is established. Secondly, the virtual synchronous control of PV-building is designed for utilizing the thermal inertia of the building, as well as to realize a grid-friendly interface of the PV -building system with frequency and voltage support ability. Finally, based on the inverter air conditioning loads and virtual synchronous control method proposed above, the model of a PV-building system is built to mimic the grid interface characteristics of a standard synchronous power. Simulation results demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of the presented virtual synchronous control of PV -building system, which not only increases the system inertia by adjusting air conditioning power, but also decreases the negative effect on grid frequency and voltage in system with high penetration of solar energy.

articleTitle: A Control Strategy for T-Type Three-Level Converter to Suppress Midpoint Voltage Fluctuation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: T-type three-level converter is widely used in high-current and low- voltage fields owing to its small number of power devices, low on state loss and high power density. Midpoint potential balance control of T-type converter is one of its key technologies. The neutral point potential imbalance increases harmonic distortion rate of output voltage and current, and reduce service life of DC side capacitor. This paper proposes midpoint potential balance control strategy in view of PIR-controlled zero-sequence voltage to control offset and fluctuation of midpoint potential. Functional model between midpoint current, reactive current and active current and the functional link between SPWM and SVPWM are established. The control strategy is simple in calculation and fast in dynamic response. It can realize midpoint potential balance domination under different power factors and the suppression of low-frequency voltage pulsation. Ultimately, simulations verify the effectiveness and correctness of proposed domination tactics.

articleTitle: Optimization of Charging and Discharging of Electric Vehicles Considering Residents' Travel Habits
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Electric vehicles have significant advantages in terms of energy saving and emission reduction, and their number is increasing year by year. Due to the strong randomness and flexibility of electric vehicles, a large number of electric vehicles may be charged disorderly during the evening peak hours of electricity load, resulting in a phenomenon of “increasing peaks”. Therefore, based on the consideration of residents' travel habits and commuting characteristics, this paper simulates the charging load of electric vehicles within a week, and obtains the basic law of disorderly charging load of electric vehicles. After that, the residents' charging and discharging behaviors are optimized with the minimum charging cost and the minimum equivalent peak-to-valley difference as the optimization goals. Simulation results show that the results of disordered charging are consistent with residents' habits. The optimization results demonstrate that the optimization model can generally improve residential district electricity load and reduce the charging cost of residents, which proves the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Flexible Control Strategy for AC/DC Bus Interface Converter in Hybrid Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To solve the problem of inertia loss in the isolated island operation mode of hybrid microgrid composed of distributed power sources, a flexible control strategy based on virtual inertia is proposed. The proposed control strategy can realize mutual support of AC side frequency and DC side voltage in the process of power flow. Firstly, the operating characteristics of AC subnets and DC subnets in hybrid microgrid are analyzed. Then, by comparing the difference between droop control and virtual inertia control, the flexible control strategy of bus interface converter based on virtual inertia is deduced by formula. Finally, a hybrid microgrid system level model was built in MATLAB/Simulink to verify the effectiveness of the proposed control method.

articleTitle: Study On Design Scheme Of Overhead Transmission Line In Bauxite Landfill
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: By analyzing and studying the settlement characteristics of large area high fill formed by open-pit mining of bauxite mine, according to the reliability requirements of overhead transmission line, according to the filling thickness, filling life and the influence of settlement on overhead transmission line, the key technologies of route selection, tower selection and foundation selection are proposed, It can minimize the disaster impact of the landfill site on the overhead transmission line, and protect the safety and reliability of the overhead transmission line.

articleTitle: Customized Pricing Strategy of Residential Consumers in Retailers for Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Residential demand response is recognized as an affordable and promising method to maintain the stable operation of the smart grid. Fueled by the large-scale employment of smart meters, retailers can collect and understand consumers' energy consumption behaviors with convenience. This paper focuses on proposing deep learning aided customized pricing strategy for residential consumers to facilitate the demand response. First, a temporal pattern attention-based long short-term memory network is applied to learn consumer's energy consumption behavior affected by price. Then, based on this behavior learning model, a customized pricing strategy is suggested to the retailer to design a dynamic pricing mechanism for the consumer for engaging in the demand response program. Numerical studies demonstrate that the applied energy consumption behavior learning model can extract complicated characteristics and feature relevance to learn consumer behavior with high accuracy, and the proposed customized pricing strategy can greatly promote the demand response program while the price risk is also hedged to a great extent.

articleTitle: Influence and Suppression Control Strategy of DC Voltage Ripple on Single-Phase Back-to-Back Three-level Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For the existing problem of large dc-link capac-itance of single-phase back-to-back converter in the co-phase power supply system, this paper proposes a control strategy to suppress the influence of dc-link voltage ripple with reduced dc-link capacitor. The proposed control strategy introduces specific-order harmonic currents control to suppress the influence of voltage ripple on the three-phase power quality based on the traditional dq decoupling control. The expression of the dc-link voltage based on the co-phase traction power supply system with YNvd transformer is derived, and the minimum value of dc-link capacitance is calculated within the acceptable ripple. The simulation results show that the proposed control strategy can reduce the dc-link capacitance by about 80% compared with the traditional control strategy under the same performance of three-phase grid.

Author Keywords: influence of dc-link voltage ripple suppression

articleTitle: Research and Realization of Management System of Generator Set Frequency Regulation Capability Based on Parallel Control Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that current power plant information management systems cannot accurately reflect and evaluate the primary frequency regulation (PFR) and auto generation control (AGC) capability of generator set, under the technical requirements of strengthening the technical management of grid-power source coordination and improving the monitoring level of frequency regulation performance of generator set, the research and development of generator set frequency regulation capability management system based on parallel control platform is carried out. Based on the parallel control platform of Zhejiang Supcon, the system collects the dynamic data of power plant information management system online. Starting from the standardization and normalization of data, it constructs the data model of PFR and AGC, calculates and analyzes the frequency regulation performance of generator set, and realizes the management functions of analysis, query and display of frequency regulation performance of generator set. It provides intelligent decision support for unit frequency regulation performance management and optimization in power generation enterprises.

articleTitle: Industry Kinetic Energy Index Prediction via Stacked Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In real world, the long sequence prediction of industry kinetic energy index is crucial, which can provide reference for business expansion and risk prevention in the company energy service. However, the existing time-series prediction methods suffer from high time and space cost, the decline of prediction speed, and the difficulty in solving long-term dependence under the long time-series forcast setting. In view of this, we propose a Stacked Transformer consists of stacked encoder and a sequence decoder. Specifically, we split the long time-series sequence into several short sequences, then learn the local and global information of the sequence by stacked encoder to solve the long-range dependency problem. The short sequence contains the position, time, and feature information of the sequence. In addition, fully connected layer efficiently predicts future sequence by one forward operation rather than a step-by-step way.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Scheduling of Integrated Energy Storage of Photovoltaic Building Based on Improved CDKF Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy storage system is of great significance for improving power quality, providing bridge power and energy management. Optimizing energy storage capacity configuration can improve the reliability and economy of system operation, which are important means. Considering the infrastructure and operation maintenance of photovoltaic building integration, this paper proposes a storage optimization method of photovoltaic building integration based on the improved CDKF(Central Difference Kalman Filter, CDKF) method, aiming at reducing the operating cost of the system and improving the economy. The introduction of the improved CDKF method can more accurately estimate the SOC of lithium battery, so as to improve the service life of battery pack. Taking an industrial park in China as the research case, it is solved by combining MATLAB with CPLEX. The results show that the effectiveness of the proposed optimization model.

articleTitle: Two-Stage Optimal Dispatch for AC/DC Hybrid Microgrid Based on Model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To combat the multiple uncertainties of AC/DC hybrid microgrid, the paper presents a two-stage optimal dispatch strategy for AC/DC hybrid microgrid. The strategy is divided into two stages: day-ahead economic dispatch and intraday rolling optimal dispatch. The objective of day ahead stage is to minimize the daily operation cost, which takes into account the operation characteristics of microgrid components and time-of-use electricity price. The intraday rolling optimal dispatch model is carried out based on model predictive control (MPC). Combining the rolling optimization with feedback compensation, the closed-loop optimization is developed. Depending on that, the model can effectively suppress the intraday power fluctuations and avoid affecting the main grid operation. According to the simulation results, the proposed strategy can effectively realize the economic and autonomous operation of AC/DC hybrid microgrid.

articleTitle: Model Construction and Construction Key Issues for Energy Internet Ecosystem
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, it has become an inevitable trend to upgrade the power grid to the Energy Internet, and more and more market players will join the Energy Internet. In this case, building an Energy Internet ecosystem with the characteristics of win-win sharing is a key issue that determines the construction of the Energy Internet. In this article, firstly, the concept, connotation and characteristics, especially the business system of the Energy Internet, are systematically sorted out. Then, on this basis, based on the ecological circle theory, the theoretical model of the Energy Internet is constructed, and various elements of the Energy Internet ecosphere are designed. Finally, combined with the development trend of the Energy Internet business, the key points for the construction of the Energy Internet ecosystem are given.

articleTitle: Performance Ratio Test and Uncertainty Evaluation of Photovoltaic Power Generation System based on Linear Regression
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of photovoltaic industry technology, the installed capacity of photovoltaic power generation is increasing, and the evaluation of performance ratio (PR) of photovoltaic power generation system is extremely important. The PR test of photovoltaic power generation system has been studied and defined in domestic and foreign standards early, and test methods have also been given, but these test methods have a strong dependence on the weather conditions during testing, and the uncertainty evaluation is extremely difficult. In this paper, a testing and evaluation method including uncertainty evaluation for PR of photovoltaic system based on linear regression is proposed. This method reduces the dependence on the weather conditions during the whole testing period, and also makes the uncertainty evaluation feasible. Finally, a numerical example proves the rationality of using this method to test the PR of photovoltaic power generation system. Compared with the traditional method, it is shown that this method reduces the sensitivity to the weather conditions in the test, it can truly reflect the performance of the photovoltaic power generation system, and has a higher engineering practice and application value.

articleTitle: Dynamic Stability Analysis of Sub-synchronous Oscillation Mode of Phase Locked Loop
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper introduced dynamic stability analysis of sub-synchronous oscillation mode of PLL with the generalized torque analysis method. Firstly, the configuration and the model of the power system connected with PMSG, including PLL, GSC and AC network is given. Then, the generalized torque analysis method in the research of power system subsynchronous oscillation is illustrated. In this method, the idea of damping torque analysis method in power system electromechanical oscillation is extended, and the generalized torque analysis method is proposed. This method is no longer limited to the analysis of the oscillation in the frequency band of 0.1-2.5Hz, and can also analyze the phenomenon of sub/super-synchronous oscillation. Finally, the dynamic stability analysis of sub-synchronous oscillation mode of PLL with the generalized torque analysis method is given, which demonstrated the correctness of the method.

articleTitle: A Robust Distribution State Estimation Algorithm for Weakly Looped Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The branch current-based state estimation algorithm is only suitable for radial distribution network, and can not be directly applied to the Weakly Looped distribution network. In this paper, a node-splitting method is proposed, in which the looped distribution network is equivalent to a radial distribution network. By adding pseudo load-measurements to the splitting nodes, the observability requirement for state estimation is satisfied. In addition, the exponential state estimation model is used to make the algorithm has the ability to resist bad measurement data. This algorithm can be realized with only a little modification on the original algorithm program, and has good practical application value.

articleTitle: Real Time Operation Strategy Of Charging Station Based On Electric Vehicle Schedulable Time
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Electric vehicle charging station connected with renewable energies like wind and photovoltaic is an effective form of coupling electric vehicle's mobile energy storage with wind and photovoltaic outputs. In order to further improve the economic operation benefits of this type of electric vehicle charging station and also ensure the operation stability of power grid, a real-time operation strategy is proposed. Firstly, based on the concept of residual schedulable time, a chargeable demand boundary model of charging station is proposed; Secondly, the relationship among electric vehicle, wind power generation system and photovoltaic power generation system in charging station is analyzed, and a real-time optimization model of charging station is established to maximize the proportion of wind and photovoltaic consumption; Thirdly, after obtaining the total guiding charging power command of electric vehicles in this dispatching period, based on the principle of meeting the charging needs of electric vehicle users, considering the characteristics of travel randomness, a real-time power allocation strategy is proposed, and the charging behavior of randomly connected electric vehicles during the dispatching command is controlled. The deviation between the actual total charging power and the issued total guiding charging power command is reduced; Finally, an example is given to verify the effectiveness of the proposed real-time operation strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Modeling and Simulation of Direct Drive Wind Turbine Based on ADPSS/ETSDAC
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The wind power generation system can provide support for my country's energy transition, meet the requirements of the new power system with new energy as the main body, and achieve the “dual carbon” goal. In order to better study the stability of wind power systems after being connected to the power grid, an electromagnetic transient model that takes into account the efficiency of regional power grid simulation and accurately simulates the dynamic characteristics of the wind power system needs to be established. Based on the operating principle of permanent magnet direct drive wind power generation system, this paper studies its control strategy, and builds an electromagnetic transient model of the grid system containing permanent magnet direct drive wind turbines in the advanced digital power system simulator (ADPSS) of the power system. Through simulation analysis, the correctness of the electromagnetic transient model of the permanent magnet direct-drive wind power generation system and its control system is verified, which provides a reference for the study of interconnected power grids containing new energy.

articleTitle: Effect of Foreign Matters Attached to The Switching Core of Vacuum on Load Tap Changer on Oil Gap Breakdown Voltage
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Carbon powder and iron powder are common in the inspection of tap changer hanging core, selected the common powder to study the breakdown characteristics of vacuum on load tap changer oil gap under the environment of 30.5mm ball electrode. The results shows that: 1. Under the static test, the foreign matter will move close to the electrode under the action of electric field; the breakdown voltage drops approximately linearly before the critical point due to the accumulated mass of foreign matter, the breakdown voltage drops exponentially after the accumulated mass of foreign matter breaks through the critical point; if the foreign matters that can move directly by electric field force, the particle size is positively correlated with the breakdown voltage drop rate. 2. Under the dynamic test, with the increase of standing time, the oil sample is gradually clear and the recovery voltage is gradually restored; compared with iron and carbon powder, carbon powder can affect the recovery ability of oil gap breakdown voltage for a relatively long time; within 5 minutes of standing, both foreign matters can lead to oil gap breakdown voltage lower than 4KV, which is similar to that tap changer accidents often occur after shifting. The relevant conclusions of this paper can provide reference for tap changer operation and maintenance.

articleTitle: Price Determination Method in Electricity Retail Market considering the Voltage-Related Distribution Network Reliability
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present the research on electricity price of electricity retail market is a hot spot. Many factors affecting electricity price in electricity retail market, however, the research associated with the combination of reliability and electricity retail market is seldom studied. The combination of reliability and electricity price is essential for electricity retail market. There are many researches about the reliability of DC distribution network. Reliability of DC distribution network affected by multiple factors. The voltage fluctuation affects the reliability of DC distribution network. In addition, the control mode of DC distribution network and topology structure of DC distribution network also affect reliability in DC distribution network. This paper presents a new method to study electricity retail market and reliability of DC distribution network. The method adds reliability of DC distribution into retail electricity market and recalculates the retail price of the electricity power. Moreover, influence of the control mode and the topology are analyzed in this paper.

articleTitle: Forced Oscillation Suppression Method of Renewable Energy High-Infiltration Power System Based on Kuramoto-like Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: China is committed to achieving carbon neutrality by 2060, which requires a prominent increase in the proportion of renewable energy power generation in the power system. However, renewable energy power generation possesses the volatility and can be a potential source of disturbance in the power grid, which sharply increases the possibility of forced oscillation in the power grid, threatening the operation of the power grid seriously. In order to formulate strategies to suppress forced oscillations, most previous researches are based on local components of the power grid, whose analysis is intricate. For this reason, this paper proposes a set of analysis methods based on the overall Kuramoto-like model, and proposes a genetic algorithm based on the elite retention strategy to formulate strategies to suppress forced oscillations. This method is of less difficulty, and can develop a suppression strategy effectively. Finally, the feasibility of the proposed suppression strategy will be verified in a field grid.

articleTitle: Single-phase Grounding Fault Line Selection in Un-Effectual Grounding Systems Based on Low-Voltage Measurements
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Single-phase grounding fault of neutral un-effectual grounding systems have been a major concern of the public safety in distribution system. Under the background of the high-quality development of energy internet promoted by State Grid Corporation of China, the construction of distribution internet of things brings new technologies and opportunities for intelligent monitoring, automation, and protection control of distribution network. This paper presents a new method to identify the fault location of neutral un-effectual grounding systems by collecting and calculating measurement data from a smart distribution transformer terminal. Through the simulation of medium-voltage and low-voltage combined distribution systems in MATLAB software, it is verified that the proposed method has good robustness and accuracy. Monitoring the status information of the medium-voltage distribution network through the smart distribution transformer terminal to realize the fault location of neutral un-effectual grounding systems has great potential in practical application and implementation.

articleTitle: Research on the Control Strategy of Phase Modulator Based on Voltage Coordination
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As a device that can well improve the dynamic performance of the power grid, the phase modulator can well solve various types of grid system problems such as insufficient reactive power provided by the receiving end grid, and strengthen voltage support. Based on the principle of automatic voltage control (AVC) of the phase modulator, this paper analyzes the control mode and switching logic between the AVC substation of the phase modulator in Shaoshan Converter Station and proposed to add voltage coordinated control based on the original AVC control mode. When the DC fails, the power can be adjusted to better maintain the stable operation of the regional power grid. Through experiments based on the phase modulator of the Shaoshan converter station, the correctness and practicability of the proposed strategy are verified, and relevant optimization suggestions are put forward, which can provide reference for the design of the control system of the converter station in the future.

articleTitle: Research on Leakage Current Characteristics and Thermal Process of Gradient Valve Plates under High Frequency Voltage Conditions
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the roof arrester fault caused by high-frequency overvoltage during the operation of high-speed EMU, combined with the high-order harmonic overvoltage characteristics during the operation of EMU, the high-frequency and high-voltage test of arrester gradient valve plate is established. The leakage current characteristics of valve plate are obtained, and the active power of valve plate with different size parameters are compared. The results show that the leakage current of arrester valve increases linearly with the increase of voltage and frequency, and increases with the increase of valve radius. The leakage current of gradient valve is obviously smaller than that of ordinary valve. In terms of heating, the electric heating distribution of gradient valve plate is more uniform. The research provides a basis for the selection of roof arrester under complex overvoltage conditions.

articleTitle: Decoupling Method of Short Line Based on Characteristic Line and Its Simulation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to fully reflect the transient process of distributed energy source (DES) to the distribution network and the limitation of the simulation speed brought by DES grid connection, it is urgent to increase the speed of transient simulation. At present, the split-core parallel simulation method is often used to speed up. It means the distribution network is decoupled by the distributed parameter long line decoupling method. However, due to the short line characteristics of the distribution network, the traditional long line decoupling method is not suitable for Distribution network. So this article improves and analyzes it in detail with traveling wave theory. A short line decoupling method based on characteristic lines is proposed, which adds distributed capacitors, and conducts simulation analysis to verify its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Analysis of Data Value and Its Properties in Electricity and Data Transactions
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Decision-making in electricity transactions is always with inevitable uncertainty, which will probably lead to economic losses of participants and mitigate the efficiency of electricity transactions. Data transactions, which can break the information barrier and promote the data circulation, aim at uncertainty elimination through data interactions and are considered a promising solution. In this paper, a general framework of electricity and data transactions considering both load-side and source-side are constructed. Electricity retailers and renewable energy producers are taken as the representative of load-side and source-side market participants who have to face and manage uncertainty. A profit curve is shown considering the imbalance between day-ahead electricity bid and real-time electricity supply/demand. Inspired by our previous work, data value, which is defined as the enhancement of economic benefits caused by data transactions, is further explored and its mathematical properties are comprehensively analyzed. Based on the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality and Kolmogorov-Smirnov test, the upper bound and possible range of data value are analytically derived. Finally, a numerical example is employed to validate the theoretical results and illustrate that appropriately utilizing the data value and its properties can help market participants make better decisions in data transactions.

articleTitle: A Thermal Simulation and Prevention Control Framework for Lithium-ion Batteries
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The operation of a lithium-ion battery consists of working at a certain constant power output (charging or discharging) for a certain period of time, and then switching to another one in the next period, and so forth, in which the thermal management matters. This paper proposes a battery thermal prevention control framework based on thermal simulations, which can ensure that the battery temperature does not exceed the limit. The framework contains an electro-thermal battery model and an optimization model for prevention control. The first model can predict the temperature dynamics of the battery pack. It consists of two models, the heat generation model of a cell, and the resistance-capacitance (RC) model to describe the heat transfer in a battery pack. Based on the electro-thermal model, we add thermal constraints and the minimized power deviation as the objective function to build the optimization model. The thermal prevention control plan can be derived by solving it, which can avoid too high temperature. This framework has a small amount of computation and can be easily extended to a battery pack case under non-periodic square wave commands.

articleTitle: Analysis of Some Common Methods for Transient Modeling of Electrothermal Coupling System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Electrothermal coupling system (ECS), as an important part of Energy Internet (EI), plays a crucial role in new energy consumption and peak-load shifting of power system. However, due to the essential difference of the nature and the transmission characteristics between electric energy and thermal energy, they show obvious differences in the dynamic process. This paper analyzes the transient characteristics of the ECS, from the theory of basic modeling, the method of model construction, the solution and optimization of the model and the model application, etc. It is hoped that the paper could provide some beneficial reference for the closer integration of electricity and heat, and for more extensive and depth EI transient research.

articleTitle: A Power Quality Pricing Method Considering Resonance in Electricity Retail Market
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of solar energy, the resonance imposes the adverse effects on power quality(PQ). In the deregulated power market, PQ service can be seen as an auxiliary service, and it can be customized according to the individual needs of users. Taking voltage sag and harmonic as examples, this paper introduces a price determining method of PQ service. Firstly, considering the risk management, this paper establishes a mathematical model to determine the price of tailored PQ service. Then the calculation method of compensation standard is given when the PQ cannot meet the expected performance. In such a way, both power sales companies and users have the motivation to improve PQ level. Finally, the analysis results show that this method can meet the needs of users and realize risk transfer from a viewpoint of the profits of electricity sales companies.

articleTitle: Wind Area Distribution Map Plotting of Power Grid Based on Meteorological Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The paper's distribution map of the power grid wind area is the foundation of the power grid wind prevention work, and is an important basis for line operation and maintenance, and wind protection transformation. Therefore, the grid wind area classification and scientific drawing of the grid wind area distribution map are carried out to improve the operation and maintenance of the power grid and prevent wind damage. This research is of great significance.

articleTitle: Distributionally Robust Optimization for Internet Data Center with Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: More and more internet data centers (IDCs) are trying to use renewable energy sources (RESs). However, powering IDCs with intermittent RESs presents a significant challenge. In addition, power and workload management in IDCs has great potential to reduce energy consumption, carbon footprints and energy cost. This study proposes an optimal load dispatch model for an IDC with battery energy storage system (BESS), which aims to lower the total costs. To accommodate the uncertainties of wind power, a data-driven distributionally robust optimization (DDRO) method is adopted. Then the column-and-constraint generation method (C&CG) is used to solve the corresponding optimization problem. In the experiment with the real-world traces of workload arrival and wholesale electricity price, three scheduling scenarios are investigated. Moreover, robust optimization and stochastic programming are implemented for comparison. Experimental results reveal that total costs of the IDC can be effectively reduced by adopting BESS and implementing workload dispatch. Meanwhile, the results also demonstrate the effectiveness of DDRO approach.

articleTitle: Research on Electricity Consumption Behavior of Coal to Power Equipment Based on Random Forest Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: ‘Coal to electricity’ is an important livelihood project. Reasonable analysis and prediction of residents' coal to electricity behavior can provide decision support for the government to adapt to the region of coal to electricity transformation. Considering the temperature, GDP and other factors, the random forest method can accurately predict the electricity consumption of coal to electricity equipment. In addition, through the comparative analysis of the electricity consumption of three types of coal to electricity equipment, it can also provide reference for the selection of coal to electricity equipment for residents, which is of great significance.

articleTitle: Scheduling and Routing of Mobile Charging Vehicles for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles Charging
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Battery capacity of Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) limits its ability to perform long-term reconnaissance missions. This paper proposes a model of Mobile Charging Vehicles (MCVs) to charge UAVs on missions. In this scenario, the UAV can land on top of the MCV and move together along its original route. Scheduling and routing of MCVs are optimized to minimize the investment cost and maximize the quality of mission completion while satisfying time- and power-related constraints. For this multi-objective optimization problem, an improved decomposition-based multi-objective evolutionary algorithm (MOEA/D) is adopted to solve it. Finally, the effectiveness of this model is verified by numerical experiments.

articleTitle: Research on Control Strategy of Grid Connected Interface Converter for Optical Storage Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The analysis and research of optical storage microgrid is of great significance to promote the transformation of clean and low-carbon energy, accelerate the construction of new power system with new energy as the main body, ensure power supply and reduce power consumption cost. Taking the optical storage microgrid as the research object, this paper studies the control strategy of grid connected interface converter. According to the grid connected operation mode and off grid operation mode of the system, the PQ control strategy and constant voltage and constant frequency control strategy of voltage source grid connected interface converter are given, and the control strategies of different unit converters are simulated, The feasibility of the proposed control strategy is verified by simulation analysis, which provides technical support for the promotion and application of large-scale optical storage microgrid.

articleTitle: Cooperative Operation for Rooftop Photovoltaic Distributed Generation and Residential Buildings
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Currently, rooftop photovoltaic (PV) generation on the residential user side has been rapidly developed due to technological progress and related costs reductions. Innovative business models need to be explored to make full use of distributed PV generation. Here, we design a energy trading framework for a residential building cluster consisting of a PV owner and multiple buildings. The Nash bargaining theory is used to solve the cooperative operation problem between the PV owner and buildings. In order to protect individual privacy, a distributed solution algorithm is employed to solve the power sharing problem. And an analytical method is proposed to solve the additional payment bargaining problem. The results show that all participants can benefit from energy sharing and the rationality of the proposed transaction framework is proven. In addition, our results show peak to valley difference of the electricity load can be reduced to 24.3%.

articleTitle: Load Disaggregation Based on Sequence-to-point Network with Unsupervised Pre-training
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: It is known that successful load disaggregation via deep learning relies on a large number of labeled data to train the deep neural networks. However, it is hard and expensive to acquire a large amount of appliance-level power data or ON/OFF labels. For overcoming such weakness, in this paper, unsupervised pre-training is applied to the state-of-the-art sequence-to-point (s2p) deep learning approach for NILM, where labeling is not required in pre-training. In the proposed method, the s2p deep neural network is initially pre-trained on unlabeled aggregate power readings for other houses, and then fine-tuned on a small set of aggregate power for the target house labeled by individual appliance monitoring. Finally, the generated network is applied to testing with the aggregate for the target house as input and outputting the power signal for the target load. The proposed method is validated on the UK REFIT dataset1, benchmark with s2p in two popular evaluation metrics. Experimental results show that the proposed unsupervised pre-training effectively improves NILM performance of the deep neural network with a lack of labeled training data.

articleTitle: Security and Energy Supply Valleys Assessment of Regional Integrated Energy System Based on Practical Security Region
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to assess the severity of the valley from the perspective of security and energy supply of regional integrated energy system (RIES), and find the specific short-boards which are should be improved, a security and energy supply valleys assessment of regional integrated energy system based on practical security region was proposed. Firstly, by defining security valley index (SVI) and energy supply valley index (ESVI) based on practical security distance and current supplied load, the severity of the valley could be quantified. Then a visual assessment was proposed. The specific directions of practical security boundaries where energy supply security degree and utilization degree of energy supply potential are low could be located from the visual and quantitative perspectives. Finally, a specific case was set to verify effectiveness of the proposed assessment method. Meanwhile, feasible methods were given to improve valleys.

articleTitle: A Method of Physical Grid Partition Division for Distribution Network Based on Heuristic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In terms of a large scale of distributed generation connect to distribution network, absorption capacity of distributed generation should be increased significantly. Partition division of physical network is an optional mode. The entire planning area is divided into geographically and electrically independent power supply zones. Combined with the effective deployment of distribution terminals, the grid planning effect of distribution network is improved. The technical feasibility and economic optimization of the global scope are realized automatically. Based on the characteristics of distribution networks, the average level and the average degree as the objective functions are proposed. In view of the priority level of branch and node, an algorithm based on heuristic rule is proposed. The solution method abided by “search and modulation” is proposed. Finally, the algorithm are validated by case of PG & E69 node in the United States.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Phase Locked Loop Nonlinearity on Impedance Measurement for Stability Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Impedance measurement is an effective and flexible technique to obtain the impedance model of power electronic devices (PED). The impedance model can be applied to implement small-signal stability analysis. Hence, the accuracy of the impedance model is essential to acquire accurate stability analysis results. Perturbation injection is widely used to excite the devices under test (DUT), and then according to the current and voltage components at the terminal of the PED with the injected frequencies, the impedance at the perturbation frequencies can be calculated. Note that impedance model is a kind of linear small-signal model, which is established based on the harmonic linearization. Therefore, in impedance measurement, it is necessary to ensure the linearization condition of the measured system as much as possible. However, the injected perturbation may arouse the nonlinearity of the real system more or less, which may interfere the impedance measurement. In view of this issue, this paper investigates the nonlinearity of phase locked loop (PLL) and the influence of PLL nonlinearity on the measurement accuracy. Based on the investigation, a simple proposal on the frequency design for the perturbation signal is proposed so as to minimize the negative impact of PLL nonlinearity.

articleTitle: Trading Interval Optimization Based on the Pricing Strategy of Adjustable Load
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For the adjustable load participating in the day-ahead market, the earlier the trade between the power company and the user yields the lower cost, but the larger the prediction deviation compared with the actual value. To reduce the trading cost of the power company, an optimization model based on the prediction deviation and the pricing strategy of the adjustable load is proposed to decide the optimal trading interval. The relationship between the prediction accuracy and the trading interval is derived with the historical statistics. Considering the cost characteristics, a pricing model of the adjustable load is proposed. Considering the penalty price of prediction deviation, the optimal trading interval is determined to minimize the total cost of the power company. Numerical results show the effect of the adjustable load on the total cost of the power company and the optimal trading interval.

articleTitle: Dynamic Time-of-use Discharging Price Strategy of Electric Vehicle Participating in Electricity Market Concerning Users Risk Appetite
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the dispatch strategy of electric vehicle (EV) is not implemented effectively in practice, the EV dynamic time-of-use (TOU) discharging price strategy which concerned the risk appetite of users is proposed in this paper. With the demand side response theory, comprehensively considering the EV users' psychology and profit risk, using the conditional value at risk (CVaR) as the users' risk metrics who participating the reserve capacity market, the optimal reserve capacity and automatic response decision model is established. And then, the day-ahead incentive EV discharging price based on the operation of both supply and demand sides in microgrid is proposed.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Impact from the Parameters on the Flow Calculation for the District Heating System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, we analyze the impact of the parameters on the flow calculation for the district heating systems (DHS). As for the hydraulic parameter, the correlation between the resistance coefficient and the operating condition of the hydraulic process in the DHS is explored. As for the thermal parameter, the correlation between the overall heat transfer coefficient per unit length and the operating condition of the thermal process in the DHS is explored. What's more, an interval flow calculation model for the thermal process in the DHS considering the uncertainty of the overall heat transfer coefficient per unit length is formulated.

articleTitle: Repetitive Control For Current Harmonic Suppression Of PMSG-Based Wind Turbines
