publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG) contains a large number of harmonic components in the stator current due to their inherent mechanical structure and the nonlinear characteristics of the inverter, which will affect the performance of the PMSG-based wind turbine. This paper firstly analyzes the stator current harmonic components of the PMSG. Secondly, a repetitive controller (RC) in the current loop is introduced to suppress the harmonic current. At the same time, the stability of the system is ensured through internal model compensation and controlled object compensation. Finally, a PMSG-based wind turbine model using RC is built in MATLAB/Simulink. The simulation results show that after RC is added, the current harmonics are greatly reduced, which verifies the correctness and effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Research of Wind Power Generation Characteristics in Southern China Based on Improved Non-Parametric Kernel Density Estimation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing proportion of wind power access in southern China, the impact of the randomness and volatility of wind power generation on power system operation cannot be ignored. Therefore, it is necessary to study the characteristics and random distribution of wind power generation in southern China. Firstly, the influence of time and geographical factors on wind power generation characteristics is analyzed. Secondly, an improved non-parametric kernel density estimation method considering the optimal bandwidth selection of kernel function is proposed to establish the random distribution models of wind power generation in five southern provinces under multiple time scales. The evaluation index system of model fitting effect is also established. Thirdly, the effectiveness of the improved non-parametric kernel density estimation method proposed is verified by comparing with two parameter estimation methods based on typical empirical distribution function. Finally, the differences of probability characteristics of wind power generation in different provinces of southern China are analyzed by daily, quarterly and annual time scales, which can play an auxiliary role in decision-making of power system dispatching, power planning, site selection and capacity determination of wind farms.

articleTitle: EMT Modelling and Overvoltage Analysis of Renewable Energy Generation Grid-connected System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of renewable energy generation, the overvoltage of power system integrated with large-scale of renewable energy generations has gradually emerged, which has become one of the main restricting factors for the integration of renewable energy generators. However, most of the existing methods mainly analyze the influence of overvoltage from the electromechanical transient (TS) aspect, and the overvoltage suppression strategies have not been given fully consideration. Based on the above considerations, in the present study, the electromagnetic transient (EMT) model of a typical UHVDC sending-end system integrated with large-scale of renewable energy generations is established based on the Advanced Digital Power System Simulator (ADPSS), and it is revealed that the terminal bus overvoltage of renewable energy generator is the main restriction factor of the UHVDC transmission capacity. In what follows, time-domain simulation results of TS as well as EMT simulation under the same operating conditions are compared. At the end of this study, the suppression effect of installing arresters on the overvoltage of renewable energy generation grid-connected system is explored. Conclusions of this study can provide reference for cognition, analysis, and suppression of power system overvoltage in practice.

Author Keywords: Power System Integrated with Large-scale of Renewable energy generations

articleTitle: Research on AC and High Frequency Breakdown Characteristics of Oil-paper Insulation of 220 kV Current Transformers
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The AC Breakdown test at 20 °C, 50 °C and 80 °C and the high-frequency breakdown test at 5 kHz, 10 kHz, and 14 kHz of the oil-paper insulation of the 220 kV current transformer with different thermal aging time is investigated. The breakdown characteristics were explored, and the Weibull distribution was used to process the data. As the aging time increases and the test temperature increases, the AC breakdown strength of oil-paper insulation continues to decrease, and the increase in temperature has a significantly greater impact on the insulation strength than the aging time. With the increase of the voltage frequency, the breakdown field strength of the sample continues to decrease, and with the increase of the aging time, the resistance of the insulating sample to high-frequency voltage gradually becomes worse. The results can provide theoretical support for the safe operation of 220 kV current transformers at different temperatures and high frequencies.

articleTitle: Research on Alarm Information Oriented Fault Event Classification Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: China is building a new power system with new energy as the main body, which puts forward higher requirements for the intelligence of power grid dispatching, and the processing of power grid alarm information also needs to be more intelligent. In this paper, a power grid fault event classification method based on LSTM is proposed to realize the end-to-end discrimination of power grid fault event types and meet the needs of power grid intelligence. Firstly, the sample data set of power grid alarm information required for modeling is constructed; Then, the alarm information is vectorized by using the word2vec model in natural language processing technology; Then, using LSTM neural network, a power grid fault event classification model based on LSTM is constructed to determine the type of power grid fault equipment end-to-end and whether there is protection and circuit breaker failure; Finally, through the comparison of numerical examples, it is verified that this method has good expressiveness in fault event classification.

articleTitle: A Novel Fault Area Identification Scheme for Inverter Station of HVDC Based on Wavelet Energy Ratio
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The existing inverter station protection will operate incorrectly when the external fault occurs. Based on this, a fault area identification scheme based on wavelet energy ratio for inverter station is proposed. This scheme compares the characteristics of the current fault component between the primary side of the converter transformer and the outlet of the AC filter, and finds that there are obvious differences between the internal and external faults. The paper uses wavelet energy to characterize the difference, so that the converter station protection has the ability to identify internal and external faults. Extensive simulations on ±800kV HVDC system built in PSCAD/EMTDC show that the proposed scheme is reliability and validity. The proposed scheme can not only identify internal and external faults correctly and quickly, but also has good adaptability under different fault types, fault locations and fault inception angles. Furthermore, the scheme is insensitive to high fault resistance and noise interference.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of Various Linear Programming Solvers for SCED in Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the marketization of electricity trading, linear programming solvers are becoming more and more important in power system decision-making. How to select a suitable solver for economic dispatching of power systems becomes a tricky problem that needs to be considered in a focused manner. In order to evaluate the applicability of linear programming (LP) solvers in power system economic dispatching problems, nine most commonly used LP solvers are sorted out and compared qualitatively from three perspectives of compatibility, openness and pervasiveness, and a quantitative efficiency comparison of these linear programming solvers is carried out based on security constrained economic dispatch (SCED) problems of different scales. Finally, based on the statistical results, a comprehensive feature presentation is made using radar diagrams to derive an optimization solver suitable for linear programming problems in power systems.

articleTitle: Research On Transaction And Market Mechanism In Micro-Grid Considering Matching Degree Between Supply And Demand
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To solve the direct transaction problem of the energy spot market under the background of diversification and openness, a direct transaction model considering matching degree between supply and demand for micro-grid is proposed. Firstly, the information matching index system is constructed based on axiomatic design theory. Then, taking the maximization of the system benefit and the optimization of information matching degree of market users as the objective function, a two-sided matching model of the electric transaction is established. And the fast non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm (NSGA-II) is used to solve the multi-objective function of the model. To solve the potential transaction conflict, a market supervision mechanism is established. In the process of transaction execution, the default behavior is constrained, and the credit is evaluated after the transaction is completed. Finally, through the analysis of specific microgrid transaction cases, the effectiveness and security of the scheme are verified.

articleTitle: A Novel Load Recognition Strategy Embedded in Power Control Loop for Multi-Port Energy Router
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel load recognition strategy for multi-port energy routers. The proposed strategy is embedded in power control loop, and can be employed during power transfer process. First, the energy router sends a specific frequency to the load using power/signal dual modulation in control loop (PSDM-CL) method. Second, the load modifies its input impedance at this frequency. Third, the energy router measures the load's input impedance to verify the compliance of the load. Since no extra wiring or communication circuits is needed by the proposed method, the method obtains advantages of low manufacturing and maintenance costs, and easy implementations. The principles of the proposed strategy, along with the necessary modifications in control loop, are introduced in detail in this paper. Finally, the feasibility of the proposed strategy is verified on a 2kW experimental platform.

articleTitle: Improved Voltage Compensation Method For Zero Sequence Directional Protection Of Double-Circuit Transmission Lines In Open-Phase Operation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve the stability of the power system, when a single-phase fault happens, the faulty phase is generally tripped while the two sound phases keep in operation, i.e., the open-phase operation state. For the double-circuit lines on the same tower (DCLST), if one circuit is in open-phase operation mode or a longitudinal asymmetric fault occurs, the zero sequence directional protection of the sound line may mal-operate due to the zero sequence voltage compensation. Based on the electrical characteristics during the open-phase state, the reason for the mal-operation of the zero sequence directional protection on the sound line in DCLST is studied in this paper. Furthermore, an improved voltage compensation method is proposed to address this problem. Depending on the phase difference of zero sequence voltage before and after the voltage compensation, the reverse status of the compensated voltage is identified first. Then by enlarging the amplitude of zero sequence voltage, the proposed reverse compensation method is utilized to improve the protection sensitivity without increasing the possibility of the protection mal-operation. The simulation results prove the effectiveness of the improved voltage compensation method.

Author Keywords: double-circuit lines on the same tower (DCLST)

articleTitle: Influence of Humidity on Partial Discharge Characteristics of Cable Buffer Layer under Different Electric Fields
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, the discharge problems in buffer layer have drawn wide attention in the industry. Relative humidity is an important impact factor of partial discharge, and it is necessary to carry out research on the mechanism of relative humidity on partial discharge characteristics. Based on the cable buffer layer structure, the partial discharge test platform based on the pulse-current method for buffer layer was established within a controllable humidity environment. The results show that the variation of relative humidity has no effects on the geometric shape of the partial discharge pattern, but it will affect the characteristic parameters of partial discharge. Under the lower humidity conditions, the discharge amplitude gradually decreases with the increase of relative humidity. Under the higher humidity conditions, the rise of relative humidity will promote the development of discharge activities in the buffer layer, and the discharge amplitude will increase with the increase of relative humidity.

articleTitle: Joint Control Based On Virtual DC Machine And Predictive Model For Hybrid Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Hybrid energy storage system (HESS) usually adopts the traditional PI control, However, the linearity of PI control and the lack of inertia of the bidirectional DC-DC converter have led to the system stability problem. The joint control of the virtual DC machine (VDCM) control with a low-pass filter and the model predictive control (MPC) is proposed. VDCM control improves the voltage stability of the DC-bus by simulating the inertia and damping characteristics of the synchronous DC machine. The low-pass filter (LPF) is to allocate the power between the battery and supercapacitor Energy Storage (ES) units. Furthermore, the MPC is used to accelerate the response speed by predicting the response based on the VDCM control. In this paper, the VDCM small-signal model with a low-pass filter is established firstly, the influence of inertia, damping coefficients and filter time constant on the dynamic step response are analyzed too. Then the MPC is applied in the inner current loop of the control. The DC-bus voltage Feedback Correction (FC) is introduced further in the MPC control to realize the optimization control. Compared with the traditional PI double closed-loop control and traditional MPC, simulation results show that the proposed control strategy enables the HESS to restrain the fluctuation of the DC bus when load changes, and has fast response speed.

articleTitle: A Scheduling Strategy of Vehicle-2-Grid based on Stackelberg Gaming Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a V2G scheduling strategy based on Stackelberg gaming model. It is assumed that the power grid operator controls a battery storage system to provide auxiliary services to reduce the operation costs, while the PEV aggregator pursues minimal charging costs through cooperative game theory. Thus a Stackelberg gaming model is established with real-time electricity price, as the PEV aggregator has to determine the optimal strategies according to the strategies formulated by the grid operators, where the grid operator, as the leader, has the priority to the charging and discharging of the battery storage system, and the PEV aggregator, as the follower, wants to reduce the total charging costs as much as possible under the strategies of the grid operator. Based on the proposed Stackelberg gaming model, this paper discusses the optimal strategies of the grid operator and the PEV aggregator under Stackelberg Equilibrium through Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions. Finally, a series of simulation experimental results have confirmed the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: An Economic Evaluation Method for New Energy Station Configuring with Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The configuration of energy storage for new energy power stations is a promising method to deal with the intermittency, randomness, and uncertainty of new energy stations. However, the deployment of energy storage requires a certain amount of investment. Therefore, scientific calculation for the economics of new energy stations with energy storage is important, which can help analyze the competitiveness for new energy stations with energy storage. Among the existing economic analysis methods for new energy stations with energy storage, nonetheless, the perspective of various full-life investment and costs has not been fully considered. In this paper, an economic evaluation method for the recoverable price of new energy station configuring with energy storage is proposed. It comprehensively considers the investment, operating life, operation and maintenance cost for both new energy station and energy storage, together with the factors of discount rate, the proportion of energy storage capacity allocated to new energy stations, the annual utilization hours, and energy storage battery replacement. A simulation case for a solar power station with energy storage presents the application of this method. In addition, the calculation is simple and convenient, thus provide an effective means for evaluating the economy for new energy station configuring with energy storage.

articleTitle: Network-Constrained AC Unit Commitment Based on Linear Approximation Techniques
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Unit commitment with AC network constraints (ACUC) becomes a fundament problem for modern power systems. Linear approximation techniques and generalized Benders decomposition (GBD) are commonly employed to make ACUC tractable. This paper investigates the solution performance under different linear approximation techniques. Three kinds of linear approximation techniques along with a GBD-based solution algorithm are presented. The results show the piecewise linear power flow model is a better alternative for linearizing ACUC due to the enhanced approximation effects especially for reactive power and voltage.

articleTitle: Three-Stage Voltage/Var Control for Distribution Systems with High Permeability Photovoltaic
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing scale of distributed generations connected to active distribution network, voltage/var control of distribution network is facing more and more technical challenges. In this paper, under the background of photovoltaic high-permeability distribution network, a three-stage voltage/Var control (VVC) is adopted to optimize the active power loss and voltage level of the distribution network from multiple time scales. First, coordinate and optimize the operation of capacitor bank and on-load tap switch in the first stage. Then, the second stage realizes the reactive power scheduling optimization of photovoltaic inverter. Finally, the response of the inverter's reactive droop curve to the voltage offset is considered in the third stage. Given the uncertainty of PV output and load demand, a stochastic optimization method is used to solve the three-stage VVC model. The feasibility and effectiveness of the strategy are verified by numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Short-Term Power Load Forecasting Based on Self-Adaptation Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a power load forecasting method based on self-adaptation random forest is proposed, which has lower complexity compared with the model based on support vector machine and neural network. In addition, for the problem that traditional random forest model can't finish parameters optimizing in regression tree. This paper designs a regression tree parameter optimization algorithm, it's used to find the optimal number of regression trees and the feature number of training set. The experimental results show that the short-term load forecasting accuracy of the proposed model is better than the common machine learning prediction model.

articleTitle: Research on the Coupling Performance of Voltage and Frequency for the Power Grid With Highly Penetrated Photovoltaics Generation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The large-scale integration of new energy into the grid is the current development trend. As the penetration rate of new energy increases, the impact on the frequency of the grid system will be more significant. Firstly, the impact of high-permeability photovoltaics on the frequency characteristics of the grid system is analyzed in this paper. However, in the actual grid system, the relationship between grid voltage and frequency is often coupled with each other and coexist. Then, based on the two-zone four- machine model with different new energy penetration rates, the frequency and voltage characteristics of the power grid under load disturbances are analyzed through the load changes in zone two. Finally, by Matlab/Simulink platform, the model of the two-zone grid system with PV generations is established to verify the impact of photovoltaics on the grid system frequency, and the rationality of analysis for the grid frequency and voltage coupling response.

articleTitle: Day-Ahead Market Trading Model of Pumped-Hydro-Solar Hybrid System Considering Contract Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The pumped-hydro-solar hybrid system is a comprehensive power generation system in which cascade hydropower and pumped storage units with strong regulation capabilities are set to stabilize the randomness and volatility of photovoltaic output. The optimization of the trading strategy of pumped-hydro-solar hybrid system in the day-ahead market considering decomposition of the contract market's daily electricity was studied in this paper. It's assumed that the contract power is decomposed into a daily contract curve, and a certain percentage of the excess and shortfall of the contract power is allowed, and the power over the contract is traded in the day-ahead market. The highest total market revenue was set as the optimization goal of the model. stochastic programming was used to obtain typical scenarios of photovoltaic output, and the randomness of electricity prices was handled through robust optimization. By linearization method and duality theory, the optimization model was transformed into a mixed integer programming model. Through the analysis of case study, the method proposed in this paper is proved to take both economy and robustness into account.

articleTitle: Optimization Allocation Strategy of Distributed Generation in Grid-Connected Microgrid Based on Economic Dispatch
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the background of vigorously promoting environmental protection and cleaning, distributed generation (DG) has become a hot research topic at home and abroad because of its advantages of energy saving and green cleaning. However, due to the uncertainty and volatility of DG output, the safety and reliability of the large power grid connected to it will be affected, so it is of great significance to the allocation planning of DG in grid-connected microgrid. In this paper, an improved economic dispatch strategy is proposed, considering the relationship between cycle life and discharge depth, and an economic optimal programming model is established. The typical daily data of load, irradiance and wind speed in an area are processed, and 12 typical scenes are taken as data for example simulation. The results show that the improved economic dispatch strategy can achieve good economy, improve load fluctuation, reduce carbon emissions, and is economic and environmental protection.

articleTitle: Indirect Power Control of Doubly-Fed Induction Generator
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the doubly fed induction wind turbine system, when the rotor side converter adopts vector control, it needs complex coordinate rotation transformation, and depends on more motor parameters, and the dynamic performance is poor. In order to overcome these shortcomings, an indirect power control strategy for doubly fed induction generator is presented. Firstly, the mathematical model of doubly fed induction generator in two-phase rotor static ɑβ coordinate is established. On this basis, the influence of amplitude increment and phase increment of rotor flux winding on active and reactive power is analyzed. Then, the phase increment and amplitude increment are adjusted quickly to achieve the goal of fast tracking the given value. Finally, the simulation in MATLAB verifies that the control strategy can accurately track the active and reactive power.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Universal Clamps for UHV Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The insulator replacement tools and instruments currently used have great shortcomings in terms of efficiency and versatility, when replacing the strain-resistant insulator string on a power transmission line. The first broken insulator on the side of the transmission line cannot be replaced in a timely and effective manner. For more stable and safer operation of ultra-high voltage (UHV) lines, a new type universal clamp is developed in this paper. The damaged insulators can be replaced in time, which improves the operation and maintenance efficiency of UHV lines. For different types of wire connecting plates, the replacement of the first damaged insulator on the transmission line side can be completed more efficiently. The finite element method is used to analyze the mechanical properties of the new clamp. And the feasibility of the new clamp structure design is verified by experimental results.

articleTitle: An Active Defense Mechanism for Cyber-Physical Power Systems Against Data Integrity Attack on ADMM-Based Economic Dispatch
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As an important power system operation scenario in the future, distributed power generation requires stable and economic operation. Due to development of technologies in physical and cyber systems, as well as the coupling of those mentioned above, cyber-physical-system needs to be modeled and analyzed together. Complex information systems and complex communication environments have introduced a series of more complex security issues. Physical systems rely on information systems to operate, and information systems themselves have fragile characteristics, all of which make them easy to become ideal targets for network attacks. The decomposition-coordination scenarios in distributed power system plays an important role, while the protection or detection on cyberattack is in lack. Therefore, this paper proposes an active detection algorithm on the ADMM-based decomposition-coordination power generation economic dispatch scenario to defend against data integrity attacks, then we test its performance under IEEE standard 9-node system.

articleTitle: Improved Virtual Synchronous Generator Control for Wind Storage System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The scale of new energy grid-connected power generation continues to expand, the problem of insufficient system inertia and damping becomes increasingly serious. Although the traditional virtual synchronous generator (VSG) control can provide inertia and damping support, the constant virtual inertia and virtual damping cannot meet the dynamic response requirements of frequency and power of the system at different periods. To this end, for the energy storage subsystem of wind storage system based on doubly-fed wind turbine (DFIG), the transfer function is first combined with power angle curve to analyze the effect of virtual inertia and damping on frequency stability and power fluctuation of the VSG control of energy storage subsystem, then, adaptive virtual inertia and damping VSG control is designed and its stability is proved. Considering the coupling problem between the active and reactive power of VSG output, a power decoupling strategy is designed. Thus, a virtual synchronous generator control technique with adaptive inertia and damping, meanwhile, considering power decoupling is proposed. Finally, the reasonable feasibility and technical advantages of proposed improved VSG control are confirmed by system modeling and simulation studies.

articleTitle: Analysis and Suppression of 6.5kV SiC MOSFET Turn-on Current Overshoot
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: SiC MOSFET (Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor Field-Effect Transistor) combines the advantages of high withstand voltage and high switching speed, and has obvious advantages in high-voltage and high-power applications. In the actual application process, the SiC SBD (Schottky Barrier Diode) is usually connected in anti-parallel at both ends of the SiC MOSFET for freewheeling to avoid the bipolar degradation of the body diode during long term operation. This paper analyzes the mechanism of the device turn-on current overshoot when SiC MOSFET and SiC SBD are used in parallel in bridge circuit topology. Based on the research group's self-developed 6.5kV SiC device, the switching characteristics of 6.5kV SiC MOSFET and SiC SBD in parallel are evaluated. The test results show that the 6.5kV SiC device has a large turn-on current overshoot due to the combined action of the body diode and SBD, and causes current distortion. By applying a negative gate bias to the freewheeling device, the turn-on current overshoot is suppressed to a certain extent. Finally, this article discusses and gives suggestions for suppressing the overshoot of the turn-on current of high voltage SiC MOSFET devices.

articleTitle: Application and Prospect of Deep Learning in New Energy Power System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Building a new power system with new energy as the main body is one of the most important measures to achieve “carbon peak and carbon neutral” in China, which also puts forward higher requirements on the data analysis and processing capacity of the current power system. In recent years, artificial intelligence algorithms represented by deep learning have provided strong support for the realization and development of new energy power system. The paper summarizes the basic characteristics of deep learning algorithm and its five mainstream models. From the aspects of image recognition, power load prediction, fault diagnosis and system optimization scheduling, the application of deep learning in new energy power system is deeply analyzed. The application prospect of deep learning in new energy power system is prospected in order to provide reference for the research and construction of new power system.

articleTitle: Hierarchical State Estimation Method for Tree Structure Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Accurate of distribution network is helpful to realize power system optimal scheduling and energy optimization management. Based on measurement data from supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) and advanced metering infrastructure (AMI) system, a hierarchical state estimation (SE) method for the distribution network is proposed in this paper. Considering the distribution network structure and the measurement point configuration, the distribution network is divided, which is helpful to implement the hybrid SE strategy for the unbalanced loads. The improved IEEE 123-bus system is analysed as a case study, and the results show that, compared with the global estimation method of distribution network, the proposed method has advantages of fast computation speed and good convergence effect, which provides a new way for SE.

articleTitle: A Credit Management Mechanism for Peer-to-Peer Electricity Trading in Blockchain Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of distributed generation, peer-to-peer (P2P) electricity trading between microgrids in blockchain environment has become one of the indispensable ways to consume the local renewable energy. The existing credit management for P2P electricity trading generally realized through the smart contract of penalty, which cannot show the risk identification and risk aversion behaviors of each microgrid. Therefore, this study proposes a newly credit management mechanism to reduce the defaults, which achieves credit-based risk control optimization and credit-based continuous double auctions. In the first stage, microgrids make robust control optimize to submit a trading strategy that follows contracts as far as possible. In the second stage, which realizes rewards and penalties through credit-based equivalent price conversion. The experimental results show that the proposed credit management mechanism can improve microgrids' interests and ensure fair environment.

articleTitle: The Coordinated Planning of Distributed Generation Considering the Electric Price Optimal Strategy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of the active distribution network, the demand side response has been widely used as an important controllable resource of the distribution network, which can effectively improve the ability of the distribution network to absorb distributed power. Meanwhile, the large-scale access of distributed generation will greatly change the timing characteristics of the net load, so the planning scheme of distributed generation must also be considered in the design of the demand side response mechanism. In the existing research results of distributed generation planning, the electricity price optimization strategy has not been considered in the same time, and it is difficult to fully reflect the impact of the demand response on the distributed generation planning scheme. For this reason, this paper proposes a two-layer optimization model of time-of-use electricity price and distributed generation planning. Firstly, combined with the electricity price elasticity matrix, a demand side response model considering the uncertainty of user response behavior is constructed. Secondly, a two-layer coordination optimization model of distributed generation planning scheme and time-of-use electricity price schemes is proposed, and the discrete particle swarm optimization method is proposed to solve the model. Finally, the result shows that the coordinated optimization of distributed generation and electricity prices can improve the utilization rate of distributed power output, promote the access of distributed power, and reduce the operating cost of the distribution network.

articleTitle: Robust Adaptive Dynamic Voltage Control for Distributed Photovoltaic Considering Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the voltage control problem in distributed photovoltaic low-voltage distribution network, a robust adaptive dynamic voltage control method that considers energy storage (ES) is established. Firstly, Considering the model parameter errors caused by load variation, power output fluctuation and line impedance variation in the dynamic operation of power grid, a hybrid robust control method is designed to suppress the influence of such uncertainty on the dynamic voltage control while ensuring the fast dynamic voltage feedback control of the system; Secondly, considering that the robust control design based on the theoretical model is usually difficult to take into account the operation constraints such as the upper and lower limits of power output and power factor in the actual operation process, the adaptive voltage regulation control rate of photovoltaic generation further designed. Through the cooperation with the proposed robust control, the good consideration of power factor constraints and active voltage regulation capability in the control process is realized.

articleTitle: An Authentication Scheme for Smart Charging of Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The charging and discharging of electric vehicles can be incorporated into the dispatching and control system of power grid. Vehicle to Grid (V2G) technology can alleviate the negative impact of the large-scale application of electric vehicles on the grid. However, V2G technology cannot be separated from the support of information and communication network technology. Aiming at the engineering application of electric vehicles participating in power grid dispatching and control through load aggregation technology, this paper studies the safety certification method of electric vehicle charging and discharging dispatching control, and proposes corresponding information security solutions. The article uses proxy short signature technology to propose a security authentication mechanism between the communication entities of electric vehicles, aggregation units, and control centers, and verifies the effectiveness of the proposed scheme through security analysis and simulation.

articleTitle: An Emergency Control Method of AC/DC Hybrid Power System Considering the Risk of DC Commutation Failure Under AC Fault
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: DC commutation failure has become one of the key factors restricting the safe and stable operation of AC and DC hybrid power system. When an AC fault occurs in the power grid, the AC fault itself may cause rapid changes in the power angle, voltage, and frequency of the AC system. At the same time, if the AC fault also causes the DC commutation failure, the power impact of the DC system and the impact caused by the AC fault itself superposition makes the characteristics of the AC power grid more complicated and may cause more serious security and stability problems. However, the characteristics of the DC commutation is related to many factors such as the type of fault, the severity of the fault, the location of the fault, the degree of voltage asymmetry, the support capacity of the AC power grid, and the DC operating conditions. Usually, the control strategies are formulated by predictive fault simulation, it is not exactly the same as it is in the actual system, so the control strategy is formulated in accordance with the most conservative situation, which may cause unnecessary excessive control, and the economic cost is relatively high. An emergency control method is proposed, which is an additional control method based on the DC commutation failure signal under AC faults. When the commutation failure is detected, additional control is performed on the base of the original emergency control strategy, which can ensure system safety and re-duce control costs. Finally, based on a simulation case of Brazil's AC/DC hybrid power grid, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified.

articleTitle: Research on Four Ground Wires Design Scheme for Tower of 220kV Double-Circuit Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the demand for power grid communication increases, the number of fiber optic cable cores erected on transmission line has also increased accordingly. Conventional tower with double ground wires cannot meet the requirements for carrying capacity. Using SmartTower software to establish the stress calculation model of double-circuit transmission line towers, calculating the influence of the four ground wires erection scheme of the double-split ground wires and the added ground wire hanging points on the mechanical properties of the tower structure for OPGW cables with different core counts, and calculating the tower weight and foundation force. The results show that when 48-core optical cable is selected, the tower weight increase caused by increasing unit communication capacity is smaller. The tangent tower adopts double split ground wire, and the tension tower adopts the scheme of increasing ground wire hanging point, resulting in less stress change of the tower and less weight increase of the tower.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Fault Location Based on Time Reversal Considering Hybrid Power Network and Load
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing attention to the power supply reliability of distribution network, the fault location method of distribution network as an important subject can be studied in depth. Traditional fault location methods, such as impedance method and traveling wave method, are limited due to the complex topology and many line types of distribution network. Based on the analysis of the limitations of impedance method and traveling wave method, this paper studies the fault location method of distribution network based on time reversal, focusing on the influence of hybrid power network and load on fault location method, Compared with the traditional fault location method, the distribution network fault location method based on time reversal has stronger adaptability.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimal Dispatching Algorithm for Park Integrated Energy System Considering Starkberg Game and Energy Cascade Utilization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of integrated energy system and the proposal of sustainable development goals, the participation of multiple stakeholders in the park integrated energy system (PIES) and the demand for efficient cascade utilization have brought huge challenges to the optimal dispatching of PIES, Therefore, for the PIES with heterogeneous energy flows of cold, heat, electricity and gas, an optimal dispatching algorithm considering Starkberg game and energy cascade utilization is proposed. Firstly, the architecture of PIES is proposed. Secondly, the PIES and users of the park are modeled, and the exergy efficiency target is expounded, and the Starkberg game equilibrium model was obtained. Finally, an example is given to illustrate the rationality of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on the Effectiveness of Water Mist Containing Surfactant on Extinguishing Transformer Oil Fire
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Four kinds of water mist with different surfactants and pure water mist were added to extinguish transformer oil pool fire based on the self-built fire extinguishing test platform. The temperature change and flame shape of the fire were recorded in the process of extinguishing transformer oil pool fire. The fire extinguishing performance was compared, and the fire extinguishing mechanism was explored. Besides, the effectiveness of the water mist containing surfactant on transformer oil fire extinguishing was analyzed. The test results showed that the fire extinguishing performance of water mist was significantly improved by adding surfactant. This was because the surfactant could greatly reduce the surface tension of water, isolate oxygen, and emulsify transformer oil in the inhibition process. The water mist containing fluorocarbon surfactant had a better suppression effect on transformer oil pool fire than the water mist containing hydrocarbon surfactant. In particular, the fluorocarbon surfactant (F2) had the highest fire-fighting efficiency and the shortest fire-fighting time, which was only 7 s. This was due to the high electronegativity and low polarizability of the fluorocarbon chain in the surfactant. It had a high surface activity in the aqueous solution, leading to forming a stable water film, and insulating oxygen to suffocate fire flame.

articleTitle: Power Capacity Planning on Integrated Multi-Energy System of the Industrial Park
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The energy system models for off-grid systems in the industrial park usually focus solely on the simple electricity supply, thus neglecting the thermal side demand and the synergies between electric energy and thermal energy. Therefore, this paper proposed the open-source micro-grid optimization tool suitable for the industrial park on the basis of the existing energy system, which can not only provide a complete corresponding scheme solving all kinds of energy demand, but also study on integration of electric and thermal components. Compared with the traditional energy micro-grid, the average energy cost and the total net present cost of the integrated energy system proposed in this paper allowing for a reduction of 59% and 69%, respectively, and renewable energy penetration is increased by 53%, etc. The results show that the modeling method on integrated multi-energy system of the industrial park proposed in this paper is effective.

articleTitle: DFIG Multi-time Scale Control Characteristics and Simplified Modeling
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the transformation and upgrading of energy structure, the proportion of doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) installed capacity in the power system will continue to increase and will have an important impact on system stability. For this reason, studying the multi-time scale control characteristics of DFIG and establishing a simplified model of DFIG are of great significance to the stability analysis of the power system. This article will start from the perspective of parameter trajectory sensitivity, and propose a multistage analysis method. Under different simulation events, the time scale is divided according to the response speed of DFIG control, and the characteristics of DFIG multi-time scale control are studied. On this basis, the detailed model of DFIG is simplified. Finally, the correctness of the research and the accuracy of the model built in this paper are verified by simulation comparison.

articleTitle: A Voltage Vector Superposition Based Control Strategy for High Voltage Capacitor Ageing Test Used Multilevel Cascaded Converter Fed with Single DC Source
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to design a high voltage capacitor ageing tester, topology of multilevel cascaded H-bridges is used. Considering the economics of the system, the converter contains only one dc source and the rest of H-bridges are fed with capacitors. However, the challenge brought with economy is control of the capacitor voltages. Existing researches mostly based on phase-shifting modulation approach. In this paper, a voltage vector superposition based control strategy and a method to select dc voltages are proposed. This control approach has merits of simple control principle and control parameters are easy to design. In the end of this paper, the simulation results validate this control strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Synergetic Effect of multi-subnet AC/DC Hybrid Microgrid Control Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The depletion of fossil fuel energy and the development of modern economy put forward higher requirements for electric energy. The power system also began to carry out a very profound change. A large number of distributed generation has been connected, and the traditional distribution network has also undergone adaptive changes. In particular, the bidirectional flow of DC and AC on the distribution network side has put forward new requirements for hybrid microgrid control technology. In this regard, based on the related concepts of multi-subnet AC/DC hybrid microgrid, this paper further clarifies the problems that need to be solved in the control of multi-subnet AC/DC hybrid microgrid. At the same time, this paper focuses on the collaborative research of multi-subnet AC/DC hybrids microgrid control technology, hoping to provide some guidance for future research in related fields.

articleTitle: Study on Power Control Optimization Technology for Wind Turbines During Power Grid Transient Process
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the increasing proportion of wind power in regional grids the four corners of the earth and the withdrawal of traditional fossil power sources from operation, wind power is required to take on more responsibility in the grid and proactively involved in controlling the actual operation of the grid on the basis of ensuring safe and stable access to the grid. The LVRT technology for wind turbines in transient processes is now more mature, but the active support technology of wind power to the grid is now mainly reflected in the single function implementation and for the steady state support of the system, as more and more AC and DC mixed connection phenomenon in the grid, and its operating conditions are very complex. This has led to a lack of research on the active support of the grid under various transient processes. This paper investigates the requirements of wind turbines for power active support optimal control techniques during grid transients, the research on the optimization of the reactive voltage control technology in the transient process of wind turbines is not perfect, one of it is the double-fed wind turbines under grid faults and the dynamic state of full power variable-speed wind turbines are unclear, and there are no targeted method for active support of transient process voltages; the other one is the two types of wind turbines, doubly fed wind turbines, as well as full power variable speed wind turbines face the problem of adaptive control of active power during transient processes.

articleTitle: Frequency Stability Enhancement of Wind Power Penetrated Power System by Switched Control of Battery Energy Storages
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increase in the penetration rate of wind power in the power system, frequency dynamics of the power system are experiencing unprecedented challenges. In this paper, a switched controller is designed for the battery energy storage to participate in the primary frequency control of the power system with 49.66 % wind power penetration. The switched control is realized by a first-order bang-bang funnel controller with neutral output, which can give full play to the equipment performance and fast response. Via the switched controller, the battery energy storage is enabled to take part in the primary frequency control of the power system, and both frequency deviation and steady-state voltage deviation are decreased. This paper compares the performance of three controller configu-rations: conventional controller, no controller and bang-bang funnel controller through the simulation of a modified IEEE 4-machine 11-node power system. The simulation results show the superior frequency control capability and better voltage dynamics of the system controlled by the switched controller.

articleTitle: An Innovative Deep Reinforcement Learning Controller for DC/DC DAB Converters Based on Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to adapt to renewable energy sources and multiple DC loads connected to the power grid, the application of dual active bridge (DAB) converters in the context of DC micro-grids (MGs) has been widely used. Aim to stabilize DC bus output voltage of the dual-active-bridge (DAB) DC-DC converter, an innovative control method is proposed in this paper. Using the deep reinforcement learning (DRL) algorithm with the Actor-Critic architecture sustains voltage stabilization of the DAB converters. More specifically, the deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG) algorithm is according to the mathematical model of the system's input and output data learning system, the optimal control of the system can be realized according to the given reward. It is guaranteed that the DC converter has strict stability in the face of all kinds of disturbance problems in the system, and the effectiveness of this control strategy is verified by simulation. In order to prove the advantages and practicability of the proposed adaptive method, The effectiveness of this control strategy is verified by simulation outcome.

articleTitle: Modeling and Optimal Control of Hydrogen Fuel Cell Cogeneration System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Hydrogen fuel cell as a new type of energy conversion device has the characteristics of stable realization of combined heat and power supply, zero pollution and high efficiency, and gradually becomes an effective means of load regulation of integrated energy system. Aiming at the complex structure and nonlinear characteristics of the proton exchange membrane hydrogen fuel cell (PEMFC), a parameter identification method is used for modeling, and model predictive control (MPC) is used to improve the hydrogen compressor control process at the input side, and sub-unit PID control is used to adjust the system output power according to the structural characteristics and output characteristics of the hydrogen fuel cell to meet the peak regulation demand of the integrated energy system. The simulation of the combined hydrogen fuel cell cogeneration system is carried out by MATLAB/Simulink platform, and the results show that the parameter identification modeling and sub-unit optimization control method of the combined hydrogen fuel cell cogeneration system can not only simplify the mathematical model of the hydrogen fuel cell through parameter identification, but also realize the stable and accurate operation of the combined hy drogen fuel cell cogeneration system by using MPC and sub-unit PID control to ensure the economy and reliability of the system.

articleTitle: Peer-to-peer Energy Trading Considering Security Constraints in Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of distributed energy resources (DERs) in power system, distribution grid or microgrid based peer-to-peer (P2P) energy trading has a promising prospect because it can take full advantage of DERs. In this paper, a novel P2P energy trading scheme in distribution networks is proposed to deal with the economic issues caused by transaction cost and the technical issues caused by network security constraint. In particular, the modified continuous double auction with social welfare maximization is proposed to obtain the un-constrained trading schedule in the presence of transaction cost. Moreover, based on alternating current power flow sensitivity analysis, the un-constrained trading schedule is verified and adjusted in order to maximize the total amount of trading energy. Then the transaction cost is formulated by combining the MW-Mile method and the increase in network loss caused by P2P transaction. Finally, the feasibility and the effectiveness of the proposed P2P energy trading scheme is verified by comprehensive case studies.

articleTitle: Extension Controller for Wind Turbine Pitch System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve the dynamic performance of the variable rotor system of wind turbine, the extension control method is used to design the controller of the variable rotor system. Firstly, the simulation model of the variable rotor is established based on the direct-driven wind turbine with permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG), and then the extension controller is established by controlling the qualification degree (correlation degree) of the input variables to control the output correction. The PID controller and the extension controller are respectively used to carry out the simulation comparison under the same conditions. The simulation results show that the extension controller designed has faster response speed and stronger robustness, which can well improve the dynamic performance of the wind turbine variable rotor system.

articleTitle: A Security Protocol for Smart Meters
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Data collection of electric power consumption is directly related to the interests of power companies and electricity users, so the collection of telegraph data is constantly updated. To effectively monitor and predict the grid status in real time, smart meters need to verify access to the grid and often send the user's electricity consumption information to the control center. However, the existing key exchange protocols, such as IEEE802.15.6 still has loopholes, which threaten the reliability of smart meters. Moreover, the server side of the power grid has a lot of delay costs because of the excessive workload, which reduces the query efficiency of users. To solve the above problems, we put forward a scheme for uploading electricity information of smart meters based on the authentication protocol key proposed by Zhang, which ensures integrity, confidentiality, and authentication while uploading the electricity information of smart meters. The protocol designed of this scheme is unbalanced and can effectively reduce the burden of the server.

articleTitle: Frequency Emergency Control for Large-scale Disconnection of Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of ultra high voltage direct current (UHVDC) and the continuous increase proportion of renewable energy (RE), it has strongly supported Chinese energy transformation strategy. However, due to the poor dynamic performance of RE generation under grid fault, in the DC sending power grid where RE is centrally connected, AC and DC faults can easily cause large-scale disconnection of RE, which brings to a great challenge to the power system transient frequency security. In this paper the process of large-scale disconnection of RE in the UHVDC sending grid is first analyzed. Then the frequency emergency control scheme triggered by the event information such as DC commutation failure is designed according to fault process analysis. Finally, a simulation example of the Northwest China Power Grid is built to verify that the proposed frequency emergency control strategy can effectively deal with the problem of large-scale disconnection of RE caused by AC and DC faults, and can greatly improve the UHVDC transmission capacity and RE generation of the power grid.

articleTitle: Discussion on Optimization Method of New Power System Planning Considering Short Circuit Ratio
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, countries all over the world pay special attention to the issue of climate change, “carbon peak, carbon neutral” has become an important goal of energy development, and the traditional power grid is gradually transformed into a new power system. DC short-circuit ratio(SCR) can represent the strength of DC connected to AC system. Based on SCR calculation and comprehensive evaluation of power grid planning scheme, a new optimization method of power system planning scheme considering SCR is proposed. The adaptability of the method is verified by an example, which provides a reference for the planning and optimization of power grid with DC.

articleTitle: An Efficient Security Scheme For Charging Piles
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Electric bicycles are popular among citizens because of their green, environmentally friendly and convenient features. However, due to the limited battery capacity of electric bicycles, charging problems have become the main factor limiting its further development. This paper proposes a secure payment scheme for charging piles based on unbalanced asymmetric authenticated key exchange (AKE). To ensure the security of the charging and billing process, the user needs to authenticate to the charging pile for subsequent communication. The scheme can allow users to effectively charge while ensuring their payment security.

articleTitle: A New Power Electronic Transformer for 10kV Distribution Grid Based on Three-phase Four Arms H-bridge Modular Multilevel Converte
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents a topology of power electronic transformer (PET) for 10kV distribution grid based on three phase four arms modular multilevel converter (TPFA-MMC). The proposed PET is a three-stage transformer. Compared with conventional three-stage PET, the proposed topology uses TPFA-MMC with H-bridge submodules, which can reduce the number of SMs. For the isolation stage, it adopts a kind of isolation SM based on phase-shifted full bridge (PSFB) topology to avoid use of input capacitors and the third phase of high voltage AC (HVAC)side is led out at midpoint of the isolation stage. This new PET topology can realize de short circuit fault protection because of no input capacitor at the isolation stage. The proposed PET structure is simulated under the condition that DC bus voltage is ±10kV and HVAC side is connected to 10kV AC grid. The simulation waveforms prove the effectiveness of the proposed topology.

articleTitle: Analysis on Fault Current Evolution for MMC-HVDC Grid Considering Fault Current Limiter and Grounding Mode
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The rapid rise of DC side short-circuit fault current brings about great challenges on the development of modular multi-level converter based high voltage direct current (MMC-HVDC) grid. Starting from the nature that both fault current limiter and grounding mode limit current by increasing fault circuit resistance or inductance, this paper focuses on the analysis on influence of parameters in both fault current limiter and grounding mode on the evolution of DC short-circuit fault current of MMC-HVDC grid. A comprehensive current limiting effect analysis method based on transient energy flow (TEF) analysis is proposed from the perspective of macroscopic energy transfer and dissipation. In this method, two evaluation indexes of TEF suppression rate and suppression efficiency are proposed. Taking four-terminal bipolar MMC-HVDC grid as an example, the comprehensive limiting effect of TEF in each region with the change of parameters in both fault current limiter and grounding mode under the condition of DC side pole to ground fault is analyzed by PSCAD/EMTDC simulation system. The proposed method can provide a theoretical basis for the comprehensive optimization of fault current limiter and grounding mode for MMC-HVDC grid.

articleTitle: Energy Internet: A Novel Green Roadmap for Meeting the Global Energy Demand
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy Internet has caught an attention of the global academic community, and it is being implemented actively. This paper describes the basic features and the key structure of Energy Internet, proposes a hierarchical model, and presents key technologies, such as distributed energy storage technology, energy router technology, big data technology and blockchain, etc. It also summarizes the evolving status of Energy Internet in the US, Germany, Japan, and China. Based on the analysis, the viable implementing measurements are suggested for accelerating the realization of Energy Internet, i.e. designing a comprehensive plan for the Energy Internet based on the prevailing conditions and facts of each country, formulating related standards and policies for Energy Internet, encouraging the development of related enterprises and demonstration projects, and promoting new technologies for Energy Internet.

articleTitle: Load Forecasting of 5G Base Station in Urban Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: 5G is the abbreviation of the 5th generation mobile communication technology. China is one of the earliest countries in the world to implement 5G commercially. The application of 5G network needs to build a large number of 5G base stations. However, there is no research on 5G base station load model connected to distribution network. In order to study the load forecasting of 5G base stations connected to the distribution network in the planning area, this paper summarized and proposed a deployment method of 5G base stations in the planning area based on a wireless signal transmission model, analyzed and modeled the basic components and electrical characteristics of 5G base station, established a single 5G base station load model, and finally took the power supply area of Feicuihu substation in a city of Anhui province as the area to be planned. According to the 5G base station load model and the 5G base station distribution model in different areas, the spatial load of 5G base stations in the planning area is predicted, which provides a reference for distribution network operation and planning.

articleTitle: Long-term Energy Consumption Forecasting for Data Center Industry in China
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The number of internet data centers increases rapidly over the past years, which results in a significant incensement on energy demand. In order to achieve a precise forecast of the data center electricity consumption in the next few years, a scale prediction model for data centers based on Bass model is proposed in this paper. We provide a forecast for the long-term energy consumption in the data centers based on the proposed model while accounting the difference between the existing and planning data centers. The simulation results show that data centers in China will consume more than 400 billion kWh of electricity in 2030, accounting for 4% of the national electricity consumption, and the growth rate will slow down at the same time. We further investigate the impact of implementing advanced technologies on cooling systems and servers. The results show that the decrease of PUE values will effectively reduce electricity consumption, and the increase of server utilization ratios will improve energy efficiency for data centers.

articleTitle: Reliability Classification Standard and Evaluation Method of Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As an important part of the entire power grid, the operational reliability of the distribution network is particularly important. However, none of the existing reliability assessment methods of distribution network involves the classification standard of distribution network reliability. Therefore, in this paper, the reliability classification standard and evaluation method of distribution network are proposed. First, considering the impact of reliability electricity prices, a new type of distribution system reliability evaluation index system is established, and then the comprehensive weights of each index based on the EW-AHP are solved. The single-index grading standard and the multi-index comprehensive grading standard were established combining the scoring function. At the same time, the power consumption information of the end users is collected, and the comprehensive scores of the operation reliability evaluation of different distribution networks are obtained. According to the classification standard, the operation reliability of the distribution network can be evaluated intuitively and accurately. The analysis of the calculation example shows that the proposed classification standard and evaluation method can reasonably consider the influence of reference indicators such as reliability electricity price on the reliability evaluation of the distribution network. Further, the accuracy of the reliability assessment of the distribution network is improved.

articleTitle: A Stochastic Hydrothermal Dispatching Model of Cascaded Hydropower Systems Considering Renewable Energy Uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To cope with the energy crisis, environmental pollution, and global warming problem, the installed capacities of renewable energy are increasing rapidly. However, this trend has brought serious stability problems to the operation of the power systems, and huge flexible resources are needed to regulate the drastic fluctuations of wind and photovoilaic power generation. Cascaded hydropower system (CHS) is an excellent regulatory power source with great flexibility, thus this paper establishes a stochastic hydrothermal dispatching model considering CHS and renewable energy uncertainties. In addition, the deep peak shaving of thermal units is also considered. The effectiveness and the validity of the proposed model are verified using numerical examples based on the Wujiang River CHS in China.

articleTitle: A V2G Scheduling Strategy Based on Electric Vehicle Users' Willingness Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing popularity of electric vehicles (EVs), the balancing on the electric vehicle (EV) users' benefits and grid optimal operation becomes to be an urgent issue during the past decade. This paper proposes a new Vehicle to Grid (V2G) scheduling strategy based on the EV user willingness model. First, we determine the user's willingness model based on the unit power wear cost of the EV battery. On this basis, considering dynamic discharging electricity price (DEP), the daily grid net income increment (GNII) is used as the optimization goal, and the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is used to obtain the daily dispatch strategy of grid. Taking the daily base load and the forecast of the wind turbine (WT)'s day-ahead power in a certain area as the simulation basic data, the results show that EVs can play the role of “peak shaving and valley filling” after participating in V2G scheduling. Through the sensitivity analysis of important model parameters, we can understand that the development of technical level in various aspects is conducive to increasing the willingness of EV group to participate in V2G, and increasing the benefits of grid and EV users. The strategy can reduce the peak-to-valley difference and enhance positive interactions between both parties.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimized Charging Strategy for Electric Vehicles Based on Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a two-stage electric vehicle charging optimization scheduling model based on the spotted hyena algorithm. Compared with random charging, this strategy reduces the user's charging fee and smoothes the grid load curve without affecting the user's charging demand. This strategy can effectively alleviate the negative consequences of increased load peak-valley difference and reduced power quality. Through the comparison of simulation results, the load peak-to-valley difference of 300 electric vehicles at 20% penetration rate is reduced by 622.7kW, a drop of 23.47%, which greatly improves the safety and economy of grid operation. The user's total charging cost has also dropped by 116.28 yuan compared with the disorderly charging, a drop of 11.26%, which provides users with a reasonable charging schedule.

articleTitle: Game Theoretical Dynamic Cybersecurity Defense Strategy for Electrical Cyber Physical Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The critical industrial infrastructures are facing increasing cyberspace threats and attacks in most recent years, the cyberspace security of different forms of Cyber Physical Systems (CPSs) has received much attention. The game theory is considered as an appropriate paradigm for formulating the behaviors of cyberspace attack and defense. This paper proposes a game theory based dynamic cybersecurity defense strategy in the context of electrical CPSs that relies on zero-sum game of incomplete information to identify the expected utility of attacker and defender under Nash equilibrium. The key idea of the proposed solution is to import physical security target and cyber safety index, analyze the asset value of different nodes in a multi-dimensional manner, and update Markov belief dynamically at each stage to reflect the understanding degree of both sides. The proposed solution is assessed through simulation experiments and the CPS testbed at Zhejiang University. The numerical results confirmed that the proposed method can carry out appropriate strategy for defense resources allocation in electrical CPS with the limited availability of defense resources.

articleTitle: Reliability Assessment of Wind Farm with Wind Turbine Gearbox Fatigue
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The gearbox of wind turbine has the longest downtime due to mechanical failure, and fatigue is the most important failure form of gearbox. Traditional wind reliability model not considering the influence of gear box of immobilized fatigue, this paper proposes a meter and gearbox fatigue reliability evaluation method of wind farms, this method is intuitive reflect the extent to which each gearbox fatigue damage caused by different failure rate difference, and applicable to other fatigue as the main failure forms of component reliability modeling. The fatigue failure rate model of wind turbine gearbox was established based on the fatigue analysis of wind turbine gearbox, and the fatigue failure state was embedded into the conventional wind turbine Markov model through the failure rate, which was applied to the reliability evaluation of containing wind farm to improve the evaluation accuracy. The results show that ignoring the gearbox fatigue failure will lead to the wind turbine outage risk assessment results are relatively conservative, overestimate the reliability level of wind farm, and the more serious the accumulation of gearbox fatigue damage, the more significant the impact on the system reliability.

articleTitle: A Data Augmentation Method for Distributed Photovoltaic Electricity Theft Using Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Because of the concealment of distributed photovoltaic (PV) electricity theft, the number of electricity theft samples held by the power sector is insufficient, which results in low accuracy of electricity theft detection. Therefore, this paper proposes a data augmentation method about electricity theft samples of distributed PV using Wasserstein generative adversarial network (WGAN). First, through the confrontation training of WGAN's generator network and discriminator network, the neural network can learn the time correlation of PV electricity theft data sequence that is difficult to explicitly model, and generate new electricity theft samples with similar distributions to the real electricity theft samples. Then, three typical photovoltaic power stealing models are proposed, and a convolutional neural network (CNN) is constructed based on the data features of the electricity theft samples. Finally, a practical example verifies the effectiveness and adaptability of the method. The experimental results show that WGAN can consider the shape and distribution of the samples, and the generated electricity theft samples can significantly improve the performance of different classifiers.

articleTitle: A Nonlinear White-Box SM4 Implementation Applied to Edge IoT Agents
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of power Internet of Things (IoT), the ubiquitous edge agents are frequently exposed in a risky environment, where the white-box attacker could steal all the internal information by full observation of dynamic execution of the cryptographic software. In this situation, a new table-based white-box cryptography implementation of SM4 algorithm is proposed to prevent the attacker from extracting the secret key, which hides the encryption and decryption process in obfuscated lookup tables. Aiming to improve the diversity and ambiguity of the lookup tables as well as resist different types of white-box attacks, the random bijective nonlinear mappings are applied as scrambling encodings of the lookup tables. Moreover, in order to make our implementation more practical in the resource-constrained edge IoT agent, elaborate design is proposed to make some tables reusability, leading to less memory occupation while guaranteeing the security.
