The validity and security of the proposed implementation will be illustrated through several evaluation indicators.

articleTitle: Study on the Prediction of Consumer Electricity Consumption Based on Hybrid Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the characteristic that energy consumption data is a complex nonlinear time series, a hybrid energy consumption prediction model based on Prophet-LSTM is proposed. Firstly, the Prophet model incorporates holiday factors, power cycle models, and trend change functions into the modeling process to improve the robustness of the model and obtain better prediction results. Secondly, a convolutional neural network (CNN) is introduced to extract features of the data to improve the predictive ability of the model on the basis of the long and short-term memory neural network (LSTM). Finally, the initial weights are respectively assigned to the predicted values of the Prophet and LSTM models, and the optimal weight distribution is obtained through grid optimization. Finally, the two models' predicted values are added to get the final predicted value. The simulation results show that the hybrid model based on Prophet-LSTM proposed in this paper can achieve ideal prediction results, and the prediction accuracy of a single model is significantly improved.

Author Keywords: Long and Short Memory Neural Network

articleTitle: A Co-optimization Mechanism of Energy and Multiple Ancillary Services with High-Penetration Renewables
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The increasing renewable generations in the power system have contributed to the reduction of carbon emission. However, their uncertainty and volatility have also challenged the system operation. To handle this, we propose a joint clearing model of energy, regulation, reserve and ramping product from both thermal generators and energy storage stations. In the proposed model, the couplings of energy and these ancillary services are studied, and the deliverability of reserve in contingency scenarios is ensured by including the post-contingency network constraints into the model. In addition, the associated marginal pricing approaches of energy, regulation, reserve and ramping are also established. The proposed co-optimization mechanism can efficiently enhance the elasticity of the power system and help the accommodation of renewable generations.

articleTitle: Research on Online Status Evaluation Technology for Main Equipment of Power Transmission and Transformation Based on Digital Twin
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Traditional status evaluation for main equipment of power transmission and transformation has some shortages, such as low timeliness, low data quality and difficulty for evaluation model construction. Based on digital twin technology system, this paper presents technology of equipment status, and constructs digital twin for power transmission and transformation equipment. According to operation characteristics of power transmission and transformation equipment, fusion and cleansing of perception data is realized. Relying on big data analysis and data mining, status evaluation differentiation, accurate fault diagnosis and status prediction for power transmission and transformation equipment is realized. Further more, this paper analyzes the application of digital twin technology in on-line status evaluation for transformer equipment, expounds specific application of digital twin technology including data governance and model building, and summarizes application prospect of digital twin technology in on-line status evaluation for main equipment of power transmission and transformation.

articleTitle: Day-Ahead Two-Stage Stochastic Scheduling of Integrated Energy System Considering Spatial-Temporal Correlated Scenarios of Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a day-ahead two-stage stochastic scheduling method of integrated energy system considering the uncertainty and spatial-temporal correlation of wind power. An improved scenario generation and reduction method is proposed for the wind power of multiple wind farms. Aiming at wind power uncertainty, a two-stage coordination scheduling method is adopted. The first stage is to formulate output of units, while the second stage is to deal with different scenarios through reserves and adjustments of units. The coupling of different energy sources brought by flexible components and the cooperation between two stages are studied in detail. The simulation results show that the application of more reliable scenarios and two-stage scheduling can improve the economic benefits and wind power utilization, which verifies the effectiveness of this proposed method.

articleTitle: Optimal Configuration of Grid-connected Microgrid Considering Real-time Electricity Price
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the upgrading of the “carbon peak and neutrality” policy to a national strategy, high penetration renewable energy grid connection becomes a necessary path for power development. In order to improve the safety, stability and economy of distribution network operation, this paper introduces a price-based demand response model and proposes an optimal configuration method for wind power, photovoltaic system, diesel generator, and battery storage grid-connected microgrid based on real-time electricity price. At the source side, the number of diesel units and energy storage units is calculated with the lowest comprehensive cost of distributed power planning as the objective function under the premise that wind turbines and photovoltaic units are determined. At the load side, according to the demand-price elasticity matrix model, the minimum absolute value of the difference between the power of the electric load and the power generated by renewable energy at 24 moments a day is used as the objective function to calculate the real-time electricity price and derive the electric load after demand response. After alternate iterations of both source and load, the optimal configuration of the microgrid is obtained. The results of the simulation study on a regional microgrid show that the optimization model can effectively reduce the configuration capacity of diesel engines and storage batteries, increase the penetration rate of renewable energy, and increase the economic and environmental benefits of the microgrid while ensuring the reliability of power supply and enhancing the interests of users.

articleTitle: Real-Time Control Strategy of Hybrid Energy Storage to Smooth Out Fluctuations in PV Industrial Parks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Combining PV power generation and industrial parks and using hybrid energy storage to smooth out fluctuations in PV industrial parks is an effective way to improve the level of PV power consumption, reduce energy consumption and pollution in industrial parks, and lower the cost of power purchase before industrial parks. In this paper, we propose a real-time control strategy to smooth out the fluctuation of PV industrial park by using hybrid energy storage system, which optimally allocates the load fluctuation to energy-based energy storage and power-based energy storage based on variational modal decomposition (VMD), and considers the charging and discharging efficiency and state of charge (SOC) of energy storage to smooth out the fluctuation of PV industrial park. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed real-time control strategy of hybrid energy storage for PV industrial park fluctuation smoothing is verified by simulation, and the strategy is evaluated economically based on the current spot market in Guangdong.

articleTitle: Integrated Energy System Station-Network Coordinated Optimal Method for Facility Agricultural Park
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper takes an facility agriculture park as the research object. Considering the characteristics of agricultural energy use, a two-tier optimisation model of energy station location planning and equipment capacity configuration is established, and a new comprehensive energy system station–network collaborative optimisation scheduling method for a facility agricultural park is proposed. Broaden the use scenarios of the integrated energy system to the field of facility agriculture. First, we analysed the load characteristics of different energy-using areas in the facility agricultural park, then, with the goal of minimizing annual operating costs, a two-tier model was established. The upper model uses an improved harmony search algorithm to establish an energy station location model under the premise of considering demand response, and the lower model considers economic, environmental, and other factors to establish a mixed integer linear programming model. The integrated energy system of the facility agricultural park is optimised under the upper-tier optimisation results and constraints. Finally, a simulation analysis of the facility agricultural park as the object, verifies the effectiveness and practicability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Coordinated Operation of Electricity and Natural Gas Integrated Energy Distribution Systems Considering Combined Electricity-gas Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the background of energy internet and the targets of carbon peak and carbon neutrality, new energy development paths need to be explored. A coordinated optimal operation method of electricity and gas integrated distribution system (EGIDS) considering electricity-gas demand response is proposed. A gradually linearized method is used to deal with the power flow equation constraints of the distribution system, and the second-order cone relaxation method and piecewise linearization method are used to constrain the natural gas power flow equation. So that the nonlinear optimal problem of the EGIDS is transformed into a mixed integer linear programming model. Then the combined electricity-gas demand response model was established and introduced into the EGIDS. A case study is implemented on a modified 51-bus distribution network with a 20-node natural gas network to demonstrate the superiority of the proposed EGIDS model. The case study shows that the method of EGIDS considering combined electricity-gas demand response (CDR) can better improve the economics of the distribution system operation and the accommodation of renewable energy.

articleTitle: Low-Carbon Economic Dispatching of Combined Heat and Power System Considering Electric-thermal Integrated Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of energy interconnection systems, integrated demand response offers new solutions for the optimal operation of energy interconnection systems and the efficient use of energy. This paper sets up price-based demand response and incentive-based demand response models on the power side. On the thermal side, the perceived inertia of customers in terms of heating comfort and the delayed transmission of thermal network are considered and a thermal load demand response model is developed. Furthermore, a carbon trading cost model is established by introducing the carbon trading mechanism. In order to fully exploit the response potential of load-side resources, a low-carbon economic dispatch model for combined heat and power systems that takes into account the electric-thermal integrated demand response is constructed, with the total operation cost of the system minimized as the objective function. Finally, the simulation results show that considering the electric-thermal integrated demand response can further decouple the combined heat and power units, promote the consumption of renewable energy, and realize the low-carbon economic operation of the system.

articleTitle: Online Load Data Compression and Reconstruction Based on Segmental Symbolic Aggregate Approximation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To ensure the performance of load identification, existing non-intrusive load monitoring (NILM) solutions usually need to transmit large amount of continuous power consumption data for cloud analysis, which brings challenges to the communication, storage and computing of NILM systems. In this paper, we propose a segmental online compression and reconstruction method of load data to reduce the data volume for transmission while ensuring the application value of the data. Due to the fact that different segmentations of the load data contain different amounts of information, the time series load data is firstly divided into event segments and non-event segments (also called steady-state segments) by event detection. While the data is retained as it is for the event segment, the symbolic aggregate approximation (SAX) method with non-uniform partition of the time axis is adopted for data compression for the steady-state segment, so as to reduce data size for transmission as much as possible without losing important information. In the master station, the load data including the event and steady-state segments received are respectively reconstructed into original time series with fine resolution in different ways. Comparative experiment results on the private and public datasets show that compared with the existing methods, the proposed method has higher reconstruction accuracy and compression efficiency, which can provide support for the data analysis applications based on high resolution data.

articleTitle: Coordinated Optimization Model of the Wind Power Plant with Hydrogen Storage System and Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The deployment of the hydrogen storage system(HSS) that smooths the wind power output and reduces wind curtailment is usually constrained by its high cost. Considering the widely dispersed demand response(DR) resources can conveniently shift load to match the wind power output and enhance the wind power integration by means of electricity price signals at a competitive cost, a coordinated model of the wind power plant with HSS(WPP-HSS) and a real-time pricing(RTP) based DR strategy is proposed. In the proposed DR strategy, a cost adjustment coefficient of consumers and the equivalent net load(ENL) ramping constraint are incorporated for adjusting consumers' electricity cost and improving the economic operation of power systems. This optimization model is transformed into a mixed-integer linear programming(MILP) problem by using the McCormick relaxation method and other linearization techniques. Finally, a test system is adopted to validate the effectiveness of the proposed model and sensitivity analysis on the cost adjustment coefficient is conducted.

articleTitle: A Short-term Load Forecasting Method of Distribution Network Based on Improved AlexNet-GRU Deep Learning Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As an important part of power system planning, load forecasting plays a very important role in ensuring the stable operation of the power grid and realizing the balance of power supply and demand. This paper proposes a short-term load forecasting method for distribution network based on improved AlexNet-GRU deep learning network. First, the Pearson correlation analysis is used to calculate the correlation coefficients between the load and the weather influencing factors of temperature, humidity, rainfall, wind speed, and wind direction, and select the main influencing factors. Then the daily load curve is divided into different date types by clustering. Finally, according to the clustering results, a distribution network short-term load forecasting model based on the improved AlexNet-GRU deep learning network is established, and compared with the traditional load forecasting method. The load forecasting results of a certain area in 2013 show that the proposed method has significant advantages in forecasting accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Perception Layer Architecture In Differentiated Application Scenarios for Power IoT:Evidence from Hunan Province
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Currently, State Grid Hunan Electric Power Company has basically realized the comprehensive information collection of power grid operation control and user electricity metering, and continuously promoted the construction of information perception of distribution network operation control, major power grid equipment status, power grid physical asset and user service. With the widespread deployment of ubiquitous power IoT, the problems in the construction, application, operation, and maintenance of the perception layer are increasingly prominent. This paper provides a comprehensive summary of currently available perception devices, as well as a comprehensive overview of the perception layer for typical scenarios in power supply, transmission, substation, and distribution, and proposes a perception layer architecture for differentiated application scenarios.

articleTitle: Short Circuit Calculation Method of Power System with Renewable Energy Sources and Experimental Verification
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the short-circuit current calculation of power grid, the renewable energy sources (RES) cannot use the equivalent method similar to the traditional synchronous generator because of the access mode and low voltage ride through control strategy. Therefore, it is difficult to solve the short circuit current directly by the traditional fault analysis method. According to the control strategy and fault characteristics of different types of RES, the equivalent calculation model of RES is obtained, especially the equivalent calculation model of doubly fed power sources when the negative sequence short-circuit current is not zero. On this basis, the node voltages equation and the iterative calculation method of the short-circuit current for the power grid with different types of RES are given. Then, an experimental platform with RES is established. The correctness of the equivalent calculation model and the iterative calculation method of short-circuit current are verified by short-circuit experiment.

articleTitle: A Temporal Convolutional Neural Network with Attention Mechanism for Industrial Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Identifying industrial appliances can assist in demand-side management in smart grids. In this paper, a temporal convolutional neural network with attention mechanism based method is proposed for industrial non-intrusive load monitoring (NILM). First, the industrial load sequence is segmented into fixed length subsequences, and the ON-OFF states of appliances are also recorded simultaneously. Then, some segmented load subsequences are used as the input of the proposed method, and the corresponding classifiers of different appliances are trained by using the input together with the corresponding appliance states. Finally, the trained classifiers are used to classify the subsequences to be identified. This paper releases a dataset named Textile Mill Load Dataset (TMLD) that contains 30 days of load data from a textile mill. Experiments on this dataset show that the overall accuracy of the proposed method is over 88% when the load data is sampled once every one second and longer.

articleTitle: Optimal Planning of Park Integrated Energy System Considering the Resilience of Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Resilience reflects the ability of power grid to resist extreme disasters, reduce fault losses and restore power supply as soon as possible. Improving grid resilience is one of the core requirements of smart grid. The PIES (park integrated energy system) can support partial electric power to the distribution network when the distribution network suffers from extreme faults. In this paper, the optimal planning of park integrated energy system considers the resilience of distribution network. Resilience income of PIES in the resilience scenes is proposed based on the resilience assessment of distribution network. Then the mathematical model of optimal planning of PIES considering the resilience income of PIES is proposed to improve the distribution network's resilience. The example analysis shows that the established optimal planning scheme of PIES considering the resilience scenes can make the PIES obtain benefits by supporting the power grid when extreme accidents occur, and improve the resilience index of the distribution network at the same time.

articleTitle: A Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning Based Multi-Timescale Voltage Control For Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As low-carbon and clean energy become an inevitable requirement for sustainable development of energy, modern distribution networks are integrating more and more renewable energy resources, mainly in the form of rooftop solar photovoltaics (PV) panels. As a DC generation source, the solar PV is interfaced with the grid through power electronics inverters. Apart from converting DC power to AC power, the PV inverters can also generate and absorb reactive power for voltage/var control (VVC) purpose. In this work, a data-driven multi-timescale volt-var control (VVC) framework has been proposed to counteract uncertain voltage fluctuation and deviation caused by PV energy integration. An MDP model has been built to describe the multi-timescale voltage control problem. A multi-agent deep deterministic policy gradient (MADDPG) method has been used to solve the model. Compared with the conventional VVC method, the proposed method has a faster response speed and a better result. The proposed method is verified on the IEEE 33-bus distribution network and compared with existing practices.

Author Keywords: Multi Agent Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (MADDPG)

articleTitle: Planning of Virtual Microgrids by Integrated Partition and DER Allocation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing Renewable Energy Source penetration, more challenges, including load mismatches and voltage fluctuations, will occur inside Conventional Distribution Networks (CDN). Virtual Microgrid(VM) is a potential solution for addressing these drawbacks by partitioning a CDN into several interconnected microgrid-style VMs. This paper proposed multi-objective planning by concurrently evaluating the economic aspect of power grid operations and functional & structural quality of grid partitions in heuristic optimization. We develop the conventional community detecting algorithm from the Complex Network Theory with the considerations of the power grid's supply-demand relations and electrical characteristics. The result shows that with the comprehensive assessments between cost and structural aspect, the allocations of Distributed Generators receive a trade-off between cost and rate of self-ad-equacy.

articleTitle: Investigate the Use of Electric Vehicles to Improve Resilience for Active Distribution Network System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The dependency upon stable electrical sources is increasing day by day because most of the industries, businesses, and small-scale factories rely on it. Almost all sectors use a power source to perform daily tasks. Due to the increase in the consumption of electric power, its stability and resilience are important. Due to various natural disasters like thunderstorms, hurricanes, earthquakes, etc., the distribution network for electric power may got damaged. Due to this power outage, there might be the unavailability of power. As most of the system depends upon an uninterrupted power supply so there must be an alternative to prevent this power outage. In this paper, the use of electric vehicles, is investigated to prevent this power outage by actively taking part in the distribution network system. Due to full or partial damage of distribution network, the energy from electrical vehicles can be used to contribute to the distribution network to enhance the resilience of the system. Vehicle to grid (V2G) and grid to vehicle (G2V) schemes are used in this paper to improve the resilience of the system.

articleTitle: Non-intrusive Electric Vehicle Charging Load Disaggregation based on Independent Component Analysis with Reference
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: While the development of electric vehicles brings positive effects to the environment, it also brings fire hazards to the community with repeated fatal fire accidents reported every year. Since the battery charging can be anywhere with the customers, it is of significance to have a technical means to detect and alert the customers. In this paper, we propose an electric vehicle charging load (EVCL) disaggregation method based on non-intrusive load monitoring technology. First, a non-intrusive EVCL disaggregation method based on independent component analysis with reference method to extract the charging periods is proposed. Then, algorithms for estimating both amplitude and time of EVCL based on signal reconstruction are applied. Finally, a validation on a publicly available real-world dataset published by Pecan Street is carried out and evaluated with two performance metrics of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$F1_{score}$</tex> and RMSE. The results show that the proposed method succeeds in EVCL extraction.

articleTitle: Transient Stability Analysis for Grid-tied Virtual Synchronous Generator Based on T-S Fuzzy Modeling and LMI Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Stability issue of grid-tied power converters has become a tough obstacle for the integration of large-scale renewable energy. In recent years, a novel power control approach called virtual synchronous generator (VSG) has been widely investigated to improve the dynamic response and inertia support. However, how to guarantee the transient stability of a grid-tied VSG under large-signal perturbations has not been fully considered, which results in difficulties for the parameters selection of VSG. In this paper, an analytical transient stability criterion is proposed for the grid-tied VSG, which provides useful guidelines for the system parameters design. Firstly, the complete nonlinear models is established for a single VSG connected with the weak grid. To deal with the complex nonlinearity, the T-S fuzzy modeling method is applied to acquire a series of linear models around different operating points. The linear matrix inequation (LMI) tool is adopted to construct Lyapunov function, which achieves the estimation of attraction region. Simulation and hardware-in-the-loop experiment results are presented to validate the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed stability criterion, which reveals the effects of different parameters on the transient stability of VSG.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of AC-DC Distribution Network in Photovoltaic-Energy Storage Charging Station Based on AHP-TOPSIS Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Increasing studies have shown that DC distributi on will contribute substantially to future photovoltaic-energy st orage charging station (PV-ES CS) owing to the high efficiency and play an important role in distribution networks. It is neces sary to comprehensively compare low voltage DC (LVDC) with AC (LVAC) distribution networks for planning and design of PV-ES CS. This paper presents a comprehensive evaluation mo del of the distribution system based on AHP-TOPSIS theory. The evaluation index system, including reliability, economy and adaptability, is proposed based on the difference of AC and DC distribution network structure and performance. The propose d approach integrates ideal solution (TOPSIS) and Analytic hie rarchy process (AHP) to determine the weights. Finally, the re sults obtained from the case studies have demonstrated the rati onality and feasibility of proposed evaluation model. It is instru ctive to the application and popularization of DC PV-ES CS.

articleTitle: Review on Modeling and Optimal Scheduling in Integrated Energy Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Building a low-carbon, clean, safe and efficient modern energy system can help implement the energy development strategy in the 14th Five-Year Plan. The integrated energy system includes the production, transmission, storage and distribution of multiple types of energy, which can effectively make up for the lack of independent planning of various energy systems such as electricity, gas, cooling, and heating, and also effectively optimize and coordinate the use of multiple energy sources to improve energy efficiency. However, because the district energy system has the characteristics of multivariable, non-linear and time-delay, and the district heating or cooling system is independent of the power system, the dynamic modeling of the system is difficult to be compatible and the operation of heterogeneous energy systems is difficult to coordinate. This study focuses on comprehensive energy system modeling and optimal dispatch. First, the advantages and disadvantages of various modeling methods are compared. Second, the current research status of integrated energy system optimal dispatch is summarized. Finally, several suggestions are given for further research.

articleTitle: TransOS-ELM: A Short-term Photovoltaic Power Forecasting Method based on Transferred Knowledge from Similar Days
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Photovoltaic (PV) power is an important part of renewable energy and has been distributed more and more widely. Due to the characteristics of intermittency and randomness, the accurate forecasting of short-term PV output will ensure secure operation and economic integration of PV power in smart grids. However, previous works on PV power forecasting show a strong dependency on weather conditions in common, that means there exists a sophisticated relationship which is hard to be described quantitatively between various influencing factors and PV power. What we have focused on is to leverage all kinds of dependencies to make up for the deficiency of traditional data-driven methods. In this paper, a hybrid learning model based on Online Sequential Extreme Learning Machine (OS-ELM) associated with transferred knowledge learned from similar days which share similar weather conditions with the target day, abbreviated as TransOS-ELM, is proposed and applied to short-term PV power forecasting problem. This model is able to optimize the prediction results according to the weather condition of the target day with the knowledge learned from samples of similar days and monitored in real time. This framework is made up of two stages. Firstly, the transfer learning part is designed to extract transferred knowledge from similar days' records, and this part of knowledge along with historical data will be put together to generate an output matrix. Secondly, the new generated data will be absorbed by the online learning model and used to modify the parameters of the first-step output. The most competitive characteristic of this model is that it can get transferred knowledge from the same PV station as well as the different ones, to tackle the problem of insufficient historical records. Both types show extraordinary performance across an open-source dataset and a real-world dataset monitored by ourselves.

articleTitle: Intelligent Fault Diagnosis Approach for PV Arrays Based on Sparrow Search Algorithm Optimized Kernel Extreme Learning Machine
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to accurately identify the fault types of photovoltaic arrays, a fault diagnosis method for PV arrays based on the kernel extreme learning machine optimized by sparrow search algorithm is proposed. Firstly, the output characteristics of photovoltaic arrays in typical fault types are analyzed. Then, the parameters containing the information of the photovoltaic array are used as input variables, and the normal operation, open-circuit, short-circuit, abnormal aging and partial shadow are used as output vectors. The penalty factor and kernel parameter of the kernel extreme learning machine are optimized by the sparrow search algorithm to improve the fault diagnosis accuracy. The example simulation results show that the approach proposed improve the generalization ability and stability of extreme learning machine, and has higher recognition accuracy of photovoltaic array faults than other methods.

articleTitle: Optimal Multi-period Pricing and Operating of Hydrogen Refueling Stations Considering the Coupling of Transportation and Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a multi-period bi-level optimization method to find t he equilibrium s tate a mong distribution power systems, transportation systems, and hydrogen refueling stations (HRSs). At the distribution power system side, a convexified a lternating current o ptimal power fl ow (ACOPF) is solved to get distribution locational marginal prices (DLMP) for each HRS. At the transportation system side, a mixed user equilibrium (UE) model is conducted to obtain fuel cell electric vehicles (FCEVs) hydrogen demands for each HRS. At the HRS side, water electrolysis hydrogen production can be decoupled with hydrogen consumption with the hydrogen storage tank. Thereby, an optimal multi-period pricing and operation optimization model of HRSs is proposed. We integrate the above three models into a bi-level optimization problem and propose an iterative algorithm to solve it. A 22-bus distribution system and a 24-node SiouxFalls traffic network a re adopted for the case studies. Numerical results validate the effectiveness of proposed models and solution methods.

articleTitle: Theoretical Study on Group Pile of Anti-liquefaction Micro-steel Pipe
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of power grid construction, the transmission line corridors are increasingly narrow, and it is inevitable that the lines will pass through saturated sand or saturated silt soil sections. The land segment is inevitable. At present, cast-in-place piles are currently mainly used to pass through the liquefaction layer to prevent soil liquefaction in China. By analyzing the mechanism of earthquake liquefaction and the stress mechanism of micro pile group, this paper concludes that anti-liquefaction micro -steel pipe group pile can strengthen soil and improve anti liquefaction shear stress. It is proposed that anti-liquefaction micro-steel pipe group pile foundation can be adopted in the earthquake liquefaction site where the transmission line passes through. Through the comparison and analysis of actual engineering data and ordinary cast-in-place pile, the anti-liquefaction micro-steel pipe group pile is obtained it has great economic benefits and great promotion value.

articleTitle: Study on Self-Monitoring Scheme of the Accuracy Deviation for the Merging Unit
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The analog-input merging unit is an essential measurement device in the digital substation, which is used to digitize the output of the electrical transformer. Its measurement accuracy is very important, which directly affects the fairness of electricity trade. Usually, the regular off-line checking is adopted to obtain the error of the merging unit and assess the accuracy deviation, but it will disturb the normal operation of power system. Therefore, an accuracy deviation self-monitoring scheme of merging unit based on the signal injection is proposed, and its signal separation and deviation evaluation methods based on digital filtering and Fast Fourier Transform respectively are specifically described. The test results show our methods can separate out the measured power-frequency signal without distortion and accurately analyze the injected signal features, and the scheme basically meets the requirements of accuracy deviation self-monitoring for the merging unit.

articleTitle: An Ensemble Method for Aggregated Baseline Load Estimation: From Probabilistic Perspective
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Demand response (DR) is regarded as an alternative for new infrastructure to meet the peak load, which curbs the greenhouse gas emission. As an intermediary agent, DR aggregator (DRA) needs to comprehend aggregated baseline load (ABL) in the DR event. However, there are a few studies estimating ABL from an aggregator's perspective. Therefore, this work proposes a new ensemble method for probabilistic ABL estimation, which utilizes multiple clustering algorithms with varying cluster numbers to produce multiple customer divisions. And the combing weights for the ABL results, produced by the multiple customer divisions, are determined by linear programming problems. We demonstrate the proposed method using real world dataset, Low Carbon London trail. For probabilistic estimation, it has good performance with high credit. We show that no single individual method can achieve good performance all the time. Ensemble method is a better choice to obtain relatively stable and good results.

articleTitle: Embedding Data Signals into Power Control Loop of Inverters for Power Line Communication in AC Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel power line communication method for single-phase inverters in alternating current (AC) microgrids. The communication function is integrated into converters by superimposing modulated signals into the power control loop. In this way, the AC bus voltage ripples carry data information of the transmitter, which can be sampled and decoded by the receiver. The proposed solution reduces system costs because no additional communication components are required. First, the fundamentals of power/signal dual modulation in the control loop approach are thoroughly explained. Then, the system applying the proposed method is modeled, and the design considerations are illustrated. Finally, a 1kW experimental platform of AC microgrids is built to realize data transmission between two single-phase parallel-operated inverters.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Load Flow Calculation for AC/DC Power Grid Based on Polynomial Chaos Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a new method based on polynomial chaos approach (PA) for probabilistic load flow of AC/DC power grid is presented. First, the steady-state model of the AC/DC power grid is constructed. Then, consider the uncertainty of the wind power, the probabilistic load flow equations are transformed into stochastic nonlinear equations by PA. Galerkin method is used to convert nonlinear stochastic equations into high-dimensional deterministic probabilistic load flow equations. The approximate coefficients of the state variables are obtained by the probabilistic load flow calculation by Newton's method. The example analysis of PS 4–4 system shows that the new method can solve the probabilistic load flow for AC/DC power grid.

articleTitle: Comparison of DC Fault Current Suppression by Current-limiting Control Algorithms for Double-Terminal Half-bridge MMC-HVDC System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the high voltage direct current system based on modular multilevel converter (MMC-HVDC), high-speed and large-capacity DC circuit breakers (DCCB) are generally needed in engineering to isolate short-circuit faults at direct current side. However, the manufacturing of DCCB is difficult and costly at present. Therefore, different current limiting control algorithms are incorporated into the MMC controller to limit the current peak, so as to reduce the cost of DC circuit breaker in current literature. In order to obtain the control algorithm with the best current limiting effect when a pole-to-pole short circuit occurs in the two-terminal MMC-HVDC system, five typical control algorithms with fault current limiting functions proposed in current literature are comprehensively compared through the index of DC current, maximum bridge arm current, DC voltage, and DC side active power within 10ms after a DC fault occurs. The analysis shows that among the five current limiting control algorithms, the emergency current limiting control algorithm can not only effectively limit the current, but also minimize the time of fault recovery. It provides an optimal choice for the selection of current-limiting control algorithms for two-terminal MMC-HVDC system.

articleTitle: Research on Control Strategy of SSSC to Suppress Wind Power Subsynchronous Oscillation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Large-scale development and utilization of wind energy is an inevitable way to achieve energy transformation. In recent years, the stability of large-scale wind farms connected to a power grid has become increasingly prominent. In order to solve the subsynchronous oscillation (SSO) problem when the doubly-fed wind farm passes through the series compensation system, this paper first analyzes the principle of SSSC to suppress the subsynchronous oscillation according to its working mechanism and mathematical model, and designs a supplementary subsynchronous damping controller (SSDC) for Static Synchronous Series Compensator(SSSC) to suppress the subsynchronous oscillation. The optimal solution of the controller parameters to be solved is obtained by using the particle swarm optimization algorithm. This paper establishes a wind power grid connection model with SSSC using Matlab/Simulink. The numerical simulation shows that the control strategy can suppress the sub-synchronous oscillation effectively.

articleTitle: A Mixed Model- and Data-Driven Approach for Subsynchronous Oscillation Analysis of VSC-HVDC Grid-Connected Offshore Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The previous research on the subsynchronous oscillation (SSO) caused by Voltage source converter-based high voltage direct current (VSC-HVDC) grid-connected offshore wind farm is based on model-driven method, but the model-driven research method has much inapplicability in multiple scenarios affected by external factors. The data-driven method has the merits of mining the characteristics from the external factors, so as to improve the applicability of the model-driven method in multiple scenarios. This paper proposes a mixed model- and data-driven approach for SSO analysis of VSC-HVDC grid-connected offshore wind farm. In model-driven stage, the small signal model of the system is established. SSO modes and the strongly correlated parameters are identified and their influence on the damping characteristics of the system is analyzed. In data-driven stage, data is processed based on the model-driven results. The Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) algorithm is applied to cluster Wind speed & current data, and the relationship between clusters and system stability is obtained.

Author Keywords: Voltage source converter-based high voltage direct current (VSC-HVDC)

articleTitle: A Multi-Layer Game Model for Commercial Air-conditioning Load Participating in Peak Shaving
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: It is difficult to meet the requirements of power balance only by the regulation of power generation side faced with the increasing peak load and the fluctuation of new energy power generation. Demand response management can effectively improve this situation. Therefore, this paper proposes a multi-layer game model for commercial air-conditioning load participating in peak shaving. It consists of three layers: the Stackelberg game between power generation enterprise and electricity retailers; the static Bayesian game between electricity retailers, and the Stackelberg game between electricity retailers and users. With this game theoretic model, the real-time pricing for power generation enterprise is optimally determined considering the profit maximization of the power generation enterprise, the electricity retailers, and the users. Simulation results show that the proposed game model is beneficial for all the participants.

articleTitle: Characteristics and High Frequency Equivalent Model of Low Voltage DC Fault Arc
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: DC arc fault occurs in the DC system due to the loose connection or contact, broken wire insulation, and other reasons. DC arc is difficuit to be extinguished and detected. The high temperature arc is easy to produce the fire, which may cause severe damage to the DC system. In this paper, an experimental platform for DC arc is established to investigate the effects of loop current and electrode spacing on the arc characteristics. The volt-ampere characteristic curve of the DC arc is obtained by fitting. The frequency spectrum of arc current is analyzed, and the high frequency components of arc current are extracted. The equivalent model of arc is established, including the steady state impedance and high frequency characteristic models. Then the equivalent model of arc is established in the MATLAB/Simulink. The simulation results are consistent with the experimental data, which verified the correctness of the arc model.

articleTitle: A Simulation Error Analysis Method for HVDC Physical Dynamic Model Parameter Design
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: According to the principle of equal standard unit value, after completing the parameter design of the low-voltage physical dynamic model platform, systematic error analysis and economic analysis must be carried out. The off-line digital simulation method can be used to verify the rationality of this set of parameters, comprehensively considering the economic cost and error requirements, and finally determine the parameter configuration of all electrical components of the dynamic model platform. This paper proposes a simulation error analysis method suitable for the HVDC physical dynamic model platform. It makes reasonable use of massive simulation data to achieve the most comprehensive and precise comparison of the real simulation levels of the two sets of models under the worst working conditions. This method guarantees the accuracy and reliability of the error calculation results. Providing data reference for the parameter design of the HVDC physical dynamic model platform.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Protection Optimization of the Intelligent Electronic Devices Based on the Passive EMI Filter Design
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Passive EMI filter is an effective way to suppress high-frequency electromagnetic interference(EMI). This work takes the electronic current transformer acquisition card as the research prototype. In order to suppress the electrical fast transient/burst (EFT/B) applied at the signal input port of the acquisition card, this work proposed an optimal index to design a specific topology of the filter. Based on the high-frequency EFT/B, the optimal parameters of the EMI filter are calculated by applying nonlinear programming theory, and the designed EMI filter is verified through experiments.

articleTitle: Accommodation of Distributed Photovoltaic Energy with Charging Strategy Optimization of Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Electric vehicles offer the potential to locally integrate the energy of distributed photovoltaic (PV) to decrease carbon emissions of the power system. In this paper, the charging strategy for PV storage charging station is formulated as a multi-objective constrained optimization problem. The energy scheduling and charging states are optimized to meet the charging requirement and to decrease carbon emissions. The constraints of the problem are charging duration, battery SOC and power balance. The objectives of the problem are total cost and battery lifetime. A charging scheduling approach based on particle swarm optimization is proposed to obtain the optimized result. Multiple metrics are considered with a hybrid fitness function to achieve the best overall performance. Simulation results show the feasibility of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Security Margin Assessment for Electricity Spot Market Clearing Based on Active Power Steady-State Security Distance
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The operation of spot market has a broad and profound impact on the whole power industry. The power flow form of power grid under the centralized spot market is quite different from that under the planning model. The system is closer to the security boundary, so there is a risk of system safe operation. The construction of power grid security margin assessment method can ensure the safety and efficiency of power grid equipment operation. This paper analyzes the security operation risk of power grid in the spot market environment, and constructs the steady-state security distance calculation model of clearing results in the spot market environment, and puts forward the power grid security margin evaluation index based on the steady-state security distance. The simulation analysis based on IEEE 39 bus example proves the effectiveness of the method, which can accurately reflect the security risk of the clearing results in the spot market, and help to improve the security operation ability of power grid in the power market environment.

articleTitle: The Optimal Energy Flow of Combined Heat and Power Systems Considering Users' Comfort
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Combined heat and electric power energy networks are common as multi-energy systems and its optimal operation is a hot topic. The goals of this manuscript is to achieve the optimal heat and power flow for the coupling network with tree-topology heat network and DC power network. The study aims to minimize the total deviations between user setting points and building indoor temperatures, decrease total energy consumption and cost. An optimization model is proposed using a steady-state method. The effectiveness of this method is proved by simulation results. Optimal operational schedule is obtained which can considers the complexity of the combined heat and electric networks.

articleTitle: A Novel Closed-Loop Control for Flexible Interconnecting Switches
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increase of DC power supply and DC load, the research significance of DC microgrid is becoming more and more important. As the key equipment of transregional low-voltage DC distribution network, flexible interconnection switch can realize inter-regional low-voltage DC power interconnection and flexible supply transfer, which is conducive to the full absorption and efficient utilization of renewable energy. But for dc power scheduling control strategy between piconets research is not many, therefore, in order to optimize the dc energy between piconets scheduling optimization, the control strategy of the implementation of flexible interconnection switch different patterns of smooth transition, this study analyses the different patterns of working status, put forward a new closed loop control structure, The control can not only realize bidirectional power transmission in the distribution area on both sides, but also adjust the dc voltage on both sides. Finally, the control structure is verified by MATLAB/Simulink simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Protection Method of Medium Voltage DC Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: DC line protection is a key issue in the development of DC distribution networks. The biggest challenge is to identify fault sections quickly and reliably. In order to ensure the reliable operation of the DC grid, this paper takes a typical four-port ring medium voltage distribution network as an example to propose a DC protection network fault protection strategy based on DC inductors. Since the parameters involved in this criterion are all implemented by local measurements, it has the characteristics of real-time communication independent of off-site signals. The MMC-based four-port DC distribution network was modelled using a real-time digital simulator (RTDS), and a number of simulation experiments were performed to verify the effectiveness of the proposed protection scheme. The simulation results show that the proposed protection method not only can detect faults quickly and accurately, but also has a certain effect on detecting high-impedance faults.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Transient Analysis of Power System based on Nonlinear Auto-regressive Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Considering the influence of uncertain factors on power system, it is difficult for traditional deterministic time-domain simulation analysis to make a comprehensive evaluation for system dynamic process. To address this issue, a probabilistic transient analysis (PTA) method based on the nonlinear auto-regressive (NAR) model is proposed in this paper. The stochastic power fluctuation is regarded as the random input variables and the dynamic state variables are regarded as the outputs in the proposed method. The NAR model is established to approximate the dynamic behaviors of power system under uncertainty, in which support vector regression (SVR) algorithm is used to depict the relationship between the NAR coefficients and random input variables. Compared with the traditional Monte Carlo simulation, the NAR model significantly improves the efficiency of PTA of power system. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is validated through time-domain simulation of IEEE 118-bus system in case study.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling Of Price-Based Demand Response In Microgrid With Classified Load Change Rate
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low generation utilization caused by distributed renewable energy uncertainty, a multi-objective microgrid optimization method considering multiple load demand responses is proposed. According to the characteristics of load working duration and period, it is classified and transformed into three kinds of controllable load state functions to express the whole day load electricity consumption function, and a price-based demand response model considering classified load is established. In order to test the coordinated operation degree of distributed renewable energy output and controllable load, an evaluation index of load change rate is proposed, which reflects the fluctuation of controllable load following distributed renewable energy output. A multi-objective optimization function is established to minimize the generation cost and consumption cost of users in the microgrid. Taking an area microgrid dominated by wind power as an example, the results show that the proposed optimal scheduling model can appropriately adjust the load working period to adapt to the fluctuation of distributed wind power output and reduce the wind curtailment rate. It can also reduce the user's electricity cost and realize the environmental protection and economic operation of microgrid.

articleTitle: Unit Output Optimization of Integrated Energy System Based on Digital Twin and Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The integrated energy system is different from the power system in that it integrates a variety of energy forms and coupling devices. The structure and scale are more complex, and the collection of system parameters is brutal. In this case, how to optimize the unit output to reduce the operation cost and maintain the safe and stable operation of the system has become an important research direction. This paper presents a method to build a virtual environment of an integrated energy system based on digital twin technology and find the optimal output strategy of the unit through a deep reinforcement learning decision model. Firstly, the real-time operation data of the integrated energy system are collected by multi-dimensional sensors to build a digital twin virtual environment. Secondly, the real-time output of the unit is simulated through the digital twin, which provides the relevant operation parameter basis for the follow-up deep reinforcement learning decision-making. Finally, the deep reinforcement learning decision model is used to find the optimal strategy for unit output, and the information is fed back to the terminal controller in real-time through the digital twin to guide the output of the integrated energy system unit. The simulation results show that the proposed method can effectively improve the unit output optimization accuracy of the integrated energy system and reduce the system operation cost.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Detection Method of LiFePO4 Battery Based on Two Dimensional Residuals
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The operation life of energy storage power stations in China is generally increasing, which leads to frequent safety accidents. How to detect the abnormal state of energy storage battery more accurately has gradually become a hot issue in the industry. This paper presents a residual early warning method based on extended Kalman filter. Firstly, the state of charge (SOC) estimation model of lithium iron phosphate battery based on extended Kalman filter is established; Then, the nonlinear function between SOC and battery parameters is fitted according to the real data, and the estimated battery voltage is obtained; Finally, nonlinear state estimation technology is used to detect the residual between the estimated value and the real value. The 54000 second data of LiFePO4 battery is used to verify the method, and the results show that the method can detect the occurrence of battery failure better.

articleTitle: Gas Pipe Leak Detection Based On Circuit-Analog Tide Calculation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The leakage of gas pipeline network is one of the most common forms of gas transmission failures. In order to detect the leakage accurately and timely, it is necessary to study the leakage characteristics to distinguish abnormal signals caused by leaks from regular service variations. And the whole detection process would be carried out on an online monitoring model to meet instantaneity. In this paper, the leakage characteristics of natural gas networks are discussed, and a leak detection model based on tide calculation using finite difference time domain scheme was proposed. Case studies indicate that this model can effectively filter the measurement noise and accurately identify the natural gas leakage fault during online dynamic monitoring.

articleTitle: Research and Demonstration of Planning and Decision-making Tools Based on Power Grid Full Cost Chain
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: “Several Opinions of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council on Further Deepening the Reform of the Electric Power System” (Zhongfa [2015] No. 9) kicked off the new round of power system reform in China. Therefore, the power grid companies urgently need to change their development modes, conform to the development trend of the new round of power system reform, and plan ahead to carry out research on new modes, new models and new methods of investment planning and decision-making in the market environment, which promotes the scientificity and effectiveness of power transmission and distribution networks, comprehensively improve the level of optimal allocation of power resources. First of all, this paper studies the calculation method of full-cost chain and full-cost node electricity price. Then, the functional module of the planning decision tool based on the full cost chain of the power grid is proposed. Finally, the selected project is determined based on the sensitivity of the investment ceiling.

articleTitle: Parabolic Rule Variable Filtering Time Constant Demand Response Method Considering SOC State of Wind Power Storage
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Using battery energy storage system to smooth wind power fluctuations can improve the reliability of wind power grid connection. Considered the adjustment of energy storage system SOC, a smooth wind power control strategy for a battery energy storage system with a parabolic regular variable filtering time constant was proposed. This method obtains the grid-connected active power target value of the wind storage system through the parabolic regular variable filtering time constant algorithm, go through the rate of change limit, SOC correction and power limit to obtain the actual output value of the battery energy storage system, issuing to the stored energy converter to perform charge and discharge operations on the battery. It can achieve the effect of smoothing wind power and ensure that the SOC is maintained within a safe range. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of this strategy were verified by MATLAB simulation.

articleTitle: Simulation of Battery Energy Storage in Cyber Physical Systems Using Different Converter Models
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the deep coupling of the information and power flows in the power grid, modeling and simulation is of the greatest challenges in cyber physical system (CPS) research. The modeling and simulation methods of active distribution network components should ensure accuracy and efficiency of the simulation analysis. In this paper, the electromagnetic transient model of battery energy storage system is established in PSCAD/EMTDC. Three different converter models are applied to multi-time scale transient simulation. The calculation results show that the detailed and switched models of DC-AC converter give detailed and accurate information characteristics, while the simulation of averaged model is beneficial to the improvement of simulation efficiency.

articleTitle: Typical Load Analysis and Forecast of a Provincial Power Grid in Mid-Southern China
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, the situation of electricity consumption of typical user groups is analyzed and predicted, and its correlation with the economic situation is explored. Based on the prophet time series algorithm, this paper analyzes and forecasts the electricity consumption trend of typical customer groups in Southern provincial capital based on time series decomposition and combined with machine learning fitting method. It also explores the impact of the 2020 epidemic on different user groups, which can provide solutions to the future economic situation on electricity consumption and to reduce the situation of oversupply or undersupply of power resources.

articleTitle: Identification of Cascading Fault Sequences in AC/DC Hybrid Power System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: How to identify the cascading fault sequences quickly and reflect the operating characteristics accurately in AC/DC hybrid power system has become an important research issue. In order to identify the cascading fault sequences of AC/DC hybrid power system, this paper established multi-feed short-circuit ratio index and weighted tidal entropy index from the perspective of power flow operation characteristics and AC-DC connection relationship respectively. Entropy weighting and correlation coefficient methods are combined to determine the weighted correlation for identifying cascading fault sequences. Load loss is used to assess the risk of the power grid by the determined cascading fault sequences. Case studies are carried out to validate the proposed method by the modified IEEE 39 AC/DC hybrid power system. Simulation results show that the proposed method identified the cascading fault sequences in AC/DC hybrid power system quickly and accurately.

articleTitle: Superpixels Segmentation and Low-rank Matrix Recovery for Thermal Fault Diagnosis of Power Equipment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Traditional thermal fault diagnosis methods usually focus on an entry image or square patches. These methods may fail to fully spatial structure information for thermal fault diagnosis of power equipment. To overcome this issue, in this paper, we propose a novel thermal fault diagnosis method. This method integrates superpixel segmentation (SS) and low-rank matrix recovery (LRMR) for diagnosis. Specifically, the proposed method has two main steps. First, an input infrared image is transformed by using a principal component analysis (PCA) algorithm, and a superpixel segmentation method is employed to the first principal component, to divide the infrared image into non-overlapping homogeneous superpixel regions. Then, the thermal fault region is detected by employing the low-rank matrix recovery (LRMR) in a superpixel-by-superpixel manner. Since we jointly excavate the spatial structure and thermal information by combining SS with LRMR, it is better than simply analyzing an entry image or square patches. Experimental results that the proposed diagnosis method has a better diagnostic performance than the current state-of-the-art detectors.

articleTitle: A Method for Optimizing Reactive Power Compensation Configuration Scheme Based on New Energy Low Voltage Ride Through Safety Assessment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper introduces a safety and stability margin evaluation method based on new energy low pass period, which provides operators with an index to evaluate the off-grid distance of new energy. This method can be used to evaluate the voltage stability level effect of different reactive power compensation schemes on the sending end power grid, especially the area near the new energy plant. At the same time, the flow chart can be used to guide the selection of reactive power compensation configuration scheme and improve the safety and stability of the system by comparing the safety and stability margin level of the new energy machine under different reactive power compensation schemes.

articleTitle: Benefits of Variable Speed Pumped Hydro Storage Technology for Increasing Renewable Integration in Regional Power Grids
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the large-scale integration of renewable energy sources such as wind power and photovoltaics, the randomness and intermittency of their output have brought challenges to the stable operation of the power grid, especially the flexibility, resilience, and frequency control during heating seasons and at nights. Compared to traditional fixed-speed pumped storage units, variable-speed pumped storage units have obvious technical advantages in frequency control and voltage stability support under pumping conditions, which thus better match the variable output of renewable energies. This paper evaluates the benefits of variable-speed pumped storage technology to increase the renewable energies integration in regional power grids. A simplified network is established based on 9 areas in an actual regional power grid. A time-sequential simulation is conducted based on the simplified regional power grid using actual hourly renewable generation and load data to evaluate the benefits of variable speed pumped hydro storage technology on increasing the integration of renewable power and reducing the peak shaving depth of thermal power. This study provided a reference for the technical and economic benefit evaluation of future variable-speed pumped hydro storage projects.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Cache of PCBA Board Based on Welding Machine
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Intelligent instrument manufacturers are undergoing automation transformation and upgrading. Although the production efficiency of the instrument has been improved and the production failure rate has been reduced, a series of problems have also arisen. For example, when the back-end equipment is abnormal, the PCBA board in the smart meter will be blocked in the welding furnace. If it is not processed for a long time, it will lead to a high rejection rate. For this reason, a PABA automatic buffer device for welding machine is designed. When there is an abnormality in the back section of the welding furnace, the PCBA board in the furnace can be automatically cached and cleared, which greatly reduces the scrap rate in the production process, improves the controllability of abnormal production and the integrated management of production.

articleTitle: Inertial Response Improvement Method for Bidirectional Power Converter in Hybrid AC/DC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Hybrid AC/DC microgrid has drawn wide attention recently for its expansibility and flexibility. The hybrid microgrid is a low inertia system due to the high proportion of distributed generators connected. Hence, the fluctuations of DC voltage and AC frequency in dynamic state become noteworthy issues. This paper proposed an inertial response improvement strategy for the bidirectional power converter (BPC) which contains two stages of converters and a built-in capacitor. The DC/DC converter of BPC can improve the DC subgrid inertial response by regulating the built-in capacitor of BPC. And the DC/AC converter of BPC will operate as virtual synchronous generator (VSG) and exhibit similar frequency dynamic response. The simulation result in MATLAB/Simulink is proposed to verify the proposed method.

articleTitle: The Effect of Salt Fog on Electric Joint Compound used in Southeast Coastal
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Electrical joint compounds are neutral conductive pastes that consist of a base oil and conductive filler. They are commonly used at metal connections of DC power equipment to reduce contact resistance and delay metal corrosion. The salt fog in the southeast coastal region of China accelerates the failure of electrical joint compounds. During aging, the contact resistance of connectors increase, which leads to abnormal heating. To prevent this, it is necessary to analyze the aging process, especially in a salt fog environment. In this article, we found that salt fog accelerated the debinding of conductive filler from the base oil. Upon increasing the aging time, the organic matter content in the substance decreased, and the inorganic filler content increased. An increase in the crosslinking extent and the volatilization of small-molecule siloxanes greatly affected the operating performance of the electrical joint compound.

articleTitle: Research on Photovoltaic VSG Control Technology Based on Generation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a photovoltaic active power reserve control strategy is proposed. This strategy makes photovoltaic array runs at the maximum sub-power point, leaving a certain reserve capacity to participate in the frequency modulation work of the system, at the same time alleviating the phenomenon of energy discard and maximizing the use of solar energy. This paper implements the photovoltaic system actively participates in the frequency modulation work by modifying the control strategy of Boost converter based on the original two-stage photovoltaic grid -connected structure, and analyze the virtual inertia support and frequency influence of the photovoltaic system by monitoring the switching time and frequency fluctuation rate.

articleTitle: Research on Autonomous Operation Control of Microgrid Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that distributed power is difficult to use on a large scale, microgrid as a solution has developed rapidly in recent years. According to different operation modes, microgrid can be divided into two operation modes: grid-connected operation and island operation. When the microgrid is operating on an island mode, in order to provide better power quality for the loads, it is necessary to design a reasonable control strategy. This paper takes isolated microgrid as the research objective and uses deep reinforcement learning to control the voltage of microgrid with a constant value. A classic isolated microgrid model, which is combined with the depth determination strategy gradient (DDPG) algorithm in deep reinforcement learning, is established to maintain the load voltage within an acceptable level. Finally, the simulation experiment is compared with the classical controller and the model predictive controller to verify the effectiveness of the proposed control method.

articleTitle: Idle and Max Power Forecasting for Linear Server Power Consumption Model Using Random Forests
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The number of data centers is growing rapidly these years to meet the requirement of the development of internet technology. Data centers operate continuously throughout the year and consume a large amount of electricity every year. Consequently, they bring a great burden to the power departments and the environment. Optimization of workload scheduling in the data centers can reduce the power consumption of both internet technology system and cooling system. The power consumption model of servers is the basis of workload scheduling, and its accuracy and convenience are very essential to the implementation of scheduling. This paper focused on the linear power consumption model which proved to be simple and of high accuracy. Idle power and max power are two main parameters in the linear model and they can be measured through experiment tests. However, the experiment tests take much time and they can not be conducted on the servers already in use. Therefore, this paper aims to build a prediction model of both idle power and max power using readily accessible hardware parameters. A dataset crawled from the SPECpower website was firstly analyzed. And a random forests regression model was built based on it. The data set showed that idle power and max power had a downward and upward trend respectively. The idle power percentage, however, continued to decrease. The random forests regression model performed well. The mean average percentage error of idle power and max power was 16.7% and 10.3% respectively, which were much better than multiple linear regression model results and empirical equation results.

articleTitle: Model Recognition Based Arc Extinction Time Recognition Strategy for True Bipolar Flexible HVDC Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Transient single-pole grounding faults are the most probable faults on transmission lines. To optimize the reclosing time of transient faults, it is necessary to identify the fault arc extinction time. Firstly, the time-domain expression between the electrical quantity and the traveling wave at both ends of the line is derived by analyzing the frequency-dependent model. Secondly, based on the idea of model recognition, the non-fault model is used as the calculation model. The actual models before and after the transient fault arc is extinguished are different, so the difference between them and the calculation model is also different. Finally, the Pearson similarity is used to extract the above-mentioned differences, and a strategy for recognizing the arc extinction time of a single-pole grounding fault in true bipolar flexible high voltage dc (HVDC) systems is proposed. PSCAD/EMTDC simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Detection Methods of Foreign Objects and Component Defects in Transmission Lines Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The foreign objects and component defects on the transmission line will cause adverse effects on the power transmission equipment, and may even endanger the safe operation of the power grid.
