Therefore, it is necessary to identify the foreign objects and component defects on the transmission line. In this paper, a method based on Faster-RCNN (Regional Convolutional Neural Network) for reorganization of the transmission line images collected by aerial photography is studied, where feature maps from the images to be detected through convolutional network operations is generated. Then the Region Proposal Network (RPN) is used to generate region of interests, and then the category of the picture is obtained. Moreover, the location of foreign objects and component defects through the classification layer is also recognized. The final result shows that the average accuracy of the presented method for the identification of foreign objects and component defects in transmission lines can reach 95.24%.

articleTitle: Research on Hybrid Simultaneous Simulation Method of Multi-energy Coupling System under Multiple time Scale
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous development of society, the traditional single energy source can no longer meet the needs of people's daily life, which makes the energy Internet of coupling and interaction of various energy forms emerge. This paper firstly analyzes the gas-electricity and heat-electricity coupling links and interface models based on the electricity-gas-heat coupled energy system structure framework, and analyzes the time-scale characteristics of the three types of flow forms of energy. On this basis, the power flow calculation process of the electricity-pneumatic-thermal coupling system is proposed and the simulation example is analyzed. The simulation results show that the electricity-gas-heat interconnection system can change the peak-to-valley ratio of various loads, optimize the allocation of power generation resources, reduce the amount of renewable energy discarded, and reduce operating costs. It can provide a reference for the optimized operation of multi-region and multi-energy systems.

articleTitle: Research on DC Power Grid Electromechanical Transient Modeling Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This article divides large AC/DC power grids into AC (alternating current) and DC (direct current) network for electromechanical transient simulating. With reference to the modeling method of AC network, all DC transmission systems are processed as one DC network for modeling and simulating, instead of being embedded in AC network. The AC and DC network exchange data through the converter buses. The establishing and solving methods for DC network equations are put forward on the basis of the mathematical models of LCC converter nodes, VSC converter nodes, DC loads, DC lines and so on. The results of example system demonstrate that the proposed method adapts to different types of HVDC transmission, simplifies HVDC system modeling, and enhances the convenience of model application.

articleTitle: Integrated Energy System Day-Ahead Dispatch Considering Supply-Side and Demand-Side Flexibility
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper studies the day-ahead scheduling model of the integrated energy system considering flexibility, and the day-ahead scheduling strategy of the integrated energy system considering both the supply-side and the demand-side flexibility is proposed. First, an integrated energy system coupled with electricity-gas-energy stations was established, in which the power network and natural gas network were modeled separately. As a link between the power network and the natural gas network, the energy station includes various energy conversion devices, energy storage and energy loads. Secondly, the flexibility of the integrated energy system is defined, and the modeling of both supply-side and demand-side flexibility is studied. Then, a day-ahead dispatch model is formulated to optimize the day-ahead dispatch of the integrated energy system under the objective including both economic and flexibility. Finally, a simulation example is utilized to analyze and verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Modeling of Heating Substations Based on LSTM
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Establish an accurate model of heating substations is the basis for optimal control of heat supply in heating substations. However, it is very difficult to achieve an accurate model by traditional manual control methods as well as neural networks. In this paper, the heat supply problem of heating substations is formulated as a time series-based problem, a new heating substations model is established, which using Long-Short Term Memory (LSTM) neural network by collecting actual meteorological data and heat supply history data of a city heating substations. The experiments show that the model based on LSTM neural network can accurately predict the heat supply at the next moment, and the LSTM neural network model has higher accuracy and stability compared with the traditional neural network models Gradient Boost Regression Tree (GBRT), Random Forest Regressor (RFR) and Feed forward neural networks (FFNN).

articleTitle: Optimal Sizing of Hybrid Energy Storage in Industrial Park Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The multi-vector energy solutions such as combined heat and power (CHP) units and heat pumps (HPs) can fulfil the energy utilization requirements of modern industrial parks. The energy storage systems play important role in both electricity and heating networks to accommodate increased penetration of renewable energies, to smooth the fluctuations and to provide flexible and cost-benefit coordination between electric and thermal systems. However, the cost and associate life span of the storage systems have become the main obstacles at current stage. Consequently, an energy storage collaborative allocation method is proposed for industrial park integrated energy system utilizing bi-level optimization model. The techno-economic value has been evaluated through simulation.

articleTitle: Bi-Objective Power-Traffic Pricing Coordination: Incorporating User Choice Stochasticity
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The population of electric vehicles and fast charging stations has created stronger interdependency between the operation of urban traffic networks and power distribution networks. Congestion tolls and charging prices are effective leverages of the two network operators to influence the drivers' routing and charging decisions and “indirectly” regulate the resulting charging loads and vehicular flows. In this paper, a two-stage power-traffic pricing framework incorporating both the multi-goal pricing and user choice stochasticity is established. In the first stage, the optimal power-traffic flow distribution is determined by the Nash bargain model. In the second stage, the prices are optimized to guide the drivers' behaviors to achieve the desired network flow pattern, where the discrete choice model is employed to describe the user decision stochasticity. Case studies demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework and methods.

articleTitle: Power Flat Management and Coordinated Control Under different Operation modes for DC Distribution System Based on Voltage Information Coding
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The construction of high efficiency, low consumption and reliable DC distribution system is an important way to achieve flexible access and efficient matching of DC source and charge. Compared with AC distribution network, it has a greater development potential. Aiming at the DC distribution system with multi-voltage level and multi-converters connected to the grid, under the different operating modes of the system, a method of voltage information coding is used to carry out flat management and coordinated control for different converters in the system, so as to meet the requirements of rapid response control of the DC system. The droop coefficient is designed and analyzed in frequency domain to ensure stable operation under disturbance. A simulation model based on PSCAD/EMTDC was established to verify the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Optimal Configuration of Comprehensive Power Supply System of Zhongshan Station in Antarctica Considering Low Temperature Characteristics of Batteries
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to achieve the dual carbon goal and solve the problem of wind power consumption at the same time, this paper proposes a hybrid energy storage capacity optimization configuration method considering electric-hydrogen coupling for Zhongshan Station in South Pole. Firstly, the model of combined heat and power supply of hydrogen storage system with electrolytic cell, hydrogen storage tank and fuel cell is established to fully explore the potential of hydrogen storage system in combined heat and power supply. Secondly, considering the influence of temperature on battery capacity and charge-discharge characteristics, the relationship between battery capacity and temperature under the low temperature environment below 15°C was analyzed and studied, and mathematical modeling of battery capacity was carried out. Finally, a specific example of Zhongshan Station in Antarctica is solved and analyzed to verify the effectiveness of the proposed configuration method.

articleTitle: Research on Small Signal Stability of Medium Voltage DC Shore Power System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to study the small signal stability of the medium voltage DC shore power system, the working principle of the medium voltage DC shore power system is analyzed, the overall state equation of the system is established, and the transfer function of the system is obtained through the state equation. In addition, the dynamic model of the medium voltage shore power system is established, and the change trajectories of the damping component and the recovery component of the system are analyzed according to different working conditions, and the dynamic characteristics and stability of the medium voltage shore power system are studied. Under different conditions, different grid strength and different control parameters, the dominant characteristic root locus and Nyquist diagram of the system are drawn to analyze the overall stability of the medium voltage DC shore power system. The results show that different control parameters need to be set in the power system with different short-circuit ratio, and the established medium voltage DC shore power system has good stability under small interference. The research results can provide reference information for engineering practice and operation of medium voltage DC shore power system.

articleTitle: A Detection System of Gas Concentration Based on Low-Loss Fiber Loop Ring-Down Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the engineering application of power transformers, due to phenomena such as overheating and partial discharge, the transformer may have a fault. Acetylene is one of the important characteristic components when the transformer is failure. The acetylene detection is significant to the diagnosis and evaluation of transformer operational condition. Therefore, a fiber loop ring-down system is built to detect acetylene in this paper. The fiber collimators at both ends of the gas cell are adjusted to reduce the loss of the gas cell system. The absorption line at 1531.6nm of the acetylene molecule was selected and the response characteristics of the system to the concentration of trace acetylene gas were studied through experiment. The ring-down waveforms at different concentrations of acetylene are measured. After fitting the peak value of waveforms, the corresponding ring-down time can be calculated and the quantitative relationship between ring-down time and concentration is also studied based on the least square method. The results show that there is a good linear dependence between the ring-down time and the concentration. The research results provide a new method for the online detection of dissolved gases in the transformer oil.

articleTitle: Research on Electromechanical Transient Equivalent Modeling of MMC-HVDC Connected to Passive Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, electromechanical transient models of MMC-HVDC connected to passive network are analyzed. Comparisons between voltage and current source equivalent models are carried out. First, the complex dynamic process inside converter is ignored and converter control loops are retained, establishing the voltage source equivalent model. Afterwards, the dynamic process of inner loop controller is simplified, establishing the current source equivalent model. Compared with the MMC-HVDC electromagnetic transient model under different operating conditions, the validity of electromechanical transient models under different disturbance are verified. For small disturbance analysis, both voltage source model and current source model are applicable. For large disturbance analysis, simulation results of voltage source model are more consistent with those of electromagnetic transient model.

articleTitle: General Secondary Equipment Simulation Drive System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The development and verification of secondary equipment is supported on specific built-in hardware devices and requires a large amount of instrumentation assistance for verification. When the secondary equipment can be simulated and run on the computer, if the simulation excitation signal can be applied at the same time, then the main functions of the secondary equipment can be stimulated and verified by these simulations. This article introduces a system for simulation and verification of general secondary equipment, through which IO signals, process layer SV, and GOOSE signals can be simulated. Connect with the device or simulation software through GOOSE message protocol, SV9-2 protocol, and smart protocol. It can be applied to a computer to simulate a secondary device running, or it can be applied to a specific embedded device, so as to realize a functional verification device. The system can be directly deployed on a laptop computer to simulate various test scenarios and serve as a relay protection device. The development, testing, and deployment reduce costs and improve efficiency.

articleTitle: A New Comprehensive Planning Method of Transmission Network with Various Functional Attributes
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the gradual development of power system, more forms of functional attributes are appearing, which have different requirements on the topology, security and reliability of the power system. Based on the feature of present power system, this paper considers four different functional attributes to comprehensively plan the transmission network, which are renewable energy accommodation, load center which is insufficient power supply, hydropower generation profit, as well as channel association. Firstly, various scenarios of renewable energy and load are conducted by adopting K-means++ clustering algorithm. On this basis, a comprehensive planing model for transmission network is developed in consideration of the four different functional attributes. Finally, the simulation is conducted by Matlab and PSD-BPA in the modified IEEE-18 transmission network, which strongly verifies the proposed planning model renders high effectiveness and robustness.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicle User Portrait Considering Market Response Potential
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a method to build user portrait of electric vehicle (EV) considering market response potential. Firstly, the user portrait index system of EV is constructed from three dimensions of electricity response potential, temporal response potential and spatial response potential. Secondly, the residual capacity and time of use (TOU) price are selected as the characteristic parameters to identify the TOU price sensitive users, and the EVs that can respond to the market in time are obtained based on support vector machine (SVM). Then, the distance, time and electricity charge are selected as the characteristic parameters to identify the charging service fee sensitive users, and the EVs that can respond to the market in space are obtained based on the neural network. Finally, eight kinds of EV user portraits with different market response potentials are obtained by identifying the charging data, which verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Market Participation of Virtual Power Plant with Renewable Generation and Waste Treatment under Incentive and Loss Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of renewable generation consumption and waste treatment, a market participation method of virtual power plant with renewable generation and waste treatment is proposed. Wastes are incinerated in the waste treatment unit, which contains a gas tank for storing gas caused by waste incineration and can decouple the processes of power generation and flue gas treatment. According to this characteristic, flue gas treatment can be regarded as time-shiftable and adjustable load, and cooperate with renewable generation for coordinated operation of virtual power plant. In order to increase the profit of virtual power plant while reducing the curtailment of renewable generation, an environmentally economic operation model with a goal of maximum benefit of virtual power plant is established, and three kinds of incentive and loss mechanisms are introduced. Results show that the objective function value is the largest under the action of three different mechanisms. The virtual power plant with renewable generation and waste treatment can improve the utilization of renewable energy generation.

Author Keywords: coordinated operation of virtual power plant

articleTitle: Power Grid Nodal Vulnerability Analysis Combining Topology and State Information
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The security of the power grid is the first element of its operation. This paper aims at finding the vulnerability nodes in the power grid to prevent it from being destroyed. A novel comprehensive vulnerability index is proposed to the singleness of evaluation indicators for existing literature by integrating the power grid's topology information and operating state. Taking IEEE-118 as an example, the simulation analysis proves that the proposed vulnerability index has certain discriminative advantages and the best weighting factor is obtained through correlation analysis.

articleTitle: An Analytical Long-Run Incremental Cost Pricing Model for Stochastic Power Flow
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, we first present an analytical investment risk-oriented long-run incremental cost (LRIC) pricing model for distribution networks under a high penetrated stochastic load. The proposed pricing method considers the tails distribution of line power flow while remains analytic. In the proposed model, the trigger time is determined by both line investment cost and customer outages cost due to the possible power curtailment in the future. The efficacy of the proposed approach has been illustrated by a comparison with the traditional LRIC pricing model. Results indicate that this method can reflect the influence of the power failure risk tolerance of load on the investment time and LRIC pricing of distribution network components.

articleTitle: Parameters Inversion of Equivalent RLC Fault Circuit for MMC-HVDC Grid Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The accurate calculation of DC short circuit current plays an important role in the protection of flexible high voltage direct current grid based on modular multilevel converter (MMC-HVDC). At present, the common method for dc fault current calculation is by transforming converter station and fault circuit into an equivalent RLC circuit within a very short period of time after the fault. However, due to the coupling between converter stations in complex MMC-HVDC grid, the accurate parameters for the equivalent RLC are difficult to be acquired, thus leading to the large calculation error. To address this problem, this paper proposes a parameter inversion method for the equivalent RLC fault circuit based on BP neural network, and derives the relationship between system parameters and inversed parameters by multivariate linear fitting method. Thus, a general and accurate analytical calculation method of DC fault current is obtained. Experiments show that the average error of fault current calculated by this method is only 2.2%.

articleTitle: Resilience Lifting Method of Active Distribution Network Considering Charging and Discharging Scheduling of Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Frequent occurrence of low probability and high-risk accidents poses a huge challenge to the safe and stable operation of a power system. Because of the “large scale and long time” fault characteristics of the distribution network under extreme natural disasters, this paper analyzes the supporting role of electric vehicles and distributed power generation on the distribution network in the process of surface disasters. First of all, according to the characteristics of electric vehicles as both loads and energy storage tasks, electric vehicles can be divided into three types: disordered charging, orderly charging, and dispatchable charging and discharging. Then the state matrix of electric vehicles is established, and the travel rules and charging and discharging rules of electric vehicles are obtained through Monte Carlo sampling. Finally, this paper uses the IEEE33 node distribution network to simulate the resilience lifting effect of active distribution network under typhoon disaster by combining optical storage for example analysis and verifies the effect of dispatchable electric vehicles on the elastomer upgrading of distribution network.

articleTitle: Research on the Development and Testing Technology of Domestic Chip Relay Protection Devices
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the core equipment of the power grid, the relay protection device's self-control plays a key role in the safe and stable operation of the power grid. The development of high-performance, high-reliability domestic chips and the localization of core components for relay protection have become the development strategy of the State Grid Corporation of China. This paper analyzes the overall plan and future direction of the domestic chip relay protection device; according to the characteristics of each domestic core component, it proposes a targeted test plan for the relay protection device; also, it analyzes and studies the failure mechanism of the domestic chip relay protection through inspection and grid connection operation which verifies the practicability of the aforementioned test plan.

articleTitle: A Case Study on Integrating Offshore Wind Power to Islanded Offshore Oil and Gas Field
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Along with the energy-form transformation, energy enterprises are paying attention to offshore wind farm, which would support the decarbonization of the offshore oil and gas field. Yet, the intermittent characteristics still prevents the field owners from embracing the wind power. To address this issue, this paper investigates the integration of wind power into an islanded offshore oil and gas field microgrid. Firstly, the structure and operating mechanism of the microgrid are presented. Source-load characteristics and network parameters that may affect the voltage and frequency features of the microgrid are analyzed. Then the models of the microgrid is presented. Based on the models, the effects of four typical disturbances on the microgrid is studied in detail, including the variation of offshore wind power output, the trip-off of offshore wind power, the failure of subsea cable, and the start-up of high-power induction motor. The results demonstrate that the microgrid can accommodate the wind power during normal operations, but may cause frequency and voltage issues during contingencies like the start-up of the motors and the failure of subsea cables.

articleTitle: Modeling Method Of Dew-Point Temperature Prediction In Industrial Workshop Based On Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In industrial production, the control of environmental dew-point temperature is related to the safety and quality of production, and affects the operation efficiency of energy consumption terminal equipment, which has gradually become a problem that cannot be ignored in the industrial processes. In this paper, a modeling method of dew-point temperature prediction in industrial workshop based on machine learning is proposed to predict the dew-point temperature in the future moment. In the modeling process, the optimal combination of input features and algorithm are obtained by comparing the model prediction accuracy of different combination of input features and different machine learning algorithms, and the hyper-parameters of model were optimized by Bayesian optimization algorithm. The proposed method is applied to an industrial case and the results show that the support vector regression algorithm has the best performance in predicting the dew-point temperature of workshop in the future moment. One evaluation index R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> for the prediction accuracy of dew-point temperature in the next moment and in the next two moment are 0.94 and 0.89, the other index CV are 3.03% and 4.10%, respectively.

articleTitle: Simulation Investigation of Airflow Distribution in Data Center using the Field Synergy Principle
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Data centers consume a significant amount of electricity every year. This electricity is largely consumed to maintain the thermal environment inside data centers. Therefore, reducing the energy usage of cooling systems is an important method for cutting down the energy consumption of data centers. Studies have been conducted on air temperature and velocity fields to improve the airflow distribution and cooling efficiency in data centers. However, the field synergy principle indicates that reducing the angle between the temperature gradient and the velocity is more effective for enhancing heat transfer. Considering this principle, the study aimed to investigate the influence of the field synergy angle on airflow distribution by building a data center model with cold aisle containment using computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulation. In the simulation, the velocity of the supply air was set at 0.6 m/s, 0.8 m/s and 1.0 m/s, and the temperature at 291 K, 293 K, 295 K. Using the field synergy principle, the distribution of field synergy angle and the influence of the supply air conditions were analyzed. The results showed that the field synergy angle performs well when baffles are installed in the space between the servers. In addition, findings also showed that an increase in the air supply velocity would deteriorate the distribution of the field synergy angle, especially in the lower states of the racks.

articleTitle: An Optimal Reconfiguration Scheme Searching Method with Consideration of Variation Characteristic of Generation and Load
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents a method of distribution network reconfiguration with consideration of variation characteristic of load and distributed generation(DG). This method can provide the optimal reconfiguration scheme(ORS) with lower power losses and less number of operations. When output power of generators or consumption of load fluctuates dramatically, switches response immediately and the network topology changes in real time. Unbalanced loading scenario, voltage-dependent load model, the probability of each candidate reconfiguration scheme and the economic cost in power transmission are also incorporated. Method to search ORS is expressed as a multi-objective optimization function with constrains of power balance, operating voltage quality, the limit transmission capacity and the request for topological structures. Particle swarm optimization algorithm(PSOA) is adopted to solve the stated math issues. The modified IEEE 34 bus system has been analyzed to illustrate the proposed techniques. Given the reconfiguration time interval as 15 minutes, simulation results of traditional real-time reconfiguration(RTR) method and ORS searching method are illustrated and compared to verify the outstanding performance of proposed method.

articleTitle: A Component Reinforcement Method Based on DAD Model for Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Identifying the key components and reinforcing them before extreme events is an effective way to improve the resilience of transmission networks. Based on the DAD model, this paper proposes a component strengthening method in coordination with network reconfiguration. Considering the mixed attack of the generators and lines and the uncertainty of the attack resources, we established a three-layer DAD model and used a two-layer CCG method to solve the problem. The example analysis on the IEEE-RTS-24 node network shows that the component strengthening method proposed in this paper can identify the key components in the transmission network and effectively reduce the load loss of the system after extreme events.

articleTitle: Application of Power System Based on Hydrogen Energy in Improving Power Quality
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a robust power grid system based on hydrogen energy to build up the energy capability of microgrids. In recent years, the progress of hydrogen technology such as electrolytic action and fuel cell makes the conversion efficiency between electricity and hydrogen higher and the cost lower. The electric frame relying on hydrogen energy is now used to replace large energy storage devices such as batteries. Compared with the traditional power system which generates a large amount of electric energy by wind or solar energy, when using a hydrogen energy system that stores high pressure, the power change becomes more stable. To realize the interconnection between electrolyzer and fuel cell in a power grid allocation method with low electric tension, high potency, and high dependability, a two-way postage current source current transducer is adopted. MATLAB/Simulink is used to build the simulation model of the planning structure, which shows suitable performance under diverse conditions.

articleTitle: Wind Storage Microgrid Energy Management System with Integrated Improved VSG Control
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Doubly-fed wind power generation with energy storage has become the mainstream of new energy generation due to its unique advantages. This paper firstly designs a new virtual synchronous generator (VSG) control strategy for the energy storage subsystem, which has the ability to adaptively adjust the virtual inertia according to external disturbances; secondly, due to the unique control principle of the VSG, it leads to a serious coupling effect between its output active and reactive power, so a decoupling link is added to this new VSG control strategy; finally, based on the new energy storage control method, a storage energy management system that can extend the life of that energy storage is designed, and the whole wind storage energy management system is built based on this energy storage energy management system. The effectiveness and optimality of the new VSG control strategy in suppressing grid frequency fluctuations, smoothing the output power and protecting the life of the energy storage battery is demonstrated through joint simulation with MATLAB and LabVIEW.

Author Keywords: Double-fed wind power with energy storage

articleTitle: Research on Power Use Inspection Management System for High Risk Industry Users under the “Dual Carbon” Target
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Once a power outage occurs in user equipment in high-risk industries, it will have a huge social impact and even endanger the stable operation of the power grid. Firstly, the current status of electricity consumption inspections for high-risk users is analyzed; Secondly, based on the insufficient power consumption detection system for users in high-risk industries, a high-risk industry user equipment safety evaluation model is designed, and power supply guarantee and safety risk prevention and control standards for users in high-risk industries are established; Finally, a “government-power supply company-user” tripartite linkage mode is proposed, and a practical manual for power inspection and power safety for petrochemical, fine chemical, and metallurgical users is formulated to optimize the management mode and content of power inspection.

articleTitle: Coordinated Frequency Control Strategy of PMSG-Based Offshore Wind Farm Connected by VSC-HVDC System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Long-distance large-scale offshore wind farms integrated to the onshore system grid causes a reduction in the inertia of the main grid. Aiming at improving the operation situation of the power system, a coordinated frequency control strategy among offshore wind farms is proposed to improve the operation condition of the power system. In the proposed strategy, the wind turbines (WTs) are considered as the frequency regulation (FR) resources. In the FR process, the participation of offshore wind farms and voltage source converters (VSCs) flexibly adjust active power output to provide effective inertial response of the system. The core idea of the control strategy is that the output active current of the grid-side inverter for the WT is quickly regulated according to the frequency auxiliary control strategy. Finally, the simulation results show that the performance of the proposed strategy can enhance the frequency response of wind power system.

articleTitle: A Transformer Vibration Amplitude Prediction Method Via Fusion Of Multi-Signals
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increase of the electrical equipment in the power system, the operation state of power transformer will further influence the security and stability of the power system. Generally, transformer surface vibration amplitude can indicate the operation status of transformer. So, a transformer surface vibration amplitude prediction model, which considered multi-signals, is proposed in this paper. The proposed method is based on CNN-LSTM model, where CNN is used to complete the feature extraction, and LSTM network is used to predict the transformer surface vibration amplitude through the extracted features. And the modified CNN-LSTM method can handle the multi-signals very well and increases the prediction performance compared with existing LSTM and CNN-LSTM. Followed by analysis, the experimental evaluation validates the claimed advantages of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Coordinated Energy Management Of Networked Microgrids In The Distribution Market
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The networked microgrids (NMGs) not only enhance the reliability of the distribution system but also bring economic benefits to the market entities in the distribution market. However, the coordinated energy management of networked micro grids is a challenge in the market environment. In this paper, a bi-level model is proposed to achieve the coordination of networked micro grids in the distribution market. At the lower level, each microgrid determines its schedule in the day ahead and bids into the distribution market. At the upper level, the distribution system operator (DSO) clears the distribution market through distribution locational marginal price (DLMP). The optimal day-ahead coordination scheme among networked microgrids is obtained iteratively. Numerical results on a modified IEEE 33 system show the effectiveness of the proposed method for solving the coordinated energy management of networked microgrids in the distribution market.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Operation of Energy Storage System for Improving Consumption of High Penetration Distributed Generation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the national improvement to consumption of high penetration distributed generation (DG) and efforts to realize “carbon neutrality & emission peak” targets, this paper proposes a decoupling-based method for optimal operation of energy storage system to improve the consumption of high generation distributed generation. Firstly, the energy storage constraints that enhance DG consumption are decoupled and thus the nonlinear constraints related to grid load flow and voltage are simplified. Then, the lower limit is modified according to the capacity and power constraints of the energy storage system. Finally, a linear programming model for optimal operation of energy storage that satisfies the modified lower limit is established. The case verification proves that this method could increase the DG consumption to the maximum extent and improve the comprehensive benefits of DG and energy storage systems while fulfilling the constraints of energy storage system operation and voltage safety.

articleTitle: Pricing Method in Retail Electricity Market Considering The Fatigue Life of Wind Turbine Gearbox
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The failures of wind turbine gearbox caused by fatigue wear is critical for wind power integrated power system reliability evaluation. Fatigue wear is a general phenomenon and has been gradually become a major concern in many utilities. In pricing method of retail electricity market until now, risk was considered and reliability are ignored. However, fatigue life is a mandatory consideration in price determination of generation system with aged wind turbine. This paper selects MW class wind turbine, building the static load analysis model of gearbox by Abaqus, and then the results are imported into Fe-safe to calculate the gearbox fatigue life, based on S-N curve and Palmgren-Miner linear damage accumulation method. According to the characteristics of aging failures, a mathematical model of failure rate that changes with the age of service is established, after that, the reliability indexes of power generation system are calculated. Finally, EENS index considering gear fatigue life and not considering fatigue life are used to evaluate outage loss and retail electricity market pricing. Considering the fatigue life of gearbox increases the reliability of the power system, the loss caused by system outage and the pricing of retail electricity market will be lower.

articleTitle: Grounding Characteristic Analysis of MVDC Distribution System Based on Matlab Simulink
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The grounding mode of medium voltage direct current (MVDC) distribution system is closely related to the grounding mode of alternating current (AC) distribution system to which it is connected, in addition to factors such as the type of converter, the wiring form of converter, and the system reliability requirement. Based on the analysis and summary of the characteristic of typical grounding modes of AC distribution system and flexible high voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission system, with the goal of reducing fault current and speeding up fault recovery, the characteristics of different grounding modes for MVDC distribution system were studied. This paper presents the typical grounding modes of MVDC distribution system with pseudo bipolar and true bipolar connection, which is composed of modular multilevel converter (MMC) and two /three-level converter and the recommended grounding schemes were given through theoretical and simulation analysis. Lastly, the simulation model of a flexible direct current (DC) distribution system demonstration project was built by MATLAB Simulink. The correctness of the theoretical analysis was verified with simulation, and the result was used in the demonstration project construction.

articleTitle: Optimization Toolbox For Multi-Regional Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, integrated energy system (IES) is becoming more widely used. The development of the simulation platform of integrated energy systems is the foundation of researches on the IES operation. This paper proposes a toolbox for IES optimization based on MATLAB-Simulink platform. The static model library of the toolbox contains modular blocks representing node-level models and network-level models in power, heating and natural gas systems. These modular blocks can be simply dragged and connected to form an IES model on Simulink. And the toolbox can automatically generate constraints in these optimization problems of regional and multi-regional IES, which avoids the repetitive and time-consuming coding process and brings much convenience to users. At the same time, the toolbox can realize the basic optimal power flow solution function, and users can complete the complex power flow calculation through a simple operation. Finally, this paper proves the feasibility and universality of the toolbox by comparing the results of the calculation examples based on the static model library and the results of the manual program.

articleTitle: Strategy of Load Source Joint Wind Power Absorption Based on Mode Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To improve the wind power absorption rate, this paper presents a regulation strategy based on VMD for coordinated elimination of wind power by thermal power unit and battery storage system. Firstly, we discussed the fluctuation characteristics of wind power and the output characteristics of thermal power unit and battery storage system. Then, the VMD variational mode is decomposed according to the equivalent load curve, and the corresponding components of different center frequencies are obtained. The components of different characteristics are adjusted by the output characteristics of thermal power unit and battery storage system correspondingly. Finally, the MATLAB software is used to solve the optimization problem, which has a better effect than the traditional single thermal power unit adjustment.

articleTitle: Neutral Current Suppression for a Common Mode Decoupling Three-phase Transformerless Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: An independently controlled neutral module (ICNM) can be adopted in common mode decoupling three-phase transformerless AC-DC converter. When the load is unbalanced, the neutral line can provide a path for the zero sequence current. The initial control goal of ICNM is to stabilize the neutral voltage. Due to the phase jump of [−180] ° at the resonant frequency of the neutral inductance in the system loop gain and the split DC bus capacitor, the system may be unstable. In order to ensure system stability, inductive current feedback scheme (ICFS) can be adopted. Firstly, the equivalent circuit and basic control method of ICNM are proposed in this paper. Then, the stability of the original control is analyzed. Finally, an ICFS method to improve system stability is proposed..

articleTitle: The Method of Circuit Breaker Interrupting Capacity Verification Considering Breaking Sequences
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In view of the problem that only considers the total current of the short circuit point instead of the probable maximum short circuit current in breaking capacity checking practice of current circuit breaker, the influence of the breaking sequence of side circuit breakers and branch circuit breakers on the short-circuit current through the circuit breaker is analyzed, a new idea for the selection of the circuit breaker interrupting capacity is provided. Taking Tianyi Substation as an example, the maximum short-circuit current in the branch of the circuit breaker and the total current of the short-circuit point were calculated. The case study shows that the breaking capacity of the circuit breaker should not be checked by the total current of the short circuit because it needs higher breaking capacity of circuit breaker.

articleTitle: Optimal Configuration of Energy Storage System of Multi-Station Fusion Model Considering Renewable Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper focuses on a novel model named multi-station fusion (MSF). The proposed model integrates transformer substation, data center, energy storage system (ESS), electric vehicle charging station (EVCS), connection information base station and other systems. It aims at improving the utilization rate of the spare space in the existing substation, reducing operation and maintenance cost, and increasing the revenue of power grid enterprises. This paper studies the optimal configuration method of ESS in the MSF model, aiming at reducing total cost and increasing revenue. Firstly, a typical MSF model is established. Then, aiming at the economy, the optimal configuration model of ESS is established. On the basis of replacing UPS, the energy storage system gains revenue by signing an agreement with the renewable energy plant to reduce renewable energy curtailment. Finally, the effectiveness of the model is verified by a practical example, and the MATLAB toolbox YALMIP with the CPLEX solver is used to conduct the ESS planning.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Voltage Doubling Rectifier Circuit in High Voltage DC Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The voltage doubling rectifier circuit is an important part of the high voltage DC power supply. This article introduces the basic working principles of CW voltage doubling circuit, symmetrical CW voltage doubling circuit and positive and negative bidirectional voltage doubling circuit, and analyzes and compares the characteristics of the three voltage doubling rectifier circuits. On this basis, a symmetrical CW voltage doubling circuit was selected as the rectifier boost circuit of the DC high voltage power supply, and a system simulation model was built in Simulink. The simulation results show that the output voltage ripple coefficient of the designed DC high voltage power supply is less than 0.1%, which meets the application requirements and has strong engineering guiding significance.

articleTitle: Consistency Evaluation of Retired Power Battery Based on the Analytic Hierarchy Process Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The security of cascade utilization and the complexity of scene matching remain to be solved. These problems Related to the consistency evaluation of retired batteries. In order to cover the important characteristics of the battery, this paper adopts the multi-parameter evaluation factor, which uses the capacity increment to extract the life characteristics. Then the AHP + entropy weight method evaluation model is used to calculate the weight ranking of each evaluation factor to achieve consistency evaluation and comparison.

articleTitle: Short-Term Load Forecasting Based on Modified Locally Linear Embedding Using Multiple Weights
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel short-term load forecasting method by using a manifold learning algorithm—modified local linear embedding (MLLE). By taking the 24h load data as a 24-dimensional data set, the intrinsic properties and overall geometric laws of high-dimensional data were extracted by manifold learning method MLLE to reduce dimension, and the load prediction was carried out in low-dimensional space. Finally, the 24-hour load prediction was obtained by using MLLE reconstruction. Simulation results show that that the method proposed in this paper has high prediction accuracy and stable prediction results.

articleTitle: A Path Analysis of Electric Heating Technology Based on Entropy Weight Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As northern China to promote large-scale electric heating, at present there are mainly adopts centralized household electrical heating and decentralized household electric heating in two forms. However, in areas with different heat transmission facilities and different power grid access capabilities, how to reasonably determine the electrical heating technology path, ensure users satisfaction and optimize the investment level has gradually become a normalized problem. This paper investigates the existing typical demonstration projects of electric heating and the extended projects, summarizes the key technology characteristics of electric heating project and put forward comprehensive evaluation index system. On this basis, the advantages and disadvantages of different technical routes are measured based on entropy weight method, so that the appropriate technical routes can be given in different regional contexts. Finally, a practical case study verifies the effectiveness of the research results.

articleTitle: Optimized Operation of Distribution Network with Photovoltaic Power Generation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Solar power plays an important role in the transition to a low-carbon energy system, especially in the context of China's latest carbon peaking and neutralization policy. Since the efficiency of Photovoltaic (PV) generation is fundamentally determined by weather conditions, it is characterized by uncertainty, intermittency and constant fluctuation. All these characteristics would pose significant threats to the operational security and stability of the power system. Therefore, it is essential to investigate the optimized operation of distribution network considering the integration of PV generation. For this sake, this paper proposes a novel PV generation modelling framework by applying the concept of “clearness index”, which can effectively capture the output characteristics of PV generation in the short term. Based on this model, this paper establishes an optimization model of distribution network operation, which takes PV plants into consideration. Through a series of case studies tested on the REDS-32 system. It is found that in order to ensure the economic operation of DN, PV power has to be curtailed under certain conditions.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization Technology of Turn to Turn Protection Considering Saturation of High Voltage Bus Shunt Reactor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The high-voltage bus shunt reactor is easy to be saturated under the superposition of low-frequency current components. The electrical characteristics of reactor saturation and inter turn short circuit are similar. The traditional inter turn protection has the risk of misoperation. In this paper, an optimization method of turn to turn protection considering reactor saturation is proposed. Considering the possibility of reactor saturation, a criterion based on the center offset of magnetization curve is constructed. Together with the traditional turn to turn protection criterion, the turn to turn protection is formed to prevent the misoperation of turn to turn protection during reactor saturation and accurately identify reactor saturation and turn to turn short circuit. PSCAD simulation is used to verify the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Optimal Energy Flow Calculation for Integrated Electric-Gas Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Gas turbines can quickly respond to the fluctuation of new energy power generation, and electric - gas integrated energy system has attracted more and more attention. This paper presents a fast solution model of optimal energy flow in electrical integrated energy system based on machine learning. Firstly, the dynamic partial differential equation of natural gas is processed based on the difference method; Then the optimization model is established to generate training data; Neural network is used to fit the relationship between load and generator output. Finally, the model is verified in 13 bus power system and 7 bus natural gas system. Under the condition of ensuring certain accuracy, the solution time is greatly reduced.

articleTitle: High-frequency Isolated and Large Capacity Power Conversion System Based on SiC MOSFET
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the interface between energy storage device and power grid, power conversion system plays an important role in the stable operation of power grid. In order to meet the development demand of large capacity energy storage system, a high frequency, isolated and large capacity power conversion system based on the new topology scheme of cascade H-bridge and common high frequency bus is proposed. The power device of SiC MOSFET is used to further improve the transmission capacity of the power conversion system. The isolated DAB structure is used between the cascaded H-bridge module and the battery unit, which effectively inhibits the secondary pulsating current and provides a better operating environment for the battery. On this basis, the working principle and characteristics of the power conversion system are analyzed in detail. Finally, a prototype with rated power of 1MW is designed for experimental verification, and the experimental results prove the feasibility of the proposed power conversion system.

articleTitle: Research on Double Active Clamping Single Staged Backward AC-AC Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the development and status of solid state transformers, a class of double-active clamping single-stage anti-excitation AC-AC converter is proposed. The circuit structure of double-active clamping single-stage anti-excitation AC-AC converter is designed. The circuit is a Buck-Boost circuit topology. Through leakage inductance and capacitance resonance, the clamping purpose is achieved. Relying on high-frequency switching tubes and zero-voltage switching tubes to realize energy transformation. The parameters of the energy storage transformer, the output filter capacitance parameters and the voltage current stress of the switching device are designed and calculated in detail. The main circuit of dual active clamped single-stage flyback AC-AC converter is studied in detail, and the simulation analysis of the designed converter is made. The simulation results show that the proposed converter has strong carrying load capacity and can adapt well to load mutation and power source mutation.

articleTitle: Active Optimization Arc Suppression Method Based on Cascaded H-Bridge Converter for Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The residual fault current of active voltage-based arc suppression (AVAS) method is affected easily by the load current in case of low-resistance ground (LRG) fault, and the active current-based arc suppression (ACAS) method is difficult to suppress the fault phase recovery voltage effectively in case of high-resistance ground (HRG) fault. In both cases, the single-phase-to-ground (SPG) fault arc cannot be expressed reliably, leading to the expansion of accidents. An active optimization arc suppression (AOAS) method is proposed to address the problems. The ACAS method that is less affected by load current can be used for LRG fault, and the AVAS method that can suppress the fault phase recovery voltage effectively can be used for HRG fault. The cascaded H-bridge converter (CHB) is used to inject current into the neutral-point of distribution networks for fault resistance estimation and arc suppression. At the beginning of a SPG fault, the CHB converter injects an interharmonic current into the distribution networks to estimate the fault resistance as a switching threshold of the two arc suppression methods. The simulation indicates that the proposed AOAS method is more adaptable for the change of SPG fault conditions and can optimize the effect of arc suppression.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Resilient Control Strategy of Multiple DERs Considering Unreliable Communication in Active Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Distributed energy resources (DERs), companied with increasing intelligent devices and local controllers, have been developed rapidly in the active distribution network. In the active distribution network, the “plug and play” feature of DERs requires flexible communication links and local control loops, which are susceptible to both communication failures and cyber-attacks. To address this potential problem, an adaptive resilient control strategy of multiple DERs considering unreliable communication is proposed. Both centralized control and distributed control are configured with resilience schemes to adaptively track the control target regardless of communication failures or cyber-attacks. The effectiveness of the proposed control strategy is verified by simulations on IEEE 34-bus system.

articleTitle: Low Frequency Oscillation Damping Strategy for Virtual Synchronous Generator Based on Port Energy Function
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increase of penetration rate of renewable energy and the installed capacity of power electronic devices in the modern power system, inertia of the whole power system is obviously reduced, and stability of the power system is going to face more and more severe challenges than before. Converter is one kind of power electronic interface between the renewable energy and the power grid. For their considerable amount and widely distributed locations, their dynamic characteristics will play an extremely important role in the stability of the system. Virtual synchronous generator (VSG) is a well-known control strategy of the converter, which artificially slows down the transient process by introducing virtual rotor motion equations. Some research has already investigated its contribution to damp low frequency oscillation (LFO) of the system. This paper proposes a novel strategy according to the port energy function concept. With extra phase and amplitude correction terms, the proposed strategy reduces the exchange energy between the VSG and the system and thus eliminates the LFO with better performance. Simulation results via the PSCAD/EMTDC software verify the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Feature Recognition Technology of Substation Inspection Image
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The task of target detection is to locate and classify the detected objects in the image. Applying it to the power inspection reduces the manpower and time consumption, improves the efficiency of the inspection work, and is of great significance to ensure the reliability of the power system operation. In this paper, the Faster R-CNN method is applied to the state detection of cotter pins. And the detection process is divided into two parts. The first part is the image preprocessing part, which will expand the date set by adding noise, sharpening, and shadowing on the original date. The cotter pins can be marked by the labeling tool Labelimage. The second part realizes the state detection of the cotter pin by Faster R-CNN model. The target candidate area is closer to the true value because of the unique RPN technology of the Faster R-CNN network. On the basis of the Faster R-CNN network, the update weight adopts L2 regularity to reduce the impact of over-fitting, which also solves the problems of gradient dispersion and gradient explosion to a certain extent. The Tensorflow's deep learning framework is applied in the experiment test to realize the location and classification of the four states: normal cotter pin, cotter pin not split, cotter pin single leg out, and cotter pin missing. The experimental results verify the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Reseach on Optimization of RFID Indoor Positioning Algorithm Based on RSSI
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The problems of RFID indoor positioning algorithm LANDMARC are optimized. In view of the abnormal correlation degree of local reference tags in this algorithm, this paper repairs the correlation degree of bad tags. Aiming at the problem of label misselection in the process of selecting adjacent labels, an improvement of minimum target area block was proposed to reduce the influence of bad labels, and then the location of target labels was estimated. Simulation results show that the proposed optimization scheme is significantly improved compared with the original algorithm, the positioning accuracy is increased by 22%, and the maximum error is reduced by 27%.

articleTitle: Blockchain Based Secure Decentralized Energy Management System for Interconnected Vehicular Power Electronic Transformer Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power Electronic Transformers (PET) offers enormous flexibility for the integration ability of renewable resources, grid, loads and energy storage systems in one device. Due to the development trend of vehicle electrification, vehicular PETs and their interconnected network are promising solutions for the future military mobile power supply. Energy management system (EMS) is crucial for the normal operation and energy routing optimization of such systems. Based on which, the most important premise for EMS is safety and invulnerability. This paper proposes a blockchain based secure distributed EMS framework and its application scheme, which features distributed database sharing and practical byzantine fault tolerance (PBFT) consensus decision. The resilience and robustness of this system are verified by experimental results when encountering communication interruption and malicious data modification.

articleTitle: Control Strategy of Hybrid Energy Storage in Large-Scale Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The large-scale access of renewable energy sources such as wind power will affect the operation and dispatch of the power system, and will affect the safe and stable of the power grid. The ESS has the ability to respond quickly, which can reduce the impact of wind power on the grid. Based on a hybrid energy storage with a certain capacity, a corresponding rolling optimization control strategy is proposed. Using batteries and super capacitor as energy storage media, an optimal control model targeting the state of charge of the hybrid energy storage system is established, and the solution is solved by a particle swarm optimization algorithm. The simulation example shows that a HESS with a certain capacity on the generation side can achieve a smooth grid connection. The control strategy proposed in this paper extends the service life of the battery.

articleTitle: Research on Capacity Configuration of Wind/Solar/Thermal Power and Energy Storage Complementary for UHVDC Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper studies the capacity configuration of wind/solar/thermal power and energy storage complementary for UHVDC transmission system using time-series production simulation method. The influence of several aspects, such as operation mode, thermal power capacity, renewable energy capacity and wind/solar proportion, power curve of the transmission system, energy storage capacity and time length, on the percentage of renewable energy generation capacity, the utilization hour of UHVDC transmission system and the utilization rate of renewable energy are analyzed. Finally, several suggestions of the capacity configuration on wind/solar/thermal power sources and energy storage complementary are put forward.

articleTitle: Modelling in Integrated Energy Trading System Under an Incentive-Compatible Market Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, carbon neutrality and sustainable development have become the key issue of social construction and development. The traditional single energy system can not meet the needs of energy sustainable development under the background of energy shortage because of its low energy efficiency. Multi-energy system generally includes electricity energy subsystem, thermal energy subsystem (heating and cooling), gas energy subsystem and other energy subsystems. The integrated energy system (IES) proposed in this paper integrates the energy of electricity, gas, heating, and cooling. At the same time, this paper proposes an integrated energy scheduling mechanism based on Vickrey-Clarke-Groves (VCG) auction. In the auction, users submit their energy demand data to the auctioneer, and then the energy hub (EH) provider completes the energy allocation through optimal scheduling, and decides the amount of payment of users, which proves that the auction mechanism has incentive compatibility property. It means that users will report their energy demand data. Cases studies are conducted to evaluate the energy optimization performance of the IES, and verify the economy of the auction mechanism.

articleTitle: Wind farm Planning Considering Output Uncertainty Under Carbon Emission Reduction Target
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Developing wind power and increasing the proportion of renewable energy in the installed capacity is an important means to achieve carbon emission reduction in the power system. Due to the uncertainty of wind turbines output, it will bring negative effects to the safe and stable operation of the power grid. Therefore, the above factors should be considered in the planning of wind farms. Firstly, the functions of carbon emission reduction cost, fuel cost, wind abandoning cost and wind power fluctuation cost are established. Then, the Beta distribution function and Metropolis sampling method are used to simulate the time-series grid connected power of wind farms, and a wind power planning model considering the output uncertainty under the carbon emission reduction goal is constructed. Then the ant colony algorithm is used to solve the model with the lowest comprehensive cost as the objective function. Finally, the validity of the proposed model is verified by IEEE30 Buses system.

articleTitle: Correlation-based Bad Data Detection of PMU Measurements for Improving Network Structure with High Penetration of Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In power grids, phasor measurement units (PMUs) are universally installed, while the existence of bad PMU data endangers the monitoring and control of power systems. Firstly, this paper describes the problem of bad PMU data detection. Then, the PMU time-series measurements from two neighboring buses are presented as a 2D diagram, where the spatio-temporal correlation analysis is conducted to solve the problem of recognizing normal data and outliers. The density-based detector DBSCAN is utilized for data clustering and bad PMU data detection. The diagram-based bad data detection method proposed in this paper is unsupervised and used to detect bad PMU data online with short computation time. Numerical and visualized results of case study on the proposed method performance are shown.

articleTitle: Distinction and Conversion Between Frequency Oscillation Mode and Rotor Angle Oscillation Mode
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In power system stability classification, rotor angle oscillation and frequency oscillation belong to dynamic rotor angle stability and small-disturbance frequency stability respectively. In existing studies, coherent oscillation of generator speeds is regarded as the key feature that distinguishes frequency oscillation from rotor angle oscillation, but there is a lack of in-depth investigation. The characteristics and variations of oscillation modes in a typical two-area system are analyzed in the paper. When the electrical connection between the two areas becomes very weak, the phase and amplitude differences between the speeds of the two generator groups in the frequency oscillation mode become notable, and they are no longer coherent. Moreover, as the electrical connection between the two areas becomes weak, the inter-area rotor angle oscillation mode converts into the frequency oscillation mode of one area, and the original global frequency oscillation mode converts into the frequency oscillation mode of the other area. This corresponds to that the original interconnected synchronous system turns into two non-interconnected synchronous systems. Therefore, strictly speaking, generator speed coherency is not the essential distinction between frequency oscillation mode and rotor angle oscillation mode. However, in the range of actual power grid parameters, the distinction is still valid and can be used in engineering. The results are helpful to understand the difference and relationship between frequency oscillation mode and rotor angle oscillation mode.

articleTitle: Fast Power Flow Calculation Method for Electricity Hydrogen Storage Integrated Energy Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power system has developed significantly because of the increasing share of renewable energy sources (RESs). Despite the advantages, they also bring inevitable challenges to power system stability. Hydrogen energy plays an indispensable role in the process of energy transformation. This paper presents fast power flow calculation method for integrated energy network which contains PV, wind farm and hydrogen storage system. Energy hub model is developed to analyze the interaction between the power system and hydrogen system in steady-state operation. The mathematical model includes power grid, hydrogen network, PV and wind generation, hydrogen storage system, energy hub and power loss. Gauss-Seidel iterate method and Newton-Raphson method are applied to calculate the power flow calculation model of integrated energy system. Finally, a calculation example is used to verify the effectiveness of the proposed model and calculation algorithm.

articleTitle: Evaluation Method of System Dominant Instability form Based on Fuzzy Evaluation Function
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For the sake of economy, the operation point of power system is more and more close to the stable boundary, so that the phenomenon of power angle instability and voltage instability are not all appearing separately in power system. Identifying which is the dominant instability form has certain guiding significance for stability control. In this paper, the mechanism of power angle instability and voltage instability and five stability evaluation indexes are analyzed firstly. Then based on the fuzzy evaluation function, a power system dominant stable form evaluation method is proposed. Finally, the correctness of this evaluation method is verified on the IEEE39 system.

articleTitle: A Directional Protection Scheme for Collector Lines of DFIG-Based Wind Farm Using Positive-Sequence Equivalent Impedance Comparison
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In case of a fault occurring in the collector line system, the overcurrent protection has the possibility of operation-rejection and the traditional directional element cannot determine the faulty collector line correctly due to the employment of various low voltage ride through (LVRT) schemes for the doubly-fed induction generators (DFIGs). Therefore, it is necessary to distinguish the faulty collector line using other fault characteristics of the DFIG. In this paper, the positive-sequence equivalent impedance of the DFIG based on the fault component principle is analyzed first. Then a novel directional protection scheme based on the impedance comparison is proposed. Solely depending on the amplitude difference between the faulty line's and healthy line's positive-sequence equivalent impedance, the proposed protection scheme can differentiate the faulty line correctly on the one hand and has a low requirement on the capability of communication on the other hand. The effectiveness of the proposed scheme is verified by extensive simulation results.

articleTitle: Information-Flow-Based Cyber - Physical Testbed for Power System Considering Cyber Contingency
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Cyber system, including state prediction and control systems, are playing a more important role in modern power system. On the other hand, the safe operation of power system is depending more on the cyber system, and contingencies on the cyber side may have larger impact on the power system. Therefore, it is necessary to consider the cyber system along with the physical system and co-simulation and security assessment. An information flow-based cyber system model is established to simulate the possible impact of cyber contingencies on the physical system. A testbed system is built, and case study on the automatic voltage control system in IEEE-14 bus system shows that the proposed model can be adopted in cyber-physical co-simulation and show the potential impact of cyber system contingencies on power system operation.

articleTitle: Analysis And Decision-Making Of Excess Renewable Energy Consumption Trading Between Electricity Retailers Based On Evolutionary Game
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The excess renewable energy consumption trading is one of the supplementary trading ways to promote the fulfillment of the responsibility of renewable energy consumption in China. To aim at the problem of how the market participants to understand and accept the excess consumption trade, a transaction decision-making method based on evolutionary game theory is proposed in the paper. Next, the paper analyses the influence of different factors such as the incentive and punishment measures for renewable energy consumption, the green certificate price and the transaction price of excess consumption on the willingness and enthusiasm of electricity retailers to participate in excess consumption trading. Analysis and simulation results show that the appropriate deregulation of regulatory incentives, higher green certificates price and reasonable excess consumption trading price can promote the cooperation between the retailers, which is conducive to the realization of excess consumption trading.

articleTitle: Energy Storage Requirement of Future Chinese Power System: Multi Scenario Analysis Towards 2050
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy storage (ES) can provide effective support for power balance between fluctuating generation units and load demand. Prediction of ES requirement is important to the planning and design of future high proportion renewable energy (RE) grids. This paper presents a calculation method of ES requirement for future power system considering the uncertainty of development pattern based on multi scenario analysis, whose results are given in the form of probability distribution. Based on the case study of Chinese power system, ES power and energy capacity requirement from 2025 to 2050 are given, and the influence of some key factors is discussed. Besides, specific ES requirement results under three typical RE development scenarios of China are analyzed.

articleTitle: Modeling and Control of Photovoltaic Hydrogen Production System Adapting to Power Fluctuations
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
