abstract: Aiming at the problems of photovoltaic (PV) generation power fluctuation and light abandonment, the model and control strategy of PV hydrogen production system are proposed in this paper. A mathematical models of PV cell, buck converter, and proton exchange membrane water electrolyzer (PEMWE) are established. To improve the efficiency of the PV hydrogen production system, the Maximum power point tracking (MPPT) control is proposed for the PV hydrogen production system by the conductivity increment method. The effectiveness of the proposed photovoltaic hydrogen production system and the proposed control method is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Optimal Operation Of Battery Energy Storage System In Industrial Park
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: An industrial park containing distributed generations (DGs) can be seen as a microgrid. Due to the uncertainty and intermittency of the output of DGs, it is necessary to add battery energy storage system (BESS) in industrial parks. The battery state of health (SOH) is an important indicator of battery life. It is necessary to fully consider the battery SOH during the energy optimization of industrial parks. In this work, a two-stage model suitable for charge and discharge optimization of BESSs in industrial park microgrids is proposed. The first stage of the model is a charge and discharge scheduling of a BESS considering the SOH. This stage mainly schedules the charge and discharge time and the total amount of time. The second stage of the model is employed to further determine the charge and discharge allocation of all battery packs to achieve BESS life prolongation. The experimental results show that the introduction of SOH makes the scheduling results more realistic. Also, it balances the changes in the SOHs of all battery packs.

articleTitle: Time Series Updating Forecasting Method Of Energy Consumption Based On VMD-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the background of “Carbon peaking, Carbon neutralization”, in order to effectively control the future carbon emissions, it is necessary to accurately and quickly predict the regional energy consumption in the short term. Therefore, this paper proposed an energy consumption prediction method based on VMD-LSTM. In order to solve the problem of large change rate of short-term energy consumption and noise in the consumption curve, the energy consumption curve was decomposed into multiple intrinsic mode functions (IMFs) and reconstructed by variational mode decomposition (VMD). The reconstructed curve was evaluated by noise reduction evaluation index. The energy consumption curve after noise reduction was forecasted by long-short term memory network (LSTM) and updated the network by real value in each step. The results of simulation that forecasted the power consumption showed that the energy consumption prediction method based on VMD-LSTM can accurately predict the short-term energy consumption with shorter time, and can provide guidance for the effective planning and control of carbon emissions.

Author Keywords: time series updating forecasting of energy consumption

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimal Control of DFIG for Unbalanced Grid Voltage
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A multi-objective optimization control strategy based on artificial bee colony algorithm for unbalanced grid voltage doubly-fed induction generators (DFIG) is proposed to simultaneously suppress active power, reactive power double-frequency oscillations and stator current negative sequence components. The multi-objective function is established, and the multi-objective function is iteratively optimized through the artificial bee colony algorithm to obtain the optimal rotor negative-sequence current command value, and realize the multi-objective optimization control of the vector control DFIG. The simulation results verify the effectiveness of the DFIG multi-objective optimization control strategy.

articleTitle: The Subarea Aggregation Model of Fast Charging Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of electric vehicles in the future transportation network, it is necessary to aggregate the flexibility of scattered, small capacity and uncertain electric vehicles to make electric vehicles become the temporal and spatial flexibility resources in power grid dispatching. In this paper, a subarea aggregation model of fast charging electric vehicles to be charged as flexible loads is established. By adjusting the price of charging stations, electric vehicle drivers can be guided to change their choice of charging stations, thus improving the spatial distribution of charging loads. The aggregation model incorporates three dimensions: time coupling, space coupling, and drivers' charging decision randomness. The electric vehicles' power and energy flexibility in each area is described, where the robust method is employed to ensure the feasibility of disaggregation. Case studies validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Data-driven Robust Planning Method for Integrated Energy System Considering Uncertainty of Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Because renewable energy is highly random and intermittent, the large-scale grid connection of renewable energy grid will seriously affect the safeness and invulnerability of the power system. The development of integrated energy system (IES) can solve this problem. With the goal of minimizing investment and operating costs, a data-driven scenario-based robust planning method for IES considering the uncertainty of renewable energy is proposed. The proposed model is solved by column and constraint generation (CC&G) algorithm. The results show that the data-driven robust model can provide flexible decision-making schemes based on a larger confidence level when the information is limited and improve the system economy.

articleTitle: An Improved Model for Hydrogen Production by Alkaline Water Electrolysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The hydrogen will be the most widely used renewable energy in the future. In this paper, we develop an improved equivalent electrical model of hydrogen production by alkaline water electrolysis based on the experimental data. Furthermore, related influence factors about hydrogen production efficiency are studied. Based on this, an optimal control strategy is proposed to ensure the high efficiency. All the conclusions analyses are verified by the experiments.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis of electromagnetic protection for live operation robot control box
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a simulation study on the electromagnetic protection of the control chassis of a live working robot is presented, and an electromagnetic protection control cabinet with a certain shielding efficiency is designed, meanwhile the influence of the shape, size, number, interval and other factors of the box hole on the shielding efficiency are taken into consideration. The ANSYS simulation of the hole electromagnetic coupling model verifies that the design has high accuracy and shielding efficiency, and the simulation results prove that the electromagnetic environment in the designed chassis is far lower than the domestic and foreign standards, and the charged robot can complete various work demands in this environment, which has good engineering practicability.

articleTitle: Simulation on Anti-Islanding Protection of Distributed PV Inverter Based on RT-LAB and Smart TTU Device
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In view of the situation that it is difficult to evaluate the effectiveness of islanding protection after distributed photovoltaic (PV) connected to rural distribution network, a criterion for islanding detection based on the offset of harmonic voltage and frequency was proposed, which was applied to the smart Transformer Terminal Unit (TTU) in low voltage transformer area. The laboratory power hardware-in-loop (PHIL) simulation platform was built to verify the anti-islanding protection function of a 10kW distributed PV inverter. Then, based on RT-LAB, a typical rural network in Northern Hebei was built to evaluate the effectiveness of the anti-islanding protection of inverter under different working conditions.

articleTitle: Net-Zero Carbon Intelligent Energy System based on Multiple Energy Integration
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid improvement of research and development of low-carbon and energy technologies, innovative technologies are becoming the critical drivers to lead the transformation of the energy industry and achieve the carbon peak and neutrality goals. A novel net-zero carbon intelligent energy system (NZIES) is proposed based on multi-energy integration, and a new analytic architecture is designed and proposed with T3-Cube transformation strategy model and four-flow value chain analysis framework. Finally, the energy pyramid methodology provides practical support for the planning and construction of intelligent energy system. Focusing on the integration of green, clean energy technologies, and digital innovation will bring new growth poles for the upgrade of the energy industry.

articleTitle: Impact Evaluation of HVDC System Control on Short-term Voltage Recovery Characteristics of Receiving-end Grid
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the construction of UHVDC project, the dynamic reactive power source mainly composed of thermal power units in the load center of power grid is gradually decreasing, which poses a serious threat to the short-term voltage security of the receiving-end power grid. Considering the high-capacity transmission and fast response performance of HVDC system during fault, it is beneficial to solve the short-term voltage stability problem of receiving-end grid of new type power system by actively exploring and utilizing the control flexibility of HVDC system. This paper analyzes in detail the short-term voltage recovery process of receiving-end grid and the influence mechanism of HVDC key control parameters on short-term voltage recovery, and proposes a short-term voltage index for quantitative evaluation. Based on the improved IEEE 39 bus model with HVDC system, the influence of key control parameters of HVDC system is quantitatively evaluated.

articleTitle: Active Equalization Circuit and Control Design of Series Battery Pack Based on Single Inductance
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The battery pack is built by a number of battery cells in series and parallel connection. The inconsistencies inhered in cells during the process of manufacturing and operation will inevitably lead to the reduced capacity, attenuated cycle life and failure of entire battery pack. To solve the inconsistence problems in simple and easy way, a single-inductor-based active balancing circuit topology for series battery packs is proposed in this paper. The balancing circuit includes a series battery pack, an energy storage inductor, and the switching network, battery management system, controller and one switch drive circuit. Based on the analysis of the working principle of the main circuit, an equilibrium control strategy based on SOC is further proposed. The simulation experiment validates the effectiveness of the proposed active balancing circuit and control method for the series battery pack with the main role of a single inductor.

articleTitle: Low-order Harmonic Suppressing Method of Renewable Energy Integration Through VSC-HVDC
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Voltage sourced converter based high voltage direct current (VSC-HVDC) transmission technology has been widely used in renewable energy integration and consumption. However, the control loops coupling leads to potential instability to the renewable energy transmission system through VSC-HVDC. This paper focuses on the low-order harmonic and analyze the reasons of oscillation by impedance scanning test method. A low-order harmonic suppressing method has been proposed by adjusting the proportions parameter of voltage control loop in the AC voltage and frequency control side of VSC-HVDC to improve the impedance matching characteristic. The hardware in-loop simulation results of Zhangbei VSC-based DC grid project with integration of large-scale renewable energy verify the correctness of analysis of low-order oscillation and the proposed low-order harmonic suppressing method.

articleTitle: Congestion Assessment in Electric Vehicle Fast Charging Stations for Coupled Traffic-Power Systems in Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Electric Vehicles (EVs) have been long recognized as a promising way for greenhouse gas (GHG) reduction and fossil fuel substitution. The growing EV charging demand and the increasing charging power may cause charging queues and overloads, threatening the safe operation of both traffic and power systems. This paper proposes an approach for the congestion assessment in fast charging stations (FCSs) due to large-scale integration of EVs in coupled traffic-power systems of smart cities. Queuing theory is utilized to model the formulation and evaluation of the spatial-temporal varying charging queues in fast charging stations. The impact of power system operation on traffic congestion in FCSs is discussed. The system studies demonstrate that the limited EV charging power may deteriorate the traffic congestions at FCSs.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis Method of Power Transformer Based on Graph Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Artificial neural networks are often used on transformer fault diagnosis. It takes the independent characteristic gas content or gas ratio as the input parameter, lacks the consideration of the correlation between gases. To solve this problem, a transformer fault diagnosis method based on graph neural network(GNN) is proposed in this paper. Relationship between gases is described by a directed graph. For the advantages on dealing with unstructured data, A GNN is designed in this paper to extract correlations characteristic between gases. The relationship between the gas characteristics and the fault type is established by a multi-layer linear neural network, then, the fault type is finally determined. The experimental results show that, compared with the methods using convolutional neural network(CNN), multilayer perceptron(MLP), K-nearest neighbor(KNN) and support vector machine(SVM), the method proposed in this paper achieves deep extraction of gas characteristics and improves diagnosis accuracy for each fault type of power transformers.

articleTitle: Design of Deterministic Transmission Framework for Distributed Power System Based on Digital Twin
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy networking and intelligence have jointly promoted the development of distributed power systems. As humankind's largest and most complex industrial system so far, the power system has higher requirements for the real-time performance of data transmission. The distributed power system based on digital twin technology realizes real-time monitoring and accurate system load forecasting through intelligent perception, real-time transmission, virtual-real interaction, artificial intelligence, and other technologies. Based on the design of digital twin technology, this paper proposes a TSN configuration method for information interaction on the virtual and real sides of the distributed power generation system. This method modifies the transmission standard of the data link layer in the original IEC61850 standard, which can effectively reduce the response time in the communication process and improve the certainty of control information flow transmission.

articleTitle: Research on Zero Sequence Circulating Current Suppression of Parallel Inverter System with Common AC and DC Bus
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The parallel inverter system with common AC and DC bus has the advantages of small size, low cost and high reliability. However, due to the inconsistency of switch status and main circuit parameters, zero sequence circulating current will be generated between inverters, which will cause serious distortion of grid-connected current, increase of system loss, and decrease of efficiency. This paper focuses on the research on zero-sequence circulating current suppression of parallel inverter systems with common AC and DC bus. First, the zero-sequence circulating current model of parallel inverters is analyzed, and the reasons for the generation of zero-sequence circulating current are analyzed. The circulation suppression method with zero-sequence component feedforward based on traditional PI control is proposed. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed control method is verified by simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Electrical Analysis and Calculation Module for Integrated Power Grid Planning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of low efficiency of analysis and evaluation and non-standard standards caused by offline collection and offline calculation methods of distribution network planning data for a long time, this paper designs an electrical analysis and calculation module of integrated power grid planning, including electrical calculation model modeling, electrical calculation algorithm and electrical calculation application. Application example shows that the proposed electrical calculation module has good practicability, and can support the daily work of planning such as current grid diagnosis and analysis, future grid planning, and grid verification.

articleTitle: A Novel Bypass MMC Sub-module Topology And Its Capacitor Voltage Balancing Strategy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The modular multilevel converter (MMC) develops rapidly in HVDC system relying on its various advantages. However, the widely used half-bridge sub-module (HBSM) cannot block the DC fault, which reduces the reliability and availability of the MMC-HVDC system. This paper classifies the existing sub modules with DC fault blocking capability, then proposes a new topology, diode clamp dual half-bridge sub-module (DCDHB), which comprises of two half-bridge submodules and its clamp circuit. Comparative studies on DC fault blocking capacity and device costs for different topologies are conducted. Aiming at the unbalanced capacitor voltage of the bypass topology, a capacitor voltage balancing strategy is proposed. The superiorities of DCDHB in DC fault blocking capability and the effectiveness of the capacitor voltage balancing strategy is verified by MATLAB/Simulink simulation.

Author Keywords: DC pole to pole short circuit

articleTitle: Short-term Wind Speed forecasting Based on Weighted Spatial Correlation and Improved GWO-GBRT algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy transformation and development is a major issue that the international community urgently needs to implement, many countries develop wind power industry energetically. However, the uncertainty of wind has been a huge challenge for wind power generation. In this paper, a spatial correlation wind speed forecasting model based on weighted grey correlation analysis model and improved gradient boosting regression tree algorithm is proposed to evaluate and forecast wind resources. The coefficient of variation method was employed to obtain the weight of spatial correlation wind speed information, and the wind speed at reference points selected based on the weighted grey relational degree were input into the gradient boosting regression tree (GBRT) to build a forecasting model. In addition, the GBRT parameters were optimized by the improved grey wolf optimization (IGWO) algorithm before the model was used to perform wind speed and direction forecasting. The experimental results show that the improved forecasting algorithm has high accuracy and real-time, thus having research and practical value.

articleTitle: Industry Community And Core Industry Detection Base On Electricity Consumption Data
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the fact that electricity consumption is an objective indicator of industrial activities, an assumption is made that the relationship of the daily electricity consumption volume curves of different industries is an energy projection of their economic connections. On this basis, a procedure is proposed for clustering analysis of industry electricity consumption. In this procedure, community detection is at first performed on electricity volume data of different industry consumers. The entire industry can be divided into several communities with meanings of economics. Then, PageRank values of industries in a certain community are computed and ranked. Core industries and the industry correlation structure can be obtained in this step. Finally, clustering of related industries can be obtained by sorting distances between selected core industry node and its neighbor nodes. The procedure is performed and verified with daily industry electricity consumption volume data of Xiaoshan District. It can be inferred from the result that electricity consumption volume clustering could provide not only a perspective for industry economy analysis, but also a potential to improve electricity consumption prediction and even power planning.

articleTitle: A Vulnerability Identification Method of Power System Based on Infomap Community Discovery Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Large-scale blackouts are often caused by cascading failures. When some components in the power system fail, they often spread and eventually cause serious accidents. Therefore, the analysis and research on the vulnerable parts of power system can help improve the overall robustness of power grid. Based on the N-1 safety test of power system, correlation matrix is constructed to quantify the relationship between different lines. We construct a directed weighted correlation network which can consider both static topology and dynamic power flow information of power system. For the correlation network, Infomap community discovery algorithm is used to divide the grid community, and the interaction between different power system components is visualized to obtain the community with the highest vulnerability level. Finally, we adopt cascading failures simulation and find that almost all the fault chains appear in the communities with the highest vulnerability. Therefore, the correlation network obtained by N-1 security test can dig out the scope of chain faults, which provides guidance for the rapid identification of vulnerable components in power grid.

articleTitle: A Novel Frequency-RoCoF Islanding Detection Method for Grid-connected Distributed Generation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the relationship between active power shortage and rate of change of frequency (RoCoF), combined with the load frequency characteristic, this paper derives the transient calculation formula of frequency and RoCoF after islanding occurrence in the grid-connected distributed generation system, and gives the setting principle of parameters in RoCoF islanding detection method (IDM). On this basis, a Frequency-RoCoF islanding detection method is proposed and its non-detection zone is calculated. The simulation results verify the accuracy of calculation formula of RoCoF and the feasibility of Frequency-RoCoF IDM.

articleTitle: Economic Optimal Scheduling of Integrated Energy System Considering Integrated Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Firstly, this paper analyzes the typical structure of IES and user side demand response scenarios, and establishes a quantitative model of user side IDR according to the load response modes and load types involved in IDR. Secondly, considering the economy, renewable energy consumption and user demand response, the economic optimal scheduling model of IES considering the comprehensive demand response is established. Then, the transferable and convertible load response ratios are defined, and the flexible IDR strategy is designed based on these parameters. Finally, through setting different scenarios, this paper compares and analyzes the impact of IDR on the system operation cost and renewable energy consumption. The results show that the comprehensive demand response can guide users to reasonably arrange their own energy consumption plan, optimize the demand side resource allocation and promote IES to absorb renewable energy, so as to reduce the operation cost of IES.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation Model of Success Degree of Power Grid Infrastructure Project Based on Entropy Weight Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the improvement of power grid infrastructure projects, the operation of completed projects has become increasingly stable, and how to evaluate the success of the project is worthy of in-depth study. For this reason, a success evaluation model is proposed based on the entropy method. First of all, based on the overall consideration of the project implementation process, effects and benefits, environmental and social benefits, and project sustainability, a success evaluation system has been established. On this basis, a reasonable weight is allocated based on all evaluation indicators. Finally, take a project as an example for analysis. The experimental results show that the constructed evaluation model can achieve an efficient and objective evaluation of the success of the project under the premise of minimizing the overall calculation workload, to provide guidance and reference for the implementation of infrastructure projects.

articleTitle: Comparison And Analysis of Grid-forming Control Methods of Wind Turbine Converter Under Load Disturbance
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the process of my country's construction of a new power system based on new energy generation, wind power generation has received extensive attention due to its huge development potential. However, as the utilization rate of power electronic devices continues to increase, the frequency stability and voltage support capabilities of the power system have been challenged. This article introduces four grid-connected control methods that adjust the frequency and voltage of the grid by controlling the grid-connected converters of wind turbines. Derive its principle formula and summarize the advantages and disadvantages. Under load disturbance, by observing parameters such as DC voltage and current waveform before saturation, four control methods are qualitatively analyzed. Finally, an IEEE9 bus simulation system was established in MATLAB/Simulink to verify the effectiveness of four different control methods.

articleTitle: Simulation Study Of Photovoltaic Array MPPT Based On Improved CS Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For the photovoltaic array failure in the harsh environment or in the shadow state for a long time the output power decline. This paper proposes an improved CS(Cuckoo Search) algorithm for maximum power point tracking(MPPT). In the improvement of the algorithm, the adaptive step size factor is added into the voltage equation to improve the global optimization ability and local optimization accuracy. At the same time, a simulation model is built based on Matlab/Simulink platform, and the improved CS algorithm is compared with the traditional PSO algorithm and the pre-CS algorithm. The results show that the improved CS algorithm shows relatively fast tracking performance and effectiveness under the shadow condition.

articleTitle: Large-scale Security Constrained Unit Commitment Optimization Method Based on Multiple Strategy Combination of Model Dimension Reduction
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The efficient operation of electricity spot market needs the support of high-performance clearing algorithm. Security-constrained unit commitment (SCUC) is one of the most important programs executed to plan a secure and economical hourly generation schedule. With the expanding of the scale of power grid, more and more generator variables and security constraints have been added in SCUC model. The size and the complexity of large-scale SCUC are often beyond reasonable computing time and resources. This paper introduces an efficient fast SCUC based on model dimension reduction for large-scale and long-term power systems. Model dimension reduction strategy used in the proposed approach include neighboring time interval combine, inactive generator state variables identification and inactive security constraints identification. A reasonable multiple strategy combination of model dimension reduction is explored. Then the number of unit variables, security constraints and time intervals can be reduced so as to lower the goal of solving dimensions. A modified IEEE RTS system, and a large system with 805 thermal units are analyzed. The results show that the proposed optimization method can greatly reduce the optimization time while retaining a high precision required by engineering calculation.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Group Search Optimization of District Cooling System Considering both Economic and Efficiency Aspects
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: District cooling system has gain more and more attention in the past decade since its high efficiency of energy generation. This paper proposes a district cooling system with a large ice tank as low-cost energy storage, which can significantly save operating cost of the whole system. With the ice tank, cooling load at the peak time can be transferred to the trough periods, which helps reduce power supply pressure of power grid in summer, so as to enhance the stability of the power system. Furthermore, multi-objective optimization method is used to deal with the high-loss problem of this cooling system. A new operation scheme is designed considering both energy efficiency and operation cost. The scheme provides adjustable running points for system operator to choose according to management requirements. Compared with single object optimization, the new operation modes can reduce system loss in different degree while keeping a relatively low operation cost.

articleTitle: Calculation of Power Development Scale Based on Carbon Peak Constraint and Renewable Energy Consumption Weight Constraint
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The energy structure of Jiangxi Province is dominated by coal and lacks resources such as oil and natural gas. Therefore, under the dual-carbon goal, Jiangxi Province urgently needs to complete the energy transition. Based on the analysis of Jiangxi's resource endowment, this paper proposes a model for calculating the scale of power development under the constraint of carbon peaking and the weight of renewable energy consumption. First, analyze the current status and trends of coal power and renewable energy power development in Jiangxi Province. Then it analyzes the level of electricity coal consumption under the constraint of carbon emissions, and calculates the installed scale of coal power, and under the constraint of the weight of renewable energy consumption, the installed scale of renewable energy is estimated. Finally, the installed capacity of coal power and renewable energy in Jiangxi during the “14th Five-Year Plan” period is predicted.

articleTitle: A Frequency Control Technology Based on Improved Virtual Synchronous Generator
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the operation of microgrid, the ability of the traditional inverter control method to maintain frequency stability is limited, especially for the islanding microgrid which lacks the support of the main grid. An improved frequency control method based on the virtual synchronous generator (VSG) is proposed in this paper. Then, the control method is applied to the electric vehicles (EVs) connected to the microgrid to participate in the frequency regulation of the microgrid Firstly, the virtual governor is improved according to robust model prediction control (RMPC) technology to realize automatic generation control. Finally, the effectiveness of the improved control scheme based on virtual synchronous generator is verified through simulation.

articleTitle: Resonance Stability Analysis Based on Impedance Network for Large-Scale Wind Power Bases Considering Frequency Coupling Characteristic
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing penetration rate of renewable energy in the power system, the unstable issues due to the resonance may emerge. The s-domain nodal admittance matrix method is an effective method to analyze the resonance stability of system. While the latest research of impedance modeling shows that there exists frequency coupling characteristic in renewable power generation systems, for which the method should be further investigated to take the frequency coupling into consideration. In this paper, the s-domain nodal admittance matrix method is introduced briefly. The impedance network based on the multi-in multi-out (MIMO) impedance model considering frequency coupling is established. And then the s-domain nodal admittance matrix considering frequency coupling is derived in detail. Taking the 10-node system with 4 wind farms as an example, this paper compares the analytical results using the s-domain nodal admittance matrix method with and without considering frequency coupling characteristic, and proves the necessity to add frequency coupling into the s-domain nodal admittance matrix in the stability analysis. And by calculating the participation factor matrix, the effectiveness of s-domain nodal admittance matrix method with considering frequency coupling is verified in the simulation.

articleTitle: Emergency Control Strategy of Gas-electric Coupling System Based on Dynamic Valve Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, with the wide use of gas-fired generation units, the natural gas system and the power system have been closely coupled. More and more studies pay attention to the security of the integrated electricity and gas system (IEGS). In the existing emergency control of IEGS, there is a problem of insufficient accuracy in the modeling of components, which may affect the solution of early warning signals and the formulation of scheduling scheme. The purpose of this paper is to construct the gas pressure regulating valve model considering the refined dynamic process, and reformulate the emergency control strategy of IEGS.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Internet of Things System Based on Customer Electricity Behavior Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the future environment of ubiquitous electric Internet of Things, smart home system will further utilize the Internet of Things to endow common household electrical equipment with good perception, decision-making and adaptability. In order to improve their intelligent degree, through real-time access to household load information to make a reasonable power consumption strategy in time, to minimize energy waste and reduce the cost of electricity for users. The authors propose a design scheme of Internet of Things platform based on the analysis of customers' electricity consumption behavior. Firstly, the authors studied the power consumption habits of different customers, then Logistic regression and probability density mathematical models for different customers have been established. A small volume of 86 boxes of sensors were designed, and the gateway of multi-protocol access for edge computing was added to complete the design of energy analysis platform. This scheme could solve the inconvenience caused by the large size of traditional sensors and the inaccuracy of traditional energy saving calculation. Because of the single communication protocol, the gateway can not be fully connected to electrical equipment, and other problems have been solved. The experiment of practical office buildings show that the proposed system is reliable and feasible, and has certain application and reference value in the field of intelligent buildings.

articleTitle: Identification of the Transmission Sections for Power System based on the Breaking Power Flow and Cut Set Filtering
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power system transmission sections are important objects for operators to monitor the power system at a lower dimension, which are of great significance in the power system security and stability analysis. In this paper, a transmission sections identification method based on breaking power flow is proposed, in which the initial sections are continuously aggregated into high-order sections through the calculation of breaking power flow, followed by cut set filtering, and then the high-order sections are further filtered according to other conditions to obtain the final transmission section set. The IEEE 39-bus system and a real-world regional system in China validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Optimal Configuration of Sectional Switches in Distribution Networks consider Reliability and Economy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the medium voltage distribution network, optimal sectional switch placement can significantly reduce investment costs and improve power supply reliability. In this paper, the optimal configuration technology of sectional switch is proposed by using minimizing power outage losses as the objective function considering the operation reliability and economy of the distribution network. Firstly, the correlation between topology and sectional switches is analyzed, and establish a topology optimization analysis model is proposed by using a fault incidence matrix. Then, the average power outage duration and power outage loss cost of the upstream, midstream, and downstream networks of the switch are analyzed by using a topology optimization analysis model, and a comprehensive iterative solution strategy considering reliability and economy is proposed. Finally, an iterative solution method for sectional switch configurations based on binary particle swarm optimization is assumed. Simulation examples verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Fault Ride-Through Method of Paralleled Synchronous and Virtual Synchronous Generators in Islanded Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of distributed power generation technologies, parallel operations of virtual synchronous generators (VSGs) and synchronous generators (SGs) become increasingly common in a microgrid. Due to the low overcurrent capacity of VSGs, fault ride-through (FRT) is necessary for microgrids, which makes the transient stability of SG-VSG-based microgrids be different from the traditional power system. In this paper, a new abnormal overcurrent phenomenon caused by FRT is discovered in SG-VSG-based islanded microgrids. Then, characteristics of the output current of the VSG which uses different parameters are compared and analyzed. Furthermore, an optimized FRT method is proposed, which suppresses the abnormal overcurrent. Finally, a simulation is performed to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method on the PSCAD/EMTDC.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Reconfiguration Method Considering Random Access of Electric Vehicles in Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to enhance the computing power of current reconfiguration algorithm, a new intelligent method of distribution network reconfiguration is proposed under the support of distribution network cloud computing platform. Firstly, the distribution network cloud computing architecture is designed; According to the operation characteristics of electric vehicles, the objective function and constraints of the reconfiguration problem are defined; Then a multi-stage reconfiguration algorithm based on greedy algorithm is proposed to realize the optimal reconfiguration analysis of complex network. At the end of the paper, a simulation example based on the improved IEEE 33 bus model shows that the proposed method has excellent calculation ability, and the operation cost of the reconstructed complex distribution network is reduced by 18.17%.

articleTitle: Stochastic Optimal Dispatch of Virtual Power Plants Considering Cyber Coupling
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As an aggregation entity, virtual power plants (VPP) have been an effective way of improving the flexibility of the power system. However, VPP is not limited to the specific location of distributed resources, so its operation cannot be separated from the support of information technology. To explore the effects of relationship between the physical network and the information network on the dispatch of VPP, constraints of physical nodes and information nodes are included in the proposed dispatch model. Additionally, the uncertainty of renewable energy output fluctuation are considered, which is modelled by scenario-based stochastic method. Numerical results carried on the modified IEEE-13 test feeder demonstrate the performance of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Virtual Inertia Control Strategy on Voltage Regulation of DC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the high proportion of power electronic devices, DC microgrid has small inertia. The DC voltage is sensitive to sudden load changes, new energy output fluctuations, and system failures. The virtual synchronous generator (VSG) control enables the inverter to operate synchronously in the AC system, which increases the inertia of the system and improves the frequency stability of the AC system. In order to make better use of the potential inertia of the DC microgrid, we analogy the relationship between AC and DC system variables and propose a DC microgrid voltage regulation strategy based on adaptive virtual inertia (AVI). The DC microgrid provides flexible dynamic inertia support to reduce DC voltage fluctuations. Finally, a six-terminal DC microgrid simulation model was established in MATLAB/Simulink to verify the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Power Oscillation Characteristics of Large Power Systems under Random Disturbances
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The vigorous development of clean energy and the large-scale connection of new types of loads to the grid have greatly increased the random factor of the grid, which is the main factor that has caused forced oscillation in recent years. The general forced oscillation theory explains that random disturbance can induce power oscillation by covering the frequency of the natural oscillation mode of the system. This paper compares narrowly-defined forced oscillations and general forced oscillations through simulation analysis in both time and frequency domain, and disassembles the oscillation components to obtain some general forced oscillation characteristics.

articleTitle: An Economic Optimization Method of Energy Storage Based on Source-Storage Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to enhance the coordination ability between energy storage and conventional thermal unit, and improve the consumption rate of new energy, an economic optimization method of energy storage system based on source-storage collaboration is proposed in this paper. According to the principle of source-storage cooperative control, the economic control optimization model of source-storage cooperative system is established. The minimum peak regulating cost of conventional thermal unit, the maximal peak regulating benefit of energy storage and the highest incremental absorption of new energy are regard as the objective functions. Combined with immune algorithm, the multi-attribute decision method is introduced into the solution of optimal model. This method is validated by a regional power system in North China.

articleTitle: Overvoltage Analysis Of AC/DC System Utilizing Two-Time-Scale Separation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As of 2021, more than 20 HVDC ties are deployed in the Chinese power system, transmitting a large trunk of electric power over distance. When an AC large disturbance occurs, a DC blocking is likely to occur. Due to the time it takes to disconnect reactive power compensators connected to the blocked HVDC, the surplus reactive power will lead to a transient overvoltage on the rectifier bus, threatening the safe operation of the AC/DC system. An equivalent sending-end multi-convertor model is constructed to reveal the transient overvoltage mechanism caused by adjacent DC blocking. Then the two-time-scale characteristics of AC/DC system are explored to decompose the complex system into simple fast and slow subsystems with the help of singular perturbation. On this basis, the three stages of HVDC overvoltage evolution are discussed, and the main reason for the dynamic voltage rising after a short time is verified to be affected by the synchronous generators. The inhibition effect of time constant of generators for overvoltage is analyzed.

articleTitle: Requirement of Generalized Modeling Technology and Parameter Identification for Wind Turbines
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: There are more than 80 megawatt-scale wind turbine manufacturers in China, and the current technical level of some manufacturers cannot provide accurate mathematical models of wind turbines, and there is no guidance for unified modeling methods in China. The International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC) has basically clarified the classification of various wind turbines, and has determined the four types of wind turbines that are currently mainstream in the market. In the current market in China, most of the III-type and IV -type turbines with variable speed and constant frequency solutions. Therefore, establishing a generalized wind power model and its parameter library, and then determining the actual parameters of each different turbines through parameter identification technology will be the main research and development direction of subsequent wind power modeling. It is an important scientific and technical basis for wind power simulation research and verification analysis capabilities which is necessary for forming a standardized and reliable system safety and stability analysis and evaluation system after large-scale wind power is connected to the power grid. It is the main research direction in the future to carry out generalized modeling research for the mainstream wind turbines in the market, so that the wind turbine / wind farm model can be standardized and generalized and can be applied to different simulation tools and different unit models.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Charging Scheduling Model for Electric Vehicles Considering Urgent Demand Under Different Charging Modes
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This study proposes a multi-objective electric vehicle (EV) charging scheduling model aiming at minimizing both the peak-valley load difference of power grid and the total charging costs of EV users. Two scenarios with different charging power and tariff schemes are investigated for EVs with urgent and unurgent charging demands. A case study is carried out with 100, 200, 300 and 500 EVs under home and public charging mode to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed model. In terms of peak-valley load difference and total charging costs, the proposed method can achieve a greater reduction rate in home charging mode than in public charging mode, except when the scale of EV is 100. Difference of coordinated charging method and uncoordinated charging method in total charging costs appears to be much lower than it in peak-valley load difference. The proposed multi-objective charging scheduling model can benefit both power grid and EV users, since it can not only reduce the impact of EVs on the stable and safe operation of power grid but also reduce the charging costs of EV users.

articleTitle: Influence of Different Factors on Fault Current Under DC Side Fault of Photo voltaic Grid Connected System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Modular multilevel converter (MMC) has many advantages, such as low loss, flexible control and so on, which has been widely used in photovoltaic grid connected system. However, the photovoltaic output has some instability, and the damping of the flexible DC system is also low, which puts forward a severe test for the stable operation of the power grid. Firstly, this paper describes the basic structure of the photovoltaic system connected by MMC. Secondly, the photovoltaic grid connected system model based on PSCAD illustrates the fault current characteristics under DC side fault, and simulates and analyzes the influence of different factors in the system on the fault current.

articleTitle: Intelligent Optimization of Reactive Voltage for Power Grid With New Energy Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy revolution is the guideline for the construction of modern intelligent power systems. All types of increasing new energy, as well as the requirement of fast demand responses will bring frequent and sizable voltage fluctuations. But existing voltage optimization method lacks accurate grid model and real-time computing capability, and can only make decisions offline. In response to the above problems, this paper proposes an intelligent optimization method for reactive voltage control based on deep reinforcement learning by transforming the voltage optimization problem of the power system into a Markov decision process. The optimization goal is to minimize the voltage deviation of each node, the system network loss, and maximize the reactive power reserve of each equipment. During offline learning, the agent continuously interacts with the power system environment built by the simulation platform to complete the network training. This method for voltage regulation of discrete reactive power compensation devices based on the Deep Q Network (DQN) algorithm does not rely on predictive data, and can achieve online optimization, effectively solving the multi-objective complex combination optimization of discrete reactive power compensation devices problems, improving the ability of the grid to respond to disturbances by massively connected new energy. Finally, through the IEEE test, in the case of new energy, load fluctuations and N-1 fault, voltage of each node, network loss and the reactive reserve of each device can be controlled rapidly, which verifies the validity of the above algorithm.

articleTitle: Insulation Breakdown Failure Analysis of a 500kV Power Transformer in Lightning Impulse Test
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: By applying artificial simulated lightning wave to transformer winding terminals, lightning impulse test could investigate impact strength of transformer main insulation and series insulation. We studied an insulation breakdown failure case of a 500kV transformer during its lighting impulse test in factory and analyzed main factors of the insulation breakdown failure. Insulator quality and insulation design related to the flawed components were discussed. This paper could provide some guidance in regarding to improving supply quality of transformer components and avoiding similar insulation weakness.

articleTitle: Experimental Verification of Energy Conversion Efficiency of Doubly Fed Wind Turbine
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As a large inertia rotating mechanism, large-scale wind turbine, converts wind energy into electric energy. It is difficult to characterize the operating conditions in factory test. In order to accurately grasp the energy conversion capacity of large horizontal axis doubly fed wind turbine, mechanical loss and electrical loss in the drive-train of doubly fed wind turbine have been analyzed. The energy conversion capacity of wind turbine is obtained by type test, and the characteristics of energy conversion efficiency of doubly fed wind turbine are proved. In the constant speed range near the cut in wind speed, the energy conversion efficiency of the doubly fed wind turbine increases significantly from 50% to 80% with the increase of power. After entering the maximum power point tracking range, the energy conversion efficiency slows down with the increase of power, and the efficiency can reach 92%∼93% at half rated power. After entering the rated speed range of the generator, the overall efficiency is asymptotically and stably maintained at more than 93%, and the overall efficiency can reach about 93.4% at rated power. This study has mastered the characteristics of segmented efficiency in the operation range of doubly fed wind turbine, and will carry out targeted customization and test verification research on energy efficiency improvement strategy in each operating range.

articleTitle: Research on Voltage Stability of HVDC Receiving-end System Based on Power Limit Trajectory
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The typical receiving-end systems in China are continuously connected with HVDC transmission lines, which changes the traditional grid form and makes the voltage stability problem prominent. How to understand the relation among voltage stability, power grid strength and equipment control is the key to grasp the mechanism of voltage stability and improve the control to avoid the systems entering into static voltage instability and transient voltage instability. In this paper, the relation among the transmitted active power, the voltage at the equipment infeed point and the current of AC system is studied, the relation among the voltage stability and the power grid strength and the control logic of the equipment is explained. Then, the influence rules of line reactance and equipment reactive power on the power limit trajectory (PLT) is studied. In the end, based on the power limit trajectory determined by line reactance, the simulation results of PSCAD/EMTDC showed that the improved DC control method can improve the voltage stability, and the theory in this paper has a certain practical guiding significance.

articleTitle: Fault Ride-through Control Strategy for Multi-terminal Flexible DC Integration of Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Utilizing voltage source converter-based high voltage direct current transmission is the future trend for large-scale long-distance wind farm integration. With the continuous operation of related projects, The fault ride-through problem of VSC-MTDC systems with wind farms has become an important issue that cannot be ignored. Aiming at the AC fault characteristics of the system, a software and hardware coordination AC fault ride-through control strategy is proposed. Given its DC fault characteristics, an enhanced adaptive droop control strategy is designed, and the DC fault ride-through capability of the system is improved by installing auxiliary circuits at the DC outlet of the converter station.

articleTitle: Research on Detection Method of High-Impedance Grounding Fault for The Grounding Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the distribution power grid with neutral point grounded through low-resistance, the zero-sequence relay of the grounding transformer can act on any grounding fault in the grid, which is the backup protection for all the feeders on the same bus, and as a result, when the zero-sequence relay of the grounding transformer acts, the circuit breaker of the bus bar should be tripped, which may increase the risk of power loss of the whole bus bar. In the fact, if a grounding fault occurs only at the grounding transformer, only the circuit breaker of the grounding transformer itself is necessary to be tripped. In this paper, a detection method for the in-area grounding fault of the grounding transformer based on zero-sequence power is proposed, which can distinguish in-area grounding faults from the out-area ones of the grounding transformer. With the relay based on the method, only the breaker of the grounding transformer itself will be tripped when an in-area grounding fault occurs, and the operation mode of the distribution power grid can be switched manually after the fault isolation, to avoid the tripping of the whole bus bar. In this way, the risk of power loss of the whole bus bar can be reduced, and the reliability of power supply can be increased.

Author Keywords: The Low Resistance Grounded Power Grid

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Performance of Energy Storage System Participating in Grid Frequency Regulation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy storage system participating in frequency regulation has become an important way for power grid to absorb the frequency fluctuation caused by renewable energy connection. At the present stage, the allocation mechanism of China's frequency regulation(FR) auxiliary service market is not perfect, and there is no fair market mechanism for energy storage to the FR of power grid. In this paper, an evaluation of energy storage system efficiency based on TOPSIS method is proposed, which comprehensively considers the cost, performance and economy of energy storage in the process of frequency modulation, so as to reasonably allocate energy storage in the auxiliary service market. The operating results show that the lithium battery has the best performance in daily disturbances, and the compressed air energy storage's performance is the best under shock load disturbance.

articleTitle: Energy Consumption Forecast of Building Models in College Town——A Case study in China
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Building load forecasting in college towns is the basis of comprehensive energy planning in college towns, lending support to decision-makers in the design and selection of energy forms, energy conversion, transmission and distribution systems, and energy infrastructure. Urban buildings are composed of buildings of different types and functions. The load of the college building group can be regarded as the sum of the load of the single building. The distribution of the college town is various in different college towns, and different building layouts have different degrees of influence on the load and energy consumption of the college town. Using the building simulation method of spatial reconstruction, the college town area is dismantled into several typical buildings, which can better predict the load of the entire college town

articleTitle: Research on the Road Map of Fujian Province's Carbon Peak
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To jointly cope with the challenges brought by global climate change, the 2015 Paris Agreement proposed that by the end of this century, the global average temperature should be controlled within 2 °C from the pre-industrial level. Carbon peak is a phased goal for countries to deal with climate change, which means that carbon dioxide emissions will no longer increase and gradually decrease after reaching the peak. Fujian Province, as the first national ecological civilization experimental zone, has outstanding advantages and challenges for achieving the carbon peak goal. This paper first analyzes the advantages and challenges of promoting carbon peak in Fujian Province. Then the development trend of carbon peak in Fujian Province is predicted. Finally, opinions and suggestions are put forward from the four aspects of energy, industry, technology and policy.

articleTitle: Distributed Demand Response of the Integrated Energy System in an Industrial Park
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Integrated demand response (IDR) is typically implemented by centralized dispatching, which is insufficient in protecting users' information privacy and control autonomy. This paper proposes a distributed IDR method for industrial parks. Firstly, a distributed framework of interaction among industrial users, park energy management system and superior power grid is designed. Then, referring to the existing electricity market mechanism, an IDR market mechanism within the park is proposed. On this basis, the user's energy utilization optimizing model and the distributed IDR model are established, and the distributed model is proved to be convergent. The simulation result shows that the proposed IDR mechanism can reduce the response cost of users and the whole park.

articleTitle: Time-Frequency Memory Recurrent Neural Networks Empowered Incipient Fault Detection in Power Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The incipient fault detection of power distribution system is essential to improving the reliability of the power grid. The incipient fault has the characteristics of low occurrence rate, instantaneous and self-clearing, and fewer samples can be collected in practical applications. This type of fault need to be detected in time, otherwise it may cause permanent fault of power equipments. This paper combines wavelet transform with long short-term memory (LSTM) unit, and proposes a novel neural network basic cell, time-frequency memory (TFM), that can perform adaptive time-frequency analysis on time series sampled voltage and current data, to realize intelligent detection of incipient faults. Based on a public dataset the TFM based recurrent neural networks (RNN) achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance.

articleTitle: Application of Volume Detection Based on Machine Vision in Coal and Gangue Separation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve the separation rate of coal and gangue, aiming at sorting of large-size coal and gangue based on density characteristics, a coal and gangue separation system based on machine vision was designed, and a side height calibrated shape from shading algorithm was proposed for volume detection. The density is calculated by measuring and analysing mass and volume detection in this system. The gray level information and side height of the ore contour obtained by two Angle cameras were used to detect the volume. Firstly, the depth information is calculated from the image gray level by using the linear shape from shading algorithm. Secondly, the side height is obtained from the image contour. Then, the depth information is corrected by combining the side height to get the height. The results show that the height correction shape from shading algorithm can effectively extract the three-dimensional information of ore and reduce the error of volume detection. The volume change rate under different light intensities is verified that the proposed algorithm can reduce the interference of light intensity on volume detection and enhance robustness, which provides an important basis for subsequent separation based on density.

articleTitle: Planning of Integrated Community Energy System Considering Uncertain Carbon Trading Price Based on Information Gap Decision Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Considering the low-carbon construction of integrated community energy system (ICES), this paper proposes a planning method for ICES considering the carbon trading price uncertainty. The information gap decision theory (IGDT) is used to deal with the uncertainty of carbon trading price, and an IGDT-based planning model of ICES is established. By minimizing the total cost associated with carbon trading cost, the optimal capacity allocation is obtained. Then avoidance coefficient is introduced to depict the range of acceptable maximum carbon trading price fluctuation of ICES. Numerical results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Correlation Analysis of Wind and Photovoltaic Power Based on Bayesian Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to Spatio-temporal complementarity in the wind and photovoltaic (P.V) energies, which makes a difference in the correlation between the power of wind and P.V. Hence it is important to optimize the capacity proportion of wind and P.V power to maximize the complementary characteristics of Wind-PV power generation capacity. Therefore, an optimum capacity allocation method is proposed which founded upon the correlation analysis of Wind-PV power output. A mathematical model for correlation analysis of M-Copula function has been established in this paper, by using the expectation-maximization(E.M.) method combined with Bayesian linear regression teach, analyzes the actual speed and P.V power data of Guyuan in previous years. Furthermore, the Kendal rank correlation coefficient is selected to calculate the correlation of Wind-PV power output quantitatively, and then the optimum capacity allocation scheme is explored.

articleTitle: High-performance Full Electromagnetic Transient Simulation System of Fujian Power Grid and its Application
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a high-performance full electromagnetic transient simulation system of Fujian power grid. The system is developed based on the General Transient Simulator (GTS), which is a self-developed electromagnetic transient simulation tool. The key technologies of the simulation system, such as the high-performance automatic parallel computing technology and the large time step electromagnetic transient simulation technology, are introduced. The full electromagnetic transient simulation of the AC power system above 10kV in Fujian power grid based on the dispatching control cloud platform is realized. Study cases are carried out and the validity and accuracy of the simulation are verified by comparing the actual fault recording data and simulation waveforms.

articleTitle: Research On Medium And Long Term Unit Commitment Of Wind Power Consumption Considering Carbon Reduction
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In response to global climate change, carbon reduction is becoming increasingly important for the development of integrated energy system. Under such background, this paper proposes a medium and long-term unit commitment model considering carbon trading mechanism, carbon capture, and power to gas. Combined with various constraints of power generations including thermal power, gas turbine and hydropower, this model takes the minimum overall cost as its optimization objective. Finally, three scenarios are established to compare the overall cost, carbon trading cost and carbon emissions. The results show that the proposed method can achieve wind power full consumption and carbon reduction in medium and long term, coordinating economy and environmental protection at the same time.

articleTitle: Energy Efficiency Evaluation of Photovoltaic Power Generation System Based on Analytic Hierarchy Process and Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low utilization efficiency of photovoltaic power generation system, high construction cost of photovoltaic power station and defects of power station operation and maintenance technology, an energy efficiency evaluation method of photovoltaic power generation system based on analytic hierarchy process and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation is proposed. Firstly, this method analyzes the energy efficiency influencing factors of photovoltaic power generation system, and establishes the energy efficiency evaluation index system of photovoltaic power generation system, which includes three categories and 11 items, including static index, dynamic index and loss index. Secondly, analytic hierarchy process is used to determine the weight of each energy efficiency evaluation index, and the membership degree of each index is calculated by the classification standard. Finally, the energy efficiency evaluation results of photovoltaic power generation system are obtained through fuzzy evaluation calculation, and the evaluation level is determined. A distributed photovoltaic power station in northwest China is selected as an example to verify the effectiveness of the method. The results show that the method can objectively reflect the actual characteristics of photovoltaic power generation system, which is in line with the energy efficiency level of actual photovoltaic power generation system, and can provide some reference experience for energy efficiency evaluation of similar photovoltaic power generation system.

articleTitle: Robust Optimization of Reactive Power for Voltage of Power Grids With a High Proportion of Distributed New Energy Access
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Distributed power generation has been widely used in power system in recent years. Under the influence of wind speed and light intensity, the output of distributed power source is random. In this paper, robust optimization of reactive power for voltage of power grids with a high proportion of distributed new energy access is studied. Firstly, the reactive power optimization model for voltage of power grid with distributed new energy is established, and the power flow balance equation is linearized. The random fluctuation of actual wind speed adds uncertain parameters to the reactive power optimization model. In this paper, based on the robust peer model of linear programming and the box set of uncertainties, the robust optimization model of reactive power for voltage of power grids with distributed new energy with the elimination of uncertain parameters is obtained. The simulation results show that the proposed model can maintain the reliability and robustness of reactive power for voltage of power grids with distributed new energy with uncertain parameter fluctuations.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-peak MPPT of Photovoltaic Array Based on Quantum Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Photovoltaic arrays exhibit multi-peak characteristics due to uneven illumination under actual working conditions. Traditional MPPT tracking algorithms cannot achieve global optimization and cannot accurately track the maximum power point. Genetic algorithm can effectively solve the multi-peak optimization problem, but the general genetic algorithm will have premature problems in the tracking process, so a quantum genetic algorithm is proposed to solve such problems. In the photovoltaic cell topology model, a simplified dual-diode model is used to replace the single-diode model, and modeling and simulation are performed under Matlab/Simulink. Experimental simulation results show that the algorithm has a more efficient global optimal search capability and high control accuracy, which proves the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: A Power Grid Planning Method Considering Dynamic Limit of Renewable Energy Security Constraints
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper puts forward a dynamic reduction method of renewable energy based on N-1 safety standard of power system, which is suitable for high-voltage distribution network and can reduce the abandoned amount of renewable energy to an ideal level. On the basis of AC sensitivity coefficient, the optimization method of distribution factor suitable for single line or multi-line disconnection is proposed. Finally, taking an actual high-voltage distribution network in Germany as an example, the simulation results show that the proposed method can effectively limit the line load, and can greatly reduce the line load with less RES reduction.

articleTitle: High Frequency Oscillation Analysis of Flexible DC Transmission System Based on Modular Multilevel Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: High Voltage Direct Current Transmission based on modular multilevel converter (MMC-HVDC) may have a wide frequency range of oscillation risks. In order to reproduce the high frequency oscillation of the MMC-HVDC system and analyze its oscillation characteristics, a Four-machine Two-area MMC-HVDC system with wind turbine was built based on MATLAB/Simulink, realized the power transmission between the two areas through MMC-HVDC system. The influence of the outer loop controller, inner loop controller parameters and delay link time constant changes on the characteristics of high frequency oscillations of the MMC-HVDC transmission system of the modular multilevel converter is studied on the built system. The results show that the outer loop controller parameters has little effect on the high frequency oscillation, while the current inner loop controller parameters can significantly affect the high frequency oscillation of the MMC-HVDC system. The delay link also has a significant impact on the high frequency oscillation of the system, and the risk of high frequency oscillation of the system increases with the increase of the long link delay parameter.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Fault Location Method Based on Graph Theory and Deep Learning under Charging Load Access
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the traditional method is difficult to satisfy the fault location of distribution network with charging load, a distribution network fault location method based on graph theory and deep learning under charging load access is proposed. Firstly, the graph theory is introduced to decompose the distribution network topology into several Y-shaped tree structures, and the distribution network topology model is constructed; Then, the fault current characteristics of distribution network during electric vehicle reverse discharge are analyzed. The mapping relationship between response data and fault location is mined by using generalized network learning (GDL), and the fault feature training model is constructed; Finally, graph theory and GDL is used for fine fault location. The experimental results show that the proposed method for short circuit fault are 98.09% and 0.019 km respectively. This method can effectively improve the positioning accuracy, accurately determine the fault section, and has strong fault tolerance.

articleTitle: Research On Sliding Mode Control Method Of Nonlinear DC Micro-Grid Active Power Filter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A large number of nonlinear components lead to ripples in the DC micro grid. Therefore, sliding mode control, which is more suitable for nonlinear systems, is applied to active filters to improve the power quality of the micro grid. The traditional sliding mode control has some problems such as chattering and slow convergence, that a DC active power filter (DC-APF) ripple suppression method based on double power fixed-time sliding mode control is proposed. The integral sliding mode surface is designed to avoid the shortcomings of the normal sliding mode surface that the initial state cannot be guaranteed to be on the sliding mode surface, and to enhance the robust performance; the introduction of the double-power reaching law enables the system to reach a fixed time convergence without considering the initial state.
