Then, double power fixed-time sliding mode control and PI control are applied to DC-APF respectively, and the comparative simulation is carried out to verify that the proposed control method has faster convergence speed, effectively reduces system chattering, and can effectively suppress the system ripple.

Author Keywords: double power fixed-time sliding mode control

articleTitle: Near-Zero Carbon Coordinated Control Of Renewable Energy Considering Environmental Costs
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The uncertainty of renewable energy such as wind and PV power will affect the safe operation of the power grid. Optimal dispatch of the wind-PV-hydro-storage system can solve this problem. To achieve the goal of “near-zero carbon emission”, this paper proposes a coordinated control strategy for wind-PV-hydro-storage system considering environmental costs. This paper takes the minimum sum of power generation cost, environment cost, penalty cost as the objective function, constructs a coordinated control model of multiple renewable energy, which is a mixed-integer linear programming(MILP) model. Through simulation, this paper analyzes the optimal dispatch economics of wind-PV-hydro-storage system in four energy storage scenarios, the four energy storage scenarios are non-energy storage system, only pumped storage system, only energy storage battery system, and combined pumped storage and energy storage battery system. The simulation results prove that the combined pumped storage and energy storage battery system can achieve better environmental benefits and achieve zero-carbon emission. In addition, this paper analyzed the optimal dispatch economics of small hydropower in three water scenarios, the three water scenarios are high, normal, and low water period.

articleTitle: Optimal Planning Method for Regenerative Electric Heating System Considering the Supply Capability of Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: An optimal planning method for regenerative electric heating considering the supply capability of the distribution network is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the model of a regenerative electric heating system with a heat pump and a hot water storage tank is established, followed by the calculation method of the supply capability of the distribution network. Then, a double-level optimal planning model of regenerative electric heating is constructed. The first level takes the annual total cost as the goal and the second level is to minimize the annual operation and maintenance cost. Finally, a typical integrated energy systems is used as a test system to illustrate the planning method. The case results show that the proposed method can effectively reduce the peak-valley load difference based on the heat storage capacity of regenerative electric heating.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of DFIG Grid-connected Based on Variable Gain Inertia Control
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The shortcomings of the additional virtual inertia control strategy of doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) in terms of frequency stability and instantaneous power angle stability are addressed. Firstly, the electromagnetic power expressions are derived using the voltage and magnetic chain equations of DFIG, and the equivalent power angle of DFIG is derived based on the concept of synchronous generator power angle, and the relationship between the frequency regulation capability of DFIG and the stability of equivalent power angle is analyzed. Secondly, given that the DFIG contains different degrees of inertial support capability at different wind speeds, an inertial control strategy with variable loop gain is proposed: the control loop gain is dynamically changed according to the DFIG rotor speed, so that the DFIG operating in the high wind speed range can provide greater inertial support. Finally, based on the simulation software RSCAD of real-time digital simulation system, a single infinity simulation system of DFIG is established, and the simulation results verify the effectiveness of the control strategy.

articleTitle: Fault Location Algorithm for Multi-Terminal Transmission Lines of Distribution System Based on Loop-Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The safe and stable operation of power system is highly affected by transmission line fault. With the rapid development and application of multi-terminal transmission lines in distribution network, the researches on fault location methods of multi-terminal transmission lines are attracting more and more attention. However, the fault location algorithms for multi-terminal transmission lines is complicated and time-consuming. To improve the effectiveness and accuracy of fault location, a novel fault location algorithm for multi-terminal transmission lines in the distribution network is proposed in this paper. First, the directed graphs of distribution system with multi-terminal transmission lines are constructed and the nodes are classified as T-type and non-T-type nodes. Then the system is divided into multiple regions by each T-type node and the voltages of T-type node in different regions have been calculated by the loop-voltage equation to identify the fault region. Finally, non-fault regions have been merged to establish a new distribution system until both the fault branch and distance are determined. A practical distribution system has been established on the CloudPSS platform to test the method, and test results verify the practicality and accuracy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Integrating Peer-to-Peer Energy Trading of Microgrids into Deregulated Electricity Market by Cascaded Model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Peer-to-peer (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$P$</tex> 2 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$P$</tex>) energy trading of microgrids is considered as a promising solution in reducing the carbon emission of renewable-embedded energy systems. This paper proposes a novel energy market framework for enabling the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$P$</tex> 2 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$P$</tex> local transactions under the deregulated market environment. The proposed market model is aimed to provide a practical mechanism design to incentivize optimal <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$P$</tex> 2 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$P$</tex> energy trading in the existing electricity market. A cascaded model predictive control (MPC) problem formulation is devised for both the day-ahead market and adjustment markets. Finally, numerical results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework in integrating microgrid <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$P$</tex> 2 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$P$</tex> trading into the electricity market.

articleTitle: Application of Adjacency Matrix in Probabilistic Energy Flow Calculation Method considering Coupling Failure
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A regional integrated system (RIES) can realize multi-energy complementarity due to the involvement of multiple energy systems connected by coupling links. However, it also means the contingency in one system may affect others through cross-system failures, which brings a great challenge to evaluate the consequence of the system. In this regard, coupling failure (CF) is proposed to describe the interaction in RIES. The adjacency matrix can be an effective tool to identify different types of CF and the effected location. A Monte Carlo based probabilistic energy flow calculation method considering accidents is then proposed. To testify the proposed method, a regional integrated energy system (RIES) with 101 nodes is adopted for calculation, and two operating cases are set and compared. The results show the effectiveness of the proposed method, which can benefit operators to maintain the safety of the RIES.

articleTitle: Defending 5G IoT Terminals in Electrical Power Communication and Information System Against Cyber Threats
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: It could be foreseen that next generation of digital revolution will endow new generation of power system with unprecedent observability and controllability. However, the emerging cybersecurity risks remain a major concern when applying the Fifth Generation(SG) mobile communication technology to power grid operations. This paper discussed the potential applications of 5G technologies in new generation power systems and the security challenges in these technologies. Moreover, the initial countermeasures are provided.

articleTitle: Parameter Optimization Strategy of Energy Storage-Based Virtual Synchronous Generator Considering Inertial and Damping Coordination
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to deal with the problem of insufficient inertia of renewable energy, the virtual synchronous generator (VSG) technology has been continuously developed. Although VSG provides inertia support for the system, the mismatch of inertia and damping parameters of VSG will also cause power oscillation and reduce angular stability of the system. Aiming at this, the influence mechanism of the inertia and damping parameters of the VSG on system stability is explained, and a parameter optimization strategy for VSG is proposed in this paper. Firstly, an objective function optimization model considering the inertia response and small signal stability of the system is established. The maximum value of the sum of the damping ratio of each oscillation mode and the minimum value of the system frequency deviation are selected as the objective function, and the stable interval of each control parameter is used as the constraint condition. Secondly, the non-dominated sorting genetic algorithms with elitist strategy (NSGA-II) is perform to solve the optimization problem. Finally, the 4-machine 2-area system integrated with 2 VSGs is used as the test system. The simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of proposed parameter optimization strategy.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Park-Level Integrated Energy System Considering the Cost of Carbon Emissions
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the context of the “carbon peaking and carbon neutrality”, it has become a major trend to build an integrated energy system (IES) that takes into account the cost of carbon emissions. The paper introduces the power to gas (P2G) devices, the combined cold, heat and power units (CCHP), the gas boilers (GB) and electric chillers (EC) to form an IES to establish a low carbon integrated energy coupling station that is universally applicable to the park. The cost of installation, operation, energy purchase and end-of-year residual value of the system is taken as the economic cost of the system, and the conversion of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions into economic benefits is included in the objective function. It also constrains the load demand situation, the cooperation of each unit in the park and the equipment output. Photovoltaic power (PV) stations are brought in to provide energy for the park and work with the grid's time-of-use tariff. Finally, different scenarios are set up to verify the effectiveness of the scheme, using a planned energy coupling station along the eastern part of China as an example.

articleTitle: A Substation-based Tri-level Model for Hardening Resource Allocation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposed a defender-attacker-defender (DAD) model for allocating the optimal hardening resource on substations. In contrast to the classical DAD model which focus on line hardening strategies, the proposed model considers the malfunction or false-action of control and communication devices installed in substation. The contingencies start from substations, and then leads to the transmission lines outages, which is rather different from the lines are on outage by natural disaster or regular component failures. The simulations conducted on the IEEE 24-bus system and the IEEE 118-bus system validate the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Key Influence Factor Analysis Related to the Transient Process of Grid-Connected VSC System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid growth of power-electronic interfaced generators, the stability characteristic during the large disturbance transient process of the power system has changed obviously. The traditional large disturbance transient stability analysis and evaluation index of the grid-connected synchronous machine system have revealed inadaptability under the new scenery, and the critical influence factors related to stability are not explicit. In this regard, an eight-order grid-connected VSC system model, including phase locked loop (PLL), outer loop, inner loop, and line dynamics, is first established. In what follows, the critical influence factors related to the large disturbance stability of grid-connected VSC systems are summarized. Finally, based on the electromagnetic transient PSCAD/EMTDC simulation, the influence of key factors on the stability of grid-connected VSC system is analyzed, and the loss of synchronism (LOS) of the system is revealed. The related work in this paper can provide a reference for cognition and analysis of LOS characteristics and dynamic behavior of the system.

articleTitle: Short-Term Thermal Load Probabilistic Forecasting Considering Electrical-Thermal Coupling Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the improvement of the consumption potential of new energy assisted by thermal system, the coupling and tightness of power and heat supply are continuously strengthened. Higher requirements are put forward for probability prediction of thermal load. In the existing research, point prediction models are usually established according to the relevant characteristics of thermal system, which is difficult to reflect the influence of the uncertainty of thermal load and the electrical-thermal coupling characteristics on the thermal load prediction result. In view of this, a probabilistic forecasting method of short-term thermal load considering electrical-thermal coupling characteristics is proposed. Firstly, the collected data is preprocessed, and the timescale is matched. Secondly, Pearson coefficient is used to analyze the electrical-thermal coupling characteristics, and the feature set considering electrical-thermal coupling is constructed. Finally, Gaussian process regression is used to establish a probabilistic forecasting model of short-term thermal load.

Author Keywords: probabilistic forecasting of short-term thermal load

articleTitle: An Autoencoder-OFDM Power Line Carrier Communication System Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The energy problem is one of the focuses of contemporary attention. As an energy-saving technology, power line carrier communication technology has been applied in many fields. However, there is some unpredictable noise or interference sources and serious multipath fading in the power line channel. Traditional QAM-ODFM technology usually solves this problem through channel estimation. In this paper, deep learning network is creatively applied to OFDM framework, and a power line carrier communication technology based on autoencoder is proposed. This new technique modulates the subcarriers specifically for different subchannels and optimizes the communication parameters from a global point of view. Itnot only reduce the impact of channel noise and interference on communication efficiency, but also greatly save communication resources and reduce power consumption.

articleTitle: Step Size Adjustment Method of Digital-Analog Hybrid Simulation for Complex Active Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Digital-analog hybrid simulation of distribution network with high-density distributed power generation is an important technical means to evaluate the ability of distribution network to accept distributed power. Aiming at the problem of adjusting the simulation step size in the digital-analog hybrid simulation of active distribution network, this paper proposes a comprehensive optimization target design method for the simulation step size of the active distribution network, and designs a simulation based on the adaptive impedance matching current-type damping impedance interface model The self-adaptive mechanism of step size, and verified by calculation examples, shows the effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed simulation step size adjustment method.

articleTitle: Multi-Terminal DC Line Fault Recovery With Fault Self-Clearing and Analysis of Converter Station Online Exit Strategy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, UHV, large-capacity, multi-terminal and flexible DC transmission technologies have developed rapidly. As a UHV hybrid three-terminal DC project that has been put into operation, the stable operation and fault ride-through capability of the Kunliulong (Kunbei-Liuzhou-Longmen) DC project has received more and more attention. Starting from the structure of the three-terminal DC system, this paper analyzes the self-clearing process of the system fault after the line fails, and then analyzes the three-terminal DC line fault recovery and the logic of the on-line withdrawal from the station. Finally, a three-segment DC model was built to simulate the process of system failure recovery and online withdrawal from the line after different types of faults occurred on the line.

articleTitle: Research on Economy of Electrochemical Energy Storage System under Peak-Valley Price Difference and Whole Value Mode
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Electrochemical energy storage system, as an important technology and basic facility for supporting the new power system, is of great significance to promote green transformation of energy, deal with extreme events, ensure energy security, facilitate high-quality development, and achieve carbon-peak and carbon-neutralization goals. China has successively released a series of policies to promote the development of energy storage, and economy is a key factor determining the development of energy storage. In this paper, the cost per kilowatt hour of the electricity of energy storage batteries is analyzed, and an analysis model of economy of energy storage projects is established under peak-valley price difference and whole value mode, so as to determine the criticality of energy storage economy.

articleTitle: A Joint Strategy of Air-Conditioning and Electrolytic Aluminum Participating in Primary Frequency Modulation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the proportion of new energy sources gradually increases, the frequency fluctuation of the system becomes stronger. The power system encounters greater challenges to the frequency stability. The frequency modulation capability of the power generation side gradually cannot meet the require. The demand response resources on the load side are rich and diverse, and have great frequency modulation capabilities. The paper first proposes an air-conditioning cluster aggregation model based on the air-conditioning equivalent thermal parameter model, and analyzes its frequency modulation characteristics. Then, the paper analyzes the equivalent circuit of typical industrial load, electrolytic aluminum, and proposes its frequency modulation characteristics. Finally, a joint strategy of air-conditioning load based on temperature sorting is proposed within the air-conditioning cluster. A joint strategy participating in grid primary frequency regulation is proposed between air-conditioning cluster and electrolytic aluminum. The simulations prove the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: An Optimal Method of Regional Integrated Energy System Based on Two-stage Robust Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to study the contradiction between the anti-interference ability of regional integrated energy system (RIES) and the optimization results, establishing an optimization model of RIES incorporating two-stage robust means. Firstly, the energy conversion model of related components in RIES is established. Then, the maximum penalty cost of abandoned wind is used as the penalty term, and the two-stage robust optimization objective function of RIES is established. Finally, the problem is decomposed into the main problem and subproblem, which can be settled by column-and-constraint generation (C&CG) algorithm. Simulation results show that robust optimization can improve the system's ability to resist uncertainty, but the optimization results will become worse. In the actual scheduling process, trade-offs need to be made according to the requirements.

articleTitle: A Novel Mobility Management Scheme for UAV Inspection in 5G-empowered Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The support and empowerment of 5G wireless communication network is required in smart grid. As one of the application scenarios of 5G-empowered smart grid, Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) inspection requires high transmission rate, low latency and high reliability. These requirements and dexterous mobility of UAV bring challenges to the mobility management of the wireless communication network. In this paper, a novel mobility management scheme is proposed, which is called uplink-based pre-handover scheme. As parts of the scheme, a pre-handover decision algorithm is proposed and a pre-handover signaling procedure is designed. As shown in simulation results, the handover failure of proposed scheme is 38% lower than that of traditional scheme.

articleTitle: Short-term Load Forecasting Method Based on Artificial Intelligence Highway Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Comprehensively considering power load and real-time weather influence factors, this paper proposes a short-term load forecasting method based on artificial intelligence highway neural network (HNN). Firstly, through the Pearson correlation analysis, the weather influencing factors that affect the most can be obtained, which are considered as part of the input variable of the model. Then, the principle component analysis (PCA) method is used to reduce the dimension of the daily feature matrix. And the matrix is used as the input of K-means clustering to divide the operating days into three categories. Next and most importantly, the HNN models corresponding to each type of operating days are established separately. Finally, through comprehensive case studies, it is proved that the HNN load forecasting model proposed in this paper can achieve better forecasting results than support vector machine (SVM), long short-term memory (LSTM) and non-clustering HNN method.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Construction and Application of Intelligent Distribution Transformer Terminal in Hubei Province
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For a long time, China's low-voltage distribution network lacks effective operation monitoring means, high failure rate, difficult fault finding, inaccurate low-voltage topology and phase relationship, low-voltage measurement data is not fully utilized, data value is not fully reflected and other outstanding problems. The emergence of intelligent distribution transformer terminal can effectively solve the above problems. In this paper, the construction mode of station area intelligent distribution transformer terminal in Hubei Province is described, and the functional configuration of station area integration terminal, low-voltage line, low-voltage branch line, user meter box and smart meter is analyzed. The main functions of station area integration terminal are explained, including the interaction with concentrator, operation monitoring, topology identification, fault diagnosis, power quality monitoring and governance, etc. It also puts forward the problems that should be paid attention to in the process of the construction of the station area integration terminal. Finally, it briefly introduces the application effect of the station area integration terminal in Hubei Province, which lays the foundation for the next large-scale construction of the station area integration terminal.

articleTitle: Access Point And Capacity Optimization Planning Method Of Virtual Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous increase of peak to valley difference, the power supply pressure of substation during peak load increases. Virtual power plants can participate in power grid peak shaving by aggregating adjustable resources to alleviate the power supply pressure of substations during peak hours. Thus, the expansion and transformation time can be delayed and the power grid investment can be saved. When building a virtual power plant, the geographical location of resources should be considered. Based on this, this paper proposes a virtual power plant's access point and capacity optimization planning method, and analyzes the impact of the virtual power plant's different construction scales on its planning. The case study shows that by optimizing the planning of the access point and capacity of the virtual power plant, the capacity-load ratio of the substation can be improved, and its expansion and transformation time can be delayed.

articleTitle: Research on Energy Management Strategy of Hybrid Energy Storage System for Electric Ship
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: During the voyage of electric ships, the propulsion motor frequently stops and restarts, and causes high current discharge of the battery, thus affecting its cycle life and ship range. Focusing on this problem, the hybrid energy storage method of super capacitor and lithium iron phosphate battery is adopted, and the energy management of the hybrid energy storage system is carried out by model predictive control. Firstly, the mathematical model of lithium-ion battery and supercapacitor is established, and the capacity configuration of the hybrid energy storage system is estimated according to the ship sailing demand; Based on the demand power of typical working conditions of ship sailing, the online optimization of system power allocation is carried out by combining with the framework of model predictive control algorithm. The simulation model of the hybrid energy storage system of the ship is built in MATLAB/Simulink using the energetic macroscopic representation. The simulation results show that the energy management strategy based on model predictive control is effective in suppressing the effects of current fluctuations and high current discharge on the cycle life of Li-ion power batteries.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Planning of Thermal-Electric Coupling Micro-Energy System to Promote the Consumption of Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the current integrated energy background, the development of thermal-electric coupling micro-energy system has become an effective solution to promote the consumption of renewable energy and sta bilize the fluctuation of renewable energy. Therefore, we propose a multi-objective planning method for thermal-electric coupling micro-energy system. First, on the basis of an analysis of the interaction characteristics of “source-grid-load” and its effect on the absorption of renewable energy in thermal-electric coupling environment, the equipment of thermal-electric coupling micro energy system is modeled. Then the multi-objective planning model of thermal-electric coupling micro-energy system is constructed with the aim of minimizing investment operation cost and system peak-valley fluctuation respectively, and then the multi-objective problem is solved by the combination of NSGA-II and TOPSIS. Finally, the simulation based on actual data verifies the rationality and feasibility of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: A Design of Additional Damping Control for Power System with High Proportion Hydropower Units Based on H-infinity Robust Control Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the situation the asynchronous interconnection between the system with high proportion of hydropower units and the main grid, the mechanism of ultra-low frequency oscill ation is analyzed. The design of additional damping controller f or ultra-low frequency oscillation is transformed to solving the mixed sensitivity problem of H-infinity robust control theory. T ime domain simulation results show that the additional dampin g controller can effectively suppress the ultra-low frequency os cillation in a wide range of operating conditions.

articleTitle: A Peer-To-Peer Energy Sharing Framework for Prosumers Considering Network Constraints and Social Preferences
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the introduction and development of cyber-physical-social system (CPSS), social information has been considered and incorporated into the cyber-physical system. In this paper, a two-stage P2P energy sharing framework for prosumers with the considerations of network constraints and bilateral social preferences is proposed. In the first stage, DistFlow model is adopted to formulate the power flow model of the distribution network, and the power loss of the energy transaction is also considered. Furthermore, the second stage is to solve the effective matching problems between buyers and sellers with different preferences. Bilateral physical-social unite preference model of prosumers is proposed to capture the energy transaction preferences. Finally, the simulation results verify the performances of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: State of Charge Balancing Control for Battery System Based on the Reconfigurable Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The state of charge (SOC) balancing techniques are required in the battery management system (BMS) to solve the inconsistency of battery modules capacity. This paper proposes a SOC equilibrium control strategy based on the reconfigurable converter. Firstly, the reconfigurable converter that can be reconfigured to four different operating modes is established. Secondly, an improved balancing control strategy is conceived to allow energy transfer between battery modules. The proposed scheme improves the SOC balancing speed through the bidirectional equilibrium of the battery charge and discharge process.
